papers.title: RxnCLF: Contrastive Transformation-Aware Reaction Foundation Model for Improved Reactivity Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Reaction yield prediction remains challenging because labeled data are scarce and reaction space is both combinatorially large and sparsely populated, limiting the generalization of existing reaction representations. String-, fingerprint-, and graph-based reaction encodings only partially capture chemical transformations, making accurate prediction difficult for reactions with complex substrates. We propose reaction contrastive learning foundation (RxnCLF), a self-supervised contrastive framework for reaction representation learning. RxnCLF is built on a condensed reaction graph (CRG) that unifies reactant and product information into a single graph, enabling the model to learn explicit and enriched transformation structure rather than disconnected graphs. Pretrained on 1.7 million Pistachio reactions, RxnCLF learns a compact and continuous latent space that captures both reaction-center features and broader side chain contexts, making it transformation-aware and chemically interpretable. Fine-tuned on multiple yield prediction benchmarks, including Buchwald-Hartwig, Pd-catalyzed BH coupling, and proprietary HTE C-N coupling and amide formation datasets, RxnCLF consistently outperforms graph and sequence-based baselines, improving R2 and achieving the best performance overall. Our results highlight the promise of CRG-based RxnCLF as a scalable reaction foundation model, with the potential to generalize across broader reaction spaces and support diverse downstream reaction informatics tasks, including regioselectivity prediction, enantioselectivity prediction, and reaction condition optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RxnCLF,一个基于自监督对比学习 (contrastive learning) 的反应表示学习基础模型。模型构建在冷凝反应图 (CRG) 上,将反应物和产物统一为单个图,以显式学习反应中心与侧链上下文。该模型在 170 万条 Pistachio 反应上预训练,并在多个产率预测基准上微调,优于图和序列基线。
Motivation: 反应产率预测因标注数据稀缺、反应空间庞大且稀疏而困难,现有的字符串、指纹和图反应编码只能部分捕获化学转化,对复杂底物反应预测不准。
Method: 提出 RxnCLF,一种自监督对比学习框架,基于冷凝反应图 (CRG) 统一反应物与产物信息为单一图,预训练后学习紧凑连续的潜在空间,同时捕捉反应中心特征和侧链上下文。
Result: 在 Buchwald-Hartwig、Pd 催化 BH 偶联以及专有 HTE C-N 偶联和酰胺形成数据集上,微调后的 RxnCLF 一致优于图和序列基线,提升 R2 并取得最佳整体性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调 CRG 基础的 RxnCLF 作为可扩展反应基础模型具有前景,并可能推广到更广泛的反应空间,支持区域选择性预测、对映选择性预测和反应条件优化等下游任务。

papers.title: MASS: Multiplayer World Models with Authoritative Shared State
papers.abstract_en: Current video world models struggle in multiplayer environments because they entangle world state with view-dependent visual latents, leading to redundant compute, view inconsistencies, and poor scalability. We propose MAS (Multiplayer world models with Authoritative Shared State) to resolve this limitation. Inspired by multiplayer game architectures, MAS disentangles world dynamics and view rendering. A learned Logic Engine advances a global, authoritative typed state from joint actions without any hand-written transition function, acting as the sole recurrent memory and synchronization reference. From this shared state, a learned Rendering Engine generates independent and consistent views for any requested camera on demand. This explicit disentangling allows MAS to achieve superior state accuracy and lower cross-view inconsistency compared to state-of-the-art multi-view baselines on a matched multiplayer Snake benchmark. It advances predicted worlds with 1,024 concurrent players for 10,000 recurrent steps. Our results show that explicit, authoritative state modeling provides a practical foundation for scalable and consistent multi-agent world simulation.
papers.summary_zh:

Conclusion: 摘要强调显式、权威的状态建模为可扩展且一致的多智能体世界模拟提供了实用基础，但未讨论其他任务或局限性。

papers.title: MetaboLLM: a metabolomics-specialized large language model for biochemical knowledge integration and predictive metabolite graph construction
papers.abstract_en: Metabolomics knowledge is distributed across heterogeneous resources and remains difficult to translate into predictive representations. We developed MetaboLLM, a metabolomics-specialized large language model adapted through continual pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and structured retrieval, together with MetaboLLM-GIN, which converts generated biochemical descriptions into metabolite graphs for patient-level prediction using a graph isomorphism network. Across four backbone families, MetaboLLM outperformed corresponding base and medically adapted models on metabolomics knowledge, relational, and description tasks, and transferred to an external public benchmark. MetaboLLM-GIN achieved the highest AUC for stress hyperglycemia prediction after coronary artery bypass grafting (0.8616) and postmenopausal hormone-regimen classification (0.8123), outperforming conventional models, alternative graph constructions, and graphs generated from unadapted or non-retrieval LLM configurations. Model interpretation further produced biologically meaningful findings in both applications. These results show that domain-specialized language models can organize heterogeneous biochemical knowledge into predictive and interpretable metabolite graph representations.
papers.comment: 60 pages, 3 figures, 16 tables; includes Supplementary Information
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MetaboLLM，一个通过持续预训练、监督微调和结构化检索适配的代谢组学专用大语言模型，并配套 MetaboLLM-GIN 将生成的生化描述转换为代谢物图，用于患者层面预测。在四种骨干模型上，MetaboLLM 在代谢组学知识、关系和描述任务上优于对应的基础模型和医学适配模型，并迁移到外部公开基准。MetaboLLM-GIN 在冠状动脉旁路移植术后应激性高血糖预测和绝经后激素方案分类上取得最高 AUC。
Motivation: 代谢组学知识分布在异构资源中，难以转化为可用于预测的表示，现有通用或仅医学适配的语言模型不足以完成生化知识的整合与下游预测。
Method: 作者提出 MetaboLLM，采用持续预训练、监督微调与结构化检索相结合的方式适配代谢组学领域；同时提出 MetaboLLM-GIN，利用图同构网络 (graph isomorphism network) 将语言模型生成的生化描述转换为代谢物图，用于患者层面预测。
Result: 在四种骨干模型上，MetaboLLM 在代谢组学知识、关系和描述任务上均优于对应基础模型和医学适配模型，并迁移至外部公共基准；MetaboLLM-GIN 在冠状动脉旁路移植术后应激性高血糖预测取得最高 AUC 0.8616，在绝经后激素方案分类取得最高 AUC 0.8123，超过常规模型、替代图构建方式以及未适配或非检索 LLM 配置生成的图。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，领域专用的语言模型可以将异构生化知识组织为具有预测性和可解释性的代谢物图表示，并在解释分析中发现生物学上有意义的发现。

papers.title: Toward Deployable Bangla Sign Language Recognition with Expert-Validated Data and a Lightweight Attention-Based Model
papers.abstract_en: Deaf and hard-of-hearing people in Bangladesh communicate mainly through Bangla Sign Language (BdSL). Automatic BdSL recognition on personal devices could widen access to education and services. Existing systems use controlled-setting datasets without expert verification and heavyweight pretrained backbones unsuited to on-device use. We introduce RSBdSL38, 10,874 expert-validated images spanning all 38 BdSL hand signs, representing the 51 letters of the Bangla alphabet, recorded from real signers at three special-needs schools across Bangladesh. We propose a lightweight attention based convolutional network of 298,470 parameters, built from grouped bottleneck residual blocks, channel and spatial attention, a multi-scale depthwise hand-feature block, dual pooling, and Swish activations. Trained from scratch, it attains 96.37% accuracy (95.72% +- 0.54% over five seeds), within 1.08 percentage points of the best of nine ImageNet-pretrained efficient architectures under an identical protocol, using 8.5 to 68x fewer parameters and 1.3 to 21.7x fewer MACs. Retrained, it reaches 92.95 to 98.33% on six public BdSL benchmarks, 97.04% on a merged corpus, and 76.25% zero-shot on BdSL-38. Removing any architectural stage costs 7.61 to 89.30 points, against at most 3.17 for the training recipe. Grad-CAM with deletion-insertion and weight-randomization checks confirms that predictions follow the signing hand. A signer-independent split holding out 6 of 36 signers yields 85.18%. Quantized to 0.48 MB, it runs at 3.98 ms per image within a 15.5 MB footprint on a commodity smartphone. Together, RSBdSL38 and our from-scratch model turn benchmark accuracy into deployable accessibility at a fraction of pretrained-backbone cost; dataset, code, and models are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RSBdSL38 数据集与一个轻量注意力卷积网络，用于孟加拉手语 (BdSL) 识别。该网络仅含 298,470 参数，从零训练在 38 类手语上达 96.37% 准确率，并在保持接近预训练模型精度的同时大幅降低计算量；量化到 0.48 MB 后可在普通智能手机上以 3.98 ms/图像运行。数据集、代码与模型均已发布。
Motivation: 现有 BdSL 识别系统依赖无专家验证的受控数据集，并使用厚重的预训练骨干网络，难以在个人设备上部署。作者希望提供经过专家验证的真实场景数据与适合端侧推理的轻量模型，以扩大聋人与听障人士获得教育和服务的机会。
Method: 构建 RSBdSL38 数据集，包含来自孟加拉三所特教学校真实手语者的 10,874 张专家验证图像，覆盖代表 51 个孟加拉字母的 38 种手语符号。提出由分组瓶颈残差块、通道与空间注意力、多尺度深度可分离手部特征块、双池化和 Swish 激活组成的轻量注意力卷积网络，并采用从零训练而非预训练主干。
Result: 从零训练达到 96.37% 准确率（五种子均值 95.72%±0.54%），与九种 ImageNet 预训练高效架构中最佳者仅差 1.08 个百分点，参数少 8.5–68 倍、MACs 少 1.3–21.7 倍；在六个公开 BdSL 基准上为 92.95–98.33%，合并语料上 97.04%，BdSL-38 零样本 76.25%；剔除任一架构阶段损失 7.61–89.30 点，而训练方案改动至多损失 3.17 点；留出 6/36 位手语者的划分得到 85.18%，量化后 0.48 MB、15.5 MB 手机端 footprint 下每图像 3.98 ms。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RSBdSL38 与从零训练的轻量模型把基准精度转化为可部署的可访问性，且成本远低于预训练骨干。Grad-CAM 结合删除-插入与权重随机化检查表明预测确实跟随手部区域；摘要强调该工作服务于孟加拉手语识别这一具体部署场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Minimax Optimal Early-Stopped Gradient Descent for Gaussian Mixture Classification
papers.abstract_en: In overparameterised classification, training data can be linearly separable even when the underlying distribution is not. In this setting, gradient descent (GD) on the logistic loss diverges in norm while converging in direction to a max-margin interpolating classifier, whose implicit bias can be statistically suboptimal. In this work, we show that early stopping can overcome this suboptimality: in a Gaussian mixture model with label-flipping noise, GD stopped at an appropriate oracle time achieves minimax-optimal excess zero-one risk for covariance spectra with fast and continuous decay, including polynomial and exponential spectral decays. Our analysis combines a sharp upper bound for the early-stopped iterate with a matching statistical lower bound over arbitrary classifiers, yielding optimal rates that are validated by experiments. A central technical contribution is a new calibration result that converts excess logistic risk into excess zero-one risk; it handles the model misspecification induced by the label-flipping noise, and removes the square-root rate in standard bounds. We also establish a lower bound for linear interpolators, showing that interpolation can require exponentially more samples than early stopping to achieve the same excess risk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究过参数化分类中早停梯度下降（early-stopped GD）的统计最优性。在高斯混合模型（Gaussian mixture model）与标签翻转噪声下，作者证明在合适的oracle停止时间提前停止GD，对快连续衰减的协方差谱（包括多项式和指数衰减）能够达到极小极大最优（minimax-optimal）的超额0-1风险。核心理论贡献是一个新的校准结果，将超额logistic风险转化为超额0-1风险，并去掉标准界中的平方根率。
Motivation: 在过参数化分类中，训练数据即使在底层分布不可分时也可能线性可分，此时logistic损失上的GD范数发散但方向收敛到最大间隔插值分类器，而该插值器的隐式偏差在统计上是次优的，可能导致更高风险。
Method: 作者对早停迭代给出一个紧的上界，并匹配一个覆盖任意分类器的统计下界，从而刻画最优停止时间。技术核心是一个新的校准（calibration）结果，用于处理标签翻转噪声导致的模型误设定（model misspecification），将超额logistic风险转换为超额0-1风险。
Result: 在具有快速连续衰减协方差谱（多项式与指数衰减）的高斯混合模型下，合适oracle时间停止的GD达到极小极大最优的超额0-1风险；实验验证了理论速率。此外，作者对线性插值器建立下界，表明要达到同样的超额风险，插值可能需要比早停指数级更多的样本。
Conclusion: 早停可以克服最大间隔插值分类器在统计上的次优性，并且新的校准结果移除了标准风险转换中的平方根率。本文的分析限于高斯混合模型与标签翻转噪声设置，适用协方差谱为快速连续衰减的情形。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Six-Dimensional Taxonomy of Post-Training Adaptation Techniques with Applications in AI Governance
papers.abstract_en: Post-training adaptation has become central to modern machine learning practice and includes techniques such as retraining, fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, alignment, retrieval augmentation, model editing, unlearning, calibration, and Multimodal Instruction Tuning. However, the literature remains fragmented across technique families, model classes, and deployment contexts, making it difficult to compare methods or describe how a trained model has been modified. This survey synthesizes the post-training adaptation literature and introduces a six-dimensional taxonomy organized by mechanism, goal, data requirement, persistence, structural scope, and model type. The taxonomy distinguishes commonly conflated terms such as fine-tuning, retrieval augmentation, and prompting, and shows how adaptation strategies evolve from traditional machine learning through deep learning, foundation models, large language models, and multimodal large language models. It also maps relationships among techniques, including inheritance, supersession, hybridization, and layered deployment stacks. The resulting vocabulary can support technical documentation, model-change tracking, and governance analysis. The survey concludes by identifying open challenges in evaluation, reproducibility, persistent inference-time adaptation, unlearning, multimodal adaptation, and governance-aware post-training workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于机器学习后训练适应（post-training adaptation）技术的综述，提出一个六维分类体系，涵盖机制、目标、数据需求、持久性、结构范围和模型类型。综述梳理了从重训练、微调、参数高效适应、对齐、检索增强、模型编辑、去学习到校准及多模态指令微调等技术的演化，并区分了微调、检索增强和提示词等常被混用的概念。文章还讨论了技术间的继承、替代、混合与分层部署关系，最后指出评估、可复现性、推理时持续适应、去学习、多模态适应等开放挑战。
Motivation: 后训练适应文献分散在不同技术族、模型类别和部署场景中，导致方法难以比较，也难以描述已训练模型被如何修改。
Method: 通过综述现有文献，提出按机制、目标、数据需求、持久性、结构范围、模型类型六个维度组织的分类体系，并建立技术间的关系映射。
Result: 该分类体系能够区分微调、检索增强、提示词等概念，展示从传统机器学习到大语言模型及多模态大语言模型的适应策略演化。
Conclusion: 文章提供了一套可用于技术文档、模型变更追踪与治理分析的词汇，并指出后训练适应领域在评估、可复现性、持续推理时适应、去学习、多模态适应及治理对齐流程方面的开放挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DASH: Divergence-Adaptive Supervision Horizons for On-Policy Self-Distillation of Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models using automatically verifiable outcome signals, but these signals are typically sparse and at the sequence-level. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) mitigates this sparsity by querying a privileged teacher at student-visited prefixes and providing dense token-level distributional supervision. Although this dense supervision alleviates signal sparsity, we find that standard OPSD still underexploits the temporal structure of the rollout. It assigns every local divergence the same coefficient, regardless of its position or the divergence sequence in which it occurs. In on-policy autoregressive generation, the same divergence magnitude can follow different discrepancy histories, reflecting different evolutions of the mismatch between the teacher and student. Since the local scalar alone cannot distinguish these temporal contexts, standard OPSD cannot adapt its token-level weights to the realized discrepancy sequence. To address this limitation, we propose Divergence-Adaptive Supervision Horizons (DASH). DASH maps the gap between each local distillation signal and the sequence-level mean to an adaptive propagation gate and then uses these gates to control backward multi-step aggregation. By doing so, DASH adjusts token-level supervision weights according to how local divergences evolve during generation. Experiments on three mathematical reasoning benchmarks across three model scales show that DASH improves over our matched vanilla OPSD reruns on every benchmark at all three scales. DASH reuses the teacher and student distributions that OPSD already computes, so the gains require no additional teacher or student forward pass. Code: https://github.com/DBtxy/DASH-OPSD
papers.comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Code at https://github.com/DBtxy/DASH-OPSD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对可验证奖励强化学习 (RLVR) 中监督信号稀疏的问题，研究同策略自蒸馏 (OPSD) 的时序结构利用不足。作者提出发散自适应监督视界 (DASH)，将每个局部蒸馏信号与序列级均值的差距映射为自适应传播门，并用这些门控制反向多步聚合，从而根据生成过程中局部发散的历史演化调整 token 级监督权重。在三个数学推理基准和三种模型规模上的实验表明，DASH 在每个基准、每个规模上都超过匹配的 vanilla OPSD 复现，且无需额外的教师或学生前向传播。
Motivation: 标准 OPSD 为所有局部发散分配相同系数，无法区分相同发散幅度背后的不同教师-学生失配演化历史，因此不能利用 rollout 的时间结构来调整 token 级权重。
Method: 提出 DASH (Divergence-Adaptive Supervision Horizons)，把局部蒸馏信号与序列均值之间的差距映射为自适应传播门，再用这些门控制反向多步聚合，使 token 级监督权重随生成过程中局部发散的演化而调整。
Result: 在三个数学推理基准、三种模型规模上，DASH 均优于匹配的 vanilla OPSD 复现；且 DASH 复用 OPSD 已计算的教师与学生分布，不增加额外前向传播。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DASH 通过感知发散历史的自适应监督来改进 OPSD，其增益来源于对既有分布的重用，因此计算开销不增加。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Timestep-Conditioned Transformers for Global Weather Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Existing machine-learning weather forecasting models rely on predetermined and fixed autoregressive timesteps. The choice of model timestep involves a fundamental trade-off: shorter timesteps (e.g. 1 to 6 hours) finely resolve atmospheric dynamics within the diurnal cycle but increase error accumulation for a given forecast horizon, while longer timesteps (e.g. 24 hours) reduce error accumulation but limit the usability of short-range forecasts where sub-daily predictability is high. In this work, we present GEM-3, a probabilistic global weather model that addresses this trade-off through explicit multi-timestep inference. With a single set of trained weights, the model timestep can be configured at inference time to balance predictability and usability across a broad forecast horizon. Additionally, we find that mixed-timestep training consistently improves rollout stability relative to timestep-specialist models. Under the hood, GEM-3 is a lightweight neighborhood-attention transformer with ~134M parameters on an equirectangular grid with a number of architectural advancements beyond its predecessor GEM-2. The result is a practical forecasting system that couples near-SOTA medium-range probabilistic skill, stable extended-range rollouts, efficient training and inference, and decision-relevant diagnostics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GEM-3，一个可配置推理时间步的全球概率天气模型，用一套权重在推理时选择 1-24 小时等时间步以平衡短程可用性与误差累积。模型是约 134M 参数的轻量邻域注意力 transformer，混合时间步训练可提升 rollout 稳定性，据摘要称达到接近 SOTA 的中期概率技能和稳定的扩展范围预报。
Motivation: 现有机器学习天气预报模型使用固定的自回归时间步，面临短时间步误差累积多、长时间步损失子日尺度可预报性的两难，缺乏在单一模型中灵活平衡预测可用性与准确性的方案。
Method: 提出 GEM-3，通过显式多时间步推理在推理时配置模型时间步；采用混合时间步训练来提升 rollout 稳定性，底层为基于等距圆柱网格、约 134M 参数的轻量邻域注意力 transformer，并包含相对前代 GEM-2 的多项架构改进。
Result: 摘要报告 GEM-3 具备接近 SOTA 的中期概率预报技能、稳定的扩展范围 rollout，以及高效训练和推理，可提供与决策相关的诊断信息。
Conclusion: 作者将其定位为实用预报系统，认为多时间步推理和混合时间步训练能够同时兼顾短程可预报性与更长时间尺度的稳定性。
Relevance: 72

papers.title: PRISM: Distribution-Gated Flow Matching for Controllable Unpaired Image Translation
papers.abstract_en: Unpaired image-to-image translation must decide, per image, what to change and what to preserve without paired supervision. Many diffusion-based unpaired translators control preservation through a single global noise or guidance value applied across the image, which cannot separate content to keep from appearance to change. We present PRISM, a GAN-free flow-matching framework that replaces this global control with a learned per-feature gate. The gate's spatial prior is derived from each source feature's standardized distance to the target feature distribution, so features far from the target are freed while target-consistent features are preserved. The same gate controls both the initialization, which mixes the real source latent with a task-matched corruption, and the transport timing during Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) integration. The corruption is matched to the task, content-anchored (AdaIN) for structure-preserving translation and partially anchored for structure-changing translation, and the gate can be overridden locally at inference from text or a detector without retraining, preserving important structures of the original image while still generating realistic results. We evaluate PRISM on five natural and biomedical benchmarks (AFHQ cat->dog, CelebA-HQ appearance translation, day->night relighting, virtual staining, and breast frozen->permanent histopathology). Among the evaluated methods under a shared same-split protocol, PRISM attains the best Inception FID and KID on four benchmarks and a competitive result on the fifth, and on histopathology yields the nuclei-count ratio closest to the ideal, supporting a favorable balance between target realism and structural preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRISM 是一个无 GAN 的流匹配 (flow-matching) 框架，用于无配对图像到图像翻译，用学习到的逐特征门控 (per-feature gate) 替代以往扩散/流模型中单一的全局噪声或引导值控制。门控的空间先验来自每个源特征到目标特征分布的标准化距离，距离远的特征被释放、与目标一致的特征被保留；同一门控同时控制初始化中真实源潜变量与任务匹配腐败 (corruption) 的混合，以及 ODE 积分过程中的传输时机。评估覆盖 AFHQ cat->dog、CelebA-HQ 外观翻译、day->night 重打光、虚拟染色和乳腺癌 frozen->permanent 组织病理五个基准，在共享同分裂协议下取得四个基准的最佳 Inception FID 和 KID。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的無配对翻译常通过作用于整张图像的单一全局噪声或引导值来控制保留程度，无法在空间上区分哪些内容需要保持、哪些外观需要改变；PRISM 针对这一粒度不足的问题提出可学习的逐特征门控。
Method: PRISM 为每个源特征计算其到目标特征分布的标准化距离，据此构建门控的空间先验，使偏离目标分布的特征被释放而目标一致的特征被保留。该门控同时控制初始化阶段真实源潜变量与任务匹配腐败的混合比例，以及 ODE 传输的时序；腐败类型按任务匹配，结构保持型翻译使用内容锚定的 AdaIN，结构改变型翻译使用部分锚定。门控在推理时可由文本或检测器局部覆盖而无需重训练。
Result: 在共享 same-split 协议的五个自然图像与生物医学基准上，PRISM 在四个基准达到最佳 Inception FID 和 KID，在第五个基准上取得有竞争力的结果；在组织病理任务上，其细胞核计数比率最接近理想值，说明其在目标真实感与结构保持之间取得了有利平衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PRISM 通过逐特征门控实现了可控制的無配对图像翻译，在不重训练的情况下支持局部门控覆盖，从而在生成逼真结果的同时保留原图重要结构；其在结构保持与目标真实感之间的平衡由门控和任务匹配腐败共同决定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Depth-Guided Video Object Counting in Crowded Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Our primary objective is to advance video object counting in crowded scenes, aiming to robustly count all instances of a target category based on given text or visual prompts. Existing methods rely on RGB information, limiting their discriminative ability in crowded and occluded conditions. To address this, we propose a Depth-Guided Detector (DG-Det) along with a general post-processing pipeline. By integrating depth cues with multi-scale RGB-D cross-attention and explicit occlusion prediction, our method enhances spatial understanding and achieves robust detection in crowded and occluded scenes. Furthermore, we introduce a unified de-duplication framework to eliminate cross-frame redundant counting. To facilitate future research, we also release a new RGB-D Video Object Counting dataset featuring depth information and multiple object categories persequence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves a 62.01\% reduction in MAE compared to existing baselines, and also produces consistent improvements in RMSE. We provide the source code at https://github.com/streamer-AP/DG-Net and the dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/aerospace123/RGBD-VideoCount.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对拥挤场景下的视频目标计数问题，提出深度引导检测器 (Depth-Guided Detector, DG-Det) 及通用后处理流程。作者将深度线索与多尺度 RGB-D 交叉注意力、显式遮挡预测结合，以提升拥挤和遮挡条件下的空间理解与检测鲁棒性，并设计统一去重框架消除跨帧重复计数。摘要报告在新释放的 RGB-D 视频计数数据集上相较于既有基线 MAE 降低 62.01%，RMSE 也一致改善。
Motivation: 现有方法仅依赖 RGB 信息，在拥挤和遮挡条件下判别能力受限，难以根据文本或视觉提示稳健地计数目标类别。
Method: 提出 DG-Det，整合深度线索，采用多尺度 RGB-D 交叉注意力 (multi-scale RGB-D cross-attention) 与显式遮挡预测；同时提出通用后处理流水线，包含统一去重框架 (de-duplication framework) 以消除跨帧冗余计数。
Result: 在实验中，该方法相较现有基线将 MAE 降低 62.01%，并在 RMSE 上取得一致改善；作者还贡献了包含深度信息和多目标类别的新 RGB-D 视频计数数据集。
Conclusion: 作者认为引入深度信息能提升拥挤和遮挡场景下视频目标计数的鲁棒性，并公开代码与数据集以促进后续研究；摘要未明确讨论方法局限。

papers.title: EmoWorld: A Decoupled Affective Field for Controllable Emotional Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Emotion shapes how viewers interpret a scene, yet existing video generators entangle global atmosphere, affect-bearing semantic cues, and temporal progression within a single text condition. We present EmoWorld, a framework that decouples these factors within a frozen flow-matching video diffusion transformer (Video DiT). A one-time preparation stage extracts layer-specific affect directions and a reusable cue library from geometry-preserving neutral and emotion-edited panoramas. At inference, Visual Atmosphere Steering (VAS) injects atmosphere directions into hidden states, Semantic Affective Steering (SAS) isolates a separately scalable prompt residual for semantic cues, and Temporal Affective Steering (TAS) interpolates endpoint residual fields across denoising and video time. On Wan2.2, VAS improves target-emotion alignment by 19% while reducing a temporal-fluctuation proxy by 48%; SAS improves target-emotion alignment by 37% and increases detected affect-bearing cues by 36%; and TAS improves transition monotonicity by 15% over the strongest baseline. EmoWorld is evaluated across 27 emotion categories in text-to-video and image-to-video settings, demonstrates portability across multiple Video-DiT backbones, and supports camera-conditioned composition without updating generator parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EmoWorld 是一个面向可控情感视频生成的框架，在冻结的 flow-matching 视频扩散 Transformer (Video DiT) 中解耦全局氛围、情感语义线索与时间进程。它通过一次性准备阶段提取层特定情感方向和可复用线索库，并在推理时用 Visual Atmosphere Steering (VAS)、Semantic Affective Steering (SAS) 和 Temporal Affective Steering (TAS) 三种机制分别注入。在 Wan2.2 上，该方法在目标情感对齐、时间稳定性和过渡单调性上均优于基线，且无需更新生成器参数。
Motivation: 现有视频生成器将全局氛围、承载情感语义的线索和时间进程纠缠在单一文本条件中，使得情感表达难以被独立、精细地控制。
Method: 提出三路解耦的情感引导：VAS 将氛围方向注入隐藏状态，SAS 分离出可独立缩放的提示残差用于语义线索，TAS 在去噪步和视频时间上对端点残差场做插值；准备阶段从保持几何关系的 neutral 与情感编辑全景中提取层特定情感方向和线索库。
Result: 在 Wan2.2 上，VAS 将目标情感对齐提升 19% 并将时间波动代理指标降低 48%；SAS 提升目标情感对齐 37% 并增加检测到的情感线索 36%；TAS 相比最强基线将过渡单调性提升 15%。方法在 27 个情感类别、text-to-video 和 image-to-video 设置中评估，并展示了跨 Video-DiT 骨干的可移植性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 EmoWorld 支持无需更新生成器参数的相机条件组合，并能在多种 Video-DiT 骨干间迁移；摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: From Passive Mirrors to Active Agents: Holonic Digital Twins for Physical AI over Networks
papers.abstract_en: Despite advances in artificial intelligence (AI) across multiple sectors, today's AI tools, including deep learning and generative AI, still fail when embedded into physical systems, such as robots and vehicles operating under real-world physical laws. This stems from their inability to maintain reliable world models for long-horizon planning under uncertainty and generalize to unseen scenarios. In this context, wireless networks, through pervasive sensing and communication, can orchestrate physical intelligence. However, current architectures optimize throughput, latency, and reliability and cannot support real-time physical AI coordination, requiring agents to maintain shared spatiotemporal context. To address these challenges, a network of holonic digital twins (HDT-Nets) framework is proposed to deliver real-time physical AI inference through holonic agents that actively reason about their environment rather than passively mirror physical assets. Each HDT is realized as a hierarchical structure spanning the physical agent and network edge, reasoning autonomously at the local level while cooperating with neighboring HDTs to form collectively intelligent units. In HDT-Net, causal Markov blankets spanning sensing, communication, and control determine which agents must coordinate and enable counterfactual reasoning over multi-domain interventions. Active inference within these boundaries unifies perception, action, and learning by minimizing expected free energy while deciding which beliefs to transmit based on their cognitive value to the receiver. Category theory ensures that transmitted beliefs preserve semantic structure across heterogeneous agents with incompatible representations. Finally, integrated information theory quantifies when collective intelligence exceeds independent operation and how network intelligence evolves through coordinated learning and information exchange.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HDT-Nets 框架，用网络化的层级数字孪生 (holonic digital twins) 为物理 AI 提供实时推理与协调。每个 HDT 跨越物理智能体与网络边缘，在局部自主推理并与相邻 HDT 协作；通过因果马尔可夫毯 (causal Markov blankets) 界定感知-通信-控制边界，用主动推理 (active inference) 统一感知、行动与学习，并用范畴论保持异构智能体间语义结构。
Motivation: 现有 AI 工具嵌入物理系统时难以在不确定性下维持可靠世界模型、无法泛化到未见场景；而当前无线网络架构只优化吞吐、时延和可靠性，不能支持物理 AI 所需的共享时空上下文协调。
Method: 提出由网络化 holonic 数字孪生组成的 HDT-Nets 框架；每个 HDT 是覆盖物理智能体到网络边缘的层级结构，局部自主推理并协同形成集体智能单元。框架用因果马尔可夫毯决定哪些智能体需要协调并支持反事实推理，用主动推理的最小化期望自由能统一感知、行动和学习，以认知价值决定传输哪些信念，用范畴论保持跨表示不一致智能体的语义结构，并用整合信息论量化集体智能何时超越独立运作。
Conclusion: 摘要将该框架定位为通过感知、通信与控制的联合设计来编排物理智能的一种网络架构方案，并强调集体智能的涌现与网络智能的演化可以通过整合信息论来度量。

papers.title: TS-RAG: Retrieval Augmented Generation for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: While deep learning models, particularly transformer-based architectures, have shown impressive performance in time series forecasting, the application of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in this domain remains limited. Since RAG has proven effective in enhancing the capabilities of large language models by incorporating relevant external information, retrieving similar time series sequences as references might also improve accuracy in time series forecasting tasks. However, most time series models are constrained by limited training data, smaller parameter scales, and a lack of the extensive generative capabilities found in large language models. Simply concatenating reference sequences into the prompt, as done in language models, may not yield the expected results. To address these challenges, we propose a novel approach, TS-RAG, which leverages RAG to enhance forecasting performance. The framework introduces specially designed reference tokens to effectively fuse information from the input sequence with that from retrieved similar sequences, enabling a more robust capture of complex temporal dynamics. Experimental results demonstrate that TS-RAG achieves consistent state-of-the-art performance across several real-world forecasting benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TS-RAG，将检索增强生成（RAG）引入时间序列预测任务。与语言模型中直接拼接参考序列不同，该框架设计了专门的参考 token（reference tokens），用于融合输入序列与检索到的相似序列的信息，以更稳健地捕捉复杂时间动态。实验表明，TS-RAG 在多个真实世界预测基准上取得一致的当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
Motivation: RAG 在增强大语言模型能力上已被证明有效，但在时间序列预测中应用有限；而时间序列模型普遍训练数据少、参数规模小、缺乏大语言模型式的生成能力，直接把相似序列拼接进输入可能无法达到预期效果。
Method: 提出 TS-RAG 框架，核心是引入专门设计的 reference tokens，将输入序列信息与检索得到的相似时间序列信息进行有效融合，从而增强模型对复杂时间动态的捕捉能力。
Result: 摘要报告 TS-RAG 在多个真实世界时间序列预测基准上一致达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为专门设计的参考 token 融合机制优于简单拼接检索序列，并验证了 RAG 思路在时间序列预测中的有效性；但摘要未涉及降水、临近预报等具体应用场景。

papers.title: Robot Learning from Human Demonstrations: Handwritten Alphabet Trajectories and Human-Likeness Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Learning from demonstration (LfD) provides a developmental framework through which robots can develop motor skills by observing and imitating human dynamics, reducing reliance on explicit programming to teach a skill to a robot. The resulting human-like robot motion is recognised as a key factor in building trust and enabling natural collaboration in human-robot interaction. This paper presents a framework for learning human-like robot motion from demonstration, including data collection, probabilistic trajectory learning, and perceptual user evaluation. A dataset of 3,142 handwriting demonstrations was collected from 22 participants across all 52 Latin alphabet character-case combinations via a touchscreen teleoperation interface, capturing planar position, contact force, and timing. Building on the widely used Gaussian Mixture Model and Gaussian Mixture Regression approach for learning from demonstration, the framework is extended in this work by incorporating force and normalised time dimensions to enable richer representation of human dynamics, and adapting it to handle non-continuous, multi-segment trajectories, enabling generalisation across demonstrations. A user study with 21 participants evaluated the perceived human-likeness of the generated trajectories using a continuous scale anchored between robotic and human-like motion, normalised to 0-100 where 50 represents the neutral midpoint. The generated trajectories achieved an overall human-likeness score of 71.50 (SD=22.56), indicating that the majority of trajectories were perceived as more human-like. Participants identified geometric positioning and trajectory sequence as the most influential perceptual factors, and reported positive attitudes toward human-like robot behaviour. The datasets are released as open-source, providing a reproducible benchmark for developing and evaluating human-like robot motion methods.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个从人类示教中学习类人机器人运动的完整框架，涵盖数据采集、概率轨迹学习与感知评估。作者通过触摸屏遥操作界面从22名参与者处采集了3,142条手写轨迹，覆盖52种拉丁字母大小写组合，并记录平面位置、接触力和时间信息。框架在GMM/GMR基础上引入力与归一化时间维度，并适配非连续多段轨迹；21人用户研究表明生成轨迹的整体类人评分为71.50（SD=22.56），多数轨迹被认为更像人类，且几何定位和轨迹顺序是最具影响力的感知因素。数据集已开源。
Motivation: 从示教学习（LfD）可让机器人通过观察和模仿人类动态来发展运动技能，减少显式编程；而类人机器人运动被视为建立信任和实现自然人机协作的关键。该工作旨在提供一个从数据采集到感知评估的完整框架，并建立可复现的基准。
Method: 通过触摸屏遥操作接口采集人手写轨迹数据，包含位置、接触力和时间；在学习阶段扩展GMM/GMR方法，加入力和归一化时间维度，并改造以处理非连续的多段轨迹；最后用21名参与者的用户研究以机器人到类人的连续量表（归一化为0-100，50为中点）评估轨迹的类人程度。
Result: 生成的轨迹总体类人评分为71.50（SD=22.56），表明大部分轨迹被感知为更接近人类运动。参与者认为几何定位和轨迹顺序是最关键的感知因素，并对类人机器人行为持积极态度。
Conclusion: 该方法结合扩展的概率轨迹学习与感知评估，可生成被多数人视为类人的运动；开源数据集为开发与评估类人机器人运动方法提供了可复现的基准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Muon on the Stiefel Manifold Admits an Exact Closed-Form Update
papers.abstract_en: We study Muon, a recently proposed matrix-aware optimization method, in the context of the Stiefel manifold. This manifold consists of matrices with orthonormal columns and is ubiquitous in machine learning and scientific computing. Existing extensions of Muon to this manifold rely on heuristic, approximate, or iterative updates with varying computational efficiency. We show that the corresponding Stiefel Muon update admits an exact closed-form solution and use this result to develop Skewon, a practical algorithm for orthogonality-constrained optimization with an efficient implementation. We further establish first-order convergence guarantees for Skewon in the smooth non-convex setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Muon 这一矩阵感知优化方法在 Stiefel 流形（由正交列矩阵构成）上的行为，证明对应的 Stiefel Muon 更新存在精确闭式解，并据此提出 Skewon 算法用于正交约束优化。作者还建立了 Skewon 在光滑非凸环境下的一阶收敛保证。
Motivation: 现有 Muon 到 Stiefel 流形的扩展依赖启发式、近似或迭代更新，且计算效率各异，缺乏精确且高效的更新方式。
Method: 推导 Stiefel 流形上 Muon 更新的精确闭式解，基于该结果设计 Skewon 算法及其高效实现，并给出光滑非凸条件下的一阶收敛性分析。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的实验数值；主要结果包括精确闭式更新的存在性、可高效实现的 Skewon 算法，以及一阶收敛保证。

papers.title: Continual Learning in Transition
papers.abstract_en: Classical continual learning (CL) has primarily focused on enabling models to update and retain knowledge through parameter-centric mechanisms, e.g., training strategies, architectural designs, and weight adaptation. However, emerging paradigms are reshaping the scope of CL beyond this traditional model adaptation view. For instance, on-policy learning broadens the space of update mechanisms; test-time training extends CL from the training phase to inference; and external harness components such as memory, skill libraries, and interaction protocols extend the evolutionary boundaries of model capabilities far beyond the static parameter space. Collectively, these developments indicate a transition from parameter-centric learning toward system-level adaptation. To characterize this transition, we examine the evolution of continual learning through three dimensions: When, How, and Where learning occurs. The How dimension encompasses off-policy, on-policy, and beyond-gradient optimization mechanics. The When dimension captures evolution across pre-training, post-training, and inference-time stages. The Where dimension delineates updates occurring within internal parameters versus external structural constraints. Anchored by this tri-axial framework, we systematically survey representative methods, trace the ongoing transition of continual learning, and discuss the key challenges, broader implications, and future directions arising from this paradigm shift.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Survey on continual learning in the LLM and agentic-AI era
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于持续学习（continual learning）在LLM与agentic AI时代发生范式转变的综述。作者提出从When、How、Where三个维度刻画持续学习从参数中心学习（parameter-centric learning）向系统级适应（system-level adaptation）的过渡，并据此系统梳理代表性方法。摘要指出，在线策略学习、测试时训练以及外部组件（如记忆、技能库、交互协议）正在扩展持续学习的边界。
Motivation: 经典持续学习主要聚焦参数中心机制（训练策略、架构设计、权重自适应），但新兴范式正在重塑持续学习的范围，例如将学习从训练阶段扩展到推理阶段，并将能力演化边界延伸到静态参数空间之外。需要一个统一框架来表征这种转变。
Method: 提出三轴分析框架：How维度涵盖off-policy、on-policy与超越梯度的优化机制；When维度涵盖预训练、后训练与推理阶段；Where维度区分参数内部更新与外部结构约束。以此框架组织对代表性方法的系统综述。
Result: 作为综述论文，本文系统梳理了持续学习在该范式转变下的代表性方法，并描绘其演进轨迹；摘要未报告具体实验数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为持续学习正在从参数中心学习走向系统级适应，并基于该范式转变讨论了关键挑战、更广泛影响与未来研究方向。

papers.title: Reversible Unlearnable Examples: Towards the Copyright Protection in Deep Learning Era
papers.abstract_en: Significant advancements in deep learning have been made possible by the utilization of large datasets, underscoring the critical importance of copyright protection. Adding meticulously designed perturbations to examples, making them unlearnable has become a crucial approach for safeguarding data copyright. Existing methods for creating unlearnable examples overlook the risk of data leakage, which can threaten data ownership. Thus, copyright protection in deep learning faces two main threats: illegal model training and malicious data leakage. We investigate that these two threats cannot be solved by straightforwardly combining existing availability attacks and watermarking techniques as their negative interaction effects. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a novel copyright protection mechanism for the aforementioned security concerns. Considering that the prevention of unauthorized model training requires powerful generalizability of unlearnable perturbations, we generate perturbations to induce the model to learn uncorrelated features of input images. It works by minimizing the mutual information of the input and output of the model. On the other hand, to eliminate the side impact of unlearnable perturbations on the watermark extraction, we design a dual extraction strategy by using two distinct watermark extractors. Extensive experiments on the image datasets {ImageNet, CIFAR10, and Pets} show that our proposed method could provide comprehensive copyright protection to images. The code is available at {https://github.com/Yeah21/ReversibleUnlearnableExamples}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向深度学习中图像版权保护的可逆不可学样本（Reversible Unlearnable Examples）机制，同时应对非法模型训练与恶意数据泄露两类威胁。作者指出简单组合现有可用性攻击（availability attacks）与水印技术会产生负面交互效应，因此设计扰动使模型学习与输入无关的特征，并采用双提取器策略消除扰动对水印提取的副作用。在 ImageNet、CIFAR10 和 Pets 上的实验表明该方法能为图像提供全面的版权保护。
Motivation: 现有不可学样本（unlearnable examples）方法忽略了数据泄露风险，而版权保护同时面临非法训练和数据泄露两大威胁；直接组合可用性攻击与水印技术会因负交互效应而失效。
Method: 通过最小化模型输入与输出之间的互信息（mutual information）生成扰动，诱导模型学习输入图像的无关特征，从而阻止未经授权的模型训练；同时设计使用两个不同水印提取器的双提取策略，以消除不可学扰动对水印提取的副作用。
Result: 在 ImageNet、CIFAR10 和 Pets 图像数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法能够提供全面的版权保护。
Conclusion: 作者认为可逆不可学样本可作为深度学习时代图像版权保护的综合机制，但摘要未讨论该方法在不同任务或更大规模数据上的局限。

papers.title: Beyond Marginal Validity: Finite-Sample Guarantees for Localized Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction endows arbitrary black-box predictors with finite-sample, distribution-free marginal coverage, yet marginal validity can hide severe covariate-specific miscalibration, while exact distribution-free conditional coverage is finite-sample unattainable. Randomly localized conformal prediction (RLCP) mitigates this gap by calibrating near the test point while preserving marginal coverage. Existing theory, however, lacks finite-sample guarantees for the realized localized set that jointly control conditional validity and oracle efficiency. We provide such guarantees. For any fixed score, under Hölder regularity of the conditional score CDF and standard density and kernel assumptions, we prove high-probability bounds, uniform over a realized localization neighbourhood, for the conditional-coverage gap and the length error relative to the oracle. The bounds decompose into an $O(h^β)$ localization bias and a calibration term decreasing with calibration size, clarifying the bandwidth bias-variance tradeoff and when RLCP tracks the oracle. We also analyze data-split learned scores: when the score targets a pivotal score, as in conformalized quantile regression, uniform local guarantees decompose into fixed-score calibration and uniform score-estimation errors, showing that improved learning sharpens localized guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机局部化共形预测 (randomly localized conformal prediction, RLCP) 的有限样本理论保证。作者证明，在条件分数 CDF 满足 Hölder 正则性以及标准密度与核假设下，可实现的高概率界能够均匀地控制真实化局部邻域内的条件覆盖缺口 (conditional-coverage gap) 和相对于 oracle 的长度误差。这些界分解为 O(h^β) 的局部化偏差项和随校准量递减的校准项，从而刻画了带宽的偏差-方差权衡。
Motivation: 边缘有效性 (marginal validity) 可能掩盖严重的协变量特定误校准，而精确的分布自由条件覆盖在有限样本下不可达；RLCP 通过在测试点附近校准来缓解这一差距，但已有理论缺乏对所实现局部化集合同时控制条件有效性与 oracle 效率的有限样本保证。
Method: 通过理论分析为 RLCP 提供高概率有限样本界：对固定分数，在条件分数 CDF 的 Hölder 正则性和标准密度与核假设下，证明均匀覆盖真实化局部邻域的条件覆盖缺口与相对 oracle 长度误差的界；并进一步分析数据切分 (data-split) 学习分数，当分数逼近枢轴分数（如共形分位回归 conformalized quantile regression）时，将均匀局部保证分解为固定分数校准与均匀分数估计误差。
Result: 摘要报告的界由 O(h^β) 的局部化偏差和随校准量减小的校准项组成，阐明了带宽的偏差-方差权衡以及 RLCP 何时能追踪 oracle；对学习分数，局部保证可分解为固定分数校准和均匀分数估计误差，显示改进的分数学习会增强局部化保证。
Conclusion: 作者强调，改进分数学习能够锐化 RLCP 的局部化保证，并澄清了带宽的偏差-方差权衡问题。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CFGPNet: Cross-Attention-Based Fused Gradient Programmed Network Framework for Multispectral Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: RGB--T object detection exploits the complementary strengths of visible and infrared imagery, supporting robust perception in low-light, adverse-weather, and complex multi-scale environments. However, existing methods still suffer from insufficient cross-modal interaction, unstable fusion from modality distribution gaps, and the high computational cost of heavy attention-based architectures. To address these issues, CFGPNet is proposed, a Cross-Attention-Based Fused Gradient Programmed Network framework for multispectral object detection. CFGPNet uses an improved GELAN backbone with RepViT-style re-parameterized blocks to strengthen feature representation while preserving computational efficiency. A Cross Computation Efficient Attention (CrossCEA) module is introduced to enhance cross-modal feature interaction and reduce redundant information transfer between visible and thermal branches. To generate compact and discriminative fused representations, an Attention Selection and Aggregation Fusion (ASAF) network combines dense feature aggregation with selective attention-based emphasis. Moreover, a programmable-gradient auxiliary branch is integrated into each CFGPNet variant to improve gradient delivery and optimization quality. Experiments on five public multispectral benchmarks, FLIR, M3FD, LLVIP, VEDAI, and MFAD, demonstrate that CFGPNet achieves strong and consistent performance across diverse scenes, object scales, and modality balances. In particular, the framework attains 80.7% mAP50 / 45.0% mAP50:95 on FLIR, 89.9% / 63.4% on M3FD, and 97.8% / 68.9% on LLVIP. It also reaches 83.3% / 56.9% on VEDAI and 83.4% / 61.8% on MFAD. These results show that CFGPNet is an effective, practical solution offering useful accuracy--efficiency trade-offs across three model scales. The code, data, and fine-tuned models are available at https://github.com/NimaHatami99/CFGPNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CFGPNet，一个用于 RGB-T 多光谱目标检测的跨注意力融合梯度编程网络框架。它采用改进的 GELAN 主干、RepViT 风格重参数化模块、跨计算高效注意力 (CrossCEA) 模块、注意力选择与聚合融合 (ASAF) 网络，并集成可编程梯度辅助分支以改善梯度传递。在 FLIR、M3FD、LLVIP、VEDAI 和 MFAD 五个公开基准上报告了强且一致的结果。
Motivation: 现有 RGB-T 检测方法仍存在跨模态交互不足、模态分布差异导致的融合不稳定，以及基于重注意力架构的高计算成本等问题。
Method: CFGPNet 使用带 RepViT 风格重参数化块的改进 GELAN 主干；通过 CrossCEA 模块增强可见光与热红外分支的跨模态交互并减少冗余信息；用 ASAF 网络结合密集特征聚合与选择性注意力生成紧凑判别性的融合表示；每个变体均集成可编程梯度辅助分支以改善优化质量。
Result: 摘要报告 CFGPNet 在 FLIR 上达到 80.7% mAP50 / 45.0% mAP50:95，在 M3FD 上达到 89.9% / 63.4%，在 LLVIP 上达到 97.8% / 68.9%，在 VEDAI 上达到 83.3% / 56.9%，在 MFAD 上达到 83.4% / 61.8%，并在三种模型尺度下提供有效的精度-效率权衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CFGPNet 是面向多光谱目标检测的有效实用方案，代码、数据与微调模型已公开。

papers.title: What Current AI Benchmarks Leave Unmeasured: Modality, Search, Citations, and Implications (for Safety Evaluations)
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) benchmark evaluations are routinely used to support claims about model safety, reliability, and deployment readiness. Yet most evaluations rely on a single access modality (model APIs), perform a single run per prompt, and report accuracy as the primary outcome metric, without accounting for conditions such as web search that may have effects on model behavior in deployment. We audit these assumptions for one of the most widely-used LLMs, comparing two modalities, ChatGPT's chat UI and OpenAI's API, with and without web search enabled. We use a stratified total sample of 401 prompts from two popular benchmarks, BBQ and SafetyBench, collecting 4,812 total responses across three repeated runs per prompt. Beyond standard performance measures, we evaluate model output dimensions including response consistency, response text similarity, citation grounding, and abstention behavior. For instance, chat UI responses were less accurate than API responses on both benchmarks with search disabled. Enabling web search reduced accuracy by up to 8 percentage points, and even reversed the direction of modality performance trends for one benchmark. Repeated runs of the same prompt produced inconsistent responses in up to 21\% of prompts. The two modalities also grounded answers in different citations, and abstention behavior was also inconsistent across both modalities. These results illustrate that, even within a model family, reporting only simple accuracy metrics can obscure important forms of model behavioral variation relevant to AI safety assessments. We argue that AI safety evaluations should systematically account for modality, multi-run consistency, search conditions, and response-level behaviors to better reflect how deployed AI systems behave in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计了当前LLM基准评估中的常见假设——单一访问模态（模型API）、每个提示仅运行一次、仅报告准确率而不考虑部署条件（如web search）。作者以ChatGPT的chat UI和OpenAI API两种模态、开关web search为条件，在BBQ和SafetyBench上对401个提示做三次重复采样，共收集4,812条响应，并额外测量响应一致性、文本相似度、引用依据和弃答行为。结果显示模态和搜索条件会显著改变模型行为，说明仅报告简单准确率会掩盖与AI安全评估相关的行为变异。
Motivation: LLM基准评估常被用来支撑模型安全、可靠性和部署就绪的说法，但大多数评估只通过API访问、每个提示只跑一次、仅报告准确率，忽略如web search等部署条件对模型行为的影响。这种评估缺口可能导致安全评估与实际部署行为不符。
Method: 以最广泛使用的LLM之一为对象，比较chat UI和API两种模态，在启用与关闭web search的条件下，从BBQ和SafetyBench两个基准中分层抽取401个提示，每个提示重复运行三次，共收集4,812条响应。除标准性能指标外，还评估响应一致性（repeated-run consistency）、响应文本相似度、引用依据（citation grounding）和弃答行为（abstention）。

papers.title: EnvACE: Internalizing Environment Dynamics via World Rehearsal for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Training large language model agents for long-horizon tool use typically relies on interactions with real or synthesized executable environments, whose construction and verification are costly, or on external simulators that are difficult to ground. We introduce EnvACE, an agentic reinforcement learning method that replaces external environment interaction during training with world rehearsal. The policy alternates between acting and rehearsal: it first generates a tool call, then plays the role of the environment to produce the response induced by that action, and conditions subsequent decisions on the rehearsed response. Both roles are jointly optimized end-to-end using task-success rewards. Through world rehearsal, the policy internalizes the relationship between actions and their environment responses in its parameters, yielding an agent world model that directly supports decision making. Across BFCL-v4, tau^2-Bench, VitaBench, and FinMCP-Bench, EnvACE achieves strong and transferable performance, outperforming environment-scaling baselines in the overall evaluation. Controlled studies further show that world rehearsal consistently improves policy learning across model scales. At test time, the internalized world model enables private rehearsal before committed execution, yielding further gains under a moderate rehearsal budget without additional external interaction. Our findings establish world rehearsal as a new path toward scaling LLM agent training beyond the constraints of external environments. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Within-yao/EnvACE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EnvACE，一种用世界排练（world rehearsal）替代外部环境交互的 agentic 强化学习方法。策略交替执行行动与排练：先生成工具调用，再扮演环境生成该行动引发的响应，并基于排练响应做出后续决策，两个角色通过任务成功奖励端到端联合优化。在 BFCL-v4、tau^2-Bench、VitaBench 和 FinMCP-Bench 上，EnvACE 表现强且可迁移，优于环境扩展基线，测试时还可利用内部化世界模型进行私有排练。
Motivation: 训练大语言模型 agent 进行长时程工具使用通常依赖真实或合成的可执行环境，其构建与验证成本高昂，而外部模拟器又难以接地，限制了 agent 训练的规模化。
Method: EnvACE 将环境交互替换为世界排练：策略在行动和排练之间交替，既生成工具调用又扮演环境产生响应，后续决策基于排练得到的响应；两个角色使用任务成功奖励进行端到端联合优化，从而将动作与环境响应的关系内化到策略参数中，形成直接支持决策的 agent 世界模型。
Result: 在 BFCL-v4、tau^2-Bench、VitaBench 和 FinMCP-Bench 上，EnvACE 在整体评估中超越环境扩展（environment-scaling）基线；受控研究表明世界排练在不同模型规模下均一致提升策略学习；测试时在中等排练预算下，私有排练带来进一步增益而无需额外外部交互。
Conclusion: 摘要将世界排练确立为一种在外部环境约束之外扩展 LLM agent 训练的新路径，强调其有效性与可迁移性，并开源代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Comparative Approaches to Agent Retrieval over Large Skill Libraries
papers.abstract_en: Agents backed by large skill libraries must decide which skills to load and in what order. Loading the entire library into context is expensive and provides no structure for autonomous sequencing. We study two systems for this problem over a corpus of 690 skills: a hybrid ranker combining lexical and dense-embedding retrieval for sparse, on-demand loading, and a typed knowledge graph encoding workflow relations such as prerequisites, data flow, and ordering. On a set of 117 realistic, non-echoing queries, the hybrid ranker retrieves the correct skill within the top five in 73.5% +/- 8.0 of cases, leaving roughly a quarter of queries unserved. When used as the design intended (substituting graph neighbours for additional ranked results at matched token budget), the graph is significantly worse (-11.2 points, p = 0.0007). Its LLM-generated edge layer adds nothing over neighbours obtained free from a local embedding pass, and 73% of the queries the ranker misses are not reachable through the graph at all. We attribute this to a pre-filter topology bound. Because the graph's candidate edges are drawn from the same embedding neighbourhood the ranker already searches, 98.6% of typed edges connect skills the ranker had already surfaced together. The graph can enrich relation semantics but cannot extend retrieval reach. We further show that evaluating on author-written queries overstates hit@5 by up to 44 points, which would have hidden these results entirely. Our contribution is a mechanistic account of why added structure does not improve retrieval over a strong ranker, and identify the conditions under which adding structural interdependence into the retrieval is optimal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型技能库场景下智能体如何选择并排序要加载的技能，比较混合排序器（结合词法检索与稠密嵌入检索）与带类型知识图谱（编码前置条件、数据流和顺序等关系）两种方案。在 690 个技能、117 个非回显查询上，混合排序器 hit@5 为 73.5%±8.0；按设计意图使用图谱时，图谱显著更差（-11.2 分，p=0.0007），且其 LLM 生成的边层相对免费邻域没有增益。作者将其归因于预过滤拓扑上界：图谱候选边来自排序器已搜索的同一嵌入邻域，98.6% 的类型边连接的是排序器已共同召回的技能，因此图谱能丰富关系语义但不能扩展检索覆盖。
Motivation: 大技能库下智能体需要决定加载哪些技能及加载顺序，而把整个库放入上下文成本高且缺乏自主排序结构；现有方案在何种条件下加入结构化知识能改善检索尚不清楚。
Method: 作者对比两种系统：一是混合排序器，结合词法检索与稠密嵌入检索进行稀疏按需加载；二是类型化知识图谱，编码技能间的依赖、数据流与执行顺序等关系。实验在固定 token 预算下将图谱邻居替换为排序器额外返回结果，并比较作者编写查询与更现实查询上的表现。
Result: 混合排序器在 117 个现实查询上 hit@5 为 73.5%±8.0；图谱按预期使用后显著更差（-11.2 分，p=0.0007），其 LLM 生成边没有超过本地嵌入邻域免费获得的邻居，且排序器漏掉的查询中 73% 在图谱中不可达。98.6% 的类型边连接的是排序器早已共同召回的技能；用作者编写的查询评估会把 hit@5 高估最多 44 分。
Conclusion: 作者给出一个机制性解释：当结构边的候选来源与强排序器的嵌入邻域重叠时，加入结构不会改善检索；并识别了在哪些条件下把结构相互依赖加入检索才是最优的。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Handling Missing Data in Probabilistic Regression Trees
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic Regression Trees (PRTrees) are a smooth and consistent alternative to classical regression trees, producing continuous predictions through probabilistic split assignments. This paper extends the PRTree framework to accommodate missing predictor values directly during tree construction, eliminating the need for prior imputation. Three strategies are proposed, each exploiting the available information differently: a uniform-probability approach, a partial-observation approach, and a dimension-reduced smoothing approach. These modifications are defined to preserve the fundamental probabilistic properties of the original methodology, including probability conservation and marginal compatibility, under arbitrary patterns of missing covariate values. The proposed methods are evaluated on several real-world datasets exhibiting different levels of missingness and are compared with classical regression trees. The results show that the effectiveness of probabilistic tree construction depends strongly on the treatment of missing observations. Across the considered datasets, the fill strategy emerged as the dominant modeling component, often exerting a larger influence on predictive performance than either the smoothing distribution or the proxy-selection criterion. In datasets where a substantial proportion of observations contained missing predictor values, the proposed methods frequently outperformed CART, while maintaining the interpretability and flexibility of tree-based models.
papers.comment: Theoretical background for the companion paper, arXiv:2510.03634
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展概率回归树 (Probabilistic Regression Trees, PRTrees)，使其能在树构建过程中直接处理缺失预测变量，无需事先插补。作者提出三种利用可用信息的策略：均匀概率法、部分观测法和降维平滑法，并保持概率守恒与边际相容等性质。在多个真实数据集上，所提方法与经典回归树对比，结果显示缺失观测的处理方式对预测性能影响显著，fill 策略常比平滑分布或代理选择准则更具主导作用。
Motivation: 经典回归树和概率回归树在处理缺失预测变量时通常依赖先验插补，而插补可能引入偏差或误差。作者希望直接在树构建阶段利用缺失数据中的可用信息，从而在任意缺失模式下保持模型的理论性质并提升预测表现。
Method: 在 PRTree 框架内提出三种缺失数据处理策略：均匀概率法 (uniform-probability approach)、部分观测法 (partial-observation approach) 和降维平滑法 (dimension-reduced smoothing approach)。这些修改被定义为保持原始方法的关键概率性质，包括概率守恒 (probability conservation) 和边际相容性 (marginal compatibility)。
Result: 在多个具有不同缺失水平的真实数据集上，与经典回归树 CART 比较，所提方法在大量观测含缺失预测值时经常优于 CART。实验表明，fill 策略是影响预测性能的主导建模组件，其影响通常大于平滑分布或代理选择准则。
Conclusion: 作者强调概率树构建的有效性高度依赖于缺失观测的处理方式，并指出所提方法在保持树模型可解释性和灵活性的同时，能在高缺失比例数据下优于 CART。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: HOPE: Hand-Object Pressure Estimation from Monocular Videos
papers.abstract_en: Estimating physical pressure from vision is essential for understanding contact-rich hand-object interaction. However, prior vision-based pressure estimation methods are largely limited to planar surfaces and single image input, making them difficult to apply to dynamic hand-object interaction with diverse objects. We instead formulate pressure estimation as a hand-centric video prediction problem with monocular video as input. This formulation predicts temporally evolving per-vertex normal pressure and contact directly on the hand mesh, yielding a unified output space independent of object shape and sensor layout. Building on this formulation, we propose \textbf{HOPE}, a framework with two key components. First, we lift tactile-glove pressure, planar-sensor pressure, and distance-based hand-object contact annotations into a shared hand vertex space, allowing bare-hand contact data to regularize pressure learning where metric labels are unavailable. Second, we introduce a vertex-anchored video transformer that treats each vertex as a persistent token, aggregates visual features and hand pose over time, and uses a contact-gated pressure head to enforce that pressure vanishes without contact. Experiments on OpenTouch, PressureVisionDB, and hand-object contact benchmarks validate HOPE across object-pressure, surface-pressure, and contact-supervised HOI settings. Despite using metric pressure supervision primarily from gloved-hand videos, HOPE generalizes to bare-hand egocentric and in-the-wild videos, producing joint contact and pressure predictions beyond the scope of contact-only or planar-pressure baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HOPE，一种从单目视频估计手-物体交互中接触与压力的框架。作者将压力估计重构为以手为中心的视频预测问题，直接在手掌网格上输出随时间演化的逐顶点法向压力与接触，从而获得与物体形状和传感器布局无关的统一输出空间。框架包含两个关键组件：将触觉手套压力、平面传感器压力和基于距离的接触标注统一到共享手顶点空间，以及一个顶点锚定的视频 Transformer，利用接触门控压力头强制无接触时压力为零。实验在 OpenTouch、PressureVisionDB 和手-物体接触基准上验证，并展示了对裸手第一人称及野外视频的泛化能力。
Motivation: 先前的基于视觉的压力估计方法大多局限于平面表面和单张图像，难以应用于动态、多样物体的手-物体交互场景。本文通过将压力估计视为手为中心的视频预测问题，建立一个与物体几何和解剖无关的统一输出空间，以支持更广泛的交互场景。
Method: 提出 HOPE 框架，包含两个部分：一是数据统一，把触觉手套压力、平面传感器压力和基于距离的手-物体接触标注提升到共享的手顶点空间，并用无手套接触数据对缺乏度量标签的区域进行正则化；二是顶点锚定的视频 Transformer，将每个顶点作为持久 token，随时间聚合视觉特征和手部姿态，使用接触门控压力头确保无接触时压力输出为零。
Result: 在 OpenTouch、PressureVisionDB 和手-物体接触基准上的实验验证了 HOPE 在物体压力、表面压力和接触监督的 HOI 设置中的有效性。尽管度量压力监督主要来自戴手套手的视频，HOPE 仍能泛化到裸手第一人称和野外视频，产生联合接触与压力预测，优于仅接触或仅平面压力的基线方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将压力估计表述为手为中心的视频预测，并利用共享手顶点空间与接触门控机制，可以在缺乏度量压力标签的裸手场景中实现泛化。

papers.title: EvReflection: Event-Driven Micro-Dynamics for Reflection Removal
papers.abstract_en: Despite remarkable progress in reflection removal, current methods primarily exploit static image priors from a single frame and still suffer from severe residual artifacts due to the inherent ambiguity between the reflection and transmission layers. In this paper, we propose leveraging event signals to break this ambiguity. By employing event cameras to capture micro-dynamics, we reveal the differential motion between these two layers. We thereby present a novel event-driven reflection removal network, EvReflection, that utilizes these dynamic cues for layer separation. Specifically, we design a Micro-Dynamics Decoupler to disentangle layer-specific motions from event streams as priors, which then guide a Parallax-Attention Rectifier to cleanly remove artifacts from the RGB image. Furthermore, to address data scarcity, we develop a parallax-aware simulation pipeline and construct the EVR$^2$ benchmark dataset, the first real-world dataset for this task. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EvReflection achieves state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks, surpassing the best competing method by more than 1.6 dB and 1.2 dB in PSNR, respectively. The code, dataset, and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/JiaxiaoWang/EvReflection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出事件驱动的反射去除网络 EvReflection，利用事件相机捕捉反射层与透射层之间的微动态差异来消除单帧静态图像先验带来的层间歧义。方法包含 Micro-Dynamics Decoupler 从事件流中解耦层专属运动作为先验，以及 Parallax-Attention Rectifier 在 RGB 图像上清理伪影；同时提出视差感知仿真管线并构建首个真实世界数据集 EVR$^2$。实验表明在合成与真实基准上均达到最先进水平，PSNR 分别超过最强对比方法 1.6 dB 与 1.2 dB。
Motivation: 现有反射去除方法主要依赖单帧静态图像先验，由于反射层与透射层之间的固有歧义，残留伪影严重。作者提出利用事件信号捕捉两层间的差异运动来打破这种歧义。
Method: 提出事件驱动反射去除网络 EvReflection：Micro-Dynamics Decoupler 从事件流中解耦各层特定运动作为先验，Parallax-Attention Rectifier 据此从 RGB 图像中清除反射伪影；并开发视差感知仿真管线，构建首个真实世界数据集 EVR$^2$。
Result: 在合成与真实世界基准上均取得最先进性能，合成基准 PSNR 超过最优对比方法 1.6 dB 以上，真实基准超过 1.2 dB 以上。
Conclusion: 摘要强调事件信号提供的微动态线索能有效缓解反射层与透射层的歧义，并指出代码、数据集和预训练模型已公开；具体局限性与消融未在摘要中提及。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MicroEvo: Knowledge-Guided LLM Sampling for Efficient Microarchitecture Design Space Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Microarchitecture design space exploration suffers from expansive search spaces and expensive PPA evaluation, leaving only a small simulation budget for design decision-making. Existing methods perform blind search without considering microarchitectural dependencies and fail to learn from the iterative search effectively, leading to wasted evaluations and weak Pareto convergence. In this paper, we propose MicroEvo, a knowledge-guided framework that couples off-the-shelf LLMs with Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) for multi-objective microarchitecture optimization. MicroEvo combines LLM-driven evolutionary operators, a Pareto-aware tree policy that balances Pareto contribution and diversity, an active knowledge accumulation mechanism that extracts and reuses optimization insights, and state-aware directives that adapt the search behavior online. Experiments show that MicroEvo improves Pareto-front quality by up to 36.2% over NSGA-II and achieves 10.6x higher search efficiency, and also demonstrates strong scalability to a complex industrial-scale core. The code repository is available at: https://github.com/GEAR-SEU/MicroEvo-ICCAD-26.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MicroEvo，一个将现成大语言模型 (LLM) 与蒙特卡洛树搜索 (MCTS) 结合的知识引导框架，用于多目标微架构设计空间探索。框架包含 LLM 驱动的进化算子、兼顾 Pareto 贡献与多样性的树策略、主动知识积累机制以及状态感知指令。实验表明该方法相比 NSGA-II 将 Pareto 前沿质量提升最多 36.2%，搜索效率提高 10.6 倍，并可扩展到工业级复杂核心。
Motivation: 微架构设计空间探索面临庞大搜索空间和昂贵的 PPA 评估，仿真预算有限。现有方法进行盲搜索，不考虑微架构依赖且不能有效从迭代搜索中学习，导致评估浪费和 Pareto 收敛弱。
Method: MicroEvo 将现成 LLM 与 MCTS 结合，使用 LLM 驱动的进化算子生成候选，Pareto 感知树策略平衡 Pareto 贡献与多样性，主动知识积累机制提取并复用优化洞察，状态感知指令在线调整搜索行为。
Result: 实验显示 MicroEvo 相比 NSGA-II 最多提升 Pareto 前沿质量 36.2%，搜索效率提高 10.6 倍，并展示了在复杂工业级核心上的强可扩展性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调知识引导与在线自适应搜索能显著改善微架构多目标优化效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On Same-Sample and Independent-Sample Stochastic Extragradient for Monotone Variational Inequalities
papers.abstract_en: We study stochastic extragradient (SEG) methods for solving monotone variational inequality problems (VIPs) over a feasible set. Although extragradient is a foundational algorithm for VIPs and its deterministic convergence theory is well developed, its stochastic counterpart remains less understood. Most existing analyses focus on independent-sample SEG (I-SEG) and assume either that the domain is compact or that the variance of the stochastic operator is uniformly bounded. The behavior of same-sample SEG (S-SEG), a natural variant with materially different properties, has received far less attention. In this work, we address these gaps in the literature. We first show that S-SEG is sensitive to samplewise Lipschitz parameters: mean Lipschitzness and bounded variance alone do not ensure convergence, even on a compact set. Then, for possibly unbounded domains, we establish a high-probability restricted-gap convergence for each SEG variant under a relaxed set of assumptions, and show that certain fundamental improvements to these results are impossible in general. Finally, we show that a known asymmetric double step-size selection that guarantees almost sure last-iterate convergence for I-SEG can fail for S-SEG: there exists a stochastic monotone VIP for which S-SEG diverges almost surely even under the modified step-sizes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究求解单调变分不等式问题（VIP）的随机外梯度方法（stochastic extragradient, SEG），重点关注同样本随机外梯度（S-SEG）与独立样本随机外梯度（I-SEG）之间的本质差异。作者证明 S-SEG 对样本级 Lipschitz 参数敏感，仅靠均值 Lipschitz 性和有界方差不足以保证收敛；随后在可能无界域上，为两种变体在放宽假设下建立高概率受限间隔（restricted-gap）收敛，并指出某些根本性改进在一般情况下不可能实现。最后展示一种已知能保证 I-SEG 几乎必然最后迭代收敛的非对称双步长选取，对 S-SEG 可能失效，存在使 S-SEG 几乎必然发散的随机单调 VIP 实例。
Motivation: 确定性外梯度算法的 VIP 收敛理论已成熟，但随机版本的收敛性理解不足；现有分析大多局限于 I-SEG，且假设域紧致或随机算子方差一致有界，而性质明显不同的 S-SEG 受到的关注很少。
Method: 采用反例和理论分析相结合的方式，分别考察 S-SEG 与 I-SEG 在单调 VIP 上的收敛行为；在可能无界域上建立高概率 restricted-gap 收敛，并分析非对称双步长选取对两种变体的影响。
Result: S-SEG 对样本级 Lipschitz 参数敏感，即使紧致集上均值 Lipschitz 性和有界方差也不能保证收敛；对可能无界域，两种 SEG 变体在放宽假设下均可获得高概率受限间隔收敛，但某些基本改进被证明不可能；非对称双步长选取在 I-SEG 上保证几乎必然最后迭代收敛，却存在随机单调 VIP 使 S-SEG 在此步长下几乎必然发散。
Conclusion: 论文指出 S-SEG 与 I-SEG 的收敛性质存在实质性差异，特别强调 S-SEG 的收敛保证需要比均值 Lipschitz 性和有界方差更强的条件，并给出其收敛理论的可能极限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SAGA: Score-Weighted Adaptive Generation Alignment for Low-Resource Nordic Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Preference optimisation has proven effective for improving large language models but typically relies on costly human preference annotations. Extending these methods to morphologically rich, low-resource languages remains challenging because such annotations are scarce. We present SAGA (Score-weighted Adaptive Generation Alignment), a parser-guided preference optimisation framework that replaces human labels with dependency-parser supervision. SAGA converts parser judgements into preference pairs for delta-DPO, combines parser quality with lexical diversity in a composite reward, filters low-information pairs using a reward-gap criterion, and monitors reward hacking to maintain reliable supervision. Across Danish, Icelandic, and Norwegian Bokmål using GPT-SW3-1.3B, SAGA consistently improves grammatical quality without requiring human preference labels. Danish parse success increases from 69.0% to 93.8%, Icelandic achieves a +4.5 percentage-point improvement on an independent Stanza evaluation (three-run mean +3.3 percentage points) while native speakers prefer SAGA outputs in 80% of pairwise comparisons, and Norwegian Bokmål improves by +28 percentage points. These results demonstrate that parser-derived supervision is a practical alternative to human preference annotation for grammatical alignment in low-resource languages where high-quality dependency parsers are available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGA 是一个解析器引导的偏好优化框架，用依存解析器 (dependency parser) 的监督替代人工偏好标注，面向低资源、形态丰富的北欧语言。作者在 GPT-SW3-1.3B 上对丹麦语、冰岛语和挪威博克马尔语进行语法对齐实验，摘要称该方法持续提升语法质量且无需人类偏好标签。
Motivation: 偏好优化 (preference optimisation) 通常依赖昂贵的人工偏好标注，而形态丰富、低资源语言缺乏此类标注，难以直接扩展这些方法。
Method: SAGA 将依存解析器的判断转换为偏好对用于 delta-DPO，构建结合解析器质量与词汇多样性的复合奖励，通过奖励差距 (reward-gap) 过滤低信息样本，并监控奖励黑客 (reward hacking) 以维持可靠监督。
Result: 丹麦语解析成功率从 69.0% 提升至 93.8%；冰岛语在独立 Stanza 评估上平均提升 +4.5 个百分点（三次运行均值 +3.3 个百分点），且母语者在 80% 的成对比较中更偏好 SAGA 输出；挪威博克马尔语提升 +28 个百分点。
Conclusion: 结果表明，在具备高质量依存解析器的低资源语言环境中，解析器监督可作为人工偏好标注的实用替代方案用于语法对齐。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: SAGA 是一个解析器引导的偏好优化框架，用依存解析器 (dependency parser) 的监督替代人工偏好标注，面向低资源、形态丰富的北欧语言。作者在 GPT-SW3-1.3B 上对丹麦语、冰岛语和挪威博克马尔语进行语法对齐实验，摘要称该方法持续提升语法质量且无需人类偏好标签。
summary_sections.motivation: 偏好优化 (preference optimisation) 通常依赖昂贵的人工偏好标注，而形态丰富、低资源语言缺乏此类标注，难以直接扩展这些方法。
summary_sections.method: SAGA 将依存解析器的判断转换为偏好对用于 delta-DPO，构建结合解析器质量与词汇多样性的复合奖励，通过奖励差距 (reward-gap) 过滤低信息样本，并监控奖励黑客 (reward hacking) 以维持可靠监督。
summary_sections.result: 丹麦语解析成功率从 69.0% 提升至 93.8%；冰岛语在独立 Stanza 评估上平均提升 +4.5 个百分点（三次运行均值 +3.3 个百分点），且母语者在 80% 的成对比较中更偏好 SAGA 输出；挪威博克马尔语提升 +28 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结果表明，在具备高质量依存解析器的低资源语言环境中，解析器监督可作为人工偏好标注的实用替代方案用于语法对齐。

papers.title: Threshold-Based Early Stopping of Accumulations in Neural Networks with Binary Activation
papers.abstract_en: Binary neural networks are very attractive for constrained deployment, enabling small footprint and low-power inference. For binary activations, the dot products become sign-controlled additions or subtractions, but the number of operations is unchanged. Indeed, every neuron or output channel still accumulates all of its input, even though only the sign will be retained, which is often wasteful. As the accumulation progresses, the running partial sum frequently drifts so far from zero that its final sign becomes highly predictable long before the last term is reached; every contribution evaluated after that point changes the value of the sum but not the final output activation. This paper turns this observation into a post-training early-stopping mechanism. We characterize the behavior of the running accumulations on the training dataset and use this information to predict the final sign as soon as possible. No model parameter is retrained. We count the number of operations under an idealized ordering of weights. On VGG11 applied to the CIFAR-10 dataset, the method removes $86.6\%$ of the accumulation terms of the deepest convolution for a $0.37$-point accuracy drop, and $25\%$ of the full-network arithmetic when used on the three deepest convolutions simultaneously, for a $1.36$-point drop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对二值激活神经网络的后训练早期停止机制。作者观察到，二值激活中累加的部分和常常很早就会偏离零足够远，使得最终符号在全部项累加完之前就高度可预测，后续贡献只改变和值而不改变输出。他们利用训练集上运行累加的行为来尽早预测最终符号，从而跳过后续运算，且不重训任何模型参数。在 VGG11 与 CIFAR-10 上，该方法对最深卷积层可移除 86.6% 的累加项，精度仅下降 0.37 点；对三个最深卷积层同时使用时可减少全网络 25% 的算术操作，精度下降 1.36 点。
Motivation: 二值神经网络虽然将点积变为符号控制的加法或减法，但操作数量不变：每个神经元或输出通道仍要累加所有输入，而最终只保留符号，因此大量累加是浪费的。
Method: 提出后训练早期停止机制：在训练数据集上刻画运行累加（running accumulation）的行为，利用该统计信息尽早预测最终符号；所有贡献在该预测点之后的操作均可跳过。模型参数不被重新训练，操作计数在理想化的权重排序下进行。
Result: 在 VGG11 应用于 CIFAR-10 的实验中，最深卷积层可移除 86.6% 的累加项，精度下降 0.37 点；同时用于三个最深卷积层时，可移除全网络 25% 的算术操作，精度下降 1.36 点。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，基于阈值的早期停止可以显著减少二值激活网络在推理时的累加运算，以很小的精度代价换取计算量下降；方法属于后处理，不涉及参数重训。

papers.title: Support Operation Factorization: Compositional Readout of Frozen Vision Encoders under Controlled Interventions
papers.abstract_en: Compositional analysis of frozen vision encoders should determine both what changed and where it changed. Standard factor probes score these axes separately, however, and can reward multiple operations that reuse the same predicted slot. We call this failure operation laundering. We introduce an injectively aligned leave-one-cell-out protocol over support x operation grids and SO-OPF, a readout that factors cell energy into support salience and a competitive operation posterior. This formulation separates two questions that aggregate scores conflate: whether the carrier composes held-out bindings when the grid is known, and whether that grid can be recovered from flat cell labels. With frozen DINOv3 features, known factorial assignment reaches 0.874 injective accuracy on Shapes3D-Extended and 0.799 on globally image-disjoint COCO; learning the assignment from flat labels reaches 0.769 and 0.762, respectively. Under matched-axis-aware supervision on Shapes3D, the factored carrier improves learned-assignment accuracy from 0.653 to 0.841 over a dense carrier and eliminates its laundering gap. SigLIP2 replicates the COCO separation. A rebuilt MuJoCo substrate exposes a boundary: learned-assignment accuracy is 0.569 with DINOv3 and 0.484 with SigLIP2, with substantial slot collapse. Thus factored readout and injective evaluation recover held-out bindings on two substrates while exposing, rather than hiding, a renderer-specific failure boundary; they do not establish universal recovery from flat labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对冻结视觉编码器的组合分析（compositional analysis）提出 SO-OPF 读出器，结合注入式对齐的留一细胞协议（leave-one-cell-out protocol），将细胞能量分解为支持显著性（support salience）与竞争性操作后验（competitive operation posterior）。在 DINOv3 特征上，已知因子化指派在 Shapes3D-Extended 上达到 0.874 注入式准确率，在全局图像不相交的 COCO 上为 0.799；从扁平标签学习指派分别达到 0.769 与 0.762。SigLIP2 复现了 COCO 上的分离，而重建的 MuJoCo 基座则暴露出学习指派准确率下降与槽位坍缩（slot collapse）的边界。
Motivation: 标准因子探针（factor probes）分别对支持轴和操作轴打分，可能奖励多个操作复用同一预测槽位，作者称之为操作洗白（operation laundering），导致聚合分数混淆了不同问题。
Method: 提出注入式对齐的留一细胞协议和 SO-OPF 读出器，将细胞能量分解为支持显著性与竞争性操作后验，从而分离两个问题：网格已知时载体是否组合了留出绑定（held-out bindings），以及该网格能否从扁平细胞标签中恢复。
Result: 已知因子化指派在 Shapes3D-Extended 与全局图像不相交 COCO 上分别达到 0.874 与 0.799 注入式准确率；从扁平标签学习指派分别达到 0.769 与 0.762。在 Shapes3D 的匹配轴监督下，因子化载体将学习指派准确率从稠密载体的 0.653 提升至 0.841 并消除洗白差距；MuJoCo 基座上 DINOv3 为 0.569、SigLIP2 为 0.484，且出现显著槽位坍缩。
Conclusion: 因子化读出与注入式评估能在两个基座上恢复留出绑定，同时暴露而非隐藏渲染器特异的失败边界；作者强调这并不建立从扁平标签进行通用恢复的能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prior-SG: Task and Prior Driven Region Segmentation for Scene Graphs in Arbitrarily-Structured Environments
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical 3D scene graphs are a promising representation for high-level spatial reasoning in autonomous mobile platforms. However, existing extraction frameworks typically rely on purely local visual clustering or strict geometric heuristics, such as wall-separated rooms, which fail in open-plan or arbitrarily-structured environments. We propose Prior-SG, a task- and prior-driven framework that casts scene graph generation fundamentally as a probabilistic alignment problem. As the robot explores, it continuously aggregates an incoming RGB-D sensor stream into a physically grounded Instance Graph utilizing a multi-scale, open-vocabulary feature fusion strategy. The system then infers the high-level functional semantics of this map through a Maximum A Posteriori (MAP) estimate, guided by a Prior Graph-a logical expectation of the environment's structure and task-relevant vocabulary synthesized dynamically by a Large Language Model. By optimizing a Markov Random Field that fuses heterogeneous experts (visual, geometric, and discrete objects) with these topological priors, the system resolves local perceptual ambiguities. We validate this approach across diverse simulated residential datasets and large, open-plan real-world environments. Prior-SG achieves state-of-the-art semantic region segmentation accuracy compared to recent baselines, robustly delineates distant functional boundaries in the absence of physical walls, and uniquely provides zero-shot ontological flexibility, enabling the robot to entirely restructure its spatial partitioning based on a given high-level task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Prior-SG，一个任务与先验驱动的三维场景图生成框架，将场景图生成建模为概率对齐问题。系统把 RGB-D 传感器流聚合成实例图，再通过最大后验估计结合大语言模型动态合成的先验图来推断高层功能语义，并优化马尔可夫随机场以融合视觉、几何与离散物体等多源信息。实验覆盖模拟住宅数据集和大型开放式真实环境，在语义区域分割上达到最新水平，并在无物理墙时也能划分远距离功能边界。
Motivation: 现有三维场景图提取通常依赖纯局部视觉聚类或严格几何启发式（如墙分隔的房间），在开放式或无固定结构的空间中容易失效，因此需要一种能利用高层先验与任务语义来消除局部感知歧义的分割方法。
Method: Prior-SG 采用多尺度、开放词汇特征融合策略将 RGB-D 流聚合为实例图，并通过由大语言模型动态生成的先验图提供环境结构与任务相关词汇的逻辑期望；随后用马尔可夫随机场联合优化异构专家（视觉、几何、离散物体）与拓扑先验，得到 MAP 估计下的功能区域分割。
Result: 在多个模拟住宅数据集和大型开放式真实环境中，Prior-SG 相比近期基线取得最先进的语义区域分割精度；在缺少物理墙的情况下仍能稳健划出远距离功能边界，并具备零样本本体灵活性，可按给定高层任务重构空间划分。
Conclusion: 作者强调任务与先验驱动的概率对齐框架可以取代严格的几何启发式，使机器人能够根据高层任务需求动态重组空间分区，从而适应任意结构的开放环境。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Schema-Guided Hierarchical Information Extraction and Semantic Evaluation Using Generative AI
papers.abstract_en: We present a schema-based framework for extracting complex, structured information from unstructured text documents using generative AI, followed by automated semantic evaluation of the extracted information against a gold standard. The schema, serving as an information model encoding domain knowledge, provides a unified, systematic, and consistent framework for extraction of hierarchical, nested information, with attributes of variable cardinality, and subsequent evaluation of the results. Information extraction from a document is performed in a single call to the model, in zero-shot mode. In the evaluation step, we introduce a path-based semantic matching algorithm to align the nested, variable-cardinality attributes in the extracted results with those in the gold standard. We use generative AI for semantic comparison of the extracted and gold standard values of an attribute, and introduce a rubric to classify the result of the comparison, according to domain-specific considerations, as an exact, semantic, useful, or non-match. We were able to extract 12 out of 14 attributes with an F1 score of $>$90\% from documents published by the health technology assessment organisation NICE, using the generative AI model Claude Opus 3. The time needed to extract the attributes from a document was $\sim$30 times lower than the time taken by a human domain expert. We further demonstrate generalisability of this framework across different generative AI models and transferability across different HTA organisations and languages.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. To be published in Proceedings of the 2026 IEEE 22nd International Conference on e-Science (e-Science), Naples, Italy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 schema 的框架，用生成式 AI 从非结构化文本中抽取层级化、嵌套的结构化信息，并对抽取结果与金标准进行自动语义评估。信息抽取在单次模型调用中以零样本 (zero-shot) 模式完成；评估阶段引入基于路径的语义匹配算法，并用 rubric 将比较结果分为 exact、semantic、useful、non-match 四类。作者在健康技术评估组织 NICE 的文档上报告 12/14 个属性 F1>90%，抽取耗时约为人类领域专家的 1/30，并展示了跨模型、跨组织与跨语言的泛化性。
Motivation: 从非结构化文档中提取复杂、层级化且属性基数可变的结构化信息，并系统地评估抽取质量，目前缺乏统一、一致的框架；人工评估成本高且难以规模化。
Method: 以编码领域知识的 schema 作为统一信息模型，指导生成式 AI 对单个文档进行单次零样本抽取；评估阶段提出 path-based semantic matching 算法，对齐抽取结果与金标准中嵌套的可变基数属性，并使用生成式 AI 对属性值做语义比较，依据领域相关考量将结果分类为 exact、semantic、useful 或 non-match。
Result: 使用 Claude Opus 3 在 NICE 发布的文档上抽取 14 个属性中的 12 个，F1 超过 90%；单文档属性抽取所需时间约为人类领域专家的 1/30。摘要还表明该框架可推广到不同生成式 AI 模型，并可迁移至不同的 HTA 组织和语言。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该 schema 驱动的框架能在零样本条件下高效、一致地执行层级信息抽取与语义评估，并具备跨模型、跨组织和跨语言的适用性；摘要未展开说明未达到 F1>90% 的两个属性或对更广泛文本类型的局限性。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 以编码领域知识的 schema 作为统一信息模型，指导生成式 AI 对单个文档进行单次零样本抽取；评估阶段提出 path-based semantic matching 算法，对齐抽取结果与金标准中嵌套的可变基数属性，并使用生成式 AI 对属性值做语义比较，依据领域相关考量将结果分类为 exact、semantic、useful 或 non-match。
summary_sections.result: 使用 Claude Opus 3 在 NICE 发布的文档上抽取 14 个属性中的 12 个，F1 超过 90%；单文档属性抽取所需时间约为人类领域专家的 1/30。摘要还表明该框架可推广到不同生成式 AI 模型，并可迁移至不同的 HTA 组织和语言。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该 schema 驱动的框架能在零样本条件下高效、一致地执行层级信息抽取与语义评估，并具备跨模型、跨组织和跨语言的适用性；摘要未展开说明未达到 F1>90% 的两个属性或对更广泛文本类型的局限性。

papers.title: Audio-to-Score Transcription using Pre-trained Features, Data Augmentation, and the New SheetSage-A2S Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Existing audio-to-score (A2S) systems primarily focus on classical music, and the application to popular music remains underexplored. This paper first presents the new SheetSage-A2S Dataset, which includes 61 hours of audio with \texttt{**kern} score encodings for 9,468 clips originating from 6,066 unique songs, the first of its kind to facilitate A2S research for popular music. Additionally, we improve on existing A2S approaches by using data augmentation and MuQ, a pretrained feature-extraction model for music audio, to enhance generalisation abilities and extract meaningful audio features. Results show that the proposed A2S model achieves 4.98\% symbol error rate (SER) on the Quartets collection for classical music, which significantly outperforms the 15.3\% SER from the existing state-of-the-art \cite{alfaro-contrerasTransformer2024}. Additionally, our model achieves 20.92\% SER on the SheetSage-A2S dataset for popular music, serving as a strong benchmark for future research. The dataset, model, and code are made publicly available at: https://github.com/Multimodal-Music-Research-Lab/SheetSage2Kern_model.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对流行音乐音频到乐谱转录（A2S）研究不足的问题，提出 SheetSage-A2S 数据集，包含 61 小时音频、9,468 个片段和对应 **kern 乐谱编码，来自 6,066 首歌曲。方法上使用 MuQ 预训练特征提取模型和数据增强提升泛化能力；在古典音乐 Quartets 集合上将符号错误率（SER）从现有最优的 15.3% 降至 4.98%，并在流行音乐数据集上达到 20.92% SER 作为基线。数据集、模型和代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有 A2S 系统主要面向古典音乐，流行音乐场景的应用尚未被充分探索，缺乏对应数据集与基准。
Method: 构建 SheetSage-A2S 数据集，并利用 MuQ（预训练的音乐音频特征提取模型）配合数据增强来改进 A2S 模型的特征提取与泛化能力。
Result: 在古典音乐 Quartets 集合上取得 4.98% SER，显著优于现有最优方法的 15.3% SER；在 SheetSage-A2S 流行音乐数据集上取得 20.92% SER，为后续研究提供强基准。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该数据集、模型和代码已公开，可支撑未来流行音乐 A2S 研究，并作为公共基准。

papers.title: BendTwin: Robust Dense-to-Sparse Physical Reconstruction with Bending-Aware Differentiable Spring-Mass Models
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing objects with mechanical properties from video observations enables physically consistent dynamic prediction, benefiting robotics planning and interaction. Existing spring--mass based physical driven reconstruction approaches offer efficient and differentiable physical reconstruction, but they typically rely on axial springs alone. Such formulations oversimplify the underlying structural mechanics and can become mechanically under-constrained when the physical graph is coarsened, limiting their ability to preserve stable local deformation. We present BendTwin, a bending-aware differentiable spring--mass framework for video-based reconstruction and future prediction of deformable objects. BendTwin introduces bending stiffness and damping over local surface triplets, penalizing deviations from rest angles and regularizing higher-order deformation. These bending constraints improve mechanical stability while preserving the simplicity of spring--mass system. Experiments show that BendTwin consistently outperforms the axial-only PhysTwin baseline. Ablation studies further demonstrate that the bending constraints maintain system stability across different downsampling ratios and consistently improve upon the original PhysTwin formulation. Overall, BendTwin provides an effective approach for constructing mechanically faithful digital twins from sparse-view RGB-D videos.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BendTwin，一种面向视频观测的、具有弯曲感知的可微弹簧-质量 (spring-mass) 物理重建框架，用于可变形物体的稀疏视角 RGB-D 重建与未来状态预测。BendTwin 在局部表面三元组上引入弯曲刚度与阻尼，惩罚偏离静止角度的形变并正则化高阶形变，以弥补仅依赖轴向弹簧的 PhysTwin 基线在结构力学上的过度简化与欠约束问题。实验表明 BendTwin 在多个指标上持续优于轴向-only 的 PhysTwin 基线，并且消融实验显示弯曲约束在不同下采样比例下均能维持系统稳定性。
Motivation: 现有基于弹簧-质量的物理驱动重建方法通常只使用轴向弹簧，这种公式过度简化了底层结构力学，当物理图被粗化时系统会变得机械上欠约束，难以保持稳定的局部形变，限制了基于视频的物理一致动态预测。
Method: BendTwin 提出弯曲感知的可微弹簧-质量框架：在局部表面三元组上引入弯曲刚度和阻尼，通过惩罚静止角度偏差并正则化高阶形变来增强力学稳定性，同时保留弹簧-质量系统的简洁性。
Result: 实验显示 BendTwin 一致优于仅轴向的 PhysTwin 基线；消融研究表明弯曲约束能在不同下采样比例下维持系统稳定性，并持续改进原始 PhysTwin 公式。
Conclusion: BendTwin 为从稀疏视角 RGB-D 视频构建力学保真的数字孪生 (digital twin) 提供了有效途径，其弯曲约束在维持弹簧-质量系统简洁性的同时改善了稳定性和形变保真度。
Relevance: 0
