papers.title: iARCS: Iterative Agentic RL for Controllable 3D Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic 3D scene generation is increasingly used as a data source for computer vision and embodied AI, but existing generators often optimize perceptual realism without reliably satisfying task-critical functional constraints. This mismatch limits the usefulness of synthetic data for downstream training, where accessibility, traversability, and spatial rule compliance are often essential. We present iARCS, an iterative agentic reinforcement learning framework that adapts a pretrained scene generator to natural-language task requirements. iARCS uses a two-stage strategy: universal-reward pretraining to improve physical plausibility and layout quality, followed by task-specific fine-tuning with LLM-generated reward programs that are iteratively refined from training feedback. Experiments show improved constraint fidelity on walkability, reachability, and clearance-focused tasks, effective task-specific constraint optimization, and competitive scene diversity. We further show that data generated by iARCS improves a base generator, supporting its value as a practical synthetic data generation tool rather than only a controllable scene editing method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 iARCS，一个迭代式智能体强化学习 (iterative agentic RL) 框架，用于将预训练的场景生成器适配到自然语言任务需求上。框架采用两阶段策略：通用奖励预训练提升物理合理性与布局质量，随后用 LLM 生成的奖励程序进行任务特定微调，并根据训练反馈迭代优化。实验显示该方法在可步行性、可达性和净空等约束任务上改善约束保真度，同时保持有竞争力的场景多样性。
Motivation: 现有合成 3D 场景生成器通常只优化感知真实感，而不能可靠满足任务关键的 functional constraints，例如可达性、可穿越性和空间规则符合性，这限制了合成数据在下游训练中的实用性。
Method: iARCS 使用两阶段训练策略：首先进行 universal-reward pretraining 以改进物理合理性和布局质量；然后通过 LLM 生成的奖励程序进行任务特定微调，这些奖励程序会根据训练反馈被迭代细化。
Result: 实验表明 iARCS 在 walkability、reachability 和 clearance 任务上提升了约束保真度，实现了有效的任务特定约束优化，并保持有竞争力的场景多样性；此外，iARCS 生成的数据能够改进基础生成器。
Conclusion: 作者认为 iARCS 的实用价值在于作为合成数据生成工具，而不仅是可控场景编辑方法。

papers.title: Verifiable Regularity Criterion for Conditional Expectation Operators and Conditional Mean Embeddings with Applications to Nonparametric Regression, Bayesian Inverse Problems, and Koopman Operators
papers.abstract_en: Conditional expectation operators (CEOs) and their associated conditional mean embeddings (CMEs) play a central role across applied mathematics and machine learning, appearing in nonparametric regression, Bayesian inverse problems, and Koopman operator theory. A fundamental question is when a CEO maps a function space on $\mathcal{Y}$ into a prescribed function space on $\mathcal{X}$, particularly a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). We show that such mapping properties are characterized by the regularity of the Radon--Nikodym density of the conditional law, and establish a simple, verifiable sufficient condition under which the CEO is bounded and Hilbert--Schmidt. For RKHSs norm-equivalent to Sobolev spaces, this condition reduces to Sobolev regularity of the conditional density. The result yields a direct route to validate CME representations and error bounds for Galerkin-type and CME-based estimators. We verify the regularity condition in three settings: nonparametric regression, Bayesian inverse problems, and Koopman operator theory for stochastic dynamical systems. We show in each case that classical regularity results on the underlying probabilistic model imply the required mapping properties. The resulting framework offers a unified perspective on conditional expectation operators across probability, operator theory, kernel methods, and stochastic dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究条件期望算子（CEO）及其条件均值嵌入（CME）的映射性质，核心问题是一个 CEO 何时把 Y 上的函数空间映射到 X 上给定的函数空间，尤其是再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）。作者证明这类映射性质由条件律的 Radon--Nikodym 密度的正则性刻画，并给出一个简单可验证的充分条件，使得 CEO 有界且为 Hilbert--Schmidt 算子；当 RKHS 与 Sobolev 空间范数等价时，该条件退化为条件密度的 Sobolev 正则性。文中在非参数回归、贝叶斯反问题和随机动力系统的 Koopman 算子理论三个场景中验证了该正则性条件，为 CME 表示和 Galerkin 型估计量的误差界提供了统一验证路径。
Motivation: 条件期望算子和条件均值嵌入在非参数回归、贝叶斯反问题与 Koopman 算子理论中广泛应用，但一个基本问题——CEO 何时把函数空间映射到指定空间（特别是 RKHS）——缺乏统一且可验证的刻画。
Method: 以条件律的 Radon--Nikodym 密度的正则性刻画 CEO 的映射性质，建立 CEO 有界且为 Hilbert--Schmidt 的简单可验证充分条件；在 RKHS 与 Sobolev 空间范数等价的情形下将条件简化为条件密度的 Sobolev 正则性，并分别在三个应用场景中验证该条件。
Result: 摘要报告该条件在非参数回归、贝叶斯反问题和随机动力系统的 Koopman 算子理论中均成立，且经典的底层概率模型正则性结果即可蕴含所需的映射性质，从而支撑 CME 表示与估计器的误差界。
Conclusion: 该框架从概率、算子理论、核方法和随机动力学角度为条件期望算子提供统一视角，重点强调可验证的正则性条件作为核心贡献。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Visual Grounding in Zero-Shot Vision-Language Control
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as zero-shot controllers, but successful trajectories do not necessarily show that decisions are grounded in visual input: simulator dynamics and conservative action priors can produce favourable scores without meaningful perception. We investigate this with an input-ablation battery: blind-image controls, repeated identical inputs, lane-axis reflection, non-visual baselines, and pipeline-integrity checks. Across nine direct-action models, six structured local VLMs, and an exploratory VLM-MPC hierarchy, we analyse 32,874 scored calls over two embodiments and three simulators. The direct-control results are largely negative: a constant-SLOW policy outperforms a scripted geometric controller, several models are image-invariant or nearly constant, and models that recognize longitudinal hazards still fail to transform LEFT and RIGHT under reflection. No local VLM meets the joint longitudinal and lateral grounding criteria. However, an image-only deterministic positive control estimates the lead gap with 0.090 m MAE and exact mirror equivariance, confirming the stimuli carry sufficient visual information; the failures are modular, not universal. A post-hoc, leakage-controlled symmetry-consensus guardian selects two models from 16 calibration frames and freezes a 2-of-4 hazard vote across original and reflected views. On 272 held-out frames it reaches 0.954 balanced accuracy (episode-cluster bootstrap 95% CI [0.895,0.990]); nested leave-one-episode-out recovers the same pair and threshold in all 12 folds. Abstaining on ties raises committed balanced accuracy to 0.973 at 0.824 coverage. With deterministic perception retaining lateral authority, offline modular replay achieves 0.934 action agreement and exact mirror equivariance. These results support current VLMs as bounded, selective hazard assistants, not monolithic zero-shot controllers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）作为零样本控制器时，其决策是否真正接地于视觉输入。作者使用盲图像控制、重复输入、车道轴反射、非视觉基线和管道完整性检查等输入消融实验，在多个直接控制模型、结构化局部VLM及VLM-MPC层级上分析了32,874次评分调用。结果表明直接控制大体负面，但图像专用确定性正对照证实视觉刺激信息充分；随后提出的事后、泄漏控制的对称一致性守护机制在272个保留帧上达到0.954平衡准确率。
Motivation: VLM作为零样本控制器的成功轨迹并不一定说明决策基于视觉：模拟器动力学和保守动作先验可能在缺乏有意义感知的情况下产生良好得分。需要系统性地检验决策是否真正依赖视觉输入。
Method: 提出一套输入消融测试（盲图像控制、重复相同输入、车道轴反射、非视觉基线、管道完整性检查），并构建一个事后、泄漏控制的对称一致性守护机制：从16个校准帧中选出两个模型，冻结原始视图与反射视图上的2-of-4危险投票，平局时弃权。
Result: 直接控制结果大多为负面：恒定SLOW策略优于脚本化几何控制器，多个模型表现图像不变或近乎恒定，能识别纵向危险的模型在反射下无法转换LEFT和RIGHT。图像专用确定性正对照估计前车间距MAE为0.090 m且具有精确镜像等变性；守护机制在272个保持帧上达到0.954平衡准确率（95% CI [0.895,0.990]），平局弃权时提升到0.973（覆盖率0.824），离线模块化重放达到0.934动作一致性和精确镜像等变性。
Conclusion: 作者认为当前VLM应被视为有边界、有选择性的危险辅助工具，而非整体式零样本控制器；失败是模块化的而非普遍的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Globally Reusable Skills for Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Automated skill evolution enables Large Language Model (LLM) agents to continuously improve without expensive retraining. However, existing approaches typically treat skill evolution as a sequence of local updates, overlooking relationships among skills and often producing overfitted skill updates that fail to generalize across tasks. We propose GSE, a globalized skill evolution framework that jointly optimizes skill compatibility and skill generalization. To preserve consistency across the skill bank, GSE maintains a Skill Relation Graph (SRG) that explicitly models and co-evolves inter-skill relationships. To improve generalization, GSE performs cluster-based skill consolidation to abstract reusable capabilities from local updates and employs replay-driven verification to prevent overfitting and behavioral regressions. We evaluate GSE on two representative software engineering tasks: bug-revealing test generation and false-positive bug report filtering. Across two state-of-the-art coding agents, OpenHands and mini-SWE-agent, GSE consistently achieves the best precision, recall, and F1-score. Compared with existing evolution techniques, GSE improves precision and recall by 6.1%~34.1% and 31.8%~180.0% for test generation, and by 15.4%~96.4% and 13.1%~19.8% for false-positive filtering. Deployment on an internal industrial agent further yields a 61.4% improvement in F1-score, demonstrating the effectiveness and generalizability of GSE for evolving effective skills.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GSE（globalized skill evolution）框架，用于让 LLM 驱动的编码智能体以全局方式进化技能，而不是像现有方法那样做局部更新。GSE 通过技能关系图显式建模技能间关联，并利用基于聚类的技能整合与回放驱动的验证来提升泛化、抑制过拟合。在 bug 触发测试生成和误报 bug 报告过滤两个软件工程任务上，配合 OpenHands 与 mini-SWE-agent，GSE 在 precision、recall 和 F1-score 上均取得最佳结果。
Motivation: 现有自动技能进化方法通常把技能更新视为一系列局部更新，忽略技能之间的关系，容易产生过拟合的更新，难以跨任务泛化。
Method: 提出 GSE 框架，联合优化技能兼容性和技能泛化：维护一个技能关系图（Skill Relation Graph, SRG）来显式建模并协同演化技能间关系；通过基于聚类的技能整合从局部更新中抽象可复用能力；采用回放驱动的验证（replay-driven verification）防止过拟合与行为回退。
Result: 在 bug 触发测试生成与误报 bug 报告过滤两个任务上，GSE 在 OpenHands 和 mini-SWE-agent 上均取得最优 precision、recall 和 F1-score。相比已有进化技术，测试生成的 precision 和 recall 分别提升 6.1%~34.1% 和 31.8%~180.0%；误报过滤分别提升 15.4%~96.4% 和 13.1%~19.8%；部署到内部工业智能体后 F1-score 提升 61.4%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 GSE 在多种编码智能体与软件工程任务上展现了有效性，并强调了其技能进化能力的泛化性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Reducing belief in conspiracy theories as they unfold using large language models
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of conspiracy theories in the wake of major events is a significant societal challenge. Here we test whether conversational dialogues with a large language model (LLM) can reduce belief in immediately unfolding conspiracies. In experiments conducted in the days following the July 2024 assassination attempt on Donald Trump and the September 2025 assassination of Charlie Kirk, U.S. adults (Experiment 1: N = 472; Experiment 2: N = 1035) holding conspiratorial views about the crisis event engaged in a multi-turn conversation with an LLM prompted to reduce their conspiracy belief. Compared to control participants who either discussed an irrelevant topic with an LLM or viewed a static fact sheet, participants in the LLM treatment showed significantly reduced conspiracy beliefs in both experiments. We also found evidence of downstream effects of the LLM treatment, observing reduced belief in different conspiracies one to two months later in the wake of subsequent crisis events. These results shed light on the psychology of emerging conspiracies and highlight the potential for scalable, cognitively-focused interventions to counteract misinformation in the immediate aftermath of high-profile societal events.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过两项在美国成年人中进行的实验（实验1 N=472，实验2 N=1035），检验大语言模型（LLM）的多轮对话能否降低人们对当时正在发酵的阴谋论的信念。实验分别在2024年7月特朗普遇刺未遂和2025年9月Charlie Kirk遇刺事件后的数天内开展，参与者均对相关危机事件持阴谋论观点。与对照组（与LLM讨论无关话题或浏览静态事实清单）相比，LLM处理组在两个实验中均显著降低了阴谋论信念，并且在后续一至两个月后的其他危机事件中仍观察到对其它阴谋论信念的减弱效应。
Motivation: 重大事件后阴谋论迅速涌现是重要的社会挑战，现有干预手段往往难以在事件发生的即时窗口内规模化应用，因此需要一种可扩展且聚焦认知的干预方式来应对即时错误信息。
Method: 采用被提示去降低阴谋论信念的多轮对话式LLM作为干预手段；两名实验中，持有相关阴谋论观点的美国成年人与该LLM进行多次对话，并以与LLM讨论无关话题或阅读静态事实清单作为对照。
Result: 两个实验中，LLM治疗组相比两种对照组都显著降低了阴谋论信念；此外还有下游效应，即在一至两个月后的后续危机事件中，参与者对其他不同阴谋论的信念也有所降低。
Conclusion: 结果表明，LLM驱动的对话式干预有潜力在重大社会事件发生后立即提供可扩展、聚焦认知的干预，并为理解新兴阴谋论的心理机制提供启示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CogVis: Must Open-Vocabulary Change Detection Perceive the Scene Anew for Every Query?
papers.abstract_en: Earth-surface monitoring requires change detection models capable of recognizing arbitrary semantic categories. Open-Vocabulary Change Detection (OVCD) addresses this need. However, existing methods often entangle temporal perception, semantic discrimination, and region verification, causing unstable results and redundant computation. Inspired by human visual change perception, we propose CogVis, a cognitive memory-guided framework that reformulates OVCD as a perception-memory-verification paradigm. CogVis first employs a Scene Change Perceptron (SCP) to extract a reusable, category-agnostic change prior from frozen bi-temporal features, thereby decoupling temporal evidence from semantic category decisions. A Semantic Memory Calibrator (SMC) then compensates for category-dependent score shifts by dynamically estimating an image-query-specific decision threshold. Finally, an Adaptive Region Filter (ARF) filters connected candidates using learned semantic, temporal, and structural reliability. Experiments on seven benchmarks spanning semantic change detection, binary change localization, and building-damage assessment show that CogVis achieves state-of-the-art performance across all evaluated datasets. By sharing scene-level change perception, CogVis further avoids repeating category-agnostic temporal perception across queries and improves inference throughput by 28.50%.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 11 figures, including 3 supplementary figures. Code: https://github.com/KotlinWang/CogVis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CogVis，一个认知记忆引导的开放词汇变化检测 (Open-Vocabulary Change Detection, OVCD) 框架，将任务重表述为感知-记忆-验证 (perception-memory-verification) 范式。CogVis 先用 Scene Change Perceptron (SCP) 从冻结的双时相特征中提取可复用且与类别无关的变化先验，再用 Semantic Memory Calibrator (SMC) 动态估计图像-查询特定的决策阈值，最后由 Adaptive Region Filter (ARF) 基于语义、时间和结构可靠性过滤候选区域。在七个基准数据集上该方法均取得最佳性能，并将推理吞吐量提升 28.50%。
Motivation: 现有 OVCD 方法常把时间感知、语义判别和区域验证纠缠在一起，导致结果不稳定且计算冗余；地球表面监测需要能识别任意语义类别的变化检测模型，因此有必要解耦这些因素。
Method: 提出三个模块：SCP 从冻结的双时相特征中提取类别无关的可复用变化先验，解耦时间证据与语义类别决策；SMC 补偿类别相关的分数偏移，动态估计图像-查询特定的决策阈值；ARF 利用学习的语义、时间和结构可靠性过滤连通候选。
Result: 在涵盖语义变化检测、二元变化定位和建筑损伤评估的七个基准数据集上，CogVis 均达到当前最优 (state-of-the-art) 性能；通过共享场景级变化感知避免跨查询重复类别无关的时间感知，推理吞吐量提升 28.50%。
Conclusion: 作者将该范式类比于人类视觉变化感知，并强调共享场景级变化感知能够在不牺牲精度的前提下减少冗余计算、提升推理效率。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: PaDoc: Layout-Grounded Parallel Decoding for Document Parsing
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end document parsers provide a unified interface, but serialize page layouts and regional contents into one autoregressive sequence. This formulation forces independent regions onto a decoding path whose length grows with the total content, whereas crop-based two-stage parsers expose region-level parallelism at the cost of repeated visual prefills and fragmented page context. To retain full-page context while removing dependencies, we propose PaDoc, a layout-grounded parser that treats the predicted layout as a branching structure over a shared page representation. Under a region-sufficiency assumption, we derive a prefix-conditioned factorization in which the layout stream and regional content branches advance concurrently, reducing the decoding depth to the longest layout-content path. We realize this factorization within a single MLLM: packed variable-length ancestor attention preserves the visibility under standard next-token training, while masked parallel decoding creates branches that the evaluated vLLM backend serves as concurrent requests with cache-resident shared-prefix reuse. On OmniDocBench Full, PaDoc attains an Overall layout F1 of 91.1 and, among end-to-end parsers, a top-tier Overall score of 94.24 together with the best Text Edit (0.038) and Formula CDM (95.59). On a 384-page subset and one A800 GPU, it is the fastest end-to-end parser at five concurrency levels, improving valid-page throughput by 67.4-118% and reducing P95 latency by 39.2-54.9% relative to a same-backbone Sequential SFT baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/Longin-Yu/Padoc
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PaDoc，一种基于版面结构 (layout-grounded) 的端到端文档解析器，将预测到的版面视为共享页面表示上的分支结构。在区域充分性 (region-sufficiency) 假设下，作者推导出前缀条件分解，使版面流与区域内容分支并发推进，从而将解码深度降低到最长版面-内容路径；该分解在单个多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 中实现，通过打包的可变长度祖先注意力和掩码并行解码，由 vLLM 后端作为并发请求处理并复用缓存中的共享前缀。在 OmniDocBench Full 上，PaDoc 取得 Overall 版面 F1 91.1，端到端解析器中的 Overall 分数 94.24，并获得最优 Text Edit (0.038) 与 Formula CDM (95.59)。
Motivation: 端到端文档解析器将页面版面与区域内容序列化为单条自回归解码路径，导致相互独立的区域被迫串行解码，且路径长度随总内容增长；而基于裁剪的两阶段解析器虽能提供区域级并行，却需要重复的视觉预填充并破坏页面上下文完整性。目标是既保留全页上下文又消除区域间的解码依赖。
Method: PaDoc 将预测版面作为共享页面表示上的分支结构，在区域充分性假设下推导出前缀条件分解，使版面流和各区域内容分支并发推进。实现上采用单一 MLLM：打包的可变长度祖先注意力 (packed variable-length ancestor attention) 在标准 next-token 训练下保持可见性，掩码并行解码 (masked parallel decoding) 产生分支，并由 vLLM 后端作为并发请求服务，复用缓存中的共享前缀。
Result: 在 OmniDocBench Full 上，PaDoc 的 Overall 版面 F1 为 91.1，端到端解析器中的 Overall 分数达 94.24，Text Edit 为 0.038、Formula CDM 为 95.59，均为最优。在 384 页子集和单张 A800 GPU 上，PaDoc 在五种并发级别下都是最快的端到端解析器，相对于同骨干网络的 Sequential SFT 基线，有效页吞吐量提升 67.4%-118%，P95 延迟降低 39.2%-54.9%。
Conclusion: PaDoc 表明，将版面作为分支结构并结合共享前缀复用，可以在保留全页上下文的同时获得区域级并行，显著降低端到端文档解析的解码深度与延迟。其有效性建立在区域充分性假设之上，实验范围主要为 OmniDocBench 基准与 vLLM 服务后端。

papers.title: FinEvo-Bench: A Longitudinal Benchmark for Self-Evolving Agents in Professional Financial Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Most agent benchmarks evaluate tasks independently and cannot measure whether experience from one task helps with later tasks. Existing self-evolution benchmarks do not jointly cover professional workflows, open-ended deliverables, and multi-aspect evaluation. We introduce FinEvo-Bench, a longitudinal benchmark with 120 real-case-grounded tasks, 20 business scenes across six financial domains. Institution-provided professional procedures define the required operations and constraints. Eligible institution-provided and publicly documented cases supply the task facts. Each scene contains six related but substantively distinct cases that share a professional procedure and a manually reviewed rubric for task quality and financial compliance. We compare four self-evolving agent scaffolds using the same Qwen3.7-Max backbone and three independently shuffled, globally interleaved task streams. Paired non-evolving controls estimate each scaffold's self-evolution gain from retained experience, while an independent Claude Code scoring agent backed by Claude Opus 4.6 evaluates all outputs. Letta achieves the highest evolved score (91.65) and fewest compliance issues (0.09 per task); Codex achieves the largest self-evolution gain (+19.37). Across scaffolds, the evolving condition raises scores by 9.33-19.37 points and reduces compliance issues by 0.12-0.44 per task. Paired score gains at within-scene ranks 4-6 exceed those at ranks 1-3 by 6.10-8.70 points. In Claude Code, skill-only evolution produces higher task quality and fewer compliance issues than memory-only and combined memory-skill evolution. Across all four scaffolds, rubric feedback also yields higher scores and fewer compliance issues than reference-answer feedback. FinEvo-Bench measures both professional performance and self-evolution ability: how effectively an agent turns prior experience into later improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FinEvo-Bench，一个面向专业金融工作流中自进化智能体 (self-evolving agent) 的纵向基准，包含来自六个金融领域 20 个业务场景的 120 个真实案例任务。作者用同一 Qwen3.7-Max 主干比较四种自进化脚手架，并在三条独立打乱的任务流上评估；结果显示进化条件普遍提升得分并减少合规问题，其中 Letta 取得最高进化得分 (91.65)，Codex 取得最大自进化增益 (+19.37)。基准同时考察专业表现与智能体将先前经验转化为后续改进的能力。
Motivation: 现有智能体基准大多独立评估任务，无法衡量一个任务的经验是否有助于后续任务；已有的自进化基准也没有同时覆盖专业工作流、开放式交付物和多维度评估这三个方面。
Method: 构建 FinEvo-Bench，以机构提供的专业流程定义操作与约束，用机构提供或公开记录的案件作为任务事实；每个场景含六个共享流程且实质不同的案例，并配有手工审核的评分 rubric。实验比较四种自进化脚手架，使用三条全局交错的任务流，配对非进化对照估计自进化增益，并由独立的 Claude Code 评分智能体 (基于 Claude Opus 4.6) 评估所有输出。
Result: Letta 达到最高进化得分 91.65 且每任务合规问题最少 (0.09)；Codex 获得最大自进化增益 (+19.37)。进化条件使得分提升 9.33-19.37 点，并将每任务合规问题减少 0.12-0.44；场景内排名 4-6 的配对得分增益比排名 1-3 高 6.10-8.70 点。在 Claude Code 中，仅技能进化优于仅记忆进化和记忆-技能联合进化；四种脚手架下，rubric 反馈也比参考答案反馈带来更高得分和更少合规问题。
Conclusion: FinEvo-Bench 能够同时度量专业工作流表现和自进化能力，即智能体把先前经验有效转化为后续改进的程度。

papers.title: Learning visual representations for compositional analysis of artworks and photographs
papers.abstract_en: Composition, the deliberate arrangement of visual elements, is central to how meaning, emotion, and aesthetic quality are conveyed in artwork, yet it remains among the least formalized dimensions of visual understanding. Prior work highlights a persistent gap in learning meaningful compositional representations, attributing it to semantic bias and suggesting that human-inspired approaches may be key. We compare two parallel paradigms for composition analysis: a human-inspired method grounded in perceptual grouping, and fine-tuned foundation models enabled by recent large-scale compositional datasets. The human-inspired approach uses object-centric models for region-level decomposition and a graph attention network to capture spatial relationships between elements. Both paradigms are evaluated on composition score/category prediction, compositional image retrieval, and visual saliency detection. With frozen encoders, the human-inspired method achieves competitive performance while remaining interpretable. When sufficient data enables fine-tuning, large self-supervised models outperform significantly, but at the cost of interpretability and cross-domain generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对艺术与照片中构图（composition）这一语义维度难以形式化的问题，比较了两条并行路线：基于知觉分组（perceptual grouping）的人类启发式方法，以及借助大规模构图数据集微调的基础模型（foundation models）。人类启发式方法利用以物体为中心的模型做区域级分解，并用图注意力网络（graph attention network）捕捉元素间空间关系。在构图分数/类别预测、构图图像检索与视觉显著性检测上，冻结编码器时该方法的性能有竞争力且可解释；数据充足时微调的大规模自监督模型显著更优，但牺牲了可解释性与跨域泛化。
Motivation: 构图是艺术作品中传达意义、情感与美学质量的核心，但仍是视觉理解中形式化程度最低的维度之一。已有工作指出学习有意义的构图表示存在持续缺口，并将其归因于语义偏置（semantic bias），认为人类启发的建模思路可能是关键。
Method: 本文对比两种构图分析范式：一是植根于知觉分组的人类启发式方法，使用以物体为中心的模型进行区域级分解，并用图注意力网络建模元素间的空间关系；二是利用近期大规模构图数据集微调的基础模型。两者统一在构图分数/类别预测、构图图像检索和视觉显著性检测三个任务上评估。
Result: 在冻结编码器（frozen encoders）条件下，人类启发式方法达到有竞争力的性能并保持可解释性；当数据量足以微调时，大规模自监督模型显著超越前者，但代价是可解释性与跨域泛化能力下降。
Conclusion: 作者指出构图表示学习中存在可解释性/跨域泛化与性能之间的权衡：人类启发式方法在低资源设置下更具吸引力，而微调基础模型在数据充足时更强但更不透明。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SkillTFM: Gated Skill Evolution for Training-Free Adaptation of Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Tabular data are ubiquitous in real-world applications and are crucial for data-driven prediction and decision-making across science, industry, finance, healthcare, and public services. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose tabular learning, offering reusable predictors across diverse datasets and substantially reducing the need for task-specific training, tuning, and model development. However, their practical deployment remains constrained by distribution shifts, heterogeneous feature semantics, and task-specific patterns that are difficult to capture without costly fine-tuning or additional labeled data. To this end, we propose SkillTFM, a training-free system that shifts TFM adaptation from parameter updates to the gated evolution of agentic skills. The core of SkillTFM is a verifiable and extensible skill bank that couples boundary evidence identification with gated skill evolution: the former characterizes task structure and base-model failure patterns, whereas the latter retrieves and extends reusable skills subject to explicit validation. Across simulated boundary settings and real-world electricity-price forecasting, SkillTFM improves AUC by 0.128--0.142, raises nonlinear-boundary AUC from 0.699 to 0.898. Furthermore, experiments across TFM backbones demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of SkillTFM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillTFM 提出一种无需训练 (training-free) 的表格基础模型 (tabular foundation model) 适配系统，将分布偏移下的模型适配从参数更新转变为带门控的技能演化 (gated skill evolution)。其核心是一个可验证、可扩展的技能库，将边界证据识别与门控技能演化结合，以刻画任务结构和基础模型失败模式，并在显式验证下检索和扩展可复用技能。摘要报告在模拟边界设置和真实电价预测任务上显著提升 AUC，并在多种 TFM 主干上验证了有效性与泛化性。
Motivation: 表格基础模型虽有可复用预测能力，但在实际部署中受分布偏移、异构特征语义和任务特定模式限制，难以在不昂贵微调或额外标注的情况下适应新任务。
Method: SkillTFM 构建可验证且可扩展的技能库，通过边界证据识别 (boundary evidence identification) 描述任务结构和基础模型的失败模式，再通过门控技能演化 (gated skill evolution) 显式验证并扩展可复用技能，从而在不更新参数的情况下完成适配。
Result: 在模拟边界设置和真实电价预测 (electricity-price forecasting) 场景中，AUC 提升 0.128–0.142，非线性边界 AUC 从 0.699 提升至 0.898；跨 TFM 主干的实验显示该方法有效且具备泛化性。
Conclusion: 作者认为将 TFM 适配从参数更新转向经门控和验证的技能演化，能够有效且通用地缓解分布偏移与任务异构带来的部署瓶颈。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: LLM Inference Under Bursty Workload Distribution: Modifying the WAIT Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT and Claude are widely used for information retrieval and problem-solving. Recent work has focused on improving scheduling algorithms to boost throughput while maintaining low latency. However, these approaches often assume Poisson request arrivals with constant rates - an assumption that fails to reflect the inherently bursty and dynamic nature of real-world traffic. We propose a lightweight extension to the state-of-the-art WAIT algorithm [1], which adapts to time-varying arrival rates without prior traffic knowledge. The proposed algorithm performs online estimation of request intensity based on observed interarrival times. Using Markov Modulated Poisson Process (MMPP)-based synthetic workloads with diverse request types, we conduct a simulation-based evaluation demonstrating that the proposed method achieves higher throughput than Sarathi-Serve [2], ORCA [3], and vLLM [4] in the evaluated low arrival-rate shift scenarios while maintaining comparable latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）推理调度中假设泊松到达率的问题，提出对 WAIT 调度算法的轻量级扩展，使其能适应时变且突发性的请求到达模式。算法仅基于观测到的请求间隔时间做在线强度估计，并在 Markov Modulated Poisson Process (MMPP) 合成负载上模拟评估，声称在低到达率偏移场景下吞吐量高于 Sarathi-Serve、ORCA 和 vLLM，且延迟相当。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 推理调度算法常假设请求服从恒定速率的泊松到达，但真实流量具有突发性和动态性，该假设不成立，需要无需先验流量知识即可适应时变到达率的调度方法。
Method: 提出 WAIT 算法的轻量级扩展：根据观测到的请求间隔时间（interarrival times）在线估计请求强度，从而让调度策略随到达率变化自适应，无需提前知道流量分布。
Result: 基于 MMPP 合成工作负载、包含多种请求类型的仿真评估显示，在评估的低到达率偏移场景（low arrival-rate shift）下，该方法相比 Sarathi-Serve、ORCA 和 vLLM 获得更高吞吐量，同时延迟相当。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该方法能提升突发负载下 LLM 推理的吞吐量并保持延迟，但评估限于合成 MMPP 负载的仿真环境。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hardware Keystores for AI Agent Signing Workflows: A Zero-Trust MCP Enforcement Architecture
papers.abstract_en: AI agents performing cryptographic operations (signing Git commits, authenticating API calls, issuing certificates) currently store private keys in software-accessible locations: plaintext files, environment variables, or container memory. Any process with sufficient read privileges can extract the raw key material. A recent production incident demonstrated the practical severity: private keys were exfiltrated from a widely deployed framework via email injection in under five minutes. We aim to enforce both key confidentiality and content-aware authorisation for key use. To that end, we replace software-resident keys with hardware-confined keys accessible through a vendor-neutral PKCS#11 interface. A hardware keystore (HSM, TPM, smart card) executes cryptographic operations on-device; the host receives only the result via opaque handles. Hardware confinement is the primary contribution; it is enabled by a surrounding five-layer Zero-Trust enforcement stack comprising session identity (SAGA), scope bounds (Smax), semantic validation (RAV), taint tracking, and the hardware execution boundary. We evaluate against 12 injection scenarios derived from AgentDojo's ImportantInstructionsAttack template (Debenedetti et al., arXiv:2406.13352). We run four LLM models; three follow injections in baseline mode (gpt-oss-120b, Qwen2.5-72B, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, n=192 combined). Baseline Attack Success Rate (ASR): 19.3% [14.3%, 25.4%]; protected ASR: 0% (Wilson 95% CI upper bound 2.0%). Zero false positives across four benign task scenarios.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures. Accompanying code and artifacts available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Hardware-Keystores-for-AI-Agent-Signing-Workflows-Artifact-357C
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AI 智能体执行密码学操作时私钥存放在软件可访问位置（明文文件、环境变量、容器内存）的安全问题，提出将密钥迁移到硬件安全模块（HSM、TPM、智能卡）中，并通过供应商中立的 PKCS#11 接口访问，主机只获得不透明的句柄。作者称硬件约束是主要贡献，并配套设计了包含会话身份（SAGA）、作用域边界（Smax）、语义校验（RAV）、污点追踪和硬件执行边界在内的五层零信任（Zero-Trust）强制架构。摘要报告在基于 AgentDojo ImportantInstructionsAttack 模板的 12 种注入场景上，基线攻击成功率（ASR）为 19.3%，受保护后为 0%。
Motivation: 当前 AI 智能体签署 Git 提交、认证 API 调用、签发证书时，私钥存储于软件可访问处，任何具有足够读权限的进程都能提取原始密钥材料。一次生产事故显示，私钥在不到五分钟内通过邮件注入从广泛部署的框架中被窃取，说明同时需要密钥机密性和基于内容的密钥使用授权。
Method: 用硬件受限密钥替换软件驻留密钥，密钥在硬件中执行密码学操作，主机仅通过不透明句柄获得结果；硬件访问基于供应商中立的 PKCS#11 接口。配套方法是一个五层零信任强制栈，包括会话身份（SAGA）、作用域边界（Smax）、语义验证（RAV）、污点追踪（taint tracking）和硬件执行边界。
Result: 在从 AgentDojo 的 ImportantInstructionsAttack 模板派生的 12 种注入场景中评估，涉及四种 LLM 模型（gpt-oss-120b、Qwen2.5-72B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash，n=192 合并）：基线模式 ASR 为 19.3%（95% CI 14.3%–25.4%），受保护后 ASR 为 0%（Wilson 95% CI 上限 2.0%）；在四个良性任务场景中零误报。
Conclusion: 摘要强调硬件密钥约束是主要贡献，配合多层零信任强制栈可以同时保证密钥机密性和对密钥使用的内容感知授权，并且在不损害良性任务的同时完全阻断所评估的注入攻击。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Contextual Information Policy Optimization for Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: Search agents extend large language models beyond static parametric memory by enabling them to acquire and use ex ternal evidence during multi-step reasoning. For knowledge intensive tasks involving complex or evolving information, their reliability depends not only on retrieving relevant ev idence but also on using it to guide subsequent reasoning. However, existing methods primarily reward final-answer cor rectness or intermediate progress, without directly assessing whether post-retrieval actions are grounded in the retrieved evidence. This misalignment encourages prior-driven reason ing: agents form conclusions based on internal knowledge and use retrieval mainly to confirm them, resulting in confirma tion bias and inefficient evidenceuse.Toaddressthisissue, we propose Contextual Information Policy Optimization (CIPO), an evidence-oriented reinforcement learning framework that explicitly aligns policy optimization with external evidence use. CIPO assigns dense, turn-level credit to reasoning ac tions influenced by retrieved information, while combining this evidence-use signal with a global outcome reward to pre serveanswercorrectness.Withthismanner,CIPOdiscourages evidence-detached guesses and promotes reasoning trajecto ries in which retrieved facts can guide or revise subsequent reasoning. Importantly, CIPO requires neither human process annotations nor an additional reward model. Extensive exper iments on seven in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks show that CIPO reduces the prevalence of prior-driven rea soning and achieves excellent performance on most tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Contextual Information Policy Optimization (CIPO)，一个面向搜索智能体 (search agents) 的、以证据为导向的强化学习框架，用于显式对齐策略优化与外部证据使用。CIPO 为受检索信息影响的推理动作分配稠密的回合级 (turn-level) 信用，并将其与全局结果奖励结合，以在保证答案正确性的同时抑制脱离证据的猜测。在七个领域内与领域外基准上的实验显示，该方法降低了先验驱动推理 (prior-driven reasoning) 的发生率，并在多数任务上表现良好。
Motivation: 现有方法主要奖励最终答案正确性或中间进展，不直接评估检索后动作是否基于检索到的证据，导致智能体依据内部知识先行形成结论、再仅用检索来确认，产生确认偏差和低效的证据使用。
Method: CIPO 是一个面向证据的强化学习框架：它对受检索信息影响的推理动作发放稠密的回合级奖励信号，并将该证据使用信号与全局结果奖励结合；该方法既不需要人工过程标注，也不需要额外的奖励模型。
Result: 在七个领域内和领域外基准上的大量实验表明，CIPO 降低了先验驱动推理的普遍程度，并在大多数任务上取得了很好的性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调，通过直接奖励证据引导的推理轨迹，CIPO 可以鼓励检索到的事实指导或修正后续推理，从而缓解确认偏差；其设计不依赖过程标注或额外奖励模型，适用于知识密集型的多步推理任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Patient Pose Assessment Using a CT-Based Framework for Synthetic Data Generation
papers.abstract_en: An adequate diagnostic quality of radiographs is essential for reliable diagnoses and treatment planning. The patient's pose during radiography is one of the most important factors determining the diagnostic quality. Since patient positioning is difficult and not standardized, an automated AI-based approach using depth images to automatically assess the patient's pose before the radiograph has been taken would be helpful. Due to regulatory hurdles, however, it is difficult in practice to acquire the required depth images and corresponding radiographs. In this paper, we present a framework that can generate such training data synthetically from Computed Tomography scans. We further show that by pretraining on our generated synthetic dataset consisting of 3077 image pairs of upper ankle joints, the pose assessment of real upper ankle joints can be improved by up to 11 percentage points.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the Journal of Machine Learning for Biomedical Imaging (MELBA) https://melba-journal.org/2026:027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 CT 扫描合成生成训练数据的框架，用于在拍片前通过深度图像自动评估患者摆位（pose），因为患者定位困难且缺乏标准化，是影响 X 光片诊断质量的关键因素。摘要报告，在包含 3077 对上踝关节（upper ankle joint）图像对的合成数据集上预训练后，对真实上踝关节的摆位评估准确率最多提升 11 个百分点。
Motivation: 放射影像的诊断质量高度依赖患者拍片时的摆位，而摆位难以标准化；基于深度图像的 AI 自动评估有望在拍片前发现问题，但监管障碍使得实际采集配对的深度图像与 X 光片非常困难。
Method: 提出从 Computed Tomography (CT) 扫描中合成生成所需训练数据的框架，利用生成的包含 3077 对上踝关节图像对的合成数据集进行预训练。
Result: 在合成数据上预训练后，真实上踝关节的摆位评估性能最高提升 11 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者认为从 CT 合成训练数据可以绕开配对数据采集的监管困难，并显著改善真实场景中的摆位评估。

papers.title: Sample-Adaptive Latent Rewards for Uncertainty-Guided Diffusion Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Latent reward models can supervise visual diffusion models without decoding intermediate states into pixel space. This makes alignment with human preferences more efficient. However, existing latent reward models output only scalar scores. They do not estimate the uncertainty of each prediction. The generator therefore cannot determine which feedback is reliable. This can drive optimization in the wrong direction and lead to reward hacking. We propose \textsc{SURE}, a unified latent-space framework for image and video diffusion models. It learns reward distributions and directly uses their reliability to guide dense post-training. First, we propose sample-adaptive latent reward model (\textsc{SURE-LRM}). It predicts a Gaussian utility for each noisy latent. Its mean predicts the reward score. Its variance reflect the uncertainty of prediction without human annotation. The learned distribution then guides post-training through uncertainty-guided reward feedback learning (\textsc{SURE-REFL}). This method provides uncertainty-guided dense feedback along the denoising trajectory. At selected transitions, \textsc{SURE-REFL} queries the frozen \textsc{SURE-LRM}. It converts detached variance into reliability weights for samples at the same transition. Each weighted reward is backpropagated only through its local transition. The entire process remains in latent space and requires neither pixel-space decoding nor the full denoising graph. Experiments show that \textsc{SURE-LRM} improves preference prediction over strong baselines. \textsc{SURE-REFL} achieves the sota performance among various metrics and further improves optimization stability. It also achieves the highest VBench quality, semantic, and total scores among the evaluated methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SURE，一个面向图像和视频扩散模型的统一隐空间框架，用于学习带不确定性的奖励分布并以此指导密集后训练。SURE-LRM 对每个带噪隐变量预测高斯效用，均值作为奖励分数，方差作为无需人工标注的不确定性估计；SURE-REFL 在去噪轨迹的选定转移处查询冻结的 SURE-LRM，将分离的方差转化为可靠性权重，且只需局部反向传播。实验表明 SURE-LRM 提升偏好预测，SURE-REFL 在多种指标上达到 sota，并在 VBench 上获得最高质量、语义和总分。
Motivation: 现有隐空间奖励模型只输出标量分数，不估计预测的不确定性，生成器无法判断哪些反馈可靠，可能使优化方向错误并导致奖励黑客 (reward hacking)。
Method: 提出统一隐空间框架 SURE，包含两个部分：样本自适应隐空间奖励模型 SURE-LRM 预测每个带噪隐变量的高斯效用（均值预测奖励、方差表示不确定性）；不确定性引导的奖励反馈学习 SURE-REFL 沿去噪轨迹提供密集反馈，在选定转移处查询冻结的 SURE-LRM，将分离的方差转换为可靠性权重，每个加权奖励只通过其局部转移反向传播，整个过程不离开隐空间，也不需要完整去噪图。
Result: 摘要报告 SURE-LRM 在偏好预测上超过强基线；SURE-REFL 在多种指标上取得 sota 性能并提升优化稳定性，在 VBench 质量、语义和总分上均达到评估方法中的最高分。
Conclusion: 本文表明通过显式建模隐空间奖励的不确定性并以可靠性权重引导密集后训练，可以改善扩散模型对齐的效果与稳定性；该方法同时适用于图像和视频扩散模型。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 SURE，一个面向图像和视频扩散模型的统一隐空间框架，用于学习带不确定性的奖励分布并以此指导密集后训练。SURE-LRM 对每个带噪隐变量预测高斯效用，均值作为奖励分数，方差作为无需人工标注的不确定性估计；SURE-REFL 在去噪轨迹的选定转移处查询冻结的 SURE-LRM，将分离的方差转化为可靠性权重，且只需局部反向传播。实验表明 SURE-LRM 提升偏好预测，SURE-REFL 在多种指标上达到 sota，并在 VBench 上获得最高质量、语义和总分。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有隐空间奖励模型只输出标量分数，不估计预测的不确定性，生成器无法判断哪些反馈可靠，可能使优化方向错误并导致奖励黑客 (reward hacking)。
summary_sections.method: 提出统一隐空间框架 SURE，包含两个部分：样本自适应隐空间奖励模型 SURE-LRM 预测每个带噪隐变量的高斯效用（均值预测奖励、方差表示不确定性）；不确定性引导的奖励反馈学习 SURE-REFL 沿去噪轨迹提供密集反馈，在选定转移处查询冻结的 SURE-LRM，将分离的方差转换为可靠性权重，每个加权奖励只通过其局部转移反向传播，整个过程不离开隐空间，也不需要完整去噪图。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 SURE-LRM 在偏好预测上超过强基线；SURE-REFL 在多种指标上取得 sota 性能并提升优化稳定性，在 VBench 质量、语义和总分上均达到评估方法中的最高分。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文表明通过显式建模隐空间奖励的不确定性并以可靠性权重引导密集后训练，可以改善扩散模型对齐的效果与稳定性；该方法同时适用于图像和视频扩散模型。

papers.title: Poli-Bias: Understanding and Measuring Large Language Model Biases in International Political Conflicts
papers.abstract_en: Measuring political bias in large language models (LLMs) remains challenging as it can manifest through subtle differences in framing, argumentation, and legal reasoning that are difficult to capture with a single metric. In this work, we introduce Poli-Bias, a counterfactual framework for measuring whether LLMs treat legally equivalent conflict scenarios differently depending on the countries involved. Poli-Bias compares responses to paired prompts in which country identities are systematically swapped across diverse geopolitical relationships, legal violations, and reasoning tasks. Rather than reducing bias to a single judgment, our framework decomposes response disparities into five interpretable dimensions, revealing how and where unequal treatment manifests. Across 13 contemporary LLMs spanning diverse model families and sizes, we find that country identities and user affiliations can systematically affect how equivalent actions are described, evaluated, and defended under international law. Our results thus establish Poli-Bias as a fine-grained framework for auditing political even-handedness and sycophancy in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Poli-Bias，一个用于测量大语言模型（LLM）在国际政治冲突中政治偏见的反事实框架。框架通过在配对提示中系统交换国家身份，比较模型对法律上等价冲突场景的回应差异，并将差异分解为五个可解释维度。作者在 13 个当代 LLM 上验证，发现国家身份和用户归属会系统性地影响模型对同等行为的描述、评价和辩护方式。
Motivation: 现有方法难以捕捉 LLM 政治偏见，因为偏见常体现在框架（framing）、论证（argumentation）和法律推理（legal reasoning）等微妙差异中，单一指标无法刻画。
Method: Poli-Bias 采用反事实框架，将国家身份在多样的地缘政治关系、法律违规类型和推理任务中系统交换，并比较配对提示下的回应差异；不把偏见归结为单一判断，而是将回应差异分解为五个可解释维度。
Result: 在跨越多个模型家族和规模的 13 个当代 LLM 上，国家身份和用户归属会系统性影响模型对国际法下等价行为的描述、评价和辩护。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Poli-Bias 可作为一种细粒度审计框架，用于检查 LLM 的政治公正性（political even-handedness）和谄媚行为（sycophancy）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Is Self-Pretraining really useful to improve diagnosis in medical Time Series?
papers.abstract_en: Inspired by recent evidence that transformer architectures benefit from Self-PreTraining (SPT) on long-context benchmarks, we investigate whether similar gains extend to multimodal, multivariate, and even simple univariate medical time series. Our objective is to assess the impact of SPT on the performance and scalability of transformer-based models across diverse medical applications, particularly under limited data conditions. We evaluate transformer architectures on three representative medical time-series tasks: rehabilitation robotics (Camargo dataset), stress detection (Non-EEG Stress), and Parkinson's disease detection (Gait Parkinson's Disease). Models are trained either from scratch or through SPT using four masking-based objectives designed to promote temporal and cross-modal representation learning, and we systematically vary model depth to examine how capacity interacts with pre-training benefits. Across datasets and configurations, SPT consistently improves classification accuracy by 0-6 percentage points depending on masking strategy, dataset and architecture, with gains observed not only in multivariate settings but also when models are restricted to simple univariate inputs. The improvements increase for deeper models that can better exploit the enriched temporal representations learned during pre-training. These findings indicate that SPT is a simple and general strategy that enhances transformer performance on medical time-series tasks without requiring task-specific architectural changes, supporting its potential to improve robustness and accuracy in data-limited clinical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统考察自预训练 (Self-PreTraining, SPT) 是否能为医学时间序列上的 Transformer 模型带来收益。作者在康复机器人 (Camargo)、压力检测 (Non-EEG Stress) 和帕金森病检测 (Gait Parkinson's Disease) 三个任务上，对比从头训练与使用四种掩码目标进行 SPT 的模型，并变化模型深度。摘要报告 SPT 一致地提升分类准确率 0-6 个百分点，且深层模型获益更大。
Motivation: 受 Transformer 在长上下文基准上从 SPT 获益的启发，作者想验证类似收益是否迁移到多模态、多变量乃至单变量的医学时间序列，尤其是数据有限的场景。
Method: 在三个医学时间序列任务上评估 Transformer：模型分别从头训练或通过四种基于掩码的目标 (masking-based objectives) 进行 SPT，这些目标旨在促进时间维度和跨模态表示学习；同时系统改变模型深度以考察容量与预训练收益的交互。
Result: SPT 在所有数据集和配置下一致提升分类准确率，增益为 0-6 个百分点，取决于掩码策略、数据集和架构；收益不仅出现在多变量设置，也出现在仅用单变量输入的模型中，并且随模型加深而增大。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SPT 是一种简单、通用的策略，无需任务特定的架构改动即可提升医学时间序列任务上的 Transformer 性能，有助于数据受限临床场景下的鲁棒性和准确性。

papers.title: Confidence matters: Leveraging Multi-view Geometric Priors for GS-based Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a widely-used tool for novel view synthesis, offering real-time rendering in a sparse representation. However, the method's reliance on structure-from-motion initialization and photometric optimization can lead to suboptimal geometric reconstruction, particularly for objects with high specularity. In this work, we investigate the integration of geometric priors, in the form of predicted normal and depth maps, into the 3DGS framework to improve the reconstruction quality. We analyze the effect of incorporating these priors into GS-based methods and our evaluation reveals that multi-view predictions, as they are done by the recent visual geometry grounded transformer (VGGT), outperform single-view alternatives. A major factor is the existence of a confidence map for the estimations, which comes as a by-product of multi-view models and which can significantly improve the effectiveness of priors by weighting each prediction appropriately. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks show consistent improvement in reconstruction quality and significant gains in complex scenes including specular objects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) 重建中引入几何先验（预测的法线图和深度图）以改善重建质量。评估显示多视图预测（如 visual geometry grounded transformer, VGGT）优于单视图方案，其附带的置信度图 (confidence map) 可通过对每个预测加权显著提升先验的有效性。标准基准上的实验表明重建质量一致提升，在包含高镜面 (specular) 物体的复杂场景中收益显著。
Motivation: 3DGS 依赖 structure-from-motion 初始化和光度优化，对高镜面物体等场景的几何重建欠佳，因此需要引入几何先验来提升重建质量。
Method: 将预测的法线图和深度图作为几何先验集成进 3DGS 框架，并利用多视图模型（VGGT）估计的置信度图对每个预测进行加权。
Result: 评估发现多视图预测优于单视图替代方案；大量实验显示标准基准上重建质量一致提升，在包含镜面物体的复杂场景中有显著增益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调置信度图是多视图预测带来的关键因素，通过按置信度加权预测可以显著改进先验在 GS-based 重建中的有效性。

papers.title: Mind the Gaps: Mixture-of-Minds for Human Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Predicting how a population will answer a new question is a long-standing goal. Statistical methods succeed at the level of the mass but falter at the level of the individual. Large language model simulators inherit this gap. They recover a population's central tendencies while flattening its heterogeneity, and they carry social biases and prompt brittleness that distort individual predictions. This paper introduces Anacreon, an audience simulation model that targets the individual level within a narrow, well-specified domain. Anacreon learns an authorship embedding that separates individuals, clusters a real qualitative corpus around seed people, and trains a dedicated adapter for each cluster, a mixture of minds, on a Gemma~4 12B base. It harvests demographics, psychological traits, and survey responses from public text, and augments each record with a chain-of-emotion. It reduces prompt brittleness by shuffling response options and reduces positive bias by balancing the training distribution. On a large, externally sourced survey, Anacreon reaches a state-of-the-art ordinal alignment of 0.775, the individual-level accuracy measure on which the field has converged, with a small residual bias. The work is a step toward drawing aggregate insight from faithfully simulated individuals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Anacreon，一个面向个体层面的人类受众模拟 (audience simulation) 模型，目标是在狭窄且定义良好的领域内预测个体如何回答新问题。它以 Gemma 4 12B 为基座，学习作者嵌入 (authorship embedding) 区分个体，对真实定性语料按种子人物聚类，并为每个聚类训练专用适配器 (mixture of minds)；同时从公开文本中提取人口统计、心理特质和调查回复，并为每条记录附加 chain-of-emotion。在外部来源的大规模调查上，Anacreon 的序数对齐 (ordinal alignment) 达到 0.775，达到该领域个体级准确率的 SOTA，且残差偏差较小。
Motivation: 统计方法在群体层面有效但无法刻画个体；LLM 模拟器虽能恢复人群的中心趋势，却抹平了异质性，并带有社会偏见和提示脆弱性 (prompt brittleness)，导致个体预测失真。
Method: Anacreon 通过作者嵌入分离个体，对真实定性语料按种子人物聚类，并为每簇训练专用适配器；从公开文本挖掘人口统计、心理特征和调查回复，给每条记录补充 chain-of-emotion；通过打乱回答选项降低提示脆弱性，并平衡训练分布以降低正向偏差。
Result: 在外部来源的大规模调查上，Anacreon 达到 0.775 的序数对齐，是该个体级准确率指标上的 SOTA，且残差偏差较小。
Conclusion: 该工作是朝向从忠实模拟的个体中获取群体洞察的一步，但方法限定在窄域，摘要未声明更广泛适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Siloed Algorithms to Compliance-First Agentic Platforms: A Multi-Layered Architecture for Hospital AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Hospitals are rapidly adopting artificial intelligence for triage, imaging, scheduling etc., yet most deployments remain isolated point solutions locked inside departmental silos, resulting in duplicated effort, hidden risks, and unrealized enterprise value. Despite explosive growth of AI in healthcare market and accelerating investment, an estimated 70-80% of healthcare AI pilots fail to scale, largely due to governance gaps, fragmented data, and missing integration blueprints. This research proposes a hospital-specific, compliance-first, Agentic AI architecture with multiple interoperable layers, extending existing hospital AI platform models with: (i) an Agent Orchestration Layer for multi-agent workflows across clinical, operational, and financial domains, (ii) a Compliance and Policy Layer that centralizes policy-as-code for HIPAA, GDPR, the EU AI Act, DISHA Act, India's DPDP Act, and ISO/IEC security and safety standards, and (iii) a Privacy-Preserving Data Fabric that plugs federated learning, differential privacy, and secure enclaves into real-world Hospital Information Management System (HIMS) flows. Using a synthetic but structurally realistic hospital dataset and an open, ready-to-deploy prototype implementation, this study demonstrates the end-to-end orchestration of triage risk prediction, workflow optimization, and compliance logging, achieving substantial simulated reductions in task turnaround times and manual documentation effort while maintaining policy-guarded data access. The resulting architecture offers hospital leaders a pragmatic blueprint to move from ad hoc tools to a governed, globally compliant, ROI-focused AI platform that can be tailored to on-premise, hybrid and cloud-native deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向医院的合规优先 (compliance-first) 智能体 AI 架构，针对医院 AI 部署碎片化问题，设计多互操作层：智能体编排层 (Agent Orchestration Layer)、合规与策略层（将 HIPAA、GDPR、EU AI Act、DISHA Act、印度 DPDP Act 及 ISO/IEC 标准以 policy-as-code 集中化）以及隐私保护数据织物 (Privacy-Preserving Data Fabric，集成联邦学习、差分隐私和安全 enclave)。研究使用合成但结构真实的医院数据与开源原型，演示分诊风险预测、工作流优化和合规日志的端到端编排，模拟显示可显著降低任务周转时间和手动文档工作量，同时维持策略管控的数据访问。
Motivation: 医院在分诊、影像、排程等方面快速采用 AI，但多数部署仍是科室孤岛内的单点方案，造成重复投入、隐藏风险和企业价值无法实现；估计 70-80% 的医疗 AI 试点无法规模化，主要归因于治理缺口、碎片化数据与缺少集成蓝图。
Method: 提出医院特有、合规优先的多层可互操作 Agentic AI 架构，扩展现有医院 AI 平台模型，包含跨临床、运营、财务领域的智能体编排层，将多项法规标准实现为 policy-as-code 的合规与策略层，以及把联邦学习、差分隐私和安全 enclave 接入 Hospital Information Management System (HIMS) 流程的隐私保护数据织物。

papers.title: Beyond Sequence Order: Syntax-Informed Positional Embeddings for Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Positional embeddings (PE) in Transformers encode token distance and order but are largely agnostic to \textit{syntactic structure}. We introduce \textbf{S}yntax-\textbf{i}nformed \textbf{P}ositional \textbf{E}mbeddings (\textbf{SiPE}), which learns a lightweight syntactic prior from dependency parses during pretraining and injects it across all three dominant PE families (absolute, relative, rotary), for both encoders and decoders, leaving self-attention and the rest of the architecture untouched. We isolate \emph{where} and \emph{how} the prior should enter the model, and find it depends on the architecture: for autoregressive decoders that use relative PE, the prior is strongest when coupled multiplicatively with the relative-position term of the attention score, outperforming injection into the input embeddings, into self-attention, or into the positional and attention terms jointly---while for encoders it is best added directly to the input embeddings, composing with each encoder's native positional mechanism. We find that models pre-trained with SiPE improve on the SyntaxGym benchmark by up to $10.3\%$ while simultaneously reducing perplexity by $9.0\%$ over a base model with no syntactic supervision---a metric nearly every existing syntax-injection method instead degrades. Crucially, these gains extend beyond syntactic generalization: SiPE also improves real-world language understanding, raising scores on the GLUE benchmark by up to $8.2\%$ over a model trained without it. Unlike existing syntactic language models that marginalize over many parses at inference or discard syntax at runtime, SiPE conditions on a single parse, establishing a new Pareto frontier between syntactic supervision and inference cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语法知情的位置编码 (Syntax-informed Positional Embeddings, SiPE)，在预训练阶段从依存句法分析中学习轻量级句法先验，并将其注入绝对、相对和旋转三类主流位置编码族，且同时适用于编码器和解码器，不改动自注意力与其余架构。作者发现注入位置取决于架构：自回归解码器（使用相对位置编码）在注意力分数中与相对位置项相乘效果最好，而编码器则直接加到输入嵌入中最佳。预训练后，模型在 SyntaxGym 上最高提升 10.3%，困惑度降低 9.0%，并在 GLUE 上最高提升 8.2%。
Motivation: 现有位置编码 (PE) 编码 token 距离和顺序，但基本忽略句法结构；既有语法注入方法大多会损害困惑度，且许多句法语言模型在推理时需要边缘化多个解析树或丢弃句法，带来额外开销。
Method: SiPE 在预训练期间从依存句法解析中学习一个轻量级句法先验，并将其注入三类位置编码家族（绝对、相对、旋转），兼容编码器和解码器；通过实验隔离并确定先验应进入模型的位置与方式，对不同架构采用不同的注入策略。
Result: 摘要报告 SiPE 相比无句法监督的基线，在 SyntaxGym 基准上最高提升 10.3%，同时困惑度降低 9.0%；在 GLUE 基准上最高提升 8.2%，说明收益超出句法泛化并延伸到真实语言理解任务。
Conclusion: 与既有句法语言模型不同，SiPE 在推理时仅基于单一解析即可运行，从而在句法监督与推理成本之间建立新的 Pareto 前沿；作者未在摘要中讨论该方法在非句法任务或低资源语法场景下的局限性。

papers.title: ECHO: A Locally-Deployable Agentic Health Assistant with Temporal Memory, Safety Guardrails, and Speech Assessment
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents ECHO (Enhanced Care \& Health Observer), a locally-deployable conversational health assistant for long-term chronic care management. ECHO integrates three complementary software modules developed under shared supervision as a unified system. The core module is an agentic chatbot built on a ReAct loop orchestrated via LangGraph, equipped with 17 clinical tools and a temporal knowledge graph for persistent cross-session memory; it achieves a 94.9\% tool-execution pass rate across a 59-scenario benchmark with GPT-5 Mini. A two-stage hybrid safety layer intercepts all incoming queries: a rule-based layer handles explicit crisis signals and jailbreak attempts in under 1ms, while a signed graph neural network (GNN) with APPNP-style propagation classifies boundary cases by clinical intent, achieving 88.8\% accuracy and 90.6\% unsafe recall on a 2,537-query annotated Turkish health dataset while outperforming zero-shot LLM baselines including Llama 3.3 70B. A multimodal speech assessment module combining Whisper acoustic encoding and BERT text encoding with cross-attention fusion estimates emotion, depression, and pain, reaching a mean macro F1 of 0.652. The full system is implemented as a web application that can run entirely on consumer hardware, with no patient data transmitted to external services, supporting compliance with GDPR and KVKK.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 ECHO（Enhanced Care & Health Observer），一个可本地部署的会话式健康助手，面向长期慢性病护理管理。系统整合三个模块：基于 ReAct 循环与 LangGraph 编排的 agentic 聊天机器人（含 17 个临床工具和时序知识图谱实现跨会话记忆），在 59 场景基准上达到 94.9% 工具执行通过率；两阶段混合安全层（规则层 <1ms 处理危机信号与越狱尝试，APPNP 式传播的签名 GNN 以 88.8% 准确率和 90.6% 不安全召回分类边界案例）；以及 Whisper 声学编码与 BERT 文本编码交叉注意力融合的多模态语音评估模块（平均宏 F1 0.652）。整体以 Web 应用实现，可完全运行于消费级硬件，不向外部服务传输患者数据，符合 GDPR 与 KVKK。
Motivation: 长期慢性病护理需要具备跨会话记忆、安全边界和语音状态评估能力的对话助手，而本地部署与隐私合规场景下同时满足这些需求的系统仍然缺乏。
Method: 采用三个互补软件模块的统一系统：核心是经 LangGraph 编排的 ReAct 循环 agent，配时序知识图谱提供持久记忆；一个两阶段混合安全层拦截所有入站查询，先用规则层处理显式危机信号和越狱尝试，再用 APPNP 风格传播的签名图神经网络（GNN）按临床意图分类边界案例；语音评估模块则结合 Whisper 声学编码与 BERT 文本编码，通过交叉注意力融合估计情绪、抑郁和疼痛。
Result: 摘要报告 59 场景基准下工具执行通过率 94.9%，安全 GNN 在 2,537 条土耳其语健康查询上达到 88.8% 准确率和 90.6% 不安全召回、优于 Llama 3.3 70B 等零样本 LLM 基线，语音评估平均宏 F1 为 0.652，且系统可运行于消费级硬件。
Conclusion: 摘要强调本地部署且无患者数据外传使系统满足 GDPR 与 KVKK 合规要求，表明该架构适合慢性病长期管理这类隐私敏感场景。

papers.title: Evaluating Investment Logic in Large Language Models: A Real-World Benchmark Towards Personalzied Financial Agents
papers.abstract_en: Investment competence is inherently personalized: the same market evidence can justify different actions for investors with different goals, horizons, portfolios, and risk boundaries. Yet financial LLMs are evaluated either by static question answering or by terminal profit and loss. The former omits agency; the latter cannot reveal whether a profitable action was grounded, profile-consistent, or merely lucky. We ask whether the community is using the wrong ruler for consequential agents. We introduce \textsc{InvestLogicBench}, a process-native benchmark containing 201,247 documented decisions from 151 real-world investors. Each episode instantiates a \textbf{P$\rightarrow$E$\rightarrow$R$\rightarrow$D$\rightarrow$O} trace: investor \textit{Profile}, observable market \textit{Events}, investment \textit{Reasoning}, executable \textit{Decision}, and delayed \textit{Outcome}. The release includes profile construction, point-in-time event binding, structured logic, horizons, outcomes, and post-mortems, and supports comprehension, profile-conditioned generation, and end-to-end replay. Across four leading LLMs, logical plausibility remains near 4/5 while event grounding is only 0.8--2.8/5; return and process quality also disagree. These results expose polished but weakly grounded reasoning that outcome-only evaluation hides. We further argue that P$\rightarrow$E$\rightarrow$R$\rightarrow$D$\rightarrow$O should be a data-system interface, requiring versioned profiles, temporal provenance, inspectable retrieval, decision ledgers, and replayable outcomes. Finance is our stress test for a broader class of personalized, consequential agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InvestLogicBench，一个以过程为中心的投资逻辑基准，包含来自 151 位真实投资者的 201,247 条记录决策，每条 episode 对应 Profile、Events、Reasoning、Decision、Outcome 的 P→E→R→D→O 迹线。基准支持理解、画像条件生成和端到端回放，并附带画像构造、时点事件绑定、结构化逻辑、horizon、结果与事后复盘。评测四个领先 LLM 后，逻辑合理性接近 4/5，但事件接地 (event grounding) 仅 0.8–2.8/5，表明模型推理看似流畅实则缺乏市场证据支撑。
Motivation: 现有金融 LLM 评估要么依靠静态问答，要么只看最终盈亏；前者忽略投资者的主体能动性，后者无法判断盈利行为是否基于证据、符合投资者画像或仅仅出于运气。作者质疑社区对这类有后果的智能体使用了错误的衡量标尺，需要一个过程原生的评估方式。
Method: 构建 InvestLogicBench，将真实投资记录组织成 P→E→R→D→O 迹线，并提供画像构造、时点事件绑定、结构化逻辑、投资期限、结果和事后复盘。基准支持三种任务：理解、画像条件下的生成、以及端到端回放。
Result: 在四个领先 LLM 上，逻辑合理性得分接近 4/5，而事件接地得分仅 0.8–2.8/5；收益表现与过程质量也出现不一致。作者认为这些结果暴露了看似精良但缺乏依据的推理，而这些缺陷会被只看结果的评估所掩盖。
Conclusion: 作者主张 P→E→R→D→O 应成为数据系统接口，需要版本化画像、时间来源、可检查的检索、决策账本和可回放结果；金融场景被视为更广泛的个性化、有后果智能体评估的压力测试。

papers.title: Kastor: An efficient fine-tuning strategy for generative emulation of PDE simulations
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning offers a promising avenue to accelerate physical simulations by replacing computationally expensive traditional Partial Differential Equation (PDE) solvers with fast, differentiable surrogate models. However, standard auto-regressive ML emulators often suffer from error accumulation over long horizons and struggle to capture the stochasticity of complex physical systems. In this paper, we propose Kastor, a comprehensive methodology to adapt a deterministic physics foundation model into a highly efficient and accurate generative surrogate. First, we introduce a two-stage inference scheme that combines a large-stride causal auto-regressive model with a non-causal temporal super-resolution network, significantly reducing error accumulation while minimizing computational cost. Second, we present Mean prediction regularization (MPR), a novel training objective that constrains the generative model to predict the deterministic distribution mean under null noise conditioning. This regularization dramatically improves the performance and stability of both Functional Generative Networks (FGN) and diffusion-based emulators. Finally, we demonstrate that incorporating spatial gradient matching improves the accuracy and physical fidelity of the simulations as measured by power spectrum density. Extensive evaluations on diverse simulation datasets of the benchmark The Well show that with these components, our model outperforms competing methods in forecasting accuracy, spectral consistency, and computational efficiency. Our model achieves a 42.9% average reduction in forecasting compared to our reference based on the Walrus finetuning methodology, and outperforms Walrus for 8 out of 10 datasets on variance-normalized RMSE (VRMSE).

TL;DR: 本文提出 Kastor，一种将确定性物理基础模型适配为高效生成式替代模型的微调方法，用于加速 PDE 仿真。方法包含两阶段推理（大步长因果自回归与非因果时间超分辨率的组合）、均值预测正则化 (MPR) 以及空间梯度匹配。在 The Well 基准的多个仿真数据集上，Kastor 相比基于 Walrus 微调方法的参考模型平均降低 42.9% 的预测误差，并在 8/10 个数据集上取得更低的方差归一化 RMSE (VRMSE)。

Result: 在 The Well 基准的多种仿真数据集上，Kastor 的预测精度、功率谱一致性 (power spectrum density) 和计算效率均优于对比方法：平均预测误差相对基于 Walrus 微调方法的参考降低 42.9%，并在 8/10 个数据集上获得更低 VRMSE。
Conclusion: 作者表明将常量预测正则化、两阶段推理和梯度匹配结合，可以显著提升 Functional Generative Networks (FGN) 与扩散式生成仿真器的稳定性和性能。

papers.title: Does Latent Context Help? A Controlled Evaluation of Inverse Reinforcement Learning in Arctic Shipping
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI)-assisted navigation can help Arctic shipping adapt to rapidly changing sea-ice conditions, but reliable deployment requires reward models that are interpretable and robust to changing environments. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) provides a framework for recovering such rewards from vessel trajectories, while recent meta-IRL methods introduce latent context variables to capture behavioral heterogeneity. However, it remains unclear whether these latent representations recover genuinely hidden preferences or simply re-encode information already available in the observed state. We conduct a controlled evaluation on 3,186 AIS-derived voyages from 202 vessels across nine Arctic shipping seasons, comparing a linear shared reward, a nonlinear shared reward, and a latent-context model built on the same nonlinear architecture. The nonlinear reward improves held-out likelihood by 50.9% over the linear baseline, whereas adding vessel-specific latent context reduces performance by 16.5%. Behavioral analysis, context probes, and a pre-registered feature-hiding ablation show that apparent vessel-level variation is largely explained by observable route and environmental conditions rather than hidden vessel-specific factors. Moreover, predictive accuracy, route fidelity, and reward transfer yield different model rankings, demonstrating that no single metric is sufficient to evaluate learned rewards. These findings motivate testing whether the observed route, environmental, and vessel features already explain behavioral variation before adding per-vessel latent context. This supports more trustworthy AI deployment in safety-critical domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对北极航运中 AI 辅助导航所需的可解释且稳健的奖励模型，对逆强化学习 (IRL) 方法进行了受控评估。作者在来自 202 艘船舶、跨越九个北极航运季的 3,186 条 AIS 航迹上，比较了线性共享奖励、非线性共享奖励以及基于同一非线性架构的潜上下文 (latent-context) 模型。结果显示非线性奖励相比线性基线将 held-out 似然提升 50.9%，而加入船级潜上下文反而使性能下降 16.5%；进一步分析表明观测到的航线和环境条件已能解释大部分行为差异。
Motivation: AI 辅助导航需要可解释且对环境变化稳健的奖励模型，但现有 meta-IRL 方法引入的潜上下文变量是否真正恢复隐藏偏好、还是仅仅重新编码了观测状态中的信息，这一问题尚不明确。
Method: 在 3,186 条 AIS 航迹数据集上开展受控评估，对比线性共享奖励、非线性共享奖励和基于相同非线性架构的潜上下文模型，并结合行为分析、上下文探针 (context probes) 与预注册的特征隐藏消融 (feature-hiding ablation) 来检验潜变量的作用。
Result: 非线性奖励相对线性基线将 held-out 似然提升 50.9%，而增加船级潜上下文使性能下降 16.5%；预测准确率、路线保真度和奖励迁移等指标给出的模型排名不一致，说明单一指标不足以评估学到的奖励。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，在加入每船潜上下文之前，应首先检验已有的路线、环境和船舶特征能否解释行为差异；这些发现支持在安全关键领域进行更可信的 AI 部署。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Signal or Spurious Cue? A Randomized Audit of Survey-Country Metadata in LLM Social Inference
papers.abstract_en: Survey-country metadata can improve an LLM's forecast of an individual response when informative, yet the same cue may redirect the forecast when assigned at random. A within-record audit tests whether disclosing a random label's uniform, record-independent origin reduces its country-directed uptake, and whether verified survey country lowers held-out Brier loss. Independent population anchors and recorded human answers measure direction and consequence across five fixed API models, six countries, and seven development-selected targets. In the primary post-review 72-record panel, opaque and disclosed-random labels each produced country-direction shifts of 0.214. Paired attenuation was 0.0003 (95% CI [-0.0157, 0.0166]). Verified country reduced Brier loss by 0.040 (95% CI [0.024, 0.056]), while random-label regret included zero. A non-overlapping mixed-coverage consistency panel retained positive disclosed-random movement and verified utility, while attenuation remained uncertain. On the selected targets, verified metadata was useful in both panels, but disclosure did not reliably attenuate random-label uptake. PROV-FORECAST contains 14,400 paired item-level probability distributions from the corrected panel.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一项记录内随机审计 (within-record audit) 检验 LLM 在个体调查响应预测中如何使用“调查国家”这一元数据。作者在五个固定 API 模型、六个国家和七个目标上比较了不透明随机标签、披露随机标签与真实国家标签的效应，并报告披露随机来源并未可靠地削弱模型对随机标签的国家方向性采纳，而真实国家元数据能降低留出 Brier 损失。数据集 PROV-FORECAST 包含 14,400 对逐项概率分布。
Motivation: 调查国家元数据既可能携带真实信号，也可能成为模型在随机标签下过度采纳的虚假线索 (spurious cue)，现有工作未清楚区分两者的因果作用，尤其是披露标签的随机来源能否减少此类误用。
Method: 采用记录内审计设计，对同一记录随机分配国家标签并披露其“均匀、与记录无关”的来源，同时用独立总体锚点和记录的人类答案衡量预测方向与后果；在五个固定 API 模型、六个国家和七个开发选择的目标上做比较，并报告配对衰减和 Brier 损失差异。
Result: 主面板 (72 records) 中，不透明与披露随机标签均产生 0.214 的国家方向偏移，配对衰减为 0.0003（95% CI [-0.0157, 0.0166]）；真实国家使 Brier 损失降低 0.040（95% CI [0.024, 0.056]），随机标签的后悔区间包含零。一致性面板保留正的披露随机移动和真实元数据的效用，但衰减仍不确定。
Conclusion: 作者总结称真实调查国家元数据在所选目标上具有预测效用，但披露随机标签来源并不能可靠地衰减模型对随机标签的采纳；该发现提示元数据的作用取决于其信息性，且披露干预的鲁棒性有限。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Dense-Cast: A lightweight ensemble of deep learning architectures for precipitation nowcasting
papers.abstract_en: Proper short-term forecasting of precipitation is crucial in disaster management and preparedness. Nonetheless, the variability and nonlinearity of precipitation make short-term forecasting challenging for meteorologists. Moreover, capturing temporal dependencies in spatiotemporal data is a challenge in precipitation nowcasting. In this article, we introduce a lightweight deep learning model for half-hourly precipitation nowcasting. This model has been designed by incorporating the DenseNet architecture, residual connections, and transformer encoders for effective precipitation nowcasting with reduced model parameters. The North-Eastern region of India has been selected as the area of interest for our study. The region receives the highest precipitation during the months of June-September due to the monsoon season. The proposed model takes the previous five time-steps of half-hourly precipitation as inputs and predicts the precipitation in the next two half-hours. The GPM IMERG precipitation dataset with a 30-minute cadence has been used in this study for training and testing the model. The proposed architecture achieves best MAE of 0.235 millimetres, RMSE of 0.735 millimetres, and KGE score of 0.816 at an interval of 30 minutes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个轻量级深度学习模型 Dense-Cast，用于半小时尺度的降水临近预报 (precipitation nowcasting)。模型融合 DenseNet 架构、残差连接和 Transformer 编码器，以较少参数捕捉时空数据中的时间依赖。研究区域选为印度东北部季风期（6—9月），输入前五个半小时降水时间步，预测未来两个半小时的降水，并使用 GPM IMERG 半小时分辨率数据集训练测试。摘要报告最佳 MAE 为 0.235 毫米、RMSE 为 0.735 毫米、KGE 为 0.816（30 分钟间隔）。
Motivation: 短期降水预报对灾害管理和备灾至关重要，但降水的变率和非线性使预报十分困难；同时，在时空数据中捕捉时间依赖是降水临近预报的一大挑战。
Method: 提出结合 DenseNet、残差连接和 Transformer 编码器的轻量级深度学习集成架构 Dense-Cast，通过减少模型参数实现有效的降水临近预报。模型以前五个时间步的半小时降水作为输入，预测未来两个半小时的降水，训练与测试采用 30 分钟节奏的 GPM IMERG 降水数据集。
Result: 摘要报告该模型在 30 分钟预测间隔下取得最佳 MAE 0.235 mm、RMSE 0.735 mm 和 KGE 0.816。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该轻量级架构能以较少的模型参数完成有效的半小时降水临近预报，并针对印度东北部季风期降水场景进行了验证。

papers.title: Domain-Grounded Candidate Selection for Agentic Image Editing: A Shadow Removal Case
papers.abstract_en: Commercial vision-language models are reshaping computer vision, with visual priors broad enough to rival task-specific systems. This raises a natural question: do they reduce the need for classic, physics-informed low-level vision? We study this through shadow removal, a problem shaped by scene geometry, illumination, materials, and occluders, where paired shadow and shadow-free data are hard to collect at scale. We find that a commercial generative editor, used directly, can produce clean shadow-free edits that preserve surface texture and local appearance. However, this comes with a new failure mode: the same editor can regenerate scene content, hallucinate objects, or misread a shadow as material or geometry, producing plausible but physically wrong edits. We address this with an agentic candidate-selection pipeline: the editor generates a guided probe, an evaluator screens for major failures, retries when needed, samples multiple candidates, filters them, and selects a final result balancing shadow removal against scene preservation. Grounding this process in shadow-formation physics makes it more reliable: prompting the generator and evaluator to treat shadows as illumination effects caused by light occlusion, not material or object structure, measurably improves quality and consistency. On the ShadowRemovalRefine benchmark, our physics-oriented pipeline achieves a CDD of 0.0075, reducing CDD by at least 47% over the strongest prior method. These results suggest that commercial vision-language models do not replace classic low-level vision priors; instead, such priors remain useful for constraining and steering physically underconstrained generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究商用视觉语言模型是否削弱了经典物理感知低层视觉先验的必要性，以阴影去除为案例。作者发现直接使用商用生成式编辑器能产生干净的阴影去除结果，但会引入幻觉物体或误读材质/几何的新失败模式；他们提出一个代理型候选选择流水线，结合阴影形成物理知识来提示生成器和评估器，显著提升质量与一致性。在 ShadowRemovalRefine 基准上达到 CDD 0.0075，较最强先前方法至少降低 47%。
Motivation: 商用视觉语言模型的视觉先验广泛，是否取代经典物理信息低层视觉是一个开放问题；阴影去除任务因需要配对数据、且受几何/光照/材质/遮挡影响，成为检验这一问题的合适场景。
Method: 提出代理型候选选择流水线：编辑器生成引导式探针，评估器筛选主要失败，必要时重试，采样多个候选并过滤，最终在阴影去除与场景保持之间平衡选择结果。将生成器和评估器提示为把阴影视为光照遮挡的照明效应而非材质或物体结构，以物理知识约束生成。
Result: 在 ShadowRemovalRefine 基准上，该物理导向流水线达到 CDD 0.0075，比最强先前方法至少降低 47% 的 CDD。
Conclusion: 结论认为商用视觉语言模型并未取代经典低层视觉先验；相反，物理先验对于约束和引导物理上欠约束的生成仍然有用。

papers.title: The Next Screenshot Knows: Gated Hindsight Distillation for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: GUI agents are commonly trained offline from successful interaction trajectories. Standard training decomposes each trajectory into prefix-action pairs: the agent predicts an action from the current screen and interaction history, while the subsequent observation is discarded. This removes the rationale of why an action is correct: the evidence often appears only on the subsequent screen. For example, to enable Soft Wrap, the agent should click Edit or View, but nothing reveals this until the menu opens. Without such evidence, standard imitation gives the model little chance of ever sampling and thus learning the correct reasoning. To address this issue, we propose Gated Hindsight Distillation (GHD), which uses the next screenshot as privileged information during training. A student predicts from the observable trajectory prefix, while a parameter-sharing teacher additionally observes the next screenshot and re-scores the student's on-policy responses. We apply distillation only when the student fails and the hindsight-conditioned teacher recovers the demonstrated action. GHD improves task success over GRPO on AndroidWorld and AndroidLab across two vision-language models. The code and checkpoints will be made available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对移动 GUI 智能体的离线训练提出门控事后蒸馏 (Gated Hindsight Distillation, GHD)。标准训练将轨迹拆成前缀-动作对并丢弃后续截图，导致模型缺乏判断动作正确的证据；GHD 在训练时把下一屏幕作为特权信息，让参数共享的教师额外观察该截图并对学生的在线响应重新打分，仅在学生失败且事后条件教师能恢复演示动作时施加蒸馏。摘要报告在 AndroidWorld 与 AndroidLab 上，两种视觉语言模型下 GHD 的任务成功率优于 GRPO。
Motivation: 标准模仿训练丢弃了动作之后的观察，去除了动作之所以正确的依据（例如必须点击 Edit 或 View 才能打开菜单启用 Soft Wrap）；缺少这些证据时，模型难以通过采样学得正确的推理。
Method: 提出 GHD 框架：学生仅从可观测的轨迹前缀预测动作，参数共享的教师额外观察下一截图，并用于对学生在线响应的重新打分；蒸馏只在学生失败且事后条件教师恢复演示动作时进行。
Result: 摘要给出 GHD 在两个视觉语言模型下于 AndroidWorld 和 AndroidLab 上的任务成功率相较 GRPO 有所提升。
Conclusion: 摘要认为利用下一截图作为训练时的特权信息能帮助移动 GUI 智能体学习正确推理，并提到代码与检查点将公开。

papers.title: Bar-JEPA: Extracting Values from Bar Chart with Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture
papers.abstract_en: Bar charts are commonly used in data visualization, and while they are easily understood by humans, it is non-trivial to extract the underlying data computationally. For a machine-learning-based approach, training chart de-rendering models usually requires labeled, real-world data. Labeling data is a time consuming task, which is why annotated data is scarce. Models can learn more efficiently when provided with features of high semantic quality, which a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) is designed to learn in a self-supervised manner. We present a per-bar, numerical value recovery pipeline for bar charts, where a JEPA encoder is used to produce semantically rich latent features. The decoder model consuming these features is simple and quick to train and outputs the coordinates of ticks and bars, which can be used to recover bar values. The effectiveness of self-supervised finetuning and quality of the extracted features is evident when comparing our model to end-to-end supervised baselines. Code, datasets and checkpoints are available on \href{https://github.com/dralois/Bar-JEPA}{GitHub}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Bar-JEPA，一种针对柱状图的逐柱数值恢复流水线，使用联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）以自监督方式学习高语义质量的潜在特征。解码器模型结构简单、训练快速，输出刻度与柱的坐标，从而恢复柱状图中的数值。作者将所提模型与端到端监督基线比较，表明自监督微调与特征提取的有效性，并公开了代码、数据集和检查点。
Motivation: 柱状图虽易被人理解，但以计算方式提取底层数据并非易事，而基于机器学习的方法通常需要标注的真实数据。数据标注耗时，导致标注数据稀缺；JEPA 这类自监督架构可学习高语义质量特征，有望提升训练效率。
Method: 提出以 JEPA 编码器为核心的逐柱数值恢复流水线：编码器在自监督方式下产生语义丰富的潜在特征，解码器消费这些特征并输出刻度（ticks）和柱（bars）的坐标，用于恢复柱值，同时结合自监督微调。
Result: 摘要未给出定量数值，仅报告与端到端监督基线相比，自监督微调的有效性和所提取特征的质量得到验证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 JEPA 产生的自监督特征可支持简单快速的解码器训练，并以公开代码、数据集和检查点作为可复现性支撑。

papers.title: Learning from Failures: Retrieval-Centric CoT via Hard Negatives for Unified Multimodal Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal retrieval aims to identify candidates that satisfy complex user intent expressed through heterogeneous inputs. Although Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM)-based retrievers are efficient and scalable, directly encoding raw multimodal inputs often misses fine-grained discriminative cues, leading to confusion among semantically similar candidates. Recent methods mitigate this limitation by generating Chain-of-Thought (CoT) rationales to enrich the query representation. However, such reasoning is typically derived from the query alone: it explains what the query describes, but not what the retriever misunderstands. We argue that effective retrieval reasoning should instead be conditioned on retrieval feedback. Based on this insight, we introduce UniME-R1, an embedder-adviser framework that learns to reason over initially retrieved candidates and generate Retrieval-Centric Chain-of-Thought (RC-CoT). The adviser analyzes candidates individually to identify the discriminative cues confused by the embedder. If the target appears in the initial top-k set, UniME-R1 directly reranks the candidates; otherwise, it generates RC-CoT to refine the retrieval direction and performs full-corpus re-retrieval with a dual-mode embedder. To train the framework, we mine hard negatives to simulate realistic retrieval failures, jointly optimize direct retrieval and RC-CoT-augmented retrieval, and align the adviser with retrieval outcomes through supervised learning and retrieval-oriented reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments on MMEB-V2 and a diverse set of general multimodal retrieval benchmarks demonstrate that UniME-R1 consistently improves retrieval performance over strong baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniME-R1，一个针对统一多模态检索 (unified multimodal retrieval) 的 embedder-adviser 框架。其核心思路是将检索推理从仅基于查询的 Chain-of-Thought (CoT) 改为基于检索反馈的 Retrieval-Centric CoT (RC-CoT)：adviser 分析初始检索到的候选，识别 embedder 混淆的判别线索；若目标在 top-k 中则直接重排，否则生成 RC-CoT 并利用双模式 embedder 进行全库重检索。训练时通过挖掘 hard negatives 模拟检索失败，并用监督学习与面向检索结果的强化学习对齐 adviser。
Motivation: 现有 LVLM 检索器直接编码原始多模态输入，容易丢失细粒度判别线索，导致语义相似候选之间的混淆；而近期方法生成的 CoT 只解释查询描述了什么，无法解释检索器到底误解了什么，推理没有利用检索反馈。
Method: 提出 embedder-adviser 框架 UniME-R1：adviser 先分析初始检索候选并生成 RC-CoT；若目标已在 top-k 中则直接重排，否则用 RC-CoT 修正检索方向并执行全库重检索。训练上通过挖掘 hard negatives 模拟真实检索失败，联合优化直接检索与 RC-CoT 增强检索，并使用监督学习和面向检索结果的强化学习对齐 adviser。
Result: 在 MMEB-V2 以及多种通用多模态检索基准上的大量实验表明，UniME-R1 相比强基线持续提升检索性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为有效的检索推理应基于检索反馈而非仅依赖查询，UniME-R1 的实验验证了这一设计在统一多模态检索中的有效性。

papers.title: DARAD: Dual Adapters and Ranking-Aware Distillation for Continual Remote Sensing Image-Text Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid growth of Earth observation technologies, remote sensing archives are rapidly expanding, making remote sensing image-text retrieval (RS-ITR) increasingly important. However, continual RS-ITR remains challenging because scale variation and distribution shifts in RS aggravate cross-modal alignment space distortion, making it difficult for existing continual learning (CL) methods to support reliable continual retrieval. To address this challenge, we propose DARAD, a dual-adapter and ranking-aware distillation framework that preserves the historical cross-modal ranking structure while learning new visual and textual concepts from evolving archives. Specifically, the visual branch introduces a spatial fusion adapter, which integrates coarse regional cues and fine-grained patch cues to accommodate RS scale variation while anchoring visual updates to the pretrained alignment space. The textual branch employs multi-expert semantic routing, which separates shared textual semantics from semantically specialized residuals to absorb newly emerging descriptions while constraining global text embedding drift. Furthermore, bidirectional ranking distillation uses a frozen teacher model and historical anchors to preserve the historical cross-modal ranking structure, thereby mitigating alignment space distortion across continual stages. Experiments under a multi-stage continual retrieval protocol show that DARAD achieves superior performance over existing CL methods, improving adaptation to newly arrived data while maintaining effectiveness on historical data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DARAD，一个用于持续遥感图像-文本检索（continual RS-ITR）的双适配器与排序感知蒸馏框架。针对遥感中尺度变化和分布偏移导致的跨模态对齐空间扭曲问题，该框架在视觉分支引入空间融合适配器，在文本分支采用多专家语义路由，并通过双向排序蒸馏保留历史跨模态排序结构。在多阶段持续检索协议下，DARAD 相较现有持续学习方法在适应新数据与保持旧数据效果上均取得更优性能。
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法难以支撑可靠的持续遥感检索，因为遥感中的尺度变化和分布偏移会加剧跨模态对齐空间的扭曲，导致检索性能退化。
Method: 方法包括三部分：视觉分支的空间融合适配器整合粗粒度区域线索与细粒度 patch 线索以适应尺度变化；文本分支的多专家语义路由分离共享语义与语义特化残差以吸收新描述并约束文本嵌入漂移；双向排序蒸馏借助冻结教师模型与历史锚点保留历史跨模态排序结构。
Result: 在多阶段持续检索协议下，DARAD 相比现有持续学习方法取得更优性能，既能更好适应新到达数据，又能保持对历史数据的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为保留历史跨模态排序结构同时学习新视觉与文本概念，可以有效缓解持续检索中的对齐空间扭曲问题。

papers.title: When History Lies: Evaluating and Improving Tool Use under Misleading Multi-Turn Histories
papers.abstract_en: Tool-calling agents infer task state from accumulated dialogue and tool traces. In persistent interactions, however, historical traces may remain structurally valid and semantically plausible after they cease to be authoritative for the current request. We show that such history can hijack a policy the model already possesses: on Qwen3-1.7B, pollution flips 32.1% of decisions that are correct under the original trajectory and frequently induces reuse of corrupted entities or interface conventions. We introduce bench, a paired benchmark with synchronized Original, Polluted, and Oracle State views that preserve the system policy, current tools, latest request, and gold next action. Eleven gold-preserving interventions isolate failures in decision state, entity binding, and interface execution across complete calls and non-call decisions. We further propose ours, which transfers an Oracle-conditioned teacher policy to a student observing only polluted history through soft supervision on student-generated prefixes. On Qwen3-1.7B, ours achieves 87.0% Balanced Tool-Use Accuracy, outperforming Gold-SFT (66.3%), Oracle sequence distillation (82.3%), and off-policy token distillation (85.0%). The method scales consistently: an 8B teacher raises the same compact 1.7B student to 91.9%, while an 8B student reaches 93.0%. The resulting policies further transfer to clean histories, unseen functions, independently regenerated evaluation contexts, external tool-use benchmarks, and noisy multi-hop question answering. These results establish history reliability as a distinct tool-use bottleneck and demonstrate reliable-state policy transfer as an effective and scalable solution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究工具调用智能体在多轮对话中因历史轨迹误导而失败的问题：已失效但结构有效、语义合理的工具痕迹会劫持模型本已具备的正确策略。作者引入配对的 bench 基准（含 Original、Polluted、Oracle State 三种同步视角）与十一种保留金标的干预方案，并提出将 Oracle 条件下的教师策略通过软监督迁移给只观察污染历史的学生模型。在 Qwen3-1.7B 上，污染使 32.1% 原本正确的决策翻转，所提方法达到 87.0% 的 Balanced Tool-Use Accuracy，并表现出跨场景的可扩展性。
Motivation: 在持久交互中，历史工具轨迹可能在当前请求下已不再具有权威性，但仍保持结构有效与语义合理，从而误导工具调用智能体。作者希望证明历史可靠性是工具使用中一个独立且未被充分认识的瓶颈。
Method: 构建配对的 bench 基准，同步提供 Original、Polluted 与 Oracle State 三种视角，保留系统策略、当前工具、最新请求与金标下一步动作；用十一种保留金标的干预隔离决策状态、实体绑定与接口执行三类失败。进一步提出方法 that:，将 Oracle 条件化的教师策略通过学生生成前缀上的软监督迁移到仅观察污染历史的学生。
Result: 在 Qwen3-1.7B 上，历史污染翻转 32.1% 原本正确的决策。所提方法达到 87.0% Balanced Tool-Use Accuracy，优于 Gold-SFT（66.3%）、Oracle 序列蒸馏（82.3%）与 off-policy token distillation（85.0%）。8B 教师可将 1.7B 学生提升至 91.9%，8B 学生则达到 93.0%，并泛化到干净历史、未见函数、独立重生成的评估上下文、外部工具使用基准及带噪多跳问答。
Conclusion: 作者将历史可靠性确立为工具使用中一个独立的瓶颈，并表明可靠状态策略迁移是有效且可扩展的解决方案。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ML-for-ML
papers.abstract_en: AI training workloads are growing rapidly, making their time, energy, and infrastructure costs increasingly important. In shared cloud clusters, training and fine-tuning jobs compete with co-running workloads for network resources, while network mechanisms and ML training choices are typically optimized separately: networking controls how bytes move, whereas ML systems control when and how much communication occurs. We argue that this separation leaves end-to-end performance on the table. We present ML-for-ML, a cross-layer perspective in which network-side and ML-side knobs are selected jointly under a shared time-to-target-loss objective. Our preliminary prototype shows that by co-optimizing the ML and network parameters, we reach the target loss up to 42% faster.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ML-for-ML，一种跨层（cross-layer）联合优化视角：在共享云集群中，将网络侧参数（如何传输字节）与 ML 训练侧参数（何时以及传输多少通信量）放在共享的 time-to-target-loss 目标下共同选择，而不是分别优化。初步原型显示，联合优化比单独优化最快可提前 42% 达到目标损失。
Motivation: AI 训练工作负载快速增长，其时间、能源和基础设施成本日益重要；在共享云集群中，训练和微调任务与共运行任务竞争网络资源，但网络机制与 ML 训练选择通常被分开优化，作者认为这种分离会损失端到端性能。
Method: 提出 ML-for-ML 这一跨层视角，将网络侧与 ML 侧的可调旋钮在共享的 time-to-target-loss 目标下联合选择，并实现了一个初步原型来验证该思路。
Result: 初步原型表明，通过联合优化 ML 与网络参数，达到目标损失的速度最多可提升 42%。
Conclusion: 作者主张网络侧与 ML 侧应联合优化而非分别设计，否则会留下端到端性能提升空间；该工作目前是初步原型，尚处早期阶段。
Relevance: 0
