papers.title: Integrating Implicit and Explicit Relational Biases through Graph-Based Multiple Instance Learning: A Case Study in Skin Lesion Diagnosis
authors: Michał Grochowski (1) ((1) Gdańsk University of Technology
papers.abstract_en: Relational inductive biases are essential for capturing structural dependencies among data. This study investigates a dual-level relational framework for image classification, bridging the gap between implicit representation learning and explicit structural modelling. We begin by establishing a baseline using an EfficientNetB3 architecture. To move beyond standard convolutional biases, we adopt a patch-based strategy, employing a convolutional masked autoencoder to learn implicit inter-patch relationships through self-supervised reconstruction. We then extend this approach by incorporating explicit relational modelling, organizing the learned embeddings into various graph topologies, including grid-based, random, and k-nearest neighbour structures. Experimental results on the ISIC-2018 and ISIC-2019 skin lesion diagnosis benchmarks show that combining implicit inter-patch modelling with explicit graph-based message passing yields the best performance. On the ISIC-2018 test set, the baseline model achieves a balanced accuracy of 76.17%, which improves to 77.12% with implicit patch-based relational modelling. The fully integrated grid-structured Graph Attention Network further increases performance to 79.27%. Similarly, on ISIC-2019, the implicit approach reaches 59.84% balanced accuracy, while the combination of implicit and explicit modelling yields 60.67%.
papers.comment: Accepted as a short paper for presentation at the 21st International Conference on Computational Intelligence Methods for Bioinformatics and Biostatistics (CIBB 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向皮肤病变图像分类，提出一种融合隐式与显式关系建模的双层框架：先以 EfficientNetB3 为基线，再用卷积掩码自编码器通过自监督重建学习 patch 间的隐式关系，并将学到的嵌入组织成网格、随机和 k 近邻等图拓扑，辅以图注意力网络进行显式消息传递。在 ISIC-2018 和 ISIC-2019 基准上，隐式建模与显式图消息传递的组合取得了最佳平衡准确率。
Motivation: 关系归纳偏置对捕捉数据中的结构依赖至关重要，但现有卷积方法主要依赖隐式表征学习，缺乏显式结构建模；该研究旨在弥合隐式表示学习与显式结构建模之间的差距。
Method: 以 EfficientNetB3 建立基线，采用基于 patch 的策略，用卷积掩码自编码器以自监督重建方式学习 patch 间隐式关系；随后将学习到的嵌入组织为网格、随机和 k 近邻等不同图拓扑，并引入图注意力网络进行显式关系建模。
Result: 在 ISIC-2018 测试集上，基线平衡准确率为 76.17%，加入隐式 patch 关系建模后提升至 77.12%，进一步整合网格结构图注意力网络后达到 79.27%；在 ISIC-2019 上，隐式方法达到 59.84%，隐式与显式结合达到 60.67%。
Conclusion: 实验表明，将隐式 patch 间建模与显式基于图的消息传递相结合能取得最佳性能，验证了双层关系框架在图像分类中的有效性。

papers.title: Dynamic Graph Prompting via Topology-Routed Mixed-Curvature Experts
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic graph prompting freezes a pre-trained temporal backbone and adapts it to label-scarce downstream tasks using lightweight prompts. However, existing methods operate within a single, fixed embedding space. In this work, we reveal that temporal shifts in local clustering and degree heterogeneity actively reorganize the edge curvature spectrum---indicating that the optimal representation geometry dynamically evolves with local topology over time. We formalize this unaddressed mismatch as geometry under-adaptation. To overcome this limitation, we propose CurvPrompt, a topology-routed geometry prompting framework for dynamic graphs. Instead of relying on a single space, CurvPrompt maintains a bank of curvature-diverse Riemannian experts, each paired with a learnable prompt. A topology-aware gate dynamically routes each node--time instance to a sparse subset of experts, constructing a personalized mixed-curvature representation. To ensure parameter efficiency and training stability under extreme label scarcity, CurvPrompt employs soft routing during pre-training to build a continuous topology--geometry mapping, and transitions to hard Top-K routing with uniform weights during downstream adaptation. Extensive experiments across four benchmark datasets show that CurvPrompt significantly advances few-shot link prediction while delivering strong, consistent performance on node classification tasks, validating the necessity of geometry-adaptive prompting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现动态图上的时间演化会使局部聚类和度异质性重组边曲率谱，说明最优表示几何会随时间与局部拓扑动态变化，而现有动态图提示方法都固定在同一嵌入空间中。作者提出 CurvPrompt，利用曲率多样化的黎曼专家库和拓扑感知门控，为每个节点-时间实例构造个性化的混合曲率表示。实验在四个基准数据集上表明该方法显著提升 few-shot 链接预测并在节点分类上保持稳定性能。
Motivation: 动态图提示（dynamic graph prompting）冻结预训练时序骨干并用轻量提示适配标签稀缺的下游任务，但现有方法只在一个固定嵌入空间中操作。作者指出时序上的局部聚类与度异质性变化会重组边曲率谱，即最优表示几何应随局部拓扑演化，并将这一未被处理的失配形式化为几何欠适应（geometry under-adaptation）。
Method: 提出 CurvPrompt，一个拓扑路由的几何提示框架：维护一个曲率多样化的黎曼专家（Riemannian experts）库，每个专家配一个可学习提示；拓扑感知门控（topology-aware gate）将每个节点-时间实例路由到稀疏专家子集，形成个性化的混合曲率表示。预训练时采用软路由以建立连续的拓扑-几何映射并保证参数效率与训练稳定性，下游适配时切换到均匀权重的硬 Top-K 路由。
Result: 在四个基准数据集上的实验显示，CurvPrompt 在 few-shot 链接预测上有显著提升，并在节点分类任务上保持强且一致的性能，验证了几何自适应提示的必要性。
Conclusion: 作者强调自适应表示几何是克服几何欠适应、提升动态图提示在标签稀缺场景下效果的关键；摘要未给出具体数值或详细消融。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PaCoNet: Deep Data Extraction for Parallel Coordinates
papers.abstract_en: Extracting data from visualizations has long challenged computer vision, with current research focused on bar, line, and pie charts, among other low-dimensional visualizations. However, parallel coordinates as a widely used high-dimensional data visualization approach, remain largely unexplored in this context. As parallel coordinate plots can quickly become cluttered and difficult to interpret when poorly designed or densely populated, automated data extraction from such visualizations is of particular interest. In this paper, we propose PaCoNet, the first approach for parallel coordinate data extraction. PaCoNet not only extracts line coordinates, but also enables the extraction of individual data samples for further analysis. Towards this end, we make the following contributions. We present the first deep learning approach tailored for parallel coordinate analysis, and demonstrate that it outperforms unadapted baselines by a significant margin. We further introduce a large-scale parallel coordinate dataset for training and testing. Together, these key contributions enable for the first time the automated analysis and redesign of parallel coordinate plots. PaCoNet thus lays the groundwork for complex visualization analysis, and further advances the intersection of computer vision and data visualization. All code, trained models, and data generation scripts will be made publicly available upon acceptance of the paper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PaCoNet，据称是首个针对平行坐标图 (parallel coordinates) 的数据提取深度学习方法。该方法不仅能提取图中的线条坐标，还能恢复单个数据样本，从而支持后续的自动化分析与重设计。作者还引入了一个大规模平行坐标数据集用于训练和测试，并声称 PaCoNet 显著优于未适配的基线方法。
Motivation: 现有可视化数据提取研究主要集中在柱状图、折线图和饼图等低维图表，而平行坐标作为一种广泛使用的高维数据可视化方法，在自动数据提取方面几乎未被探索；平行坐标图在密集或设计不佳时容易杂乱难读，自动提取数据有助于后续分析。
Method: PaCoNet 是首个面向平行坐标分析的深度学习模型，输入平行坐标图并输出线条坐标与单个数据样本；同时作者构建并发布了大规模平行坐标数据集，用于训练和评测。
Result: 摘要报告 PaCoNet 在平行坐标数据提取上显著优于未适配的基线方法，但未给出具体数值或基准细节。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作首次实现了平行坐标图的自动化分析和重设计，为复杂可视化分析奠定基础，并推动计算机视觉与数据可视化的交叉研究；代码、模型和数据生成脚本将在论文接收后公开。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该工作首次实现了平行坐标图的自动化分析和重设计，为复杂可视化分析奠定基础，并推动计算机视觉与数据可视化的交叉研究；代码、模型和数据生成脚本将在论文接收后公开。

papers.title: FormBharo: Designing and Evaluating a Voice Agent for Conversational Form Filling in Rural India
papers.abstract_en: In India, almost every social benefit starts with a form, yet the people who need these benefits most are often unable to read or write. Reaching them requires a spoken conversation. Today that work falls to frontline health workers who enroll beneficiaries one at a time, a poor use of stretched capacity. We built FormBharo ("fill the form" in Hindi), a voice agent that fills a structured form over a phone call under tight latency and cost budgets by pairing Large Language Models (LLMs) with deterministic, rule-based validation and flow control. It is being piloted with ARMMAN, an NGO running large-scale maternal and child mobile-health programs in India, to enroll low-income, Hindi-speaking mothers in antenatal and postnatal care. To our knowledge, it is the first voice agent piloted to fill an enrollment form for this population. We openly release FormVoiceAgentBench, a benchmark pairing human-recorded Hindi audio with 3,760 multi-turn conversation tests across 960 simulated calls, to evaluate our agent's components (transcription, extraction, reply generation) and end-to-end form completion under real acoustic variations. Form completion drops by up to ~41 points when LLMs receive error-prone real-speech transcripts instead of reference ones. The rule-based controls recover many turn-level extraction errors, helping smaller, cheaper models match or surpass frontier models on form completion. Component performance does not predict end-to-end performance: GPT-5.5 leads turn-level extraction accuracy on reference transcripts (99.8%) but ranks lower on form completion. Since errors both propagate and cancel across the pipeline, the optimal model choice of models emerges only through end-to-end evaluation. Finally, no single model is best across accuracy, cost, and latency at once, so we use a Pareto-based weighted-sum scalarization to select a deployable configuration balancing the three.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 FormBharo，一个通过电话对话填写结构化表单的语音代理，面向印度农村低识字率人群，将大语言模型（LLM）与确定性规则校验和流程控制结合，在严格的时延和成本预算下运行，并正在与 NGO ARMMAN 合作试点，用于低收入、讲印地语的母亲在产前和产后护理中的登记。作者还公开了 FormVoiceAgentBench 基准，包含人类录制的印地语语音与 960 次模拟通话中的 3760 个多轮对话测试，用于评估转写、抽取、回复生成及端到端表单完成。
Motivation: 在印度，几乎所有社会福利都始于表单，但最需要这些福利的人往往无法读写，只能依靠一线卫生工作者逐人登记，导致有限的人力被低效占用。因此需要一种通过口语对话完成表单填写的自动化方案。
Method: 将 LLM 与确定性的基于规则的校验和流程控制配对，通过电话通话填写结构化表单，并在低延迟和低成本的约束下运行。同时构建 FormVoiceAgentBench 基准，结合人工录制的印地语语音和模拟通话，用于分别评估转写、抽取、回复生成以及端到端表单完成。
Result: 当 LLM 收到易出错的真实语音转写而非参考转写时，表单完成率最多下降约 41 个百分点；规则控制能恢复许多回合级抽取错误，使较小、较便宜的模型在表单完成上达到或超过前沿模型。组件性能并不能预测端到端性能：GPT-5.5 在参考转写上的回合级抽取准确率领先（99.8%），但表单完成排名较低；且没有单一模型能同时兼顾准确性、成本和时延，作者采用基于 Pareto 的加权和标量化来选择可部署配置。
Conclusion: 摘要强调错误会在流水线中传播并相互抵消，因此最优模型选择只能通过端到端评估才能确定。作者称 FormBharo 是首个针对该人群试点填写登记表单的语音代理，并公开了 FormVoiceAgentBench 以支持后续研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hybrid-Adaptive Thread Tuning to Mitigate Simulation Execution Bottlenecks in High-Performance Reinforcement Learning Inference
papers.abstract_en: In simulation-in-the-loop decision-making systems, reinforcement learning (RL) inference is often constrained by simulator-side execution overhead, where workloads are highly dynamic and sensitive to runtime thread configurations. Existing multithreaded strategies struggle to match thread resources before or during execution, causing resource contention, scheduling overhead, and reduced throughput. Through empirical analysis, we identify the ratio of task execution time to scheduling time as the key factor determining the optimal thread count. Building on this insight, we propose AutoThread, a hybrid adaptive thread-tuning method for mitigating simulation bottlenecks in RL inference. AutoThread employs a Physics-Informed Neural Operator (PINO) as a thread-count predictor and incorporates a finite-source M/M/1 queueing model to constrain and guide prediction, enabling fast and accurate estimation under dynamic workloads. It further performs load-aware online fine-tuning to compensate for prediction errors and refine resource allocation. Experiments show that AutoThread improves average speedup by 18.4\% over static strategies, achieves average throughput of 1.7x and 1.8x that of XGBoost and Reinforcer, respectively, and reduces execution time by up to 83.8\% compared with state-of-the-art methods. Our code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/suchenjm/AutoThread.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对模拟器端线程配置与动态负载不匹配导致的 RL 推理瓶颈，提出 AutoThread 混合自适应线程调优方法。它用 Physics-Informed Neural Operator (PINO) 预测线程数，用有限源 M/M/1 排队模型约束和引导预测，并做负载感知在线微调。实验显示相对静态策略平均加速 18.4%，吞吐量约为 XGBoost 和 Reinforcer 的 1.7 倍和 1.8 倍，执行时间最多降低 83.8%。
Motivation: 仿真在环决策（simulation-in-the-loop）系统中，RL 推理常受模拟器端执行开销限制，负载高度动态且对运行时线程配置敏感。现有多线程策略难以在运行前或运行中匹配线程资源，导致资源竞争、调度开销和吞吐下降。
Method: 提出 AutoThread：通过经验分析确定任务执行时间与调度时间之比是决定最优线程数的关键因素；采用 PINO 作为线程数预测器，并结合有限源 M/M/1 排队模型约束与引导预测，实现动态负载下的快速准确估计；再通过负载感知的在线微调补偿预测误差并细化资源分配。
Result: 实验显示 AutoThread 相比静态策略平均加速 18.4%，平均吞吐量分别达到 XGBoost 和 Reinforcer 的 1.7 倍和 1.8 倍，与现有方法相比执行时间最多降低 83.8%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将物理信息预测与排队模型约束结合的混合自适应线程调优能够快速适应动态负载并缓解 RL 推理中的模拟执行瓶颈，且代码与数据集已公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: BioKD: Selective Physiology-to-Video Knowledge Distillation via Reliability Gate for Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: To address the limitations of video-based emotion recognition under ambiguous or socially masked behavioral cues, as well as the poor deployability of physiological signals, this paper proposes a reliability-aware physiology-to-video knowledge distillation framework, termed BioKD. The proposed framework leverages physiological signals as privileged information during training to guide a video-based student model in learning deep affective representations, while relying solely on non-intrusive video inputs at inference time. To cope with the high noise and instability of physiological teacher supervision caused by inter-subject variability, signal artifacts, and temporal inconsistency, BioKD incorporates a sample-wise reliability-aware gating mechanism together with a progressive distillation strategy. By adaptively regulating the strength of knowledge transfer, the framework suppresses negative transfer induced by unreliable physiological supervision and enables more stable cross-modal distillation. Experiments on DEAP and AMIGOS show that BioKD consistently outperforms representative baselines under both trial-wise and subject-wise evaluation protocols for valence and arousal recognition. For example, BioKD achieves 68.01\% on DEAP (trial-wise arousal) and 65.29\% under the more challenging subject-wise setting, demonstrating improved performance under a subject-independent evaluation setting. Further analyses show that BioKD effectively mitigates overconfident teacher errors and outperforms an entropy-only weighting strategy, confirming the importance of explicitly modeling supervision reliability. In addition, BioKD introduces no additional inference-time overhead relative to the same video student architecture and removes the need for physiological sensing and multimodal synchronization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BioKD，一种基于可靠性感知的生理信号到视频知识蒸馏框架，用于情绪识别。该方法在训练阶段以生理信号作为特权信息指导视频学生模型，推理时仅依赖非侵入式视频输入。实验在 DEAP 与 AMIGOS 数据集上验证了 valence 与 arousal 识别性能。
Motivation: 视频情绪识别在行为线索模糊或被社交掩盖时性能受限，而生理信号虽信息丰富但部署困难，因此需要一种仅靠视频输入、同时借用生理信号监督的跨模态蒸馏方案。
Method: 提出 BioKD 框架，利用生理信号作为训练时的特权信息，并引入样本级可靠性门控机制与渐进式蒸馏策略，自适应调节知识迁移强度，以抑制不可靠生理监督导致的负迁移。
Result: 在 DEAP 和 AMIGOS 上，BioKD 在 trial-wise 与 subject-wise 评估协议下均优于代表性基线；例如 DEAP trial-wise arousal 达到 68.01%，subject-wise 设置下为 65.29%。分析显示该方法能缓解过度自信的教师错误，并优于仅依赖熵的加权策略。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式建模监督可靠性对稳定跨模态蒸馏的重要性；该方法不增加推理开销，也无需生理传感与多模态同步。

papers.title: From Economic Agents to Agentic Economies: A Systems Blueprint for Economic World Models
papers.abstract_en: Economic World Models (EWMs) are generative economic models that simulate how economies evolve from within by modeling heterogeneous agents, their beliefs and actions, and the market and institutional mechanisms through which their interactions produce aggregate outcomes. This paper develops an implementation roadmap for building economic world models as generative engines in which heterogeneous agents act, interact, adapt, and co-evolve with markets and institutions, thereby producing economic dynamics from the inside. We organize EWM systems into a six-level capability ladder, from fixed rule-based agent worlds to adaptive and LLM-based agent worlds, self-evolving agents, evolving institutional worlds, and sim-to-real economic twins aligned with real observations. A systematic literature survey across these levels reveals that existing work remains concentrated in lower-level agent and simulation environments, while systems with self-evolving agents, endogenous institutions, persistent empirical alignment, and validated economic mechanisms remain rare. By translating the EWM agenda into an implementation blueprint, this paper aims to accelerate the development of the next generation of economic simulation environments that can serve as high-fidelity sandboxes for human decision-makers and as training, planning, evaluation, and safety substrates for AI agents. We release a curated paper list and related resources to support future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出构建经济世界模型 (Economic World Models, EWM) 的实施路线图，将 EWM 系统组织为从固定规则智能体世界到自进化智能体、演化制度世界以及 sim-to-real 经济孪生的六级能力阶梯。作者对各级别文献进行系统调研，发现现有工作集中在较低层级的智能体与仿真环境，而自进化智能体、内生制度、持续经验对齐及经验证的经济机制等高层级系统仍很稀缺。文中还发布了精选论文列表与相关资源，以加速下一代经济仿真环境的发展。
Motivation: 现有经济仿真研究多停留在低层级的智能体与模拟环境，而具备自进化智能体、内生制度、持续经验对齐以及经验证经济机制的高保真系统仍然罕见；这阻碍了经济世界模型作为人类决策沙箱及 AI 智能体训练、规划、评估和安全基座的应用。
Method: 将 EWM 议程转化为实现蓝图，提出涵盖六个能力层级的系统框架，从固定规则智能体世界依次扩展到自适应与基于 LLM 的智能体世界、自进化智能体、演化制度世界，再到与真实观测对齐的 sim-to-real 经济孪生；并基于该框架开展系统文献调研及资源整理。
Result: 摘要给出的调研结论是：现有研究主要集中于较低层级的智能体和仿真环境，而自进化智能体、内生制度、持续经验对齐以及经过验证的经济机制等高层级系统仍属稀缺。
Conclusion: 作者认为该实现蓝图可以加速下一代经济仿真环境的发展，使其成为供人类决策者使用的高保真沙箱，并充当 AI 智能体的训练、规划、评估与安全基座。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ProDVI: Programmatic Dynamics Priors for Value Network Initialization
papers.abstract_en: Deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) is notoriously sample inefficient. One contributing factor is that RL agents are typically initialized from scratch, forcing them to acquire task-relevant knowledge through online interaction. Existing approaches obtain informative initializations through pre-collected datasets, high-fidelity simulators, or meta-learning over related tasks, but these prerequisites may be difficult to access or even unavailable. In this paper, we propose Programmatic Dynamics Priors for Value Network Initialization (ProDVI), a framework that leverages the commonsense and domain knowledge encoded in large language models to initialize RL agents without relying on these resources. Specifically, ProDVI prompts a code-generating language model to produce executable Python functions that encode coarse hypotheses about environment dynamics. These functions are then used to generate synthetic transitions. Based on these transitions, we construct an auxiliary dynamics prediction objective to pretrain the state-action encoder of the value network in an actor-critic framework. The learned representation provides dynamics-aware inductive biases before online RL begins. Importantly, the generated programs are used only for representation pretraining and are not required to faithfully simulate the target environment. While the generated programs may be inaccurate, their induced initialization can be corrected through online learning from real transitions and rewards. Experiments on OpenAI Gym and DeepMind Control Suite tasks show that ProDVI can effectively improve the sample efficiency of model-free RL algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProDVI，一个利用大语言模型编码的常识与领域知识来初始化 RL 智能体的框架，避免依赖预收集数据集、高保真模拟器或元学习等难以获取的资源。方法让代码生成型语言模型产出可执行的 Python 函数，将其作为对环境动力学的粗略假设，并用这些函数生成合成转移数据，进而通过辅助动力学预测目标预训练 actor-critic 中价值网络的状态-动作编码器。该初始化仅用于表征预训练，不要求程序真实模拟环境，在线学习可从真实转移和奖励中修正不准确的程序假设。在 OpenAI Gym 和 DeepMind Control Suite 任务上的实验表明 ProDVI 能有效提升无模型 RL 算法的样本效率。
Motivation: 深度强化学习样本效率低下，部分原因在于智能体通常从零初始化，只能通过在线交互获取任务相关知识；现有初始化方法依赖预收集数据集、高保真模拟器或相关任务的元学习，而这些前提在现实中可能难以获得甚至不可用。
Method: ProDVI 提示代码生成型大语言模型生成可执行的 Python 函数，编码关于环境动力学的粗粒度假设；利用这些函数生成合成转移数据，构造辅助动力学预测目标来预训练 actor-critic 框架中价值网络的状态-动作编码器，使在线 RL 开始前就获得动力学感知的归纳偏置。
Result: 在 OpenAI Gym 和 DeepMind Control Suite 任务上的实验显示，ProDVI 能够有效提升无模型 RL 算法的样本效率。

papers.title: Iterate or Widen? When Test-Time Refinement Helps LiDAR Scene Completion: A Controlled Study of Evidence Geometry, Training Coverage, and Compute
papers.abstract_en: Should a completion model spend extra test-time compute by iterating, or spend a similar parameter budget on a wider one-shot predictor? The answer is easily confounded by denoising curricula, corruption augmentation, capacity, and unpaired evaluation. We study this question in LiDAR semantic scene completion by comparing a one-shot predictor, a parameter-matched wider predictor, and a weight-tied multigrid refiner initialized from the same frozen predictor. The protocol separates coherent region removal, independent thinning, range-dependent attenuation, and additive clutter while preserving exact scene-condition pairing. Across five training seeds and 815 SemanticKITTI sequence-08 frames, the full iterative system improves mIoU over the wide control by 0.911 points under contiguous angular removal, with a 95% moving-block bootstrap interval of [0.804, 1.040] that clears a predeclared 0.5-point practical margin. Under independent 75% thinning, iteration adds only 0.300 points [0.166, 0.436], whereas observation-family augmentation adds 5.975 points [5.662, 6.140]. Neither intervention repairs additive clutter. The iterative system also costs 10.74 ms and 0.75 GiB per frame, versus 6.25 ms and 0.23 GiB for the wide control. These results establish a geometry-conditioned empirical boundary rather than a universal advantage: coherent gaps can justify fixed-depth refinement, broadly thinned evidence is addressed more effectively by training coverage, and spurious evidence requires a different robustness mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用受控实验研究 LiDAR 语义场景补全中“迭代细化 vs 更宽的单次预测器”这一计算分配问题。作者比较了单次预测器、参数匹配的更宽预测器，以及从同一冻结预测器初始化的共享权重重网格细化器，并设计协议将相干区域移除、独立稀疏化、距离相关衰减和加性杂波分开，同时保持精确的场景-条件配对。在 SemanticKITTI sequence-08 的 815 帧上，完整迭代系统在连续角度移除下相对宽基线提升 mIoU 0.911 点，95% 置信区间为 [0.804, 1.040]，越过了预先声明的 0.5 点实际性阈值；而在独立 75% 稀疏化下迭代仅增加 0.300 点，观测族增强却增加 5.975 点；两者均无法修复加性杂波。迭代系统每帧耗时 10.74 ms、占用 0.75 GiB，宽基线为 6.25 ms、0.23 GiB。
Motivation: “应把额外测试时算力花在迭代上，还是把相近参数量投入更宽的单次预测器”这一问题，容易被去噪课程、损坏增强、容量差异和无配对评估等因素混淆。作者希望在 LiDAR 补全任务中建立一个不受这些混淆因素干扰的受控对比。
Method: 提出一个受控评测协议，比较三种系统：单次预测器、参数匹配的更宽预测器，以及由同一冻结预测器初始化的权值共享多网格细化器；协议将相干区域移除、独立稀疏化、距离相关衰减和加性杂波四类退化分离，同时保留精确场景-条件配对，并使用五个训练种子进行统计推断。
Result: 在 815 帧 SemanticKITTI sequence-08 上，迭代系统在连续角度移除下比宽基线高 0.911 点 mIoU，95% moving-block bootstrap 区间 [0.804, 1.040] 清除 0.5 点实际性阈值；在独立 75% 稀疏化下迭代仅高 0.300 点 [0.166, 0.436]，而观测族增强高 5.975 点 [5.662, 6.140]；加性杂波两者都无法修复。迭代系统成本为 10.74 ms 和 0.75 GiB 每帧，宽基线为 6.25 ms 和 0.23 GiB。
Conclusion: 作者强调这些结果建立的是“由几何条件决定的经验边界”而非普适优势：相干间隙可以支撑固定深度细化，广泛稀疏化的证据更应由训练覆盖（增强）来处理，而虚假证据需要不同的鲁棒性机制。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: HERALD: Counterfactual Audits and Minimal Repairs for Proof-of-Retrieval Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Search-agent rewards mix answer quality, citation grounding, tool cost, and anti-hacking terms; a high score therefore need not imply that cited evidence was retrieved, and added penalties can cancel. We introduce HERALD, an offline audit that applies exact same-question interventions, separates candidate-visible from oracle information, and enumerates detector contracts before policy optimization. On four Qwen3-8B pools from HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue, $R_0$ rejects search deletion and fake IDs, but a label-free citation-laundering attack succeeds. A complete $2^3$ ablation identifies targeted strengthening of $L$---citing a corpus passage absent from the retrieved evidence---as the observed inclusion-minimal repair: $R[L]$ has zero empirical ASR with a 0.50% one-sided cluster upper bound. The gap persists across pool rules, a visible BM25 attacker, and four models; broader hardening remains vulnerable when the attack removes an oracle support-ID penalty. Under strict 5M-token matched training evaluated on 256 paired questions per benchmark, $R[L]$ meets the EM non-inferiority gate on HotpotQA and 2Wiki but not MuSiQue. Equal-suite citation precision and support recall improve by 2.02 and 1.46 points, unsupported citations fall by 1.69, and laundering attackability falls on 2Wiki and MuSiQue. Natural $L$ is not reduced, and the detector appears in only 18 of 58,368 training trajectories. HERALD thus separates robust scoring, sparse learning signal, and policy transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HERALD，一种针对搜索智能体奖励函数的离线审计方法，通过同题干预、区分候选可见与 oracle 信息、在策略优化前枚举检测器契约，检验高分是否真的来自检索证据。基于 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA 和 MuSiQue 上的 Qwen3-8B 池，基线 $R_0$ 能拒绝搜索删除和伪造 ID，但被无标签的引用洗白攻击绕过；完整 $2^3$ 消融将最小修复定位为加强 $L$（引用检索证据中不存在的语料段落），使攻击成功率降为零。
Motivation: 搜索智能体奖励混合了答案质量、引文依据、工具成本和反滥用项，高分并不必然意味着引用的证据确实被检索到，而且各项惩罚可能相互抵消，导致奖励被攻击者利用。
Method: HERALD 是一种离线审计框架：对相同问题施加精确干预，将候选可见信息与 oracle 信息分离，并在策略优化前枚举检测器契约；随后通过 $2^3$ 完整消融识别出包含意义最小的修复项，即强化 $L$ 对未出现在检索证据中的语料引用进行惩罚。
Result: 强化 $L$ 后 $R[L]$ 的经验攻击成功率（ASR）为零，单侧聚类上界为 0.50%；在严格 5M-token 匹配训练与每基准 256 对问题的评估下，HotpotQA 和 2Wiki 通过 EM 非劣效门槛而 MuSiQue 未通过；等套件引文精度和支撑召回分别提升 2.02 和 1.46 点，无支撑引用下降 1.69 点，2Wiki 和 MuSiQue 上的洗白攻击性下降。
Conclusion: HERALD 表明可以在较少的训练信号下分离鲁棒评分、稀疏学习信号与策略迁移，但更广泛的加固在面对攻击移除 oracle 支撑 ID 惩罚时仍然脆弱；自然 $L$ 并未降低，检测器仅出现在 58,368 条训练轨迹中的 18 条。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Wan-Animate-2: Pushing the Application Boundaries of Character Animation
papers.abstract_en: Character image animation remains a foundational yet challenging task in computer vision. Existing approaches can be broadly categorized into three paradigms: methods based on explicit motion representations suffer from extraction errors and identity drift; methods based on implicit motion features lose fine-grained dynamics through compression; and in-context learning approaches avoid intermediate representations but incur prohibitive computational costs. Furthermore, all current systems are designed for offline synthesis, unable to meet the real-time requirements of interactive applications such as digital avatars and live-streaming hosts. To address these limitations, we present Wan-Animate-2, an end-to-end character animation framework that directly consumes the driving video within a redesigned Diffusion Transformer. Our architecture achieves superior motion fidelity and identity preservation by eliminating intermediate motion extractors entirely. We further introduce text driven viewpoint control that decouples the output camera perspective from the driving video--a capability rarely supported by prior character animation methods that rely on explicit motion representations. Beyond generation quality, we present Wan-Animate-2-Lite, an efficient variant that reduces inference latency to real-time thresholds through a three-stage training paradigm: teacher forcing pretraining with error buffer mechanism, and Self-Forcing distillation with chunk-wise backpropagation. This enables streaming character animation for interactive applications, opening new deployment scenarios that were previously infeasible. Qualitative evaluations and user studies demonstrate that Wan-Animate-2 achieves high-fidelity animation results across diverse characters and motion patterns. To foster further research and community development, we will release the Wan-Animate-2-Base model weights to the public.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Wan-Animate-2，一个端到端角色动画框架，直接消费驱动视频并基于重新设计的 Diffusion Transformer，消除了中间运动提取器，以提升运动保真度和身份保持。作者还引入文本驱动的视角控制，可将输出相机视角与驱动视频解耦；并推出高效变体 Wan-Animate-2-Lite，通过三阶段训练（teacher forcing 预训练与误差缓冲机制、Self-Forcing 蒸馏与分块反向传播）将推理延迟降至实时阈值。定性评估和用户研究表明其在多样角色和运动模式上取得高保真动画结果。
Motivation: 现有角色图像动画方法存在三类局限：基于显式运动表示的方法受提取误差和身份漂移影响；基于隐式运动特征的方法在压缩中丢失细粒度动态；上下文学习方法避免中间表示但计算成本高昂。此外，所有现有系统都面向离线合成，无法满足数字人、直播主持等交互应用的实时需求。
Method: 提出 Wan-Animate-2，一种端到端角色动画框架，在重新设计的 Diffusion Transformer 中直接消费驱动视频，完全移除中间运动提取器。引入文本驱动的视角控制，将输出相机视角与驱动视频解耦。为实时推理提出 Wan-Animate-2-Lite，采用三阶段训练范式：teacher forcing 预训练配合误差缓冲机制，以及带分块反向传播的 Self-Forcing 蒸馏。
Result: 摘要报告定性评估和用户研究显示，Wan-Animate-2 在多样角色和运动模式上实现高保真动画结果，且 Wan-Animate-2-Lite 的推理延迟达到实时阈值，支持流式角色动画。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架突破了现有角色动画方法在实时交互和视角控制上的应用边界，并将公开 Wan-Animate-2-Base 模型权重以促进社区发展。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出 Wan-Animate-2，一种端到端角色动画框架，在重新设计的 Diffusion Transformer 中直接消费驱动视频，完全移除中间运动提取器。引入文本驱动的视角控制，将输出相机视角与驱动视频解耦。为实时推理提出 Wan-Animate-2-Lite，采用三阶段训练范式：teacher forcing 预训练配合误差缓冲机制，以及带分块反向传播的 Self-Forcing 蒸馏。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调该框架突破了现有角色动画方法在实时交互和视角控制上的应用边界，并将公开 Wan-Animate-2-Base 模型权重以促进社区发展。

papers.title: Do Tabular Foundation Models Agree with Themselves?
papers.abstract_en: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) are currently the best approach to tabular prediction problems. They are constructed as transformers that approximate the Bayesian posterior predictive distribution based on a pre-training prior. These univariate predictors can be converted into multivariate ones autoregressively by sampling one target and adding it to the features. However, the faithfulness of the resulting joint has not been investigated. Furthermore, TFMs cannot be evaluated against the posterior itself, at least not on real-world datasets, because the ground-truth distribution is unknown. We therefore propose asking a different question: could a model's predictions result from any joint distribution? To answer this question, we pose two requirements that any such model must satisfy. The first is marginalization consistency, which demands that marginalized conditionals are equal to directly predicted marginals. The second is factorization consistency, which demands that different factorization orders result in equal joint distributions. Every TFM that we evaluate violates both of these requirements for both classification and regression across all datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究表格基础模型（Tabular Foundation Models, TFMs）在以自回归方式从单变量预测器构造多变量联合分布时，该联合分布是否忠实的问题。作者提出两个可检验的一致性要求：边际化一致性（marginalization consistency）和因子分解一致性（factorization consistency），并在所有评估的TFM上发现分类和回归任务的所有数据集均违反这两个要求。
Motivation: TFM是目前表格预测问题的最佳方法，但将其转换为多变量预测器时，所得联合分布的忠实性从未被研究。由于真实后验分布未知，无法直接评估模型与后验的匹配程度，因此需要其他评判标准。
Method: 提出两个任何有效联合分布都必须满足的要求：边际化一致性（边际化的条件分布与直接预测的边际分布相等）和因子分解一致性（不同因子分解顺序产生相同的联合分布），并用这两个要求检验TFM的预测是否能来自任意联合分布。
Result: 摘要报告所有被评估的TFM，在分类和回归的所有数据集上，都同时违反边际化一致性和因子分解一致性。
Conclusion: 作者认为TFM的预测无法由任何联合分布产生，表明其自回归构造的联合分布存在系统性的不忠实问题，需要进一步研究或改进。

papers.title: Hybrid Machine Learning Framework for Herd-Level Cattle Growth Pattern and Weight Gain Forecasting in Grazing-Based Production Systems
papers.abstract_en: Commercial grazing systems yield irregular livestock observations, which challenge cattle growth forecasting. This study developed a hybrid machine learning framework for herd level cattle weight forecasting using automated sensing observations collected between 2022 and 2024 in southeastern Australia. Weekly live weight observations, demographic variables, and lagged environmental predictors were integrated into structured forecasting datasets. Herd level forecasting trajectories were generated through temporal aggregation of animal level predictions. Four hybrid architecture families were evaluated, including residual, stacked, cascade, and ensemble assisted frameworks. ARIMA, LSTM, and GRU models were used as comparative baselines. Independent testing demonstrated strong predictive agreement across multiple forecasting horizons. The cascade GB to RF to NN architecture achieved the best performance, with a test R^2 of 0.889, RMSE of 21.319 kg, and MAE of 15.462 kg. Hybrid architectures maintained greater robustness than recurrent sequential models under sparse observation conditions. Forecasting error increased progressively across extended prediction horizons. Feature importance analysis identified animal age, rainfall, and temperature as dominant predictors influencing herd level growth forecasting. The proposed framework may support feed allocation, grazing management, and livestock marketing decisions under heterogeneous sensing environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向放牧生产系统中牧群水平牛只增重预测的混合机器学习框架，基于2022-2024年澳大利亚东南部自动化传感观测数据，将周活重、人口统计变量和滞后环境预测因子整合为结构化数据集，并通过动物个体预测的时间聚合生成牧群级预测轨迹。研究比较了残差、堆叠、级联和集成辅助四类混合架构，并以ARIMA、LSTM、GRU作为基线。独立测试中，级联GB→RF→NN架构表现最佳，测试R²为0.889，RMSE为21.319 kg，MAE为15.462 kg。
Motivation: 商业放牧系统的牲畜观测记录不规律，给牛只生长预测带来挑战，需要一种能适应稀疏观测条件、应用于实际放牧生产环境的预测框架。
Method: 构建混合机器学习框架，整合每周活重观测、人口统计变量及滞后环境预测因子；对四种混合架构族（residual、stacked、cascade、ensemble assisted）进行评估，并用ARIMA、LSTM、GRU作为比较基线；通过时间聚合将动物级预测转换为牧群级预测轨迹。
Result: 独立测试显示多个预测区间上均具有较强预测一致性；级联GB到RF再到NN的架构取得最佳性能（测试R²=0.889，RMSE=21.319 kg，MAE=15.462 kg）；在稀疏观测条件下，混合架构比循环序列模型更具稳健性；误差随预测区间延长而增大；特征重要性分析表明动物年龄、降雨量和温度是牧群级生长预测的主导因子。
Conclusion: 该框架在异构传感环境下可能支持饲料分配、放牧管理和牲畜营销决策，但摘要未讨论外部验证或对更广泛生产系统的泛化边界。

papers.title: A Unified Risk View of Uncertainty: Posterior Risk for Disentanglement and Evaluation Beyond Proxies
papers.abstract_en: Reliable uncertainty estimates are critical in safety-sensitive applications, where understanding the sources of predictive uncertainty is essential. This often requires disentangling epistemic uncertainty from aleatoric uncertainty, yet these uncertainty types are not defined consistently across the literature, making it difficult to assess whether a method produces accurate uncertainty estimates. Evaluation is further complicated by the fact that ground-truth epistemic uncertainty is typically unavailable. Existing benchmarks therefore mostly rely on proxy tasks such as out-of-distribution detection, which do not provide complete ground-truth uncertainty targets and offer limited insight into the structure and quality of uncertainty estimates. We propose a unified definition of uncertainty as pointwise posterior risk, the expected loss of a predictor under the distribution of plausible ground-truth functions given the data. This view combines Bayesian uncertainty over functions with estimator-dependent deviations from the posterior mean, capturing effects such as misspecification and optimization error. This formulation constitutes the foundation of a theory-backed benchmark that enables direct computation of oracle epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty using semi-synthetic datasets with real covariates and known generative processes. By avoiding proxy evaluations, the benchmark enables fine-grained analysis of uncertainty estimates. Empirically, we find that accurate prediction does not guarantee reliable uncertainty disentanglement. The benchmark reveals practically useful differences between methods, identifying approaches with meaningful alignment to oracle uncertainty targets while exposing sensitivity to datasets and modeling choices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将不确定性统一定义为逐点后验风险（pointwise posterior risk），即在给定数据下预测器对合理真实函数分布的期望损失。该视角结合了关于函数的贝叶斯不确定性与估计器相对后验均值的偏差，可涵盖错误设定（misspecification）和优化误差。作者以此构建理论支持的基准，利用真实协变量和已知生成过程（generative processes）的半合成数据集直接计算 oracle 认知不确定性与偶然不确定性，从而避免代理评估。实验发现准确预测并不保证可靠的不确定性解耦，基准揭示了方法之间具有实际意义的差异。
Motivation: 认知不确定性与偶然不确定性在文献中缺乏一致定义，且真实认知不确定性通常不可得，导致评估困难。现有基准多依赖 out-of-distribution (OOD) 检测等代理任务，无法提供完整的地面真值目标，也难以洞察不确定性估计的结构和质量。
Method: 提出将不确定性视为逐点后验风险的定义，把关于函数的贝叶斯不确定性同估计器偏离后验均值的效应统一起来，以涵盖错误设定和优化误差。基于该定义，构建可计算 oracle 认知与偶然不确定性的半合成数据集基准，用真实协变量配已知生成过程实现直接评估。
Result: 摘要报告：高预测准确性并不能保证可靠的不确定性解耦；基准识别出与 oracle 不确定性目标对齐较好的方法，同时显现方法对数据集和建模选择的敏感性。
Conclusion: 作者主张用统一的后验风险视角和半合成基准替代代理评估，以支持对不确定性估计的细粒度分析。摘要未明确讨论局限性，但强调不同方法的表现受数据集与建模选择影响。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: OPERA: Operator-residual feedback for reliable autonomous optical experiments with language-model agents
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents choose actions using scores that may not reflect experimental success. We developed OPERA, an operator-residual framework for optical experiments. It represents experimental actions as optical operators and evaluates their outcomes using physically interpretable residuals. Operators specify executable changes to measurement, control or reconstruction, while residuals report departures from specified physical conditions. The agent uses both to select, combine or generate operators, and physical performance is evaluated independently against a withheld reference. Across three optical tasks, score-only feedback produced score increases without physical improvement in 23.6--39.0\% of decisions, compared with 0.9--1.9\% for operator-residual feedback. Operator-residual feedback increased the probability of reaching and maintaining task targets and reduced experimental budgets. Protocols selected in digital twins were transferred to three optical instruments, and repeated experiments showed a lower projection budget in structured-light reconstruction. Together, operators and residuals guide autonomous decisions using measurable physical evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OPERA，一个面向光学实验的算子-残差 (operator-residual) 反馈框架，用于让语言模型智能体基于可测量的物理证据做出自主决策。它将实验动作表示为光学算子，并用物理上可解释的残差评估结果；智能体利用这两者选择、组合或生成算子。摘要报告，在三个光学任务中，仅用分数反馈的决策中有 23.6–39.0% 出现分数上升但无物理改进，而算子-残差反馈的这一比例仅为 0.9–1.9%。数字孪生 (digital twin) 中选择的协议被迁移到三台光学仪器，且结构化光重建中的投影预算更低。
Motivation: 自主智能体依赖的评分可能并不反映实验是否真正成功，因此需要能提供物理证据的反馈机制来保证光学实验的可靠性与可重复性。
Method: OPERA 将实验动作表示为光学算子，算子规定对测量、控制或重建的可执行改动；残差则报告与指定物理条件的偏离。智能体基于算子和残差来选择、组合或生成算子，并独立地用留出的参考来评估物理表现。
Result: 在三个光学任务中，算子-残差反馈相比仅分数反馈显著降低了无物理改进的分数虚增比例（0.9–1.9% 对比 23.6–39.0%），同时提高了达到并维持任务目标的概率并减少了实验预算。数字孪生中选择的协议成功迁移到三台光学仪器，重复实验显示结构化光重建中的投影预算更低。
Conclusion: 摘要强调算子和残差共同利用可测量的物理证据来指导自主决策，从而提升光学实验的可靠性；验证范围限于三个光学任务和三台光学仪器。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Observation-Grounded Self-Predictive Reinforcement Learning for Visual Continuous Control
papers.abstract_en: Sample-efficient policy learning from pixels is a long-standing challenge in reinforcement learning (RL). Recent dynamics-based representation learning methods have significantly improved the sample efficiency of model-free visual RL by learning dynamics-aware representations through auxiliary prediction performed either in latent space (self-prediction) or observation space (observation prediction). However, state-of-the-art methods from both categories still struggle on challenging visual control tasks when training data is limited. We posit that relying on either predictive objective alone may be insufficient. In contrast, observation prediction grounds learned representations in observation-level dynamics, but does not directly regularize the temporal predictability of latent representations over extended horizons. In this paper, we propose Observation-Grounded Self-Predictive Representations (OG-SPR), a model-free visual RL algorithm for continuous control that learns representations that are both temporally predictive in latent space and grounded in observation-level dynamics. OG-SPR incorporates two core auxiliary objectives: multi-step latent self-prediction and next-observation prediction. We empirically show that directly imposing latent self-prediction on the shared representation may over-constrain it and does not necessarily improve performance. To address this issue, OG-SPR introduces two lightweight adapters for latent self-prediction, allowing the shared representation to benefit from temporally predictive signals without being forced to directly satisfy the self-prediction objective. Experiments on 28 visual control tasks from the DeepMind Control Suite show that OG-SPR improves aggregate performance over state-of-the-art self-predictive and observation-predictive RL methods, with particularly pronounced gains in challenging domains such as dog and humanoid.

papers.title: AgentOPSD: Recursive Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards constructs trajectory-level advantage estimates, yet it often fails to credit the few pivotal decisions that determine outcomes in long-horizon, multi-turn agentic tasks. Recent work introduces privileged self-distillation for credit assignment, providing denser supervision, but it remains unclear how such local signals should represent sequential credit. We propose AgentOPSD, a critic-free, recursive method for turn-level credit assignment in agentic reinforcement learning. AgentOPSD aggregates token-level teacher-student log-probability gaps into turn-level evidence and recursively updates a Bayesian belief state in log-odds space. This yields a principled reweighting scheme that converts sparse outcome supervision into turn-level credit signals and identifies pivotal turns through the marginal belief revision between consecutive states. The method is fully compatible with standard policy optimization and requires neither an additional critic nor extra rollouts. We evaluate AgentOPSD on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA using Qwen2.5 models at two scales (3B and 7B). AgentOPSD outperforms GRPO and strong self-distillation baselines, achieving 89.1% success on ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-7B. Ablation studies attribute the gains to turn-level aggregation and history-dependent recursive belief updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentOPSD，一种无需 critic 的递归式回合级 (turn-level) 信用分配方法，用于智能体强化学习 (agentic RL)。它将 token 级师生对数概率差聚合成回合级证据，并在 log-odds 空间中递归更新贝叶斯信念状态，从而把稀疏的结果监督转换为回合级信用信号，并通过相邻信念修订识别关键回合。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 Search-QA 上使用 Qwen2.5-3B/7B 评估，该方法优于 GRPO 和强自蒸馏基线，在 ALFWorld 上取得 89.1% 的成功率。
Motivation: 基于可验证奖励的 RL 构建轨迹级优势估计，但在长 horizon、多轮智能体任务中常常无法将信用归因于少数决定性动作。已有的特权自蒸馏 (privileged self-distillation) 能提供更密集的监督，但局部信号如何表达序列化的信用归属仍不清楚。
Method: 提出 critic-free 的递归式回合级信用分配方法 AgentOPSD：将 token 级师生对数概率差距聚合为回合级证据，在 log-odds 空间递归更新贝叶斯信念状态，据此对稀疏结果监督进行原则性的重加权，并通过连续状态间边际信念修订识别关键回合；该方法与标准策略优化完全兼容，不需要额外 critic 或额外 rollout。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 Search-QA 上使用 Qwen2.5-3B/7B 评估，AgentOPSD 在成功率上优于 GRPO 和强自蒸馏基线，其中 Qwen2.5-7B 在 ALFWorld 上达到 89.1% 成功率；消融实验将收益归因于回合级聚合与依赖历史的递归信念更新。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法无需额外 critic 或展开即可将稀疏监督转化为回合级信用信号，并在多个智能体基准上带来稳定提升。

papers.title: Universal Concept Disruption for SAM3 Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: SAM3 extends promptable segmentation from geometry-driven mask prediction to open-vocabulary concept segmentation, where a text-conditioned grounding model decides whether a concept is present and segments all matching instances. While this presence-gated design improves concept-level prediction, its adversarial robustness remains unexplored. In this paper, we introduce Universal Concept Disruption (UCD), the first universal cross-concept adversarial attack tailored to SAM3 image segmentation. UCD learns a single bounded image perturbation from (image, noun-phrase) pairs and attacks SAM3 as an integrated concept-grounding system. It jointly disrupts the text-conditioned input path, maximizes divergence in prompt-shared visual features, suppresses the final presence-gated concept scores, and corrupts the spatial validity of retained masks through area collapse and clean-mask Dice disruption. Across SACo-Gold, LVIS, RefCOCO, PhraseCut, and OpenImages datasets, UCD consistently outperforms all baselines under a matched evaluation protocol, reducing average mask AP from 59.43 to 18.73 and average cgF1 from 50.32 to 20.49. The learned perturbation also transfers to SAM3.1 and to SAM3 video inference without re-optimization, while prompt ensembling, lightweight head fine-tuning, and temporal filtering provide limited recovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 SAM3 图像分割提出首个跨概念通用对抗攻击 Universal Concept Disruption (UCD)。UCD 从 (图像, 名词短语) 对中学习单一有界扰动，将 SAM3 作为整体概念接地系统进行攻击，同时破坏文本条件输入路径、放大提示共享视觉特征的分歧、压制存在门控概念分数，并通过面积坍缩和干净掩码 Dice 扰动破坏保留掩码的空间有效性。在 SACo-Gold、LVIS、RefCOCO、PhraseCut 和 OpenImages 上，UCD 在一致评估协议下优于所有基线，将平均 mask AP 从 59.43 降至 18.73，平均 cgF1 从 50.32 降至 20.49，且扰动可迁移到 SAM3.1 和 SAM3 视频推理。
Motivation: SAM3 将可提示分割扩展为开放词汇概念分割，其存在门控设计提升了概念级预测，但该设计的对抗鲁棒性尚未被探索。
Method: UCD 通过联合优化多个目标学习单个有界图像扰动：干扰文本条件输入路径、最大化提示共享视觉特征中的分歧、抑制最终存在门控概念分数，并通过区域坍缩和干净掩码 Dice 破坏来破坏保留掩码的空间有效性。
Result: 在五个数据集上的统一评估协议下，UCD 持续优于所有基线，平均 mask AP 从 59.43 下降到 18.73，平均 cgF1 从 50.32 下降到 20.49；学习到的扰动无需重新优化即可迁移到 SAM3.1 和 SAM3 视频推理，而提示集成、轻量头部微调和时间滤波只能提供有限的恢复。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SAM3 作为集成概念接地系统的对抗脆弱性，并指出现有防御手段对此类通用跨概念扰动的恢复能力有限。

papers.title: THBKG: A Temporal Biomedical Knowledge Graph for Decision-Aligned Clinical Advancement Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Inadequate target--disease linkage accounts for 40--50\% of Phase~II efficacy failures, so anticipating which programmes will advance would let sponsors back the hypotheses most likely to reach patients. What a programme can be judged on is the evidence that supported its linkage \emph{when it entered the clinic}. No existing biomedical knowledge graph allows that evidence profile to be assembled as of a past date. We present the Temporal Heterogeneous Biomedical Knowledge Graph (THBKG), which describes and predicts therapeutic target--disease links through time: 110,396 entities and 11.1M edges across nineteen relation types, each edge carrying the year its evidence changed, so a pair's profile can be recovered as it stood when its own decision fell due. On this graph we define a decision-aligned benchmark that predicts, for a target--disease pair entering Phase~II, whether it advances to Phase~III on evidence datable before that decision. Graph propagation over the THBKG outranks every direct-evidence reference scored under the same decision-aligned protocol, reaching a relative success of 4.3--4.5 at the top ten pairs per therapeutic area. The gain concentrates on the 72.8\% of pairs with no direct target--disease evidence at their decision point, where a direct-edge model has nothing to read: the encoders still rank five- to sixfold above chance, recovering the signal by propagating over the intervening biology. Adapting a path-based explainer to the decision-time subgraph decomposes each prediction into the evidence landscape behind the hypothesis for explainable prediction. We release the THBKG as a continually updated substrate for studying therapeutic target hypotheses by retrospective validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出时间异构生物医学知识图谱 THBKG（Temporal Heterogeneous Biomedical Knowledge Graph），用 110,396 个实体、11.1M 条边和 19 种关系类型描述治疗靶点-疾病关联随时间的变化，每条边携带证据变化的年份，从而可以按过去某个决策时点重建证据画像。作者在其上定义决策对齐基准，预测进入 II 期的靶点-疾病对是否会推进到 III 期，并发现图传播方法优于直接证据基线。
Motivation: 靶点-疾病关联不充分是约 40–50% II 期有效性失败的原因；若能提前预判哪些项目会推进，资助方就能优先支持最可能惠及患者的假说。现有生物医学知识图谱无法按过去的日期重构某个项目进入临床时的证据画像，这是该方法要填补的空白。
Method: 构建时间异构知识图谱 THBKG，每条边带有其证据发生变化的年份。在此基础上定义决策对齐基准：对进入 II 期的靶点-疾病对，仅使用决策前可定日期的证据预测其是否推进到 III 期。采用图传播（graph propagation），并适配基于路径的解释器（path-based explainer）在决策时点子图上分解预测。
Result: 摘要报告图传播在相同决策对齐协议下超过所有直接证据参考方法，在每个治疗领域前十个靶点-疾病对上达到 4.3–4.5 的相对成功率；增益集中在 72.8% 在决策时点没有直接靶点-疾病证据的配对，这些配对上编码器仍比随机机会高出五到六倍。
Conclusion: 作者将 THBKG 作为持续更新的资源发布，用于通过回顾性验证研究治疗靶点假说；其核心价值在于允许按过去的决策时点重建证据并做可解释预测。

papers.title: Temporal Bridges for Spatial Resolution: Enhancing Climate Data Super-Resolution with Bidirectional Alignment
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution climate data is crucial for meteorological predictions and for informing decision support across diverse domains. However, the acquisition of such high-resolution climate information is often prohibitively costly, necessitating the development of data-driven meteorological prediction models. These models aim to generate fine-grained climate data from low-resolution inputs, a process termed climate data super-resolution (SR). Nevertheless, recent advancements in deep learning for climate data SR have primarily focused on leveraging single-frame spatial information, largely neglecting the temporal correlations between different time frames that could enhance SR outcomes. Furthermore, climate data are inherently stochastic and noisy, rendering widely used temporal alignment methods, such as optical flow models, ineffective in this context. Consequently, the development of a framework tailored for climate data SR that effectively captures implicit temporal correlations remains an unresolved challenge. To this end, we propose a novel Temporal-Enhanced framework with bidirectional temporal alignment. In essence, our framework establishes a temporal bridge to enhance spatial resolution in climate data SR through bidirectional alignment, leading to improved SR performance. Within this framework, Paired Latent Mapping achieves spatial alignment and noise reduction by unifying latent spaces. Then a Bidirectional Temporal Alignment captures temporal correlations by training forward and backward networks on consecutive latent frames. Temporal Enhanced Super-resolution then optimizes the entire framework for climate data SR. Experiments on large-scale real-world datasets demonstrated the superior performance of our framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对气候数据超分辨率 (climate data super-resolution, SR) 任务，提出一种基于双向时间对齐 (bidirectional temporal alignment) 的时间增强框架，以弥补现有方法仅利用单帧空间信息、忽略帧间时间相关性的不足。框架由 Paired Latent Mapping（通过统一潜空间实现空间对齐与降噪）、Bidirectional Temporal Alignment（在连续潜帧上训练前向与后向网络捕捉时间相关性）和 Temporal Enhanced Super-resolution（对整体框架进行优化）三部分组成。摘要报告在大规模真实世界数据集上的实验表明该框架取得更优的 SR 性能。
Motivation: 高分辨率气候数据获取成本高昂，需要数据驱动的 SR 模型从低分辨率输入生成细粒度数据；但现有深度学习 SR 方法多依赖单帧空间信息，忽略了不同时间帧之间的时间相关性。同时气候数据本质随机且含噪，光流 (optical flow) 等常用时间对齐方法在此场景下失效，因此需要一个针对气候数据 SR、能有效捕捉隐含时间相关性的专用框架。
Method: 提出 Temporal-Enhanced 框架，通过建立时间桥来增强空间分辨率：先用 Paired Latent Mapping 统一潜空间完成空间对齐与噪声抑制，再用 Bidirectional Temporal Alignment 在连续潜帧上分别训练前向与后向网络以捕捉双向时间相关性，最后由 Temporal Enhanced Super-resolution 端到端优化整个框架。
Result: 摘要仅报告在大规模真实世界数据集上的实验显示该框架性能优于现有方法，未给出具体数值或基准名称。
Conclusion: 作者认为双向时间对齐能够有效利用气候数据中隐含的时间相关性，从而提升气候数据超分辨率表现，并且该设计针对气候数据的随机性与噪声特性，不同于光学流等传统时间对齐手段。

papers.title: How Far Do Simple Transformations Translate Across Text Embedding Models?
papers.abstract_en: We investigate whether simple transformations can translate representations across heterogeneous text embedding models. Understanding how independently trained models organize semantic information is an enabler for AI-to-AI latent communication without decoding into human-readable text. Focusing on lightweight translators such as linear mappings, we test the literature hypothesis of latent universality in a realistic text setting beyond simplified benchmarks. Across nine embedding models differing in architecture, pooling strategy, and training objective, we evaluate compatibility using CKA, downstream transfer, fidelity, and retrieval. Simple translators recover meaningful shared structure and support transfer for some compatible pairs, but fail sharply for others. Compatibility depends jointly on architecture, training objective, pooling, and data distribution. Overall, the results show that heterogeneous embedding spaces are not universally related by simple mappings as often suggested in some literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究独立训练的异构文本嵌入模型之间，能否通过线性映射等简单变换实现表示迁移，并将该问题置于真实文本场景而非简化基准。作者在九个架构、池化策略与训练目标各异的嵌入模型上，用 CKA、下游迁移、保真度与检索等指标评估兼容性。结果发现简单变换对部分兼容组合有效，但对另一些组合明显失效，说明异构嵌入空间并不普遍地由简单映射关联。
Motivation: 文献中常假设潜在空间具有普遍性（latent universality），即不同模型学到的表示可通过简单映射对齐；该假设若成立，将支持不经过人类可读文本解码的 AI 间潜在通信。作者认为此前验证多基于简化基准，缺少真实文本条件下的系统检验。
Method: 以线性映射等轻量翻译器为研究对象，在九个嵌入模型（架构、池化策略、训练目标各不相同）上评估表示兼容性；评测指标包括 CKA、下游迁移性能、表示保真度和检索。
Result: 摘要报告简单翻译器对某些兼容模型对能够恢复有意义的共享结构并支持迁移，但对其他模型对显著失效；兼容性同时取决于架构、训练目标、池化与数据分布。
Conclusion: 总体结果表明，异构嵌入空间之间并非像部分文献暗示的那样普遍存在简单映射关系，即潜在普遍性在现实文本场景中不成立。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Multi-Year Geospatial Reasoning using Interannually-Consistent Historical Predictions as a Free Input Modality
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning, and deep networks in particular, are increasingly used to derive higher-level Earth observation (EO) products such as annual land-cover and crop-type maps. Many are generated operationally: each year a new acquisition is processed, typically with the same model, extending a multi-year archive. In the process these systems accumulate two kinds of useful signal that are almost never fed back into the model: the system's own archive of past predictions, and ancillary layers produced by other partners in a processing consortium. Both are normally used outside the network, as rule-based post-processing or a fixed input mask. Using the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service High Resolution Layer (HRL) Croplands crop-type product as a testbed, we show that bringing both signals inside the model turns a single-year, single-task pixel classifier into one that reasons across years. We introduce a Crop Type (CTY) embedding encoder that represents each past prediction as a confidence-scaled, time-ordered categorical token and attends over the year axis, and we study how the externally provided Base Vegetation Layer (BVL) mask should be represented in the model's inputs and outputs. To compare designs fairly when they relabel non-crop pixels, we evaluate on the 18 crop classes only and report precision and recall separately. On a pan-European dataset of about 5.4M labelled pixels, adding the prediction history raises crop-only F1 by 1.6 percentage points (pp) and, more importantly, corrects a recall-skewed error profile, with the largest gains on perennial and tree crops (olives +4.6, fruits +3.7, nuts +3.2 pp). Representing the BVL mask consistently in both the history and the target year adds about 2.5 pp on the crop classes. The approach is a low-cost recipe for any recurring geospatial or foundation model that emits class maps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对周期性地球观测产品生成中一个被忽视的信号源问题：模型自身积累的历史预测档案以及外部伙伴提供的辅助层，通常只被用作规则后处理或固定输入掩码，而未被反馈进模型。作者以 Copernicus HRL Croplands 作物类型产品为测试平台，提出把这两种信号纳入模型，使单年单任务像素分类器变为跨年推理。方法核心是一个 Crop Type (CTY) 嵌入编码器，将每个过去预测表示为置信度缩放、时间排序的分类 token，并在年份轴上做注意力；同时研究了外部提供的 Base Vegetation Layer (BVL) 掩码在输入和输出中的表示方式。在约 5.4M 标注像素的泛欧数据集上，加入预测历史使作物专用 F1 提升 1.6 个百分点，并在多种作物类别上纠正了 recall 偏斜的错误分布。
Motivation: 现有周期性 EO 分类系统每年用同一模型处理新数据并扩展多年度档案，但系统自身的历史预测和外部伙伴提供的辅助层几乎从不回传到模型中，而是被放在网络外部使用，导致模型无法利用跨年一致性和外部先验信息进行推理。
Method: 提出将两种信号（模型自身历史预测档案、外部提供的 BVL 掩码）引入模型内部：设计 Crop Type (CTY) 嵌入编码器，把每个历史年度预测表示成置信度缩放、时间排序的分类 token，并沿年份轴进行注意力交互；同时系统性地研究 BVL 掩码在模型输入和输出中的表示方式，以确保历史年度与目标年度的一致性。
Result: 在约 5.4M 标注像素的泛欧数据集上、仅考虑 18 个作物类别时，添加预测历史使 crop-only F1 提高 1.6 个百分点，并纠正了 recall 偏斜的错误分布，最大增益出现在多年生和树木作物（橄榄 +4.6、水果 +3.7、坚果 +3.2 pp）；在历史与目标年度一致地表示 BVL 掩码再带来约 2.5 pp 的提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为这是一种低成本、易于复用的方案，适用于任何周期性输出类图的地理空间模型或基础模型；通过公平比较（仅对作物类别、分别报告 precision 和 recall）避免了重新标注非作物像素带来的偏差。

papers.title: Diff-VF: Training-free High-quality Long Video Generation via Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: Recently, diffusion models have made great progress in video generation. However, most existing video diffusion models are trained with short videos, and degrade when extrapolated to long videos, struggling to maintain long-range temporal coherence while retaining diverse motions. To generate consistent, high-quality and dynamic long videos, we propose Diff-VF, a training-free, plug-and-play and model-agnostic framework that converts existing short-video diffusion backbones into long-video generators without modifying or fine-tuning the base model. Diff-VF couples three complementary strategies: Hybrid Noise Initialization (HNI) to constrain global semantics, Weighted Window Sampling (WWS) to remove inter-window discontinuities, and Temporal Extended Sampling (TES) to establish long-range dependencies with a timestep-varying fusion. We further extend Diff-VF to long-video enhancement via Skip Residual Guidance that balances fidelity and realism through timestep-dependent guidance. VBench-Long evaluation results show that Diff-VF achieves a more favorable balance between temporal coherence and motion diversity than base models and recent training-free long video generation baselines, including FreeNoise, FreeLong, and RIFLEx, while maintaining competitive frame-wise quality. Experiments on two base models demonstrate the applicability to video diffusion models with different spatial-temporal modeling strategies. Extensive ablations validate the contribution of each component and hyperparameters.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications, and Applications (TOMM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Diff-VF，一个无需训练、即插即用且与模型无关的框架，将现有短视频扩散模型扩展为长视频生成器。它通过混合噪声初始化 (HNI)、加权窗口采样 (WWS) 和时序扩展采样 (TES) 三种互补策略，在不修改或微调基础模型的情况下生成一致、高质量且动态的长视频，并进一步通过 Skip Residual Guidance 实现长视频增强。在 VBench-Long 上的评估显示，Diff-VF 在时间一致性与运动多样性之间取得了优于基础模型及 FreeNoise、FreeLong、RIFLEx 等近期无训练长视频基线方法的平衡。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型大多在短视频上训练，外推到长视频时会退化，难以在保持多样化运动的同时维持长程时间一致性。
Method: Diff-VF 是无需训练、即插即用、模型无关的框架，包含三种策略：混合噪声初始化 (Hybrid Noise Initialization, HNI) 约束全局语义，加权窗口采样 (Weighted Window Sampling, WWS) 消除窗口间不连续性，时序扩展采样 (Temporal Extended Sampling, TES) 通过随时间变化的融合建立长程依赖；并用 Skip Residual Guidance 通过时间步相关引导平衡保真度与真实感。
Result: VBench-Long 评估显示，Diff-VF 在时间一致性与运动多样性之间取得优于基础模型及 FreeNoise、FreeLong、RIFLEx 等无训练长视频生成基线的平衡，同时保持竞争性的逐帧质量；在两个基础模型上的实验验证了其对不同时空建模策略的视频扩散模型的适用性，消融实验验证了各组件和超参数的贡献。
Conclusion: Diff-VF 提供了一种无需训练的长视频生成与增强方案，能够兼容不同时空建模策略的基础模型；摘要未明确讨论局限。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: TRACE: Learned Proprioceptive Odometry for Legged Robots under Unreliable Contact Conditions
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present TRACE (Tokenized Robust Attention for Contact-Aware Estimation), an end-to-end learned proprioceptive odometry estimator for legged robots under unreliable contact conditions. The proposed estimator directly predicts relative displacement, relative rotation, and body-frame velocity from a recent history of onboard inertial and joint measurements. To improve robustness under unreliable contact conditions, we introduce a foot-aware cross-attention module that adaptively weights IMU and leg-wise kinematic tokens without relying on manually defined contact or slip thresholds. The estimator is trained with direct supervision and two physics-inspired auxiliary losses that promote kinematic consistency and reliable use of leg information. To reduce policy-specific overfitting and consequently improve sim-to-real transfer, simulation training incorporates policy randomization, followed by partial real-world fine-tuning of the temporal encoder and prediction head. Experiments across diverse indoor and outdoor terrains demonstrate consistent reductions in position drift compared with classical filtering-based, hybrid, and purely learning-based baselines. Ablation studies further validate the contributions of the proposed training objectives, policy randomization, and real-world fine-tuning, particularly under unreliable contacts and sim-to-real mismatch.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE（Tokenized Robust Attention for Contact-Aware Estimation），一种面向足式机器人的端到端学习的本体感受里程计（proprioceptive odometry）估计器。它从近期 IMU 与关节测量历史中直接预测相对位移、相对旋转和机体坐标系速度，并通过脚部感知的交叉注意力模块在不依赖手工接触/滑移阈值的情况下自适应加权 IMU 与腿部运动学 token。摘要报告其在多种室内外地形上相较经典滤波、混合及纯学习方法一致降低位置漂移。
Motivation: 足式机器人在接触不可靠（如打滑、接触状态不确切）条件下，基于手工接触或滑移阈值的传统里程计方法容易退化，导致位置估计漂移增大。
Method: 采用端到端网络架构，使用直接监督和两个物理启发的辅助损失来促进运动学一致性并可靠利用腿部信息；训练中引入策略随机化（policy randomization）以减少策略特定过拟合，并对时间编码器和预测头做部分真实世界微调（fine-tuning）。
Result: 在多种室内外地形上的实验表明，TRACE 相比经典滤波、混合和纯学习基线一致降低位置漂移；消融研究验证了训练目标、策略随机化和真实世界微调在不可靠接触与 sim-to-real 失配下的贡献。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过脚部感知注意力与物理启发损失，可以在无需显式接触阈值的情况下提升不可靠接触条件下的本体感受里程计鲁棒性，并借助策略随机化与微调改善 sim-to-real 迁移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SkillMemo: Expert-guided Skill Memory Framework for Compositional Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Embodied visuomotor models, including Diffusion Policy (DP) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, have demonstrated promising performance on robotic manipulation benchmarks. However, their potential remains fundamentally constrained by the scarcity of large-scale embodied trajectory datasets, leading to insufficient compositional generalization in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios with limited capability to capture reusable skill structures. To address this limitation, we propose Skill-Based Memory (SkillMemo) framework that implicitly decomposes long-horizon demonstrations into latent atomic skills and integrates skill-level features into a dynamic episodic memory bank for solving compositional tasks. Specifically, we first introduce an expert-guided trajectory segmentation module built upon a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, which implicitly partitions trajectories into distinct skill primitives represented by learned gating coefficients. We further design a skill-level episodic memory architecture that stores compact skill representations as retrievable key-value pairs. During inference, the memory bank retrieves the most relevant skill primitives which are subsequently fused with the model's current gating distribution, providing a robust contextual prior to refine action predictions. Extensive experiments on the simulation benchmark and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that SkillMemo consistently enhances both DP and VLA backbones, achieving state-of-the-art performance and outperforming $π_{0.5}$, while exhibiting strong compositional generalization to unseen task configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillMemo（Skill-Based Memory）框架，用于组合式具身操控（compositional embodied manipulation）。该方法通过专家引导的轨迹分割模块（基于 Mixture-of-Experts）将长时程示范隐式分解为潜在原子技能，并用技能级情景记忆（episodic memory）存储可检索的技能表示；推理时检索相关技能并与当前门控分布融合，为动作预测提供上下文先验。摘要报告在仿真基准和真实世界操控任务上一致提升 Diffusion Policy 与 VLA 骨干模型，达到最优性能并超过 π0.5，且对未见任务配置表现出强组合泛化能力。
Motivation: 具身视觉运动模型（如 Diffusion Policy 和 VLA）受限于大规模具身轨迹数据稀缺，导致其在分布外（OOD）场景下的组合泛化不足，也难以捕获可复用的技能结构。
Method: 提出 SkillMemo 框架：先构造基于 Mixture-of-Experts 的专家引导轨迹分割模块，通过学习的门控系数将轨迹隐式划分为不同技能原语；再设计技能级情景记忆架构，将紧凑技能表示存为可检索的键值对；推理时从记忆库检索最相关技能原语，与当前门控分布融合，作为上下文先验来细化动作预测。
Result: 在仿真基准和真实世界操控任务上的大量实验表明，SkillMemo 能一致增强 DP 和 VLA 骨干模型，取得当前最优性能并优于 π0.5，同时对未见任务配置展现出强组合泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过隐式技能分解与情景记忆检索提供的上下文先验，可以有效缓解轨迹数据稀缺带来的组合泛化瓶颈，并推广到不同的动作生成骨干模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Topology-Aware Neighborhood Learning for Source-Free Cross-Scene Hyperspectral Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Domain adaptation has advanced cross-scene hyperspectral image classification, significantly improving discriminative capability in complex scenarios. However, privacy rules or storage limits often block access to data from the source domain. Conventional domain adaptation methods become impractical, severely restricting their utility in realistic remote sensing scenarios. To tackle this challenge, we propose a topology-aware source-free learning framework. We first introduce the entropy momentum pseudo-labeling (EMP) to refine k-means assignments by leveraging entropy-aware confidence and temporal prediction momentum. Under the guidance of the refined pseudo-labels, we further utilize the contextual neighborhood topology (CNT) to exploit the intrinsic geometric structure of the target feature space. Combining the global structural information extracted by collaborative representation with the local similarity information modeled by nearest neighbor search, the CNT accomplishes the comprehensive encoding of manifold-level geometric properties in the target domain feature space. The overall objective integrates cross-entropy on refined pseudo-labels, log inner product-based topology consistency, and an information-maximization term for balanced classification, ensuring stable adaptation in the source-free setting. Extensive experiments on three typical cross-scenarios demonstrate that the proposed method exceeds state-of-the-art performance, and ablation studies further validate the contribution of each module. The results highlight the critical role of topology-aware modeling in achieving robust and accurate classification without source data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对跨场景高光谱图像分类中源域数据因隐私或存储限制不可用的问题，提出一种拓扑感知的无源域自适应 (source-free domain adaptation) 学习框架。方法先用熵动量伪标签 (entropy momentum pseudo-labeling, EMP) 修正 k-means 聚类分配，再用上下文邻域拓扑 (contextual neighborhood topology, CNT) 建模目标特征空间的流形几何结构。在三个典型跨场景实验上超过现有最优方法，消融实验验证了各模块的有效性。
Motivation: 传统域自适应方法依赖源域数据，但在真实遥感场景中，隐私规则或存储限制常阻断源域数据访问，导致此类方法不实用；需要在完全无源数据条件下完成跨场景高光谱图像分类。
Method: 提出拓扑感知的无源学习框架：先通过熵动量伪标签 (EMP) 利用熵感知置信度和时序预测动量细化 k-means 分配；再在细化伪标签指导下，用上下文邻域拓扑 (CNT) 结合协同表示 (collaborative representation) 的全局结构与最近邻搜索 (nearest neighbor search) 的局部相似性，对目标域特征空间进行流形级几何编码。总体目标包含基于细化伪标签的交叉熵、log 内积拓扑一致性以及用于平衡分类的信息最大化项。
Result: 在三个典型跨场景高光谱图像分类任务上，该方法超过现有最优性能 (state-of-the-art)，消融实验进一步验证了每个模块的贡献。
Conclusion: 摘要强调拓扑感知建模在无源数据条件下实现鲁棒且准确分类的关键作用，说明该方法适用于隐私或存储受限的真实遥感场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Big, Bright, or Invisible: A Frozen-Feature Benchmark of 3D CT Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Routine CT interpretation is inherently comprehensive, capturing incidental findings across the entire scan volume. 3D CT foundation models could assist this process by providing generalizable representations of anatomy and pathology. To evaluate their diagnostic breadth, we benchmark ten frozen CT encoders across three cohorts of thoracic CT scans, including an unseen internal clinical dataset, using $k$-nearest neighbors, zero-shot prompting, and linear probing. We find no universal state-of-the-art, with rankings fluctuating significantly depending on the evaluation context. While models combining fine-grained image tokenization with vision-language alignment generally perform best, a lightweight supervised encoder remains highly competitive, demonstrating that explicit labels can effectively substitute for scale. Crucially, rather than model architecture, we observe that the primary determinant of performance is a physical bottleneck: a finding's detectability scales with its contrast against surrounding tissue and its spatial extent. Through controlled within-organ comparisons, we empirically demonstrate that widespread or high-contrast abnormalities, such as devices and effusions, are reliably recovered. Conversely, small, low-contrast focal lesions remain a persistent challenge across all evaluated encoders. We attribute this to the inherent limitations of globally pooled embeddings, suggesting that accurately representing small, low-contrast structures will require region- or lesion-level pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对十个冻结的 3D CT 编码器（frozen CT encoders）进行了基准测试，覆盖三个胸部 CT 队列（含一个未见过的内部临床数据集），评测方式包括 k 近邻、零样本提示和线性探针。结果表明不存在通用的最优模型，排名随评测语境显著波动；结合细粒度图像 tokenization 与视觉-语言对齐的模型总体表现最好，但轻量级有监督编码器仍极具竞争力。关键发现是性能的首要决定因素并非模型架构，而是物理瓶颈：发现的可检测性随其与周围组织的对比度和空间范围而变化。广泛或高对比度的异常（如器械和积液）能被可靠恢复，而小尺寸、低对比度的局灶性病变在所有编码器上仍是持续挑战。
Motivation: 常规 CT 判读本质上是全面性的，需要捕捉整个扫描范围内的偶然发现。3D CT 基础模型若能提供可泛化的解剖与病理表征，将有助于这一过程；因此需要对其诊断覆盖面进行系统评测。
Method: 在三个胸部 CT 队列上基准测试十个冻结的 CT 编码器，使用 k 近邻、零样本提示和线性探针三种评估方式，并通过受控的器官内比较来检验异常检测能力。作者将小病灶的困难归因于全局池化嵌入（globally pooled embeddings）的固有限制，并由此提出需要区域级或病灶级预训练。
Result: 摘要报告没有发现普遍最优模型，排名依评估语境变化。结合细粒度图像 tokenization 与视觉-语言对齐的模型通常表现最佳，但轻量级有监督编码器依然高度有竞争力。物理瓶颈主导性能：可检测性与对比度和空间范围成正比；器械和积液等广泛或高对比度异常可被可靠恢复，小而低对比度的局灶性病变则对所有编码器都是难题。
Conclusion: 作者强调性能的首要决定因素是物理瓶颈而非模型架构，并认为准确表征小尺寸、低对比度结构需要区域级或病灶级预训练策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stability of Ranking-dependent Pair-wise Comparison Patterns in the Analytic Hierarchy Process
papers.abstract_en: The paper addresses several ranking-dependent decision support methods. Ordinal information on compared objects can be used to improve the quality of expert data during estimation and help reduce the number of comparisons that the experts need to perform. In the paper we compare three incomplete ranking-dependent pair-wise comparison patterns which can be used in the Analytic Hierarchy Process - Best-worst method, Best-Second Best (Top 2) method, and the original maximum difference method. The first two comparison patterns (and respective methods) are incomplete, while the third can be a complete one. We determine conditions under which these three methods can be compared in terms of stability to expert errors. We also present the results of a simulation-type experiment, in which the three methods are compared. The research allows us to define the most stable incomplete ranking-dependent pair-wise comparison pattern and reduce the number of comparisons without loss of credibility of expert session results. The research contributes to algorithmic, cognitive, and applied aspects of decision support in uncertain environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究层次分析法 (AHP) 中三类依赖排序的成对比较模式——Best-worst 法、Best-Second Best (Top 2) 法与原始最大差异法，并比较它们在专家误差下的稳定性。作者给出了三种方法可比较的条件，并报告了仿真实验结果，目标是找出最稳定的不完备比较模式，从而在不损失专家结论可信度的前提下减少比较次数。
Motivation: 序数信息可用于提升专家数据质量并减少专家需要执行的比较次数；当前缺少对不完备依赖排序比较模式在稳定性方面的系统比较。
Method: 对比三种依赖排序的成对比较模式（其中前两者为不完备，第三个可为完备），确定它们在专家误差稳定性意义上可比较的条件，并开展仿真型实验对三种方法进行对比。
Result: 摘要报告仿真实验比较了三种方法，研究得以界定最稳定的不完备依赖排序比较模式，并能在不损失专家会话结果可信度的前提下减少比较次数。

papers.title: Training a Conditioned Video Game Agent on a VLM Annotated Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is a powerful but far from easy-to-use technique for policy learning. In the specific case of video games, access to the game engine is required to get rewards for training (e.g. to collect rewards from the environment). Furthermore, the proper identification and weighting of the rewards generally requires a difficult trial-and-error approach. Lastly, rewards are often sparse and understanding how they eventually affect the learned policy is a non-trivial exercise. To ease these issues we propose annotating a video game dataset with Vision Language Models (VLMs) instructed to extract human defined rewards. We show that offline RL can then be used to train a conditioned agent that responds accordingly to the desired returns and we discuss the difficulties and limitations that emerged in our early experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用视觉语言模型（VLM）为视频游戏数据集标注人类定义奖励，以缓解强化学习在视频游戏中需要访问游戏引擎、奖励识别与加权依赖试错以及奖励稀疏难解释等问题。作者展示离线强化学习（offline RL）可以基于这些标注训练一个按期望回报条件响应的智能体，并讨论了早期实验中出现的困难与局限。
Motivation: 强化学习在视频游戏场景下通常需要访问游戏引擎才能获取奖励，而奖励的识别与加权往往依赖困难的试错过程，且奖励常稀疏、对最终策略的影响难以理解。
Method: 使用指令式的视觉语言模型（VLM）从视频游戏数据集中提炼人类定义的奖励标注，再基于该标注数据集采用离线 RL 训练条件智能体（conditioned agent）。
Result: 摘要报告离线 RL 可以借助 VLM 标注训练出按期望回报响应的条件智能体，但未给出具体数值；同时强调早期实验中暴露了若干困难与局限。
Conclusion: 该方法有望降低对游戏引擎和人工奖励设计的依赖，但作者将其定位为早期探索，并明确指出仍需解决标注与训练过程中的难点和限制。

papers.title: VLMs for Videogame Data Annotation
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents have revolutionized how engineers approach complex problems in real-world applications. Their adoption in video games is on the other hand limited by the extreme variability of the synthetic scenarios and their poor compliance with real-world physics. Here we investigate the use of VLMs for annotating video game frame sequences with reward signals, a task with several potential applications including, among others, conditioned training and offline reinforcement learning. We show that VLMs often struggle to answer basic questions on racing video games (although we observed a similar behavior on other game genres) and discuss countermeasures such as VLM output mixing and prompt optimization. We also show how input sequence length, resolution, and question batching affect the annotation quality and its token consumption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究使用视觉语言模型 (VLM) 为视频游戏帧序列标注奖励信号，目标应用包括条件训练和离线强化学习。作者发现 VLM 在回答赛车游戏等场景的基础问题时经常失败，并讨论了输出混合与提示优化等应对措施，同时考察了输入序列长度、分辨率和问题批处理对标注质量与 token 消耗的影响。
Motivation: VLM 和 AI agent 已在真实应用中广泛使用，但在视频游戏中的采用受到合成场景高度可变性以及其与现实物理不符的限制；将 VLM 用于游戏帧序列的奖励信号标注具有多种潜在应用，但目前能力尚不清楚。
Method: 系统评估 VLM 对视频游戏帧序列进行奖励标注的能力，覆盖多种游戏类型；提出并讨论输出混合 (VLM output mixing) 和提示优化 (prompt optimization) 作为改进对策，并分析输入序列长度、分辨率与问题批处理对标注质量和 token 消耗的影响。
Result: 摘要报告 VLM 在赛车游戏（以及其他游戏类型）上经常难以回答基础问题；输出混合和提示优化可部分缓解；标注质量与 token 消耗受输入序列长度、分辨率和问题批处理方式影响。
Conclusion: 作者强调 VLM 直接用于游戏帧序列奖励标注的可靠性有限，需要采取对策，并揭示序列长度、分辨率与批处理带来的质量-成本权衡。

papers.title: GAUGE: A Measurement-Grounded Benchmark for Physical Fidelity in Simulation Engines and Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Physics engines facilitate large-scale training and evaluation for embodied intelligence, while generative video world models are emerging as implicit simulators of future states and interactions. However, existing evaluations of physical fidelity are often conducted in isolation and rely heavily on perceptual similarity or human judgments, providing limited insight into which physical principles or parameters are violated. We introduce GAUGE, a real-world-grounded diagnostic benchmark for jointly evaluating how numerical simulators and generative video world models reproduce or deviate from real-world physics. It comprises 22 controlled task families covering rigid bodies, flexible cables, textiles, and volumetric deformable objects. Grounded in real-world trajectories and paired with calibrated physical metadata, uncertainty annotations, and task-specific observables, these tasks cover fundamental physical processes including collision, friction, momentum transfer, oscillation, self-contact, and deformation across diverse materials and conditions. We benchmark Isaac Sim, Genesis, and Newton on 14 task families using generalized trajectory errors, and evaluate 6 image-to-video models on 5 rigid-body tasks by testing physical-law consistency and the temporal stability of inferred parameters. Our results reveal no uniformly faithful physics engine, with the largest discrepancies arising in impulsive contact, rapid textile motion, and volumetric deformation. We further find that video world models can produce trajectories with the expected equation form while recovering incorrect accelerations, momentum transfer, and oscillation timing. GAUGE lays the groundwork for developing more physically faithful simulators and world models for embodied intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GAUGE，一个以真实世界轨迹为基准的物理保真度诊断基准，用于联合评估数值模拟引擎与生成式视频世界模型对真实物理的复现或偏离程度。基准包含 22 个受控任务族，覆盖刚体、柔性线缆、织物与体积可变形物体，并附带校准的物理元数据、不确定性标注和任务专属可观测量。作者在 14 个任务族上用广义轨迹误差评测 Isaac Sim、Genesis 和 Newton，并用 6 个图像到视频模型在 5 个刚体任务上检验物理规律一致性与参数时间稳定性，发现没有引擎在物理上完全保真，而视频模型虽能产生符合方程形式的轨迹，却会恢复出错误的加速度、动量传递和振荡时序。
Motivation: 现有物理保真度评估往往彼此孤立进行，且过度依赖感知相似性或人工判断，难以指出具体违反的物理原理或参数，缺乏对模拟引擎与视频世界模型的联合诊断。
Method: 构建 GAUGE 基准，包含 22 个受控任务族以覆盖碰撞、摩擦、动量传递、振荡、自接触和变形等基本物理过程，用真实世界轨迹和校准元数据对引擎与生成模型进行统一测量。
Result: 评测显示不存在 uniformly faithful 的物理引擎，最大偏差出现在冲击接触、快速织物运动和体积变形；视频世界模型可以输出符合预期方程形式的轨迹，但推断出的加速度、动量传递和振荡时序不正确。
Conclusion: 作者认为 GAUGE 为开发更符合物理规律的模拟器与世界模型奠定基础，服务于具身智能的大规模训练与评测。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Respect Your Zero-Shot Uncertainty: Conservative Calibration for Test-Time-Adapted Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) can improve the recognition accuracy of vision-language models under distribution shift, but often degrades calibration, making predictive confidence unreliable for downstream decision-making. Many existing label-free calibration approaches are either coupled to prompt optimization or rely on logit-range statistics that provide only a coarse characterization of the predictive distribution. We show that TTA can increase confidence and reduce entropy even when the top-1 prediction and its correctness remain unchanged, a failure mode we term prediction-preserving sharpening. Across diverse TTA methods and benchmarks, larger entropy reductions relative to paired zero-shot predictions are associated with greater increases in Expected Calibration Error (ECE). On entropy-reduced samples, confidence gains also tend to exceed accuracy gains. Based on these findings, we propose Zero-Shot-Anchored Entropy Calibration (ZAEC), a label-free post-hoc method that uses zero-shot entropy as a sample-specific uncertainty reference. ZAEC selectively restores the zero-shot entropy of sharpened predictions through minimal temperature scaling while leaving all other predictions unchanged. It requires no labeled calibration data or learned parameters and preserves class rankings and classification accuracy. Across five TTA methods and 15 datasets, ZAEC achieves the lowest post-hoc macro-average ECE on ViT-B/16, with consistent gains on RN50.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究测试时自适应 (test-time adaptation, TTA) 对视觉语言模型校准的影响，发现 TTA 可能引起“预测保持锐化”(prediction-preserving sharpening)：即使 top-1 预测和正确性不变，置信度上升、熵下降，且熵降越大，Expected Calibration Error (ECE) 增幅越大。基于此提出 Zero-Shot-Anchored Entropy Calibration (ZAEC)，一种以零样本熵为样本级不确定性参考的无标签后处理校准方法，通过最小温度缩放恢复锐化样本的熵而不改动其他预测。在五种 TTA 方法和 15 个数据集上，ZAEC 在 ViT-B/16 上取得最低的 post-hoc macro-average ECE，在 RN50 上也有一致增益。
Motivation: TTA 能提升视觉语言模型在分布漂移下的识别精度，但常损害校准，使置信度不可靠。现有无标签校准方法要么与提示优化耦合，要么依赖 logit 范围统计，对预测分布的刻画较粗糙；本文进一步识别出 top-1 预测不变但熵下降、置信度升高的失败模式，并将其与校准恶化联系起来。
Method: 提出 ZAEC，一种无需带标签校准数据和可学习参数的无标签后处理方法。它以零样本熵作为样本特定的不确定性参考，仅对熵被锐化 (sharpened) 的样本施加最小温度缩放，使其熵恢复到零样本水平，其余预测保持不变，从而保持类别排序和分类精度。
Result: 在五种 TTA 方法和 15 个数据集上，ZAEC 在 ViT-B/16 上达到最低的 post-hoc macro-average ECE，并在 RN50 上持续取得增益。摘要还报告，相对于配对零样本预测的熵减少越大，ECE 增加越大，且置信度增益往往超过准确率增益。
Conclusion: 作者认为，TTA 后预测的零样本熵可以作为样本级不确定性锚点，通过保守校准恢复锐化样本的熵，可在不改变预测结果和分类精度的前提下改善校准。

papers.title: Operating Multi-Node Full Fine-Tuning on NVIDIA B300: A Field Report on Telemetry-Based Triage, Negative Results, and Operational Hardening
papers.abstract_en: We report operational experience full-fine-tuning a 32.76B-parameter dense model (Qwen3-32B) on 16 x NVIDIA B300 (two nodes, FSDP / ZeRO-3) -- among the first published field accounts on this accelerator. We claim no new algorithm. The individual mechanisms we use are established practice; our contribution is the integrated field experience and a set of calibrated measurements on new hardware. Concretely we offer four practitioner artifacts. (1) A B300-calibrated power-draw triage table that distinguishes compute / communication / data-starvation / checkpoint-or-deadlock / idle by board wattage (utilization% reads 100% during an NCCL hang). (2) A set of honest negative results that dispel common optimization folklore at this scale: a controlled A/B in which per-step NFS reading matches a pretokenized local cache (~53k tok/s) because the corpus fits in page cache and the job is compute-bound; and a reconstruction of an earlier "throughput collapse" as NFS/CPU contention rather than a storage-medium limit. (3) Calibrated 4/8/16-GPU strong-scaling and GPU-hour numbers on B300 (near-linear, as expected in this regime; we report absolute values as reference data). (4) A worked failure case -- an epoch-end NCCL deadlock from per-rank token-packing imbalance -- together with a 2.7-second pre-run invariant gate and an external watcher that turn multi-hour silent failures into instant rejections. This deadlock and its remedy correspond to PyTorch's documented Join / equalize-to-minimum practice; we position our instantiation against that prior art and report the GPU-hours the failure cost and the gate saves. The transferable takeaway is operational, not algorithmic: for data-dependent data-parallel jobs, watch power rather than utilization, and verify invariants before launch -- a passing smoke test is not evidence of a safe full run.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一份关于在 16 块 NVIDIA B300（两个节点，FSDP / ZeRO-3）上对 32.76B 稠密模型 Qwen3-32B 进行全参数微调的现场经验报告，宣称是该加速器上最早公开的运维记录之一。作者不声称提出新算法，而是以工程视角提供四项实践产物：基于板卡功耗的故障分类表、一组否定性结果（如 NFS 读取与本地预分词缓存在该规模下性能相当）、4/8/16 GPU 强扩展数据，以及一个 epoch 结束时因 per-rank token packing 不平衡导致的 NCCL 死锁案例及其防护机制。核心经验是运维性的：在数据相关的数据并行任务中，应观察功耗而非利用率，并在启动前验证不变量。
Motivation: NVIDIA B300 是新型加速器，业界缺乏公开的多节点全参数微调运维经验，现有的利用率监控和常见优化直觉（如必须使用本地缓存）在该规模下可能误导排障。
Method: 作者不提出新算法，而是给出集成现场经验：用板卡功耗区分计算/通信/数据饥饿/检查点或死锁/空闲等状态；开展受控 A/B 对比测试；复现并归因早前的吞吐量崩溃；实现一个 2.7 秒的预运行不变量门控和外部监视器，用于将数小时的静默失败转为即时拒绝。
Result: 摘要报告在 53k tok/s 量级上 NFS 读取与本地预分词缓存相当；4/8/16 GPU 强扩展接近线性；并量化了 NCCL 死锁造成的 GPU 小时损失以及不变量门控所能节省的 GPU 小时。
Conclusion: 作者强调其可迁移结论是运维而非算法层面的：对数据依赖的数据并行作业，应监控功耗而非利用率，且通过冒烟测试并不代表完整运行安全；死锁与修复对应 PyTorch 已文档化的 Join / equalize-to-minimum 实践。
