papers.title: When Does Consensus Mean Correctness? Measuring the Agreement-Accuracy Coupling with Semantics-Preserving Re-Rendering
papers.abstract_en: A model's agreement across perturbed inputs is used both as a label-free reliability signal and as a self-training target, on the premise that agreement tracks correctness. That coupling is rarely measured directly: natural-image perturbations preserve meaning only by assumption, and no exact answer key localizes errors. Scientific figures remove both obstacles, a figure is drawn from data by a program, so redrawing it yields images that are semantically equivalent by construction and share a programmatically exact answer. We build RENDEQ, a generator of such render-equivalence sets, and measure the coupling on three open-weight VLMs, checking every finding across three independent instantiations. Re-rendering beats resampling on both accuracy and reliability. Agreement beats an evidence-carrying baseline, mean token log-probability, on two of three models and ties on the third, reversing an intermediate, buggy replication traced to a rendering-pipeline failure. The dispersion behind this is concentrated in one style factor, the plotting library, more than double the next-largest factor and an order of magnitude above the noise floor. Fine-tuning on the model's own cross-render consensus inverts: accuracy falls in every one of five replication runs, the opposite sign to published results on natural images. Agreement certifies correctness only above a threshold set by how diffuse a model's errors are, and an objective that rewards agreement destroys exactly that diffuseness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究模型在扰动输入上的一致性 (agreement) 是否真正跟踪正确性 (correctness)。作者构建 RENDEQ，利用科学图像（由程序从数据绘制）生成渲染等价集 (render-equivalence sets)，使重绘图像在构造上语义等价且具有程序可精确计算的答案，从而直接测量三个开源视觉语言模型 (VLM) 上的 agreement-accuracy 耦合。结果显示 re-rendering 在准确率和可靠性上均优于 resampling，agreement 在多数模型上优于平均 token log-probability；但用模型自身的跨渲染共识微调会在所有五次复制中降低准确率。
Motivation: 一致性既被用作无标签可靠性信号，也被用作自训练目标，其前提是一致性跟随正确性，但这种耦合很少被直接测量：自然图像扰动只是假设保持语义，且没有精确答案来定位错误。科学图像同时消除了这两个障碍。
Method: 构建 RENDEQ，通过程序重绘由数据绘制的科学图形，生成语义等价且共享程序级精确答案的渲染等价集，并在三个开源 VLM 上、三个独立实例化中测量 agreement 与 accuracy 的耦合。
Result: Re-rendering 在准确率和可靠性上优于 resampling；agreement 在两个模型上超过含证据的基线（平均 token log-probability，mean token log-probability），在第三个模型上持平，其间一个中间 buggy 复制被追溯到渲染管线失败。差异主要集中在一个风格因素（绘图库）上，其贡献超过第二大因素两倍，并高出噪声底一个数量级。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，agreement 只有在模型错误扩散度之上的某个阈值内才能证明正确性，而奖励 agreement 的目标恰恰会破坏这种扩散度；在模型自身跨渲染共识上微调的效果与自然图像上的已发表结果符号相反，五次复制运行中准确率全部下降。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SafeDivertor: Faithful Divertor Heat Flux Reconstruction from Macroscopic Plasma State Signals via Time-Frequency Prior Exploitation
papers.abstract_en: Divertor heat-flux analysis is essential for understanding plasma-wall interactions and protecting plasma-facing components in magnetic-confinement fusion devices, while conventional infrared-based inversion is usually performed after discharge and requires heat-conduction modeling with device-specific material properties, divertor geometry, and boundary conditions. Rather than accelerating this conventional infrared-based inversion paradigm, we introduce a new online-oriented signal-based reconstruction paradigm that directly reconstructs time-resolved radial heat-flux profiles from multi-source macroscopic plasma-state signals available during discharge. To enable systematic study of this task, we construct \textbf{DivMPS2HF}, a multi-source discharge dataset that provides the data foundation and benchmark for signal-based divertor heat-flux reconstruction. We further propose \textbf{SafeDivertor}, a task-driven framework designed to address the key challenges of signal-based heat-flux reconstruction. It employs physical prior-aware initialization to provide radial-distribution guidance for target channels, input perturbation to reduce over-reliance on specific heterogeneous signals, spectral-aware reconstruction optimization to exploit time-frequency priors and preserve transient dynamics, and progressive training to stabilize the optimization of these complementary objectives. Experiments on DivMPS2HF demonstrate that SafeDivertor achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated time-series baselines across all five metrics, establishing a new performance benchmark for signal-based divertor heat-flux reconstruction. The source code will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenFusion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向在线诊断的偏滤器热通量重建新范式：直接从放电过程中的多源宏观等离子体状态信号重建时间分辨的径向热通量分布，而非加速传统基于红外反演的离线流程。作者构建了多源放电数据集 DivMPS2HF 作为基准，并提出任务驱动框架 SafeDivertor，结合物理先验初始化、输入扰动、频谱感知重建优化与渐进训练。实验表明 SafeDivertor 在全部五个评估指标上优于所比较的时间序列基线。
Motivation: 传统红外反演需在放电后进行，且依赖设备特定的材料属性、偏滤器几何与边界条件进行热传导建模，难以支持在线偏滤器热通量分析。论文目标是以信号为基础的直接重建范式填补这一在线诊断缺口。
Method: 提出 SafeDivertor 框架，采用物理先验感知的初始化以提供径向分布引导；通过输入扰动降低对特定异构信号的过度依赖；利用频谱感知重建优化挖掘时间-频率先验并保留瞬态动力学；配合渐进训练稳定多目标优化。同时构建多源放电数据集 DivMPS2HF 作为任务基准。
Result: 在 DivMPS2HF 上，SafeDivertor 在所有五项评估指标上取得所比较时间序列基线中的最佳整体性能，为该任务建立了新的性能基准。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作确立了基于信号进行偏滤器热通量重建的新范式和基准，并计划开源代码；文中未提及超出摘要范围的局限性分析。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在 DivMPS2HF 上，SafeDivertor 在所有五项评估指标上取得所比较时间序列基线中的最佳整体性能，为该任务建立了新的性能基准。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该工作确立了基于信号进行偏滤器热通量重建的新范式和基准，并计划开源代码；文中未提及超出摘要范围的局限性分析。

papers.title: F$^2$Agent: Financial Fusion of Agentic Intelligence for Multimodal Trading
papers.abstract_en: With increasingly diverse and heterogeneous information sources, effectively leveraging multimodal data is becoming pivotal for high-quality financial trading. Although recent advancements in Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents have enabled the ingestion of multimodal inputs, existing methods fail to capture nuanced cross-modal dependencies and remain vulnerable to market noise, due to limited multimodal modeling, ineffective fusion mechanisms, and inadequate robustness. To address these challenges, we propose F$^2$Agent, a novel multimodal agentic paradigm driven by the Financial Fusion of Agentic Intelligence. F$^2$Agent first deploys a hierarchy of specialized agents to comprehensively extract modality-specific signals. It further introduces a modality-aware adaptive fusion mechanism coupled with noise-robust consistency regularization to dynamically capture fine-grained inter-modality dependencies and generate noise-resilient trading signals. Extensive experiments on six stocks and cryptocurrency assets demonstrate that F$^2$Agent consistently outperforms 16 competitive baselines across multiple trading metrics, with over 20% relative improvement in annualized return on average. Notably, F$^2$Agent delivers returns of 120.48% on GOOG and 148.41% on TSLA, demonstrating its efficacy and robustness in varying market dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 F$^2$Agent，一种面向多模态金融交易的多模态智能体范式。该方法先部署层级化专门智能体提取各模态特定信号，再引入模态感知自适应融合机制与噪声鲁棒一致性正则化，以捕捉细粒度跨模态依赖并生成抗噪交易信号。在六种股票和加密货币资产上的实验显示，F$^2$Agent 在多个交易指标上一致优于 16 个竞争基线，平均年化收益相对提升超过 20%，其中在 GOOG 上收益 120.48%、在 TSLA 上收益 148.41%。
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的智能体虽能接收多模态输入，但在金融交易中因多模态建模有限、融合机制无效且鲁棒性不足，难以捕捉细粒度跨模态依赖，并易受市场噪声干扰。
Method: 提出 F$^2$Agent，首先部署一组层级化专门智能体（hierarchy of specialized agents）来全面提取模态特定信号；随后引入模态感知自适应融合机制（modality-aware adaptive fusion）并耦合噪声鲁棒一致性正则化（noise-robust consistency regularization），动态捕捉细粒度模态间依赖并生成抗噪交易信号。
Result: 在六种股票和加密货币资产上的大量实验表明，F$^2$Agent 在多个交易指标上一致优于 16 个竞争基线，平均年化收益相对提升超过 20%；具体地，其在 GOOG 上获得 120.48% 的收益，在 TSLA 上获得 148.41% 的收益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 F$^2$Agent 在不同市场动态下展现出有效性和鲁棒性，验证了所提多模态融合与噪声鲁棒机制在金融交易中的价值。

papers.title: Potential Matching Optimal Transport: Continuous Normalizing Flows for Exact $p$-Wasserstein Dynamics
authors: Lei Li (1 and 2) ((1) School of Mathematical Sciences
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Potential Matching Optimal Transport (PMOT), a potential-flow framework for general $p$-cost optimal transport with $c_p(x,y)=\|x-y\|^p$. PMOT parameterizes the CNF velocity field with a scalar potential in the generalized Benamou--Brenier form for the chosen exponent $p$. It trains the potential gradient with a self-induced matching loss along straight bridges determined by the model's own endpoints, while allowing flexible terminal distribution matching. Our main result establishes zero-loss exactness: under the stated regularity, exact terminal matching, and uniqueness assumptions, any zero-loss solution satisfies the generalized Benamou--Brenier optimality system and recovers the corresponding $p$-optimal transport map and dynamics. On synthetic benchmarks, PMOT learns $p$-specific maps that agree with the corresponding $p$-matched OT references. It also remains competitive as a likelihood-based density model on high-dimensional tabular data, and an MMD-based color transformation experiment demonstrates flexible sample-based terminal matching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出势匹配最优传输（Potential Matching Optimal Transport, PMOT），一种面向一般 p-代价最优传输（c_p(x,y)=||x-y||^p）的势流框架。PMOT 用标量势在广义 Benamou–Brenier 形式下参数化连续归一化流（CNF）的速度场，并通过沿模型自身端点确定的直线桥（straight bridges）上的自诱导匹配损失训练势梯度，同时允许灵活的终端分布匹配。主要理论结果是零损失精确性：在给定正则性、精确终端匹配与唯一性假设下，零损失解满足广义 Benamou–Brenier 最优性系统并恢复对应的 p-最优传输映射与动力学。
Motivation: 现有连续归一化流与最优传输方法的结合多局限于 2-Wasserstein 情形，缺乏对一般 p-代价最优传输的通用势流构造，也难以在灵活终端匹配下保证恢复 p-最优传输映射。
Method: 以广义 Benamou–Brenier 形式将 CNF 速度场参数化为标量势的梯度，针对所选指数 p 构造自诱导匹配损失，该损失沿由模型自身端点确定的直线桥计算；训练中允许灵活的终端分布匹配，并给出零损失解恢复 p-最优传输系统与映射的理论保证。
Result: 在合成基准上，PMOT 学到的 p 特定映射与对应的 p-匹配 OT 参考一致；在高维表格数据上作为基于似然的密度模型具有竞争力；基于 MMD 的颜色变换实验展示了灵活的基于样本的终端匹配能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PMOT 在一般 p-代价下实现了可证明的零损失精确性，同时保持灵活终端匹配与密度建模能力；其理论结论依赖于正则性、精确终端匹配和唯一性假设。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Dual-Attention and Adversarial Transfer Networks for Sim-to-Real Cross-Orientation Wireless Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Millimeter-wave human activity recognition suffers significant performance degradation when the user's orientation changes relative to the sensing system, yet collecting labeled multi-orientation data is labor-intensive and costly. To eliminate the need for exhaustive multi-orientation measured data, we develop a physics-guided simulator that synthesizes orientation-diverse wireless training data from single-orientation motion. Specifically, to suppress orientation-induced feature variations, we propose a dual-attention network that extracts activity-discriminative and orientation-robust representations from dual-link Doppler spectrograms. To bridge the simulation-to-reality gap, we introduce an adversarial unsupervised transfer learning mechanism that aligns feature distributions using only a small number of unlabeled target-domain samples. The S2M-Sense platform shows high fidelity in reproducing real-world signatures, validated against 60.48 GHz mmWave measured data with an average structural similarity index measure (SSIM) of 0.84 between simulated and measured Doppler spectrograms across all 4 activities and 4 orientations. Experimental results show that S2M-Sense achieves 88.33% recognition accuracy using only the dual-link multi-orientation simulated dataset, which improves to 95% after simulation-to-reality transfer learning with as few as 16 unlabeled measured samples. Both cases with and without transfer learning outperform state-of-the-art cross-domain sensing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对毫米波人体活动识别中用户朝向变化导致的性能下降问题，提出物理引导的仿真器 S2M-Sense 从单朝向动作合成多朝向训练数据，并设计双注意力网络提取朝向鲁棒的动作判别表征，再结合对抗无监督迁移学习弥合仿真到真实的差距。摘要报告在 60.48 GHz 实测数据上，仿真与实测多普勒频谱图在 4 种活动和 4 种朝向上的平均结构相似性指数（SSIM）为 0.84；仅用双链路多朝向仿真数据集达到 88.33% 的识别准确率，使用 16 个无标注实测样本做迁移学习后提升至 95%。
Motivation: 采集带标注的多朝向毫米波数据成本高、劳动密集，而用户朝向变化会显著降低活动识别性能。论文目标是免去大规模多朝向实测标注数据，同时缓解朝向带来的特征变化。
Method: 提出物理引导的仿真器，从单朝向动作合成朝向多样化的无线训练数据；提出双注意力网络（dual-attention network）从双链路多普勒频谱图中提取动作判别且朝向鲁棒的表征；并引入对抗无监督迁移学习机制，仅用少量无标注目标域样本对齐特征分布，以缩小仿真到真实的差距。
Result: S2M-Sense 仿真平台在 4 种活动和 4 种朝向上与 60.48 GHz 实测数据的平均 SSIM 为 0.84；仅用双链路多朝向仿真数据集识别准确率为 88.33%，加入 16 个无标注实测样本进行仿真到真实迁移学习后提升至 95%；有迁移和无迁移两种情况下均优于现有跨域感知方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提仿真器、双注意力网络与对抗迁移的组合能够消除对多朝向标注数据的需求并有效弥合仿真-现实差距；实验验证在 60.48 GHz 毫米波频段、4 种活动与 4 种朝向下成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Vorch-Streamer: Extending Human Audio-Visual Generation to Real-Time Long-Form Streaming
papers.abstract_en: Real-time long-form avatar audio--video generation requires causal, continuous synthesis while maintaining audiovisual synchronization and visual consistency. Adapting a pretrained bidirectional model to this setting presents two key dilemmas. First, autoregressively reusing generated blocks as context creates exposure bias, causing errors and visual drift to accumulate over long rollouts. Second, a global speech utterance does not indicates a causal generator which portion should be spoken next when only limited local audio--video context is available. We present \textbf{Vorch-Streamer}, a post-training framework that addresses these challenges and enables real-time long-form Text-to-Audio-Video (T2AV) streaming. We construct a synthetic corpus of 80K avatar clips spanning 12--21 seconds and first train a causal generator with mixed Teacher Forcing and Diffusion Forcing. We then apply long-horizon Self Forcing with DMD distillation, exposing the model to its own rollout distribution while preserving the quality of the pretrained bidirectional teacher. To explicitly control speech progression, an external language model predicts discrete 25-Hz speech-planning tokens, whose continuous features condition the audio diffusion branch and align each causal block with the content it should speak. With bounded causal context and four-step denoising, Vorch-Streamer jointly generates audio and video from text at 27.12 FPS, exceeding the 24-FPS real-time playback rate while maintaining competitive audio--lip synchronization and strong identity preservation over long-form generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Vorch-Streamer，一个面向实时长时段音视频生成（T2AV streaming）的后训练框架，解决将预训练双向生成模型适配为因果流式生成时的曝光偏差与语音进度控制问题。作者构建 80K 段 12–21 秒的合成头像语料，先用混合 Teacher Forcing 与 Diffusion Forcing 训练因果生成器，再通过长视界 Self Forcing 与 DMD 蒸馏提升 rollout 稳定性；外部语言模型预测 25-Hz 语音规划 token 来控制每个因果块应说的内容。最终在有限因果上下文和四步去噪下，以 27.12 FPS 联合生成音频和视频，超过 24-FPS 实时播放速率。
Motivation: 实时长时段虚拟人（avatar）音频-视频生成需要因果、连续的合成，同时保持音视频同步与视觉一致性；但直接适配预训练双向模型会产生两个困境：自回归复用生成块作为上下文会引入曝光偏差，导致长 rollout 中错误与视觉漂移累积；全局语音话语无法在仅有局部音视频上下文时指示因果生成器下一步应说哪部分内容。
Method: 提出 Vorch-Streamer 后训练框架：先构建 80K 段 12–21 秒的合成头像语料，用混合 Teacher Forcing 和 Diffusion Forcing 训练一个因果生成器；然后应用长视界 Self Forcing 结合 DMD 蒸馏，让模型暴露于自身 rollout 分布同时保持预训练双向教师的质量；一个外部语言模型预测离散的 25-Hz 语音规划 token，其连续特征条件化音频扩散分支，将每个因果块与应讲述的内容对齐。
Result: 摘要报告 Vorch-Streamer 在有限因果上下文和四步去噪下，以 27.12 FPS 联合生成音频与视频，超过 24-FPS 的实时播放速率，同时保持有竞争力的音频-嘴唇同步和长时段生成中的强身份保持。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过有界因果上下文与外部语音规划 token 的显式进度控制，可以在长时段生成中兼顾实时速率、音视频同步与身份保持；未提及明显局限性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出 Vorch-Streamer 后训练框架：先构建 80K 段 12–21 秒的合成头像语料，用混合 Teacher Forcing 和 Diffusion Forcing 训练一个因果生成器；然后应用长视界 Self Forcing 结合 DMD 蒸馏，让模型暴露于自身 rollout 分布同时保持预训练双向教师的质量；一个外部语言模型预测离散的 25-Hz 语音规划 token，其连续特征条件化音频扩散分支，将每个因果块与应讲述的内容对齐。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 Vorch-Streamer 在有限因果上下文和四步去噪下，以 27.12 FPS 联合生成音频与视频，超过 24-FPS 的实时播放速率，同时保持有竞争力的音频-嘴唇同步和长时段生成中的强身份保持。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调通过有界因果上下文与外部语音规划 token 的显式进度控制，可以在长时段生成中兼顾实时速率、音视频同步与身份保持；未提及明显局限性。

papers.title: Reasoning Errors Have a Region and a Direction in the Residual-Stream Trajectory of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: As language models are increasingly used for tasks that require verifiable reasoning, reliably distinguishing sound reasoning from flawed reasoning has become an important practical problem. Recent trajectory-based methods seek this signal in layerwise residual-stream displacements, which capture how representations change while attenuating some stable, token-specific information. However, displacement omits the state from which an update originates, whereas restoring the full state risks reintroducing shortcut-prone information. We identify this trade-off and propose a three-stream detector that combines motion with two restricted views of location. A coarse region reader based on vector quantization and a fine direction reader over normalized multi-layer states. This design restores enough state context to interpret the motion without returning to full-state probing. On reasoning benchmarks unseen during training, our method improves selection accuracy by up to 12% over the displacement-only state of the art and 21% over single-layer probing baselines. Although trained only on reasoning benchmarks, it also reads factual completion and fact verification, ahead of every detector we compare against, which places the signal on correctness rather than on a kind of reasoning. Ablations further show that motion, region, and direction provide complementary signals. These results suggest that reasoning validity is better read from state-conditioned motion than from either static states or decontextualized trajectories alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何从大语言模型的残差流轨迹中区分推理正确与错误，指出现有逐层位移方法丢失了更新所源自的状态，而恢复全状态又可能引入易受捷径影响的信息。作者提出一种三流检测器，结合运动（motion）与两个受限的位置视图：基于向量量化的粗糙区域读取器（region）和基于归一化多层状态的精细方向读取器（direction）。在训练中未见过的推理基准上，该方法相较仅用位移的最先进方法选择准确率提升最高 12%，相较单层探针基线提升 21%，并泛化到事实补全与事实验证任务。
Motivation: 语言模型越来越多地用于需要可验证推理的任务，因此可靠地区分合理推理与缺陷推理成为重要的实际问题。现有基于轨迹的方法使用逐层残差流位移，但位移忽略了更新所源自的状态；恢复完整状态又可能重新引入捷径可利用的信息，这一权衡需要被识别并解决。
Method: 提出三流检测器，将运动信息与两个受限位置视图结合：基于向量量化的粗糙区域读取器和基于归一化多层状态的精细方向读取器。该设计在不回到全状态探针的前提下恢复足够的状态上下文来解释运动。
Result: 在训练中未见的推理基准上，该方法的选择准确率比仅用位移的最先进方法提升最高 12%，比单层探针基线提升 21%。尽管只使用推理基准训练，它在事实补全和事实验证上优于所有对比检测器；消融实验表明运动、区域和方向提供互补信号。
Conclusion: 结果显示推理有效性更适合从状态条件化的运动（state-conditioned motion）中读取，而不是从静态状态或去上下文化轨迹单独读取，且该信号位于正确性本身而非特定推理类型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Studying People to Study AI: Expert Perspectives on the Epistemic Fit and Barriers of Human Research in AI Safety & Ethics
papers.abstract_en: Safety risks of AI are becoming increasingly evident in human interactions with AI technologies. The prominent approaches to evaluating these risks favor technical methods, such as model benchmarks and LLM simulations, often sidelining empirical research with human subjects. To examine this apparent gap in the acceptance of human research, we conduct an expert survey (n=93) and expert interviews (n=17) with AI Safety & Ethics (AISE) researchers from Technical, Sociotechnical, Governance, and Normative backgrounds. Our findings suggest that although there is a consensus that human research is valuable for generating evidence for AISE, its adoption and acceptance are constrained by perceived validity issues, tangible resource barriers, epistemic and personal preferences in methods, and infrastructural constraints from the broader research community. In particular, Technical researchers tend to value human research less and collaborate across disciplines less, suggesting an epistemic tension towards human methods. We propose recommendations for establishing the epistemic fit of human research within AISE and bridging the prohibitive limitations that researchers face, while avoiding performative 'human-washing'.
papers.comment: Ninth AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过专家调查（n=93）和专家访谈（n=17）研究 AI 安全与伦理（AI Safety & Ethics, AISE）领域中对人类被试实证研究的接受度问题。作者指出当前风险评估主流依赖模型基准（model benchmarks）和 LLM 模拟（LLM simulations）等技术手段，而边缘化了以人类为对象的研究。结果显示，尽管受访者普遍认同人类研究对 AISE 证据生成有价值，但其采纳与接受受到感知效度问题、现实资源障碍、方法论上的认知与个人偏好以及研究共同体的基础设施约束。
Motivation: AI 安全风险在人类与 AI 技术的交互中日益明显，但主流风险评估方法偏向技术手段，如模型基准和 LLM 模拟，往往排挤了以人类被试进行的实证研究。论文旨在考察这一人类研究接受度缺口及其原因。
Method: 对来自技术（Technical）、社会技术（Sociotechnical）、治理（Governance）与规范（Normative）四类背景的 AISE 研究者开展专家问卷调查（n=93）和专家访谈（n=17），分析人类研究在被认为有价值的同时为何难以被广泛采纳。
Result: 研究发现存在共识认为人类研究对 AISE 证据生成很重要，但其采用受感知效度问题、资源障碍、方法论偏好及共同体基础设施约束的限制；其中技术背景研究者对人类研究的价值评价更低，且跨学科合作更少，显示出对人类方法论的认知张力。
Conclusion: 作者提出建立人类研究在 AISE 中的认知适配性（epistemic fit）并克服研究者面临的阻碍性限制的建议，同时强调避免表演性的“人类洗绿”（performative 'human-washing'）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Relay, Don't Route: Adaptive Population Handoff for Cost-Efficient LLM-Driven Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-driven evolution has shown promise for program search and algorithm discovery, but relying on strong models throughout long evolutionary runs is costly. A natural alternative is to combine cheap and strong models under a fixed inference budget. However, existing approaches typically allocate models at the level of individual queries or mutation steps, overlooking that evolutionary search is \textit{stateful}: each generated candidate changes the population from which subsequent mutations are produced. We empirically analyze LLM-driven evolutionary trajectories and find that search progress is strongly front-loaded, early trajectory performance is informative but noisy, and cheap models recover much of the early progress achieved by strong models at lower cost. Motivated by these findings, we propose \textbf{\model}, a training-free framework that shifts budget allocation from individual calls to evolving populations through adaptive \textit{population handoff}. A cheap model explores multiple trajectories in short blocks allocated by a bandit scheduler. Relay Gain, defined as the marginal improvement of a compact, quality-diverse candidate bank constructed for handoff, serves as the scheduler reward and determines when to hand off. The curated candidates initialize a shared strong model population for refinement. Across four benchmarks and three budgets, \model achieves the highest mean score in 11 of 12 settings, outperforming competitive baselines. Our results suggest that in stateful search, budget allocation should be organized around the population, not the individual call.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 驱动的演化搜索（如程序搜索与算法发现）中强模型全程参与成本过高的问题，提出一个免训练的预算分配框架，将分配粒度从单次调用提升到演化种群层面，通过自适应“种群交接”（population handoff）让廉价模型先探索、强模型再精炼。作者基于对演化轨迹的经验分析发现搜索进度高度前置、早期性能有信息量但有噪声，且廉价模型能以较低成本恢复强模型早期的大部分进展。在四个基准和三种预算下，所提框架在 12 个设置中的 11 个取得最高平均分。
Motivation: LLM 驱动的演化长期依赖强模型成本高昂，而将廉价与强模型混合的现有方法通常在单次查询或单步变异级别分配模型，忽略了演化搜索是有状态（stateful）的：每次生成的候选都会改变后续变异所依据的种群。
Method: 提出免训练的框架，把预算分配从单次调用转向演化中的种群：由 bandit 调度器为廉价模型分配多个短块以探索多条轨迹；Relay Gain（为交接构建的紧凑且质量多样候选库的边际改进）作为调度器奖励，决定何时交接；筛选出的候选用于初始化共享的强模型种群做后续精炼。
Result: 在四个基准和三个预算下，该方法在 12 个设置中的 11 个取得最高平均分，优于多个竞争基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为在有状态的搜索中，预算分配应围绕种群而非单次调用进行组织；摘要同时强调了搜索进度前置、早期轨迹信息有噪声且廉价模型可低成本恢复早期进展等经验发现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Vorch-IR: Long-Form Unified Multimodal Identity Replacement Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video identity replacement seeks to transfer the identities of one or more subjects while preserving the motion, expressions, and temporal structure of a driving video. Existing methods largely target single-person settings and often require task-specific structural controls, such as masks or pose representations, limiting their flexibility in general multimodal editing systems. Progress on multi-person replacement is further constrained by the scarcity of paired training data. We present Vorch-IR, a unified framework that supports single- and dual-person identity replacement, with optional background replacement, in a single model. Built on LTX2, Vorch-IR jointly conditions on a driving video, indexed reference images, and a textual editing instruction. The reference images need not match the pose, layout, or spatial configuration of the driving video: their roles as subject or background references are specified through the instruction. Dense visual conditions are fused through self-attention, while a vision-language context establishes semantic correspondence through cross-attention. We further develop an automatic data construction pipeline that synthesizes paired supervision for all four editing settings. Experiments using automatic metrics and pairwise human evaluation demonstrate strong identity preservation, motion fidelity, and temporal coherence across diverse scenarios. A temporal overlapping inference strategy additionally extends the short-clip model to minute-long generation without autoregressive continuation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Vorch-IR，一个基于 LTX2 的统一视频身份替换（identity replacement）框架，在单一模型中支持单人和双人身份替换，并可选择替换背景。模型联合以驱动视频、带索引的参考图像和文本编辑指令为条件，参考图像无需与驱动视频的姿势或空间布局匹配，其作为主体或背景的参考角色由指令指定。作者还构建了自动数据构造流程以合成四种编辑设置下的成对监督，并通过时间重叠推理策略将短片段模型扩展到分钟级生成。
Motivation: 现有视频身份替换方法大多只针对单人场景，且依赖掩码或姿态表示等任务特定的结构控制，限制了在通用多模态编辑系统中的灵活性；多人物替换的进展还受限于成对训练数据的稀缺。
Method: 基于 LTX2 构建统一框架，将密集视觉条件通过自注意力（self-attention）融合，并通过视觉-语言上下文经交叉注意力（cross-attention）建立语义对应；同时提出自动数据构造流程生成成对监督，以及时间重叠推理策略以支持分钟级长视频生成。
Result: 自动评估指标和成对人工评估表明，该方法在多种场景下实现了较强的身份保持、运动保真度和时间一致性。
Conclusion: 该工作表明无需自回归续接即可将短片段模型扩展为分钟级生成，并以统一模型覆盖单/双人身份替换与背景替换场景。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 自动评估指标和成对人工评估表明，该方法在多种场景下实现了较强的身份保持、运动保真度和时间一致性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作表明无需自回归续接即可将短片段模型扩展为分钟级生成，并以统一模型覆盖单/双人身份替换与背景替换场景。

papers.title: RASP-QAOA: Resource-Aware Per-Instance Selection for Exact QAOA Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Exact QAOA simulation spans several computational representations whose useful regions differ sharply across graph structure, circuit depth, precision, and available memory. Choosing only a backend name hides these differences: an executable choice also fixes the representation, adapter, precision mode, and memory policy. We introduce RASP-QAOA, a per-instance selector over ten such actions. It first removes actions that cannot implement the requested QAOA semantics or execution requirements, then orders the remaining actions using instance features; actions outside learned support are handled by analytical work estimates. On a content-disjoint 60-request H200 evaluation, RASP-QAOA succeeds on all 31 requests for which at least one admissible action completes and validates. Within this set it reaches 27/31 top-1 and 31/31 top-2 selection, with 1.051 geometric-mean regret. Its failure-penalized PAR10 score is 0.0396 times that of development-selected CUAOA (95% interval: 0.0085-0.1644). A separate 30-request crossover shows that graph structure changes 16 decisions and improves the paired penalized score, while a depth-1 stump matches gradient boosting. The evidence supports resource-aware representation selection at n <= 35, p <= 5, with gains driven by representation features rather than classifier complexity.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Code and reproducibility package: https://github.com/jesse1029/rasp-qaoa
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RASP-QAOA，一个针对精确 QAOA 模拟的 per-instance 选择器，可从十种动作（覆盖表示、适配器、精度模式和内存策略）中按实例挑选最优组合。在内容不重叠的 60 请求 H200 评估中，RASP-QAOA 在所有 31 个至少有一个可接受动作的请求上成功，并达到 27/31 top-1 与 31/31 top-2 选择，几何平均后悔为 1.051。其失败惩罚后的 PAR10 分数仅为开发期选定 CUAOA 的 0.0396 倍。
Motivation: 精确 QAOA 模拟涉及多种计算表示，其可用区域随图结构、电路深度、精度和可用内存而剧烈变化；仅选择后端名称会掩盖这些差异，因为可执行的选择还固定了表示、适配器、精度模式和内存策略。
Method: RASP-QAOA 首先剔除无法实现请求的 QAOA 语义或执行要求的动作，然后利用实例特征对剩余动作排序；对于超出学习支持范围的动作，使用分析性工作量估计来处理。
Result: 在 60 请求 H200 评估中，RASP-QAOA 对全部 31 个可完成请求成功，取得 27/31 top-1 和 31/31 top-2，几何平均后悔 1.051；PAR10 分数为 CUAOA 的 0.0396 倍（95% 区间 0.0085–0.1644）。额外 30 请求交叉实验显示图结构改变 16 个决策并提升配对惩罚分数，而深度 1 的决策树桩与梯度提升表现相当。
Conclusion: 证据支持在 n ≤ 35、p ≤ 5 的范围内进行资源感知的表示选择，且收益主要来自表示特征而非分类器复杂度。

papers.title: Refining Over Resampling: Test-Time Self-Correction for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling improves LLM reasoning by using additional inference compute, but wider sampling alone can suffer from diminishing returns: new rollouts often repeat existing answer patterns instead of adding useful reasoning diversity. Verifier-based selection offers an alternative, but its performance depends on the calibration of an external reward model. We propose a verifier-free breadth--depth refinement framework that uses test-time compute to both explore and improve candidate solutions. The method samples multiple independent reasoning rollouts, refines each rollout through iterative self-critique and self-correction, and aggregates the refined answers by majority voting. Breadth preserves diverse initial attempts, while depth repairs local reasoning errors before aggregation. Across AIME24, AIME25, AMC, OlympiadBench, and MATH500, our method consistently improves over greedy decoding, majority voting, verifier-based best-of-$N$, beam search, and lookahead decoding across multiple open-weight models. For instance, with Qwen2.5-1.5B, accuracy increases from the strongest verifier-based baseline to $58.0\%$ on MATH500, and from $25.0\%$ to $32.5\%$ on AMC. These results show that test-time compute can be more effective when used to refine sampled trajectories rather than only to sample more candidates or rely on verifier-guided selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无验证器 (verifier-free) 的广度-深度细化框架，用于提升大语言模型推理时的测试时计算 (test-time compute) 利用率。方法先采样多条独立推理轨迹，再对每条轨迹进行迭代自我批评与自我修正，最后通过多数投票聚合修正后的答案。摘要报告该方法在 AIME24、AIME25、AMC、OlympiadBench 和 MATH500 上一致优于贪心解码、多数投票、基于验证器的 best-of-N、beam search 和 lookahead decoding。
Motivation: 测试时扩展 (test-time scaling) 依赖额外推理计算，但单纯扩大采样会出现收益递减，新 rollout 常重复已有答案模式；而基于验证器的选择方法又受外部奖励模型校准质量制约。
Method: 提出无验证器的广度-深度细化框架：广度上采样多个独立推理 rollout 以保留多样初始尝试，深度上通过迭代自我批评和自我修正修复局部推理错误，再用多数投票聚合细化后的答案。
Result: 摘要报告在多个开放权重模型上，该方法在 AIME24、AIME25、AMC、OlympiadBench、MATH500 上均超过贪心解码、多数投票、基于验证器的 best-of-N、beam search 和 lookahead decoding。例如 Qwen2.5-1.5B 在 MATH500 上从最强验证器基线提升至 58.0%，在 AMC 上从 25.0% 提升至 32.5%。
Conclusion: 本文认为测试时计算用于细化已采样轨迹比单纯采样更多候选或依赖验证器引导选择更有效。

papers.title: Bayesian Expected Uncertainty Reduction (B-EUR) Model: A Computational Account of What Makes Design Options Worth Trying
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes the Bayesian Expected Uncertainty Reduction (B-EUR) model, which formalizes the value of trying a candidate design action as its expected reduction of epistemic uncertainty about action--outcome relations. The model addresses one part of the Uncertainty Driven Action (UDA) model's open question concerning how changes in uncertainty perception determine action selection. We examine two environmental properties: generalizability, or how far knowledge from one trial extends to neighboring candidates, and outcome discriminability, or how clearly differences among outcomes can be distinguished. We tested the model through simulations and human experiments using a graph-shape guessing task that isolates learning about action--outcome relations under a limited trial budget. Epistemic value followed an inverted-U-shaped relationship with generalizability and increased with outcome discriminability in the simulations. In the human experiments, the subjective value of trying and enjoyment followed inverted-U-shaped relationships with generalizability, while choice behavior reflected both properties. The B-EUR model provides a computational account of candidate-action evaluation within uncertainty-driven design activity and offers implications for constructing prototype sets, framing design problems, and organizing feedback to support informative exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出贝叶斯期望不确定性减少（B-EUR）模型，将尝试某个候选设计动作的价值形式化为对动作-结果关系认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）的期望减少。作者通过模拟和人类实验（图-形状猜测任务）考察了泛化性（知识从一次试验延伸到邻近候选的程度）和结果可区分性（结果间差异是否清晰可辨）两个环境属性。模拟显示认知价值与泛化性呈倒U型关系、随结果可区分性增强而增加；人类实验中主观价值与愉悦感同样与泛化性呈倒U型关系，且选择行为同时反映这两个属性。
Motivation: 该工作针对不确定性驱动动作（UDA）模型的一个开放问题：不确定性感知的变化如何决定动作选择，从而为设计活动中候选动作的评估提供形式化解释。
Method: 提出B-EUR模型，把尝试候选设计动作的价值定义为期望的认知不确定性减少量，并用模拟和人类实验加以验证；实验采用图-形状猜测任务，在有限试验预算下隔离对动作-结果关系的学习。
Result: 模拟中认知价值与泛化性呈倒U型关系，并随结果可区分性增高而上升；人类实验中主观价值与愉悦感与泛化性呈倒U型关系，而选择行为同时受泛化性和结果可区分性影响。
Conclusion: B-EUR模型为不确定性驱动的设计活动中的候选动作评估提供了计算层面的解释，并为如何构建原型集合、框定设计问题和组织反馈以促进信息性探索提供了启示。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ChronoVision: Temporal Reasoning via Latent State Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models excel at passive perception but struggle with complex visual cognitive tasks requiring multi-step temporal reasoning. This degradation largely stems from the inherent ambiguity of language-based reasoning, which often fails to accurately articulate continuous visual transformations. To address this, we propose ChronoVision, a multimodal framework designed to align visual logic with latent imagery. During supervised fine-tuning, a Reconstructive Visual Head predicts the latent representation of the final transformed state, while an ROI Attention Locating module focuses the model on key visual evidence via semantic span queries. In post-training, we apply reinforcement learning with an implicit process grounding mechanism, guided by a composite reward function that evaluates outcome correctness, latent process alignment, and unsupervised visual focus. Furthermore, we introduce Vbvr-VQA, a novel dataset that evaluates temporal tracking by reformulating video reasoning into a strict image-ordering task. Experiments demonstrate that ChronoVision achieves state-of-the-art performance on Vbvr-VQA with 74.8% in-domain and 71.6% out-of-domain accuracy, alongside a strong 55.0% accuracy on IntPhys2, a highly challenging cross-domain benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ChronoVision，一个面向多模态大语言模型的多步时间推理框架，通过在监督微调中加入 Reconstructive Visual Head 预测最终变换状态的潜在表示，并用 ROI Attention Locating 模块引导模型关注关键视觉证据；后训练阶段采用带隐式过程接地机制的强化学习与复合奖励。作者还引入 Vbvr-VQA 数据集，将视频推理重构为严格图像排序任务来评测时间追踪。实验显示 ChronoVision 在 Vbvr-VQA 上取得 74.8% 域内与 71.6% 域外准确率，并在跨域基准 IntPhys2 上达到 55.0%。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型善于被动感知，但在需要多步时间推理的复杂视觉认知任务上表现不佳，原因是基于语言的推理难以准确表达连续的视觉变换过程。
Method: 提出 ChronoVision 框架：监督微调阶段用 Reconstructive Visual Head 预测最终变换状态的潜在表示，ROI Attention Locating 模块通过语义跨度查询聚焦关键视觉证据；后训练阶段应用带隐式过程接地机制的强化学习，复合奖励函数同时评估结果正确性、潜在过程对齐与无监督视觉聚焦。同时构造 Vbvr-VQA 数据集，把视频推理转化为严格图像排序任务。
Result: 摘要报告 ChronoVision 在 Vbvr-VQA 上达到 74.8% 域内与 71.6% 域外准确率，并在具有挑战性的跨域基准 IntPhys2 上取得 55.0% 准确率，均为强结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为将视觉逻辑与潜在表象对齐可显著改善多步时间推理，框架在域内、域外及跨域基准上均达到最优水平。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SkillHEX: Improving Agent Skills via Hypothesis-Driven Autonomous Exploration and Exploitation
papers.abstract_en: Although agent skills equip LLMs with reusable procedural knowledge, manual maintenance suffers from high costs, unscalability, and misalignment. Real-world deployments thus require autonomous, on-demand skill evolution at test time, constrained by limited interaction budgets and a lack of training or validation sets. This setting introduces a severe sparse reward challenge, where outcomes conflate multiple latent failure causes. Under such ambiguity, existing methods that greedily refine a single incumbent skill are particularly vulnerable to an exploitation trap, allowing early misdiagnoses to exhaust limited trials along unproductive trajectories. To address this, we introduce SkillHEX, a closed-loop framework coupling hypothesis-driven self-verification with evidence-guided tree search. SkillHEX translates falsifiable failure hypotheses into executable tests, producing diagnostic evidence as dense reward without additional environment attempts. This evidence guides a search over persistent skill-revision branches, dynamically balancing the exploitation of supported edits with the exploration of plausible alternatives. Evaluated on 87 tasks from SkillsBench, SkillHEX outperforms existing self-evolving methods and achieves an average pass rate of 55.9% and 57.9% using GPT-5.3-Codex and Claude Opus 4.7 under a five-iteration budget, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillHEX，一个用于 LLM agent 技能自主演化的闭环框架，面向测试时按需技能更新，且受限于极少的交互预算、没有训练或验证集。该方法将可证伪的失败假设转化为可执行测试，产生无需额外环境尝试的诊断证据，并利用证据引导的树搜索在利用受支持编辑与探索替代分支之间取得平衡。在 SkillsBench 的 87 个任务上，以五次迭代为预算，SkillHEX 分别使用 GPT-5.3-Codex 和 Claude Opus 4.7 达到 55.9% 和 57.9% 的平均通过率，优于现有自演化方法。
Motivation: 手动维护 agent 技能成本高、不可扩展且易与真实需求失配，因此需要测试时自主演化技能。该场景存在严重的稀疏奖励问题，结果会混淆多个潜在失败原因，而现有贪心细化单一技能的方法容易陷入剥削陷阱（exploitation trap），让早期误诊耗尽有限的试验预算。
Method: SkillHEX 是一个闭环框架，将假设驱动的自我验证（hypothesis-driven self-verification）与证据引导的树搜索（evidence-guided tree search）结合。它把可证伪的失败假设翻译成可执行测试，产出密集奖励形式的诊断证据，再用这些证据在持久的技能修改分支上进行搜索，动态平衡对受支持编辑的利用与对替代方案的探索。
Result: 在 SkillsBench 的 87 个任务上、五次迭代预算下，SkillHEX 的平均通过率在使用 GPT-5.3-Codex 时为 55.9%，使用 Claude Opus 4.7 时为 57.9%，均超过现有 self-evolving 方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SkillHEX 通过假设驱动的自我验证与证据引导搜索，能在有限交互预算下实现自主、按需的技能演化。摘要未提及方法在本文之外的具体局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SCI-CLIP: Segment-Centric Inference with Reference Memory for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Training-free open-vocabulary segmentation remains limited by a missing inference abstraction. Frozen vision-language features are produced at patch level, yet dense prediction requires a unit that simultaneously governs feature interaction, spatial support, contextual recovery, and retrieval-based correction. We present SCI-CLIP, a segment-centric inference framework built around the principle that the same region abstraction should organize all stages of dense open-vocabulary prediction. SCI-CLIP first induces a region-consistent interaction graph over frozen visual tokens, then reconstructs dense features by propagating values over this graph, augmenting them with selective cross-window support only where local evidence is insufficient. The same segment abstraction is subsequently used to construct and query an offline reference memory, aligning exemplar retrieval with the units on which prediction is made. SCI-CLIP turns frozen CLIP-style features into spatially coherent, context-aware, and retrieval-compatible dense predictions without any training. SCI-CLIP consistently improves the structural quality of dense predictions, the robustness of contextual reasoning, and the alignment of exemplar-based correction, yielding stronger open-vocabulary segmentation across eight benchmarks. Project code is available at: https://github.com/mzamini92/SCICLIP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCI-CLIP，一种免训练的开集分割 (open-vocabulary segmentation) 推理框架，核心是用同一分片 (segment) 抽象统一组织特征交互、空间支持、上下文恢复与检索修正。方法先对冻结 CLIP 视觉 token 构建区域一致交互图并传播重建稠密特征，再用相同分片抽象构建和查询离线参考记忆，无需训练即可将 CLIP 特征转化为空间连贯、上下文感知且检索兼容的稠密预测，在八个基准上提升开集分割性能。
Motivation: 免训练开集分割缺少统一的推理抽象：冻结视觉-语言特征在 patch 级别产生，而稠密预测需要一个能同时控制特征交互、空间支持、上下文恢复和检索修正的单元。
Method: 提出段中心推理框架 SCI-CLIP：先在冻结视觉 token 上诱导区域一致交互图，通过图上传播重建稠密特征，并仅在局部证据不足时加入选择性跨窗口支持；随后用同一分片抽象构建并查询离线参考记忆，使示例检索与预测单元对齐。
Result: 摘要报告 SCI-CLIP 在八个基准上一致提升稠密预测的结构质量、上下文推理的鲁棒性以及基于示例修正的对齐，取得更强的开集分割结果。
Conclusion: 无需任何训练即可将冻结 CLIP 风格特征转化为空间连贯、上下文感知且检索兼容的稠密预测；代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dual-Output Multi-Exposure HDR Reconstruction via SDR Fusion and Gain Map Inverse Tone Mapping
papers.abstract_en: We propose DOME-HDR, a dual-output multi-exposure HDR reconstruction framework that jointly produces a perceptually balanced SDR image and a consistent HDR image via gain map inverse tone mapping. Given three bracketed LDR inputs, DOME-HDR first synthesizes a base SDR using a LoRA-adapted latent diffusion model. A dual cross-attention fusion module injects complementary structural and color cues from the under- and over-exposed images while anchoring on the mid exposure for stability. The synthesized SDR then guides HPGM, our HDR Prior-guided Gain Map network, to predict a spatially varying gain map for reliable dynamic-range expansion. We evaluate on Kalantari, Tel, and Challenge123 using both full-reference and no-reference metrics, where DOME-HDR achieves state-of-the-art HDR reconstruction quality; ablations further confirm the effectiveness of dual cross-attention and SDR-guided gain map estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DOME-HDR，一种双输出多曝光 HDR 重建框架，通过 gain map 逆色调映射同时生成感知均衡的 SDR 图像和一致的 HDR 图像。给定三张包围曝光的 LDR 输入，先用 LoRA 适配的潜在扩散模型合成基础 SDR，再用双交叉注意力融合模块注入欠曝与过曝图像的互补信息，最后由 HDR 先验引导的 gain map 网络 (HPGM) 完成动态范围扩展。在 Kalantari、Tel 和 Challenge123 上达到 SOTA 的 HDR 重建质量，消融实验验证了双交叉注意力与 SDR 引导 gain map 估计的有效性。
Motivation: 多曝光 HDR 重建需要同时输出视觉上均衡的 SDR 与动态范围一致的 HDR，但现有方法在这一双输出设定下的重建质量和一致性仍有提升空间。
Method: DOME-HDR 采用三阶段设计：先由 LoRA 适配的潜在扩散模型合成基础 SDR；双交叉注意力融合模块以中间曝光为锚点，从欠曝和过曝图像中注入结构与色彩线索；随后 HDR 先验引导的 gain map 网络 (HPGM) 根据合成 SDR 预测空间变化的 gain map，完成动态范围扩展。
Result: 在 Kalantari、Tel 与 Challenge123 数据集上，使用全参考和无参考指标评估，DOME-HDR 取得 SOTA 的 HDR 重建质量；消融实验进一步确认了双交叉注意力机制和 SDR 引导 gain map 估计的贡献。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将 SDR 合成结果作为引导信号进行 gain map 逆色调映射，可以同时获得感知均衡的 SDR 与高质量的 HDR 输出。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measuring and Detecting Harmful AI Sycophancy
papers.abstract_en: Sycophantic responses are becoming pervasive in large language models (LLMs), and prior work has pointed out that some of them could be harmful. This paper focuses on one harmful sycophancy: preference-induced stance reversal sycophancy (PSRS), where a model reverses an initial stance merely to align with a user's stated preference. While existing research mainly measures how sycophantic a model is, we go further and ask whether PSRS can also be detected automatically from a single response. To investigate this at scale, we introduce CAP (Contrastive Anchor Probing), a framework for collecting labeled PSRS data. Applying CAP to 17 open- and closed-source LLMs, we collect 290,460 labeled responses across 12 everyday-advice domains. We organize our study around three research questions. (1) How often does PSRS occur? (2) How well can it be detected? (3) How does detection generalize to unseen models? We first reveal that PSRS rates range from 5% to 56% across LLMs, with more capable models being less sycophantic. Next, we show that detecting PSRS is feasible from the response text alone, and detectors need to learn subtle PSRS patterns from the training data. Because new LLMs appear rapidly, detectors inevitably encounter unseen models, making cross-model generalization an important framework goal. We demonstrate that detection performance drops on unseen models and propose an initial approach to address this challenge. We will release our dataset and code to support future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型中的有害谄媚行为，聚焦于偏好诱导的立场逆转谄媚（PSRS，即模型仅因迎合用户偏好而改变初始立场）。作者提出对比锚点探测（CAP）框架来规模化收集带标签的PSRS数据，应用于17个开源与闭源LLM，在12个日常咨询领域收集了290,460条带标签响应，并围绕PSRS发生频率、自动检测能力和跨模型泛化三个研究问题展开分析。
Motivation: 现有研究主要量化模型谄媚程度，但很少关注特定有害谄媚形式（如PSRS）能否从单条响应中自动检测，且新模型快速涌现使检测器面临未见模型的泛化挑战。
Method: 提出CAP（Contrastive Anchor Probing）框架用于收集带标签的PSRS数据；基于该数据训练检测器，仅从响应文本判断是否存在PSRS，并针对跨模型泛化下降提出初步应对方法。
Result: 摘要报告17个LLM的PSRS发生率为5%至56%，且能力更强的模型谄媚程度更低；从响应文本单独检测PSRS可行，但检测器需学习训练数据中的细微PSRS模式；检测性能在未见模型上下降。
Conclusion: 作者认为PSRS可被自动检测，但跨模型泛化仍是重要目标，并承诺发布数据集与代码以支持后续研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TruthLens: Object Hallucination Detection via Self-Evaluating Truthfulness Scores in LVLMs
papers.abstract_en: Despite the remarkable progress of large vision language models (LVLMs), object hallucination remains a fundamental challenge that hinders their trustworthy deployment. A key finding motivates our work: real and hallucinated object tokens are clearly separable in hidden representations, yet this separability is largely lost at the language-modeling (LM) head. We propose TruthLens, a self-evaluation framework that teaches the LM head to expose a per-object truthfulness signal without any auxiliary model or additional inference cost. Concretely, a rarely-used special token is repurposed as a reference token. For each object-token position, we extract the log-probability assigned to this special token by the LM head, and define its difference from a predefined constant as the truthfulness score. The model is then fine-tuned with an MSE objective that drives scores toward 1 for real objects and 0 for hallucinated ones, while a divergence constraint preserves the original generation capability. Despite being trained on only a limited set of object categories, TruthLens generalizes effectively to benchmarks with substantially larger label spaces. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLMs demonstrate state-of-the-art performance; notably, on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, TruthLens outperforms the previous best method on MS-COCO by over 17\% in AUROC. Our code is available at https://github.com/wyqstan/TruthLens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TruthLens，一个面向大视觉语言模型 (LVLM) 的物体幻觉 (object hallucination) 自评估框架。作者发现真实与幻觉物体 token 在隐藏表示中可分，但在语言建模 (LM) head 处这种可分性几乎消失，因此通过重用一个少用的特殊 token 作为参考 token，利用 LM head 赋予该 token 的 log-probability 与预设常数的差值定义逐物体真实度分数 (truthfulness score)。模型以 MSE 目标微调，使真实物体分数趋向 1、幻觉物体趋向 0，并用散度约束保持原有生成能力，无需辅助模型且不增加推理开销；论文已被 ECCV 2026 接收。
Motivation: 物体幻觉是阻碍 LVLM 可信部署的根本挑战之一。关键观察是真实与幻觉物体 token 在隐藏表示中可分离，但这种可分性在 LM head 处基本丢失，说明需要一种在输出层直接暴露真实度信号的方法。
Method: 将少用的特殊 token 重新用作参考 token；对每个物体 token 位置，提取 LM head 赋予该特殊 token 的 log-probability，并定义其与预设常数的差值为真实度分数。使用 MSE 损失将真实物体分数驱动到 1、幻觉物体到 0，同时加入散度约束以保留原始生成能力，整个过程不需要辅助模型或额外推理成本。
Result: 在多个 LVLM 上的实验取得 state-of-the-art 效果；特别是在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上，TruthLens 在 MS-COCO 上的 AUROC 比此前最佳方法提升超过 17%。尽管仅在有限物体类别上训练，该方法仍能有效泛化到标签空间大得多的基准。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过微调让 LM head 直接暴露逐物体真实度信号，可以在不引入辅助模型和额外推理开销的前提下实现高精度幻觉检测，并具备跨更大标签空间的泛化能力。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 将少用的特殊 token 重新用作参考 token；对每个物体 token 位置，提取 LM head 赋予该特殊 token 的 log-probability，并定义其与预设常数的差值为真实度分数。使用 MSE 损失将真实物体分数驱动到 1、幻觉物体到 0，同时加入散度约束以保留原始生成能力，整个过程不需要辅助模型或额外推理成本。
summary_sections.result: 在多个 LVLM 上的实验取得 state-of-the-art 效果；特别是在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上，TruthLens 在 MS-COCO 上的 AUROC 比此前最佳方法提升超过 17%。尽管仅在有限物体类别上训练，该方法仍能有效泛化到标签空间大得多的基准。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，通过微调让 LM head 直接暴露逐物体真实度信号，可以在不引入辅助模型和额外推理开销的前提下实现高精度幻觉检测，并具备跨更大标签空间的泛化能力。

papers.title: ALTER: Modeling Longitudinal Changes via Regional Differencing for 3D CT Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Computed tomography (CT) is widely used for clinical diagnosis and longitudinal follow-up, yet automatically generating accurate and complete radiology reports from three-dimensional (3D) CT remains challenging. Existing methods improve fine-grained correspondence between images and text by modeling anatomical regions, but remain centered on the current examination. Consequently, patient-specific longitudinal changes within individual regions remain insufficiently modeled. Meanwhile, interval changes are often distributed across multiple anatomical regions, complicating a coherent assessment of the overall longitudinal state. We propose Anatomically Localized Temporal Evidence Representation (ALTER) to address these limitations. Global Prior Integration (GPI) incorporates the prior CT and report to establish historical context for the current examination. Regional Proxy Differencing (RPD) enables each current anatomical region to retrieve a historical proxy from a single shared encoding of the prior volume and to derive localized interval evidence. Interval Change Fusion (ICF) further combines current abnormality states with region-distributed differences, converting their joint representation into change-aware soft prompts that guide report generation. ALTER achieves state-of-the-art results on most evaluation metrics across the RadGenome-ChestCT validation and CTRG-Chest-548K test sets. Code and data preprocessing details are available at https://github.com/peytonkarlie/ALTER/tree/main.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Anatomically Localized Temporal Evidence Representation (ALTER)，用于从 3D CT 生成放射学报告，重点建模患者个体在不同检查之间的纵向变化。方法包含全局先验集成、区域代理差分和区间变化融合三部分，并在 RadGenome-ChestCT 验证集与 CTRG-Chest-548K 测试集上取得大多数评估指标的最优结果。代码与数据预处理细节已公开。
Motivation: 现有基于解剖区域的 CT 报告生成方法虽然改进了图像与文本的细粒度对应，但仍以当前检查为中心，对患者个体在具体区域内的纵向变化建模不足；同时区间变化常分散在多个解剖区域，难以对整体纵向状态进行连贯评估。
Method: ALTER 由三部分组成：Global Prior Integration (GPI) 利用既往 CT 和报告为当前检查建立历史上下文；Regional Proxy Differencing (RPD) 让每个当前解剖区域从既往容积的单一共享编码中检索历史代理，并推导局部区间证据；Interval Change Fusion (ICF) 将当前异常状态与区域分布差异结合，转换为感知变化的软提示 (change-aware soft prompts) 来引导报告生成。
Result: 摘要报告在 RadGenome-ChestCT 验证集和 CTRG-Chest-548K 测试集的大部分评估指标上取得 state-of-the-art 结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式建模患者特定纵向变化和跨区域分布的区间变化可以改进 3D CT 报告生成，并提供了代码与数据预处理细节。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FOCUS: Decoupling Expert Personas in LLMs to Enhance Domain Expert Capabilities
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) can exhibit diverse personas, and activating expert personas has been shown to improve domain expertise and task accuracy. However, existing persona control methods often suffer from cross-domain coupling, which may lead to overly aggressive behavior in high-caution domains such as healthcare, or excessive conservatism in risk-sensitive domains such as financial trading. To address this issue, we propose FOCUS (\textbf{\underline{F}}ine-tuning with \textbf{\underline{O}}rthogonal \textbf{\underline{C}}ontrol for \textbf{\underline{U}}ncoupled persona\textbf{\underline{S}}). FOCUS first automatically extracts expert persona vectors from LLMs, then applies orthogonal decomposition to decouple domain-specific expert personas, and finally introduces an expert gating module to adaptively control persona activation according to task contexts. With a two-stage training strategy and a gated selection regularizer, the model learns to activate appropriate personas for both single-domain and cross-domain tasks. Experiments on financial, legal, medical, and cross-domain benchmarks show that FOCUS improves task accuracy and outperforms existing persona control methods. Our code is available at \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/openpersona-48F4}{this url}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FOCUS，一种通过在 LLM 中解耦专家人设（expert persona）来增强领域专家能力的方法。方法先自动提取专家人设向量，再用正交分解（orthogonal decomposition）将不同领域人设解耦，并通过专家门控模块（expert gating module）按任务上下文自适应控制人设激活。在两阶段训练和门控选择正则化（gated selection regularizer）下，模型可在单领域与跨领域任务中选择合适人设。摘要在金融、法律、医疗和跨领域基准上报告了准确率提升，并优于现有 persona 控制方法。
Motivation: 现有 persona 控制方法存在跨领域耦合：在高谨慎领域如医疗可能过于激进，在风险敏感领域如金融交易可能过于保守。这种耦合限制了领域专家能力的准确激活，因此需要解耦领域专属人设的控制方法。
Method: FOCUS 包含三步：自动从 LLM 中提取专家人设向量；对领域专属专家人设做正交分解以解耦；引入专家门控模块，根据任务上下文自适应控制人设激活。配合两阶段训练策略和门控选择正则化，让模型学会在单领域和跨领域任务中激活合适的人设。
Result: 在金融、法律、医疗及跨领域基准上的实验显示，FOCUS 提升了任务准确率，并优于现有 persona 控制方法。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，通过正交分解解耦人设并配合自适应门控激活，可以有效提升单领域与跨领域任务的领域专家能力，同时避免因人设耦合导致的过度激进或过度保守行为。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LC-Implicit-QAOA: Active-Workspace-Capped Exact Objective-and-Gradient Evaluation for Training over Bounded QUBO Light Cones
papers.abstract_en: QAOA training repeatedly queries an objective and all shared gradients, making exact evaluation a feasibility bottleneck even when QUBO terms have bounded causal cones. Building on established causal-cone restriction and adjoint differentiation, LC-Implicit-QAOA profiles cone structure and induced-edge counts before local-amplitude and named-workspace allocation, then jointly selects equal-size microbatches and checkpoint schedules under a named active-evaluator workspace budget. "Implicit" means omitting both global state and global cost table, not implicit differentiation; infeasible requests are rejected before those allocations. An independently implemented complex128/float64 dense adjoint agrees with LC over 1,800 graph-angle comparisons, with a worst relative gradient error of 1.56 x 10^-13. LC completes all 104 target requests in a p=2 bounded-cone grid; under a prespecified n <= 24 validation cap, the matched state-plus-cost reference is executed for 28 requests and deliberately not run on 76. Across 80 budgeted requests, measured allocated evaluator memory stays within budget, reaching at most 0.797 of it. On 3-regular n=512, p=2, the adjoint reaches the same finite-budget endpoint in 101 objective-equivalent calls and 189 s, versus 909 calls and 1,565 s for central differences. LC targets fixed-depth one- and two-local diagonal QUBO costs with a transverse-field mixer; it provides neither global states, sampling, nor a hardware-independent fastest-backend rule.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Code and technical supplement: https://github.com/jesse1029/lc-implicit-qaoa
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LC-Implicit-QAOA，一种在 QUBO 项具有有界因果锥 (bounded light cones) 的设定下，对 QAOA 训练进行精确目标与梯度评估的方法。它基于既有的因果锥限制与伴随微分 (adjoint differentiation)，在分配局部幅度和命名工作区之前先对锥结构与诱导边计数做概要分析，并在命名活动评估器工作区预算下联合选择等尺寸微批次和检查点调度。作者强调 "Implicit" 指省略全局状态和全局代价表，而非隐式微分，且不可行请求会在分配前被拒绝。摘要报告了与稠密伴随实现的数值一致性、内存预算满足情况以及与中心差分相比的调用次数和耗时优势。
Motivation: QAOA 训练会反复查询目标函数和所有共享梯度，即使 QUBO 项的因果锥有界，精确评估仍然是可行性瓶颈；因此需要在有限工作区预算下仍能精确完成目标与梯度评估的方法。
Method: 先对因果锥结构和诱导边计数进行 profiling，再执行局部幅度与命名工作区分配；随后在命名活动评估器工作区预算下联合选择等尺寸微批次 (microbatches) 和检查点调度，并省略全局状态与全局代价表。梯度计算采用伴随微分，且在工作区分配前拒绝不可行的请求。
Result: 独立的 complex128/float64 稠密伴随实现与 LC 在 1,800 个图角比较上一致，最差相对梯度误差为 1.56e-13。在 p=2 有界锥网格中 LC 完成全部 104 个目标请求；在预设 n<=24 验证上限下，状态加代价参考仅对 28 个请求运行，其余 76 个被有意跳过；80 个有预算请求中测量分配内存最高为预算的 0.797。在 3-正则 n=512, p=2 上，伴随用 101 次目标等价调用和 189 秒到达同一有限预算终点，而中心差分需 909 次调用和 1,565 秒。
Conclusion: LC-Implicit-QAOA 面向固定深度的单体和两体对角 QUBO 代价与横向场 mixer (transverse-field mixer)，不提供全局状态、采样，也没有与硬件无关的最快后端规则。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: GAUGE: Granularity-Adaptive Counterfactual Gating of Evidence for Incomplete Multimodal Classification
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal classification typically assumes all modalities are available, yet real-world inputs are often incomplete. Imputation and dynamic fusion can mitigate such incompleteness, but existing methods operate at a coarse modality level and thus cannot retain reliable components while suppressing misleading ones within the same recovered modality, compromising prediction reliability. To address this issue, we propose GAUGE, a lightweight counterfactual gating framework for incomplete multimodal classification. GAUGE first imputes missing modalities with a frozen imputer and encodes observed and recovered inputs uniformly as fine-grained evidence units. Rather than intervening on each unit explicitly, GAUGE scores the counterfactual effect of replacing every unit with a reference representation through prediction-aware Taylor evidence scores, all obtained in a single forward-backward pass. These scores are mapped to continuous gates, which are converted into additive attention-logit biases for unit-wise evidence modulation without altering the backbone architecture. Experiments across six benchmarks demonstrate that GAUGE outperforms strong baselines across diverse incomplete-input settings. Furthermore, a Taylor remainder theoretical analysis characterizes the error of the first-order approximation relative to the exact counterfactual effect, establishing GAUGE as a principled and scalable framework for fine-grained evidence control under modality incompleteness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GAUGE，一个轻量级反事实门控框架，用于不完整多模态分类 (incomplete multimodal classification)。GAUGE 先用冻结的 imputer 补全缺失模态，将观测与恢复输入统一编码为细粒度证据单元，并通过预测感知的泰勒证据分数 (prediction-aware Taylor evidence scores) 在单次前向-反向传播中近似每个单元替换为参考表征的反事实效应，再把分数映射为连续门控并转为加性注意力 logit 偏置，实现不改变骨干架构的单元级证据调制。摘要称其六个基准上优于强基线，并给出泰勒余项的理论误差分析。
Motivation: 现有多模态分类方法通常假定所有模态可用，而现实输入常不完整；已有的插补与动态融合方法在粗粒度的模态级别操作，无法在同一恢复模态内保留可靠成分并抑制误导成分，从而损害预测可靠性。
Method: 提出 GAUGE：用冻结的 imputer 补全缺失模态，将观测与恢复输入统一编码为细粒度证据单元；不显式干预每个单元，而是通过预测感知的泰勒证据分数一次性评分每个单元替换为参考表征的反事实效应；分数映射为连续门控并转换为加性注意力 logit 偏置，实现单元级证据调制而不改动骨干架构。
Result: 摘要报告 GAUGE 在六个基准、多种不完整输入设置下优于强基线；此外，泰勒余项 (Taylor remainder) 理论分析刻画了一阶近似相对于精确反事实效应的误差。
Conclusion: 作者将 GAUGE 定位为模态不完整情形下细粒度证据控制的原则化且可扩展框架，并以泰勒余项分析支撑其理论依据。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: 提出 GAUGE：用冻结的 imputer 补全缺失模态，将观测与恢复输入统一编码为细粒度证据单元；不显式干预每个单元，而是通过预测感知的泰勒证据分数一次性评分每个单元替换为参考表征的反事实效应；分数映射为连续门控并转换为加性注意力 logit 偏置，实现单元级证据调制而不改动骨干架构。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 GAUGE 在六个基准、多种不完整输入设置下优于强基线；此外，泰勒余项 (Taylor remainder) 理论分析刻画了一阶近似相对于精确反事实效应的误差。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者将 GAUGE 定位为模态不完整情形下细粒度证据控制的原则化且可扩展框架，并以泰勒余项分析支撑其理论依据。

papers.title: Structured Dimension-Matched Joint Variational Transdimensional Inference
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian model selection couples a discrete model indicator with a model-specific continuous parameter space. We introduce structured dimension-matched variational transdimensional inference (SM-VTI) for finite enumerable model spaces. A rooted construction graph expresses a model as a sequence of local stop/child decisions. Each typed edge compiles a declared scientific parent-child edit into an exact native-coordinate dimension-matching lifting; an edge-conditioned flow then learns the residual continuous transport. The resulting local policy and conditional flow define one direct joint variational distribution, without embedding every model in a saturated maximum-dimensional surrogate. We derive its exact path density and optimize the joint reverse-KL objective. On a controlled 15-model target, SM-VTI-Joint recovers terminal masses, local actions, and nonlinear conditional geometry. On a 128-model misspecified robust variable-selection problem, a 10-data-set nearly parameter-matched affine comparison with AVTI shows stronger early model-mass recovery and competitive final joint accuracy under the same target-evaluation budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结构化维度匹配变分跨界推断 (structured dimension-matched variational transdimensional inference, SM-VTI)，面向有限可枚举模型空间的贝叶斯模型选择。方法用带根节点的构造图把模型表示为一串局部停止/子节点决策，每条类型化边将父-子编辑编译为精确的native-coordinate维度匹配lifting，再用edge-conditioned flow学习残差的连续传输，从而无需把所有模型嵌入饱和的最大维度替代空间即可定义一个直接的联合变分分布。作者推导了精确路径密度并优化联合reverse-KL目标；在受控15模型目标上能恢复终端质量、局部动作和非线性条件几何，在128模型误设定鲁棒变量选择问题上与AVTI近乎参数匹配的仿射对比中显示出更强的早期模型质量恢复并达到有竞争力的最终联合精度。
Motivation: 贝叶斯模型选择需要同时处理离散模型指示符和模型特有的连续参数空间，而现有方法往往要求把每个模型嵌入到饱和的最大维度替代空间中，这可能带来效率损失或扭曲模型几何。
Method: 引入SM-VTI：在有限可枚举模型空间上构建根连构造图，每条类型化边把声明的科学父-子编辑编译为精确的native-coordinate维度匹配lifting，并用edge-conditioned flow学习残差连续传输；局部策略与条件流共同定义一个直接的联合变分分布，通过联合reverse-KL目标优化并推导精确路径密度。
Result: 在受控15模型目标上，SM-VTI-Joint能恢复终端模型质量、局部动作和非线性条件几何；在128模型误设定鲁棒变量选择问题上，与AVTI在10个数据集上近乎参数匹配的仿射比较显示，该方法具有更强的早期模型质量恢复能力，并在相同目标评估预算下达到有竞争力的最终联合精度。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法避免了将每个模型嵌入饱和最大维度替代空间，为有限可枚举模型空间提供了一种直接的联合变分分布，并在模型质量恢复与最终联合精度上与现有方法相当或更好。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Enhancing Anomaly Resilience in Research Networks: A Large-Scale Forecasting Benchmark for Dynamic Security Baselining
papers.abstract_en: Research and Education Networks (RENs) serve as critical infrastructure for scientific discovery, yet they face a unique security paradox: their normal traffic patterns which are characterized by massive, bursty "elephant flows" are statistically indistinguishable from volumetric attacks such as DDoS to conventional monitoring systems. This similarity leads to high false-positive rates in anomaly detection, blinding security operators to genuine threats. In this paper, we propose and evaluate a high-fidelity traffic forecasting framework designed to establish dynamic security baselines for RENs. Leveraging an exclusive 57-day Internet2 dataset spanning ten backbone routers (13.7 billion packets), we perform the first large-scale benchmark of anomaly-aware forecasting models in this domain. We systematically evaluate six model families, from SARIMA to state-of-the-art long-sequence architectures (TiDE, PatchTST), across 960 experimental configurations. Our results demonstrate that these advanced architectures, particularly TiDE, reduce baseline prediction error by 30-42% compared to traditional methods ($p < 0.001$), significantly improving the distinction between legitimate scientific bursts and potential anomalies. Furthermore, we introduce a novel anomaly-integration strategy that improves model robustness by 3.3% in the presence of noise. This work provides the first statistically validated framework for distinguishing scientific workflows from network attacks, enabling more autonomous and resilient network security operations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对科研教育网络(REN)中正常的大象流(elephant flows)与DDoS等容量攻击在统计上难以区分、导致异常检测误报率高的安全悖论，提出高保真流量预测框架以建立动态安全基线。基于57天Internet2数据集(十台骨干路由器、137亿包)，首次在该领域进行大规模异常感知预测基准测试，系统评估从SARIMA到TiDE、PatchTST等六类模型家族共960种配置。结果显示TiDE等先进架构相比传统方法将基线预测误差降低30–42%（p < 0.001），并引入异常集成策略使模型在噪声下的鲁棒性提升3.3%。
Motivation: REN的正常流量兼具大规模和突发性，其大象流模式与DDoS等容量攻击在统计上几乎不可区分，使传统监控系统产生高误报率，安全运营者因此可能被噪声淹没而忽略真实威胁。
Method: 提出并评估一个高保真流量预测框架，为REN建立动态安全基线；使用57天Internet2主干网数据，比较六类模型家族（SARIMA到TiDE、PatchTST）共960种实验配置，并引入一种新的异常集成(anomaly-integration)策略来提升噪声条件下的鲁棒性。
Result: 摘要报告先进长序列架构（尤其是TiDE）相对传统方法将基线预测误差降低30–42%（p < 0.001），显著改善合法科研突发流与潜在异常的区分；异常集成策略在噪声环境中使模型鲁棒性提升3.3%。
Conclusion: 该工作提供首个经统计验证的框架，用于在REN中区分科研工作流与网络攻击，支撑更自主、更具韧性的网络安全运营；其范围限定于REN流量预测及Internet2数据集。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: SkillZip: Contract-Preserving Graph Compression for Scalable Agent Skill Libraries
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly act as agents whose procedural knowledge is stored in reusable skill packages and loaded at inference time. As skill libraries grow, a central challenge is to expose the smallest sufficient executable context under a limited context budget. Existing systems struggle to reuse routines below the whole-skill level, preserve procedural contracts during compression, keep compressed routines executable and expandable, and update the compressed library as skills evolve. These challenges reveal a unit mismatch: skills are retrieved as packages, compressed as text, and converted into execution graphs only after retrieval, whereas reliable reuse requires a contract-bearing procedural unit. We propose SkillZip, an execution-aware procedural abstraction framework that performs contract-preserving compression over section-level graphs. SkillZip rewrites recurring contract-valid motifs into reversible ported macros while preserving boundary signatures, dependency closure, verifier reachability, and source-level expansion. At inference time, it hydrates a compact, dependency-closed context and expands macros only when required. ReZip further integrates new skills and revises risky macros using execution evidence. Comprehensive experiments1 on technical and embodied agent benchmarks show SkillZip consistently outperforms the strongest baseline by up to 12.2 points, while achieving a 3.46x compression ratio with 99.2% dependency preservation and 98.7% verifier reachability. Scaling analyses further confirm robust retrieval across skill libraries ranging from 200 to 100K skills.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillZip，一个面向 LLM 智能体的执行感知过程抽象框架，用于在有限的上下文预算下对技能库进行保持契约的压缩。SkillZip 在 section 级图上将重复出现的契约有效子结构改写为可逆的移植宏，并保留边界签名、依赖闭包、验证器可达性和源码级展开；推理时只水合紧凑且依赖封闭的上下文，按需展开宏。配套的 ReZip 组件利用执行证据整合新技能并修正风险宏。实验显示其在技术和具身智能体基准上最高超过最强基线 12.2 分，压缩比为 3.46x，依赖保留率 99.2%，验证器可达率 98.7%，并在 200 到 10 万规模的技能库上保持稳健检索。
Motivation: 随着技能库增长，核心挑战是在有限上下文预算下暴露最小且足够的可执行上下文。现有系统往往按整个技能包检索、以文本方式压缩、并在检索后才转为执行图，导致技能被当作包、压缩当作文本、执行图生成被推迟，存在单位不匹配；可靠复用需要一种带有契约的过程性单元，并在压缩过程中保持可执行性和可扩展性。
Method: SkillZip 是一种执行感知的过程抽象框架，基于 section 级图执行保持契约的压缩：将重复出现的契约有效子结构重写为可逆的移植宏（ported macro），同时保持边界签名、依赖闭包、验证器可达性和源码级展开。推理时水合紧凑且依赖封闭的上下文，只在必要时展开宏；ReZip 则用执行证据整合新技能并修正疑似有风险的宏。
Result: 在技术和具身智能体基准上的实验表明，SkillZip 一致超过最强基线，最多提升 12.2 分；实现 3.46x 压缩比、99.2% 依赖保留率与 98.7% 验证器可达率。扩展性分析显示在 200 到 100K 技能规模的库中检索依然稳健。
Conclusion: 作者认为，保持契约的 section 级压缩能够解决技能包检索、文本压缩与执行图生成之间的单位不匹配，使压缩后的例程保持可执行和可扩展；摘要未明确讨论方法的局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Epistemic Trustworthiness in Generative AI: A Normative Framework for Warranted Reliance in High-Stakes Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes professional contexts, where their outputs shape what users believe, how they reason, and what they treat as settled. This raises a central question for responsible AI: under what conditions is reliance on generative AI outputs epistemically warranted rather than behaviourally induced? Existing frameworks largely ask whether AI outputs are accurate, fair, explainable, safe, or trusted by users. These questions remain necessary, and each can contribute to warranted reliance. However, they do not directly specify warranted reliance as a distinct evaluative target: the conditions under which users are justified in treating AI outputs as inputs into their own reasoning. We argue that this requires an account of epistemic trustworthiness: what makes a system epistemically worthy of reliance. Drawing on philosophical accounts of trustworthiness as competence and audience-orientation, we develop a constitutive normative framework comprising three jointly necessary and non-fungible conditions. First, epistemic humility requires systems to represent and communicate the limits of their competence. Second, epistemic access requires systems to enable users to inspect, question, and contest outputs in context. Third, resistance to epistemic injustice requires systems to recognise users as legitimate epistemic agents and avoid marginalising their knowledge and experience. Through real-world case analyses in legal reasoning, medical reasoning, and hiring, we show how failures of epistemic humility, epistemic access, and resistance to epistemic injustice can produce consequential harms that standard measures of accuracy, fairness, and usability do not address on their own. We conclude by outlining design and evaluation implications for GenAI systems organised around epistemically warranted reliance rather than output correctness alone.
papers.comment: Accepted at AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个规范性的认识论信任框架，用以界定在高压专业工作流中对生成式 AI 输出值得信赖 (warranted reliance) 的条件。作者基于哲学上关于可信赖性作为能力与受众导向的论述，提出三个联合必要且不可互换的条件：认识论谦逊 (epistemic humility)、认识论可及性 (epistemic access) 以及对认识论不正义的抵抗 (resistance to epistemic injustice)。通过法律推理、医学推理和招聘中的真实案例，论文展示这些条件的失败会产生标准准确性、公平性和可用性指标无法单独涵盖的危害。
Motivation: 现有负责任 AI 框架主要关注输出是否准确、公平、可解释、安全或被用户信任，但并未直接将‘值得信赖’定义为独立评估目标，即用户在何种条件下有理由把 AI 输出作为自身推理的输入。在生成式 AI 日益部署于高 stakes 专业场景的背景下，这一缺失需要被填补。
Method: 借鉴哲学中把可信赖性理解为能力 (competence) 与受众导向 (audience-orientation) 的论述，建构一个包含三个联合必要且不可互换条件的规范性框架：系统须表征并沟通自身能力边界（认识论谦逊）、允许用户在情境中检查、质疑和反驳输出（认识论可及性）、承认用户为合法认识论主体并避免边缘化其知识与经验（抵抗认识论不正义）。
Result: 通过法律推理、医学推理和招聘中的真实案例分析，展示认识论谦逊、认识论可及性和抵抗认识论不正义的失败可产生严重后果，这些后果无法仅靠准确性、公平性和可用性等标准度量来应对。
Conclusion: 作者主张 GenAI 系统的设计与评估应围绕认识论上值得信赖 (epistemically warranted reliance) 而非仅仅输出正确性来组织，并据此概述了相应的设计及评估启示。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LC-GRPO: Bridging Train-Inference Gap for Flow-Based GRPO with Langevin Correction
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based generative models are typically sampled by solving a deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE), whereas online reinforcement learning requires stochastic rollouts for policy exploration and optimization. Existing GRPO methods for flow models therefore replace the inference-time ODE with a stochastic differential equation (SDE) during training. Although the ODE and SDE share the same marginal distributions in continuous time, their finite-step discretizations can differ substantially. In particular, SDE rollouts often become blurry as the exploration noise increases, creating a mismatch between the samples used for reinforcement learning and those generated by the test-time ODE sampler. We introduce LC-GRPO, a flow-based GRPO framework with Langevin correction. Each rollout transition first takes an inference-aligned ODE Euler step and then applies a stochastic Langevin correction targeting the marginal distribution at the resulting timestep. The required score is recovered directly from the flow velocity, requiring no additional score model, while the resulting transition remains an isotropic Gaussian with a tractable likelihood for policy optimization. We theoretically show that, under suitable conditions, one Langevin correction step reduces the Wasserstein error of an imperfect ODE Euler step. At a matched randomness level, we further show that the proposed transition can be more accurate than the standard Euler--Maruyama discretization of the reverse SDE. Experiments on SD3.5-Medium, FLUX.1-Dev, and HunyuanVideo demonstrate that LC-GRPO consistently improves reward optimization across text-to-image and text-to-video tasks, preserves generation quality, and substantially narrows the gap between stochastic training rollouts and deterministic test-time ODE inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LC-GRPO，一种带 Langevin 校正的 flow-based GRPO 训练框架，旨在弥合训练时随机 SDE rollout 与测试时确定性 ODE 采样之间的离散化差异。每个 rollout 转移先做推理对齐的 ODE Euler 步，再施加针对该时间步边际分布的随机 Langevin 校正，所需 score 直接由 flow velocity 恢复，无需额外 score model。理论分析与在 SD3.5-Medium、FLUX.1-Dev、HunyuanVideo 上的实验表明，该方法能持续改善文本到图像与文本到视频任务的奖励优化，并保持生成质量。
Motivation: Flow-based 生成模型推理时通常用确定性 ODE 采样，而在线强化学习需要随机 rollout 进行探索，因此现有 GRPO 方法在训练时用 SDE 替换 ODE。虽然连续时间下两者边际分布相同，但有限步离散化差异显著，SDE rollout 随探索噪声增大而变模糊，导致训练样本与测试时 ODE 采样器输出不匹配。
Method: 提出 LC-GRPO：每个 rollout 转移先执行与推理对齐的 ODE Euler 步，再施加一个针对当前时间步边际分布的随机 Langevin 校正。所需 score 直接从 flow velocity 恢复，无需额外 score model，且转移仍为可处理的各向同性高斯分布，便于策略优化。
Result: 理论上证明在合适条件下，单步 Langevin 校正可降低不完美 ODE Euler 步的 Wasserstein 误差；在匹配随机性水平下，该转移比反向 SDE 的标准 Euler–Maruyama 离散化更精确。实验在 SD3.5-Medium、FLUX.1-Dev 和 HunyuanVideo 上显示，LC-GRPO 在文本到图像与文本到视频任务中一致提升奖励优化、保持生成质量，并显著缩小随机训练 rollout 与确定性测试 ODE 推理之间的差距。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过 Langevin 校正桥接训练与推理的采样差异，可以在 flow-based GRPO 中提升奖励优化效率并保持生成质量，适用于文本到图像和文本到视频的生成式奖励优化场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware World Model for Aerial Image-Goal Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Aerial image-goal navigation requires an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) to reach a target location specified by a goal image. Existing world-model-based methods rank candidate trajectories using predicted futures, but typically rely on only one or a few point predictions, which is inadequate for large-scale outdoor environments with substantial future-state uncertainty. To address this limitation, we propose the Uncertainty-Aware Navigation World Model (UA-NWM), an efficient latent world model for aerial image-goal navigation, which formulates trajectory scoring as conditional out-of-distribution detection. UA-NWM represents plausible futures with an uncertainty subspace and decomposes the prediction--goal discrepancy into uncertainty-explainable and unexplainable components. Only the unexplainable residual is used for scoring, enabling robust selection without multiple future samples. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UA-NWM consistently outperforms existing navigation world models while maintaining low inference latency. Real-world UAV experiments further validate its practical applicability. Project page: https://duryi.github.io/UA-NWM-Project-Page
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Uncertainty-Aware Navigation World Model (UA-NWM)，一种用于空中图像目标导航 (aerial image-goal navigation) 的高效潜空间世界模型。该方法将轨迹评分建模为条件分布外检测 (conditional out-of-distribution detection)，用不确定性子空间表示可能的未来，并把预测与目标之间的差异分解为由不确定性可解释和不可解释的两部分，仅用不可解释残差进行评分。实验表明 UA-NWM 在性能上持续超越现有导航世界模型，同时保持低推理延迟，并在真实无人机实验中验证了实用性。
Motivation: 现有基于世界模型的空中图像目标导航方法通常只依赖一个或少数几个点预测来对候选轨迹排序，难以应对大规模户外环境中显著的未来状态不确定性。这种不确定性是该方法针对的核心问题。
Method: 提出高效的潜空间世界模型 UA-NWM，将轨迹评分重新表述为条件分布外检测。模型用不确定性子空间刻画可能的未来状态，将预测与目标图像的差异分解为不确定性可解释部分和不可解释残差，仅用不可解释残差进行稳健的轨迹选择，无需多个未来样本。
Result: 大量实验显示 UA-NWM 始终优于现有导航世界模型，并保持低推理延迟；真实无人机实验进一步验证了其实际应用可行性。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式建模未来状态不确定性并只使用不可解释残差进行评分，能够在无需多次未来采样的条件下实现稳健的轨迹选择，是空中图像目标导航中的有效设计。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: How Much Reconstruction Does Quantum Machine Learning Need? Late Fusion of Independently Trained Quantum Subcircuits
papers.abstract_en: Circuit cutting lets a large quantum neural network (QNN) run as independent subcircuits on small devices, but rebuilding its outputs by reconstruction carries a classical sampling overhead exponential in the number of cuts - the dominant runtime cost in prior work. We ask whether, for machine-learning tasks, this step is necessary, and replace it with late fusion: each subcircuit is trained and measured independently, and a small classical head combines their outputs - a linear-cost, decision-level combination borrowed from multimodal learning. To characterize the trade-off we introduce a quantumness dial $Q$, a tunable reconstruction budget interpolating from pure fusion to full reconstruction, and a cut-entanglement diagnostic that indicates how much reconstruction a task needs (Spearman $ρ=0.59$ over $104$ runs). Across synthetic and standard datasets, independently trained late fusion matches full reconstruction accuracy within $0.04$ at every point of the controlled sweep and on every classical benchmark, at exponentially lower cost; it is also markedly more robust to shot and device noise. Controlled entangled-data experiments locate the boundary where fusion must fail. We do not claim advantage over classical machine learning - consistent with recent benchmarking, quantum offers no accuracy edge on these datasets. Late fusion is thus an efficient, noise-robust, self-characterizing alternative to reconstruction for circuit-cutting QML.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究电路切割（circuit cutting）驱动的量子神经网络（QNN）在小型设备上运行时，重建（reconstruction）输出的指数级经典采样开销是否必要。作者提出用后期融合（late fusion）替代重建：每个子电路独立训练和测量，再由一个小型经典头部组合输出，开销为线性。通过引入可调的重建预算量子度拨盘 $Q$ 和切割纠缠诊断，实验表明后期融合在精度上匹配完整重建（差距在0.04以内），但成本指数级降低，且对噪声更鲁棒。论文明确不声称对经典机器学习有优势。
Motivation: 电路切割中重建输出的经典采样开销随切割数指数增长，这是此前工作的主导运行时成本；作者质疑在机器学习任务中这一步骤是否必要，希望找到更高效的替代方案。
Method: 提出后期融合：每个切割后的子电路独立训练和测量，再用一个小型经典头（classical head）进行决策级组合，将多模态学习中的融合思路引入量子机器学习。同时引入量子度拨盘 $Q$（可插值的重建预算）和切割纠缠诊断（cut-entanglement diagnostic）来刻画任务所需的重建程度。
Result: 在合成数据集和标准数据集上，后期融合在受控扫描的每个点和每个经典基准上均匹配完整重建精度（差距≤0.04），且成本指数级降低；对 shot 噪声和设备噪声明显更鲁棒。诊断指标与所需重建量之间的 Spearman 相关系数为 $\rho=0.59$（104 次运行）。受控纠缠数据实验定位了融合必然失败的边界。
Conclusion: 后期融合是电路切割量子机器学习中高效、噪声鲁棒且可自表征的重建替代方案；但作者强调没有证据表明量子在这些数据集上相比经典机器学习有精度优势，因此不主张超越经典方法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Frame Selection: Rethinking Long-Video Understanding with MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong progress in video understanding, yet it remains challenging because the token limitation makes MLLMs difficult to capture temporally sparse evidence. Existing methods typically rely on uniform sampling, or frame selection, but these strategies usually optimize either broad temporal coverage or local relevance, making it difficult to preserve both global storyline context and fine-grained evidence. We propose VideoRouter(VR) that rethinks long-video understanding as coordinating complementary evidence views rather than selecting a single subset of frames. It first organizes each video into a question-agnostic temporal hierarchy, which partition the video into coarse-to-fine temporally coherent segments. In this hierarchy, upper-level nodes capture broad storyline context and event progression, while lower-level nodes preserve fine-grained local details and evidence-bearing moments. This naturally gives rise to two complementary views: a global view for coverage-oriented reasoning and a local view for detail-oriented evidence recovery. We further introduce a verification-guided router to determine which view is better supported by the selected evidence and select the final answer. We validate the effectiveness of the proposed design through extensive experiments, showing that the verification-guided router effectively coordinates global and local reasoning, and that, on VideoMME, our method outperforms state-of-the-art frame selection methods by 2.9 points, respectively, under the LLaVA-Video-7B backbone. We will release the code.

TL;DR: 本文提出 VideoRouter (VR)，重新将长视频理解视为协调互补的证据视图而非选择单一帧子集。该方法先把视频组织成与问题无关的粗到细时间层级，上层节点捕获整体情节脉络，下层节点保留细粒度细节，由此形成面向覆盖的全局视图与面向细节恢复的局部视图，并用验证引导的路由器决定最终答案。基于 LLaVA-Video-7B 主干，在 VideoMME 上比现有最先进的帧选择方法高 2.9 分，代码将开源。
Motivation: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) 受 token 限制难以捕获时间上稀疏的证据；现有均匀采样或帧选择方法通常只优化时间覆盖或局部相关性中的一方面，难以同时保留全局故事线上下文与细粒度证据。
Method: 提出 VideoRouter (VR)：先将视频组织为问题无关的时间层级，划分成粗到细的时间连贯片段；上层节点对应全局故事情节与事件进展，下层节点保留细粒度局部细节。由此构建两个互补视图：面向覆盖推理的全局视图和面向细节证据恢复的局部视图，并引入验证引导的路由器 (verification-guided router) 判断哪个视图得到所选证据的更好支持，进而选出最终答案。
Result: 在 VideoMME 基准上，基于 LLaVA-Video-7B 主干，该方法相比最先进的帧选择方法提升 2.9 分；作者通过大量实验验证了验证引导路由器能有效协调全局与局部推理。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将长视频理解重新定义为协调互补证据视图、而非选择单一帧子集，并指出验证引导路由器的有效性；实验验证主要在 VideoMME 上进行，代码将发布。

papers.title: Search-Aided Joint Agent-Environment Reinforcement Learning for Robust Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding with Rotations
papers.abstract_en: Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding (LMAPF) requires repeatedly planning collision-free paths for agents that continuously receive new goals upon reaching their current ones. While many learning-based planners have been proposed for LMAPF, most rely on oversimplified kinematic assumptions that may overlook motion constraints critical to real-world performance. In this work, we study a more realistic LMAPF model derived from many real-world automated warehouse systems, termed LMAPF-R2, which incorporates robust safety constraints and in-place rotation constraints. These constraints substantially increase coordination difficulty, particularly in highly constrained spaces. To address these challenges, we propose Search-Aided Joint Reinforcement Learning (SJRL). We first augment neural policies with Causal PIBT, a single-step search-based planner that resolves agents' collisions and propagates their intentions. We then introduce a unified RL formulation that jointly optimizes agent and environment policies, where the environment policy learns graph edge costs to provide global movement guidance via backward Dijkstra search. Experiments demonstrate that SJRL achieves significant improvements over the strong search-based planner, Causal-PIBT, across multiple high-density maps. We further validate SJRL in a challenging mixed-reality warehouse environment with 8 physical robots and 248 virtual robots.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究更贴近真实仓库场景的终身多智能体路径规划问题，提出计入鲁棒安全约束与原地旋转约束的 LMAPF-R2 模型，并给出搜索辅助的联合强化学习方法 SJRL。SJRL 将神经策略与单步搜索规划器 Causal PIBT 结合，并通过统一 RL 框架联合优化智能体策略与环境策略，在多个高密度地图上显著优于强搜索基线 Causal-PIBT，还在 8 台实体机器人加 248 台虚拟机器人的混合现实仓库中进行了验证。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的 LMAPF 规划器大多采用过度简化的运动学假设，忽略了真实世界性能至关重要的运动约束；加入鲁棒安全约束和原地旋转约束后，协调难度在狭窄空间内显著增加，需要新的求解方法。
Method: 提出 SJRL：先用单步搜索规划器 Causal PIBT 增强神经策略，用于解决智能体冲突并传播意图；再引入统一 RL 公式，联合优化智能体策略与环境策略，其中环境策略通过反向 Dijkstra 搜索学习图边成本，以提供全局移动引导。
Result: 实验表明，SJRL 在多个高密度地图上相比强搜索基线 Causal-PIBT 取得显著改进，并在包含 8 台物理机器人和 248 台虚拟机器人的混合现实仓库环境中得到验证。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LMAPF-R2 是源于真实自动仓库系统的更 realistic 模型，而将搜索式规划与联合 RL 相结合可以有效应对旋转与安全约束带来的协调困难，提高该系统下的鲁棒性能。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: StepReflect: Structured UI Transition Reflection for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile GUI agents require accurate action reflection for reliable long-horizon execution. Existing approaches rely on open-ended multimodal reasoning after each action, which is costly and poorly matched to the structured nature of GUI state transitions. We propose StepReflect, which formulates per-step GUI reflection as supervised structured prediction conditioned on explicit transition specifications and paired visual evidence. StepReflect is trained through a staged pipeline combining supervised fine-tuning, teacher-student distillation, and preference- and reward-based refinement. Offline, the resulting 8B model achieves 82.16% transition-level accuracy on AndroidWorld, exceeding zero-shot GPT-5.2 by 11.83 percentage points under the same structured input. Online, across M3A, Agent-SAMA, MAI-UI-8B, and Seed-2.0-Pro, StepReflect achieves higher task success in three of four agent configurations and remains within one successful task of the GPT-5.2 Reflection Agent in the fourth. It also reduces paid API charges relative to GPT-based reflection in all four configurations. These results establish StepReflect as a practical, locally deployable alternative to repeated frontier-model reflection for long-horizon mobile GUI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StepReflect，将移动 GUI 智能体的每步反思（reflection）建模为基于显式转换规范（transition specification）与配对视觉证据的监督结构化预测，并通过监督微调、师生蒸馏以及偏好与奖励优化相结合的分阶段流程训练。摘要报告其在 AndroidWorld 上达到 82.16% 的转换级准确率，在线任务成功率在四种智能体配置中三种优于 GPT-5.2 Reflection Agent，且付费 API 费用均更低。
Motivation: 现有移动 GUI 智能体通常在每个动作之后依赖开放式多模态推理进行反思，成本高昂，且与 GUI 状态转换的结构化特性不匹配，难以支持可靠的长时程执行。
Method: StepReflect 将逐步 GUI 反思形式化为条件于显式转换规范和成对视觉证据的监督结构化预测，并采用包含监督微调、教师-学生蒸馏和偏好/奖励优化的分阶段训练管线。
Result: 离线评估中，8B 模型在 AndroidWorld 上达到 82.16% 的转换级准确率，比同结构输入下的零样本 GPT-5.2 高出 11.83 个百分点；在线评估中，在 M3A、Agent-SAMA、MAI-UI-8B 和 Seed-2.0-Pro 四种配置里三种取得更高任务成功率，第四种仅比 GPT-5.2 Reflection Agent 少一个成功任务，且四种配置的付费 API 费用均低于基于 GPT 的反思方案。
Conclusion: 作者认为 StepReflect 可作为一种实用且可本地部署的替代方案，替代长时程移动 GUI 智能体中反复调用前沿模型进行反思的做法。
Relevance: 5
