papers.title: Optimal or Greedy Decision Trees? Revisiting their Objectives, Tuning, and Performance
authors: Jacobus G. M. van der Linden
papers.abstract_en: Recently there has been a surge of interest in optimal decision tree (ODT) methods that globally optimize accuracy directly, in contrast to traditional approaches that locally optimize an impurity or information metric. However, the literature shows conflicting evidence on the value of ODTs, with some demonstrating superior out-of-sample performance of ODTs over greedy approaches, while others show the opposite. The value and performance of ODTs therefore remains one of several open question regarding ODTs, most of which could not be answered before due to lack of scalability. With our experimental study---the largest to this date---we examine five such open questions. Our results show (i) that a major advantage of ODTs over greedy approaches is that they can optimize the target objective directly (e.g., accuracy rather than a proxy such as Gini impurity); (ii) that hyperparameter tuning of ODTs is essential; and reaffirm (iii) that optimal methods, on average, obtain smaller and more accurate trees than greedy approaches. Our results also refute two previously posited hypotheses: (iv) that the difference between optimal and greedy approaches diminish with more data, and (v) that optimal methods are more sensitive to overfitting. Finally, our work provides insights on the value of ODTs, clear recommendations for researchers and practitioners on the usage of greedy and optimal methods, and code for future comparisons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是针对最优决策树 (Optimal Decision Trees, ODT) 与贪心决策树方法的最大规模实验研究之一，旨在回应文献中对 ODT 价值的矛盾结论。作者在实验中重新检验了 ODT 能否直接优化目标指标、超参数调优的重要性、树大小与准确率差异，以及两个此前提出的假设（数据增多时差异消失、ODT 更易过拟合）。结果表明 ODT 的主要优势在于直接优化目标而非代理指标，且调参至关重要。
Motivation: 现有文献对最优决策树与贪心方法的价值存在相互矛盾的证据，此前因可扩展性不足，许多关于 ODT 的开放问题难以回答。
Method: 作者开展了至今最大规模的实验研究，系统比较 ODT 与贪心决策树方法，并围绕五个开放问题设计实验，包括目标函数直接影响、超参数调优、树大小与准确率、数据规模影响以及过拟合敏感性。
Result: 结果发现：(i) ODT 的主要优势是可直接优化目标（如准确率而非 Gini 不纯度等代理指标）；(ii) ODT 的超参数调优至关重要；(iii) 最优方法平均能获得更小且更准确的树。同时否定了两个假设：并非数据越多差距越小，ODT 也并非对过拟合更敏感。
Conclusion: 作者为研究者和实践者提供了关于何时使用贪心或最优决策树方法的明确建议，并公开代码以支持后续比较研究。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Latent Utility Q-Learning for Preference-Adaptive Dynamic Treatment Regimes
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing individualized treatment sequences for patients who weigh multiple, competing outcomes differently poses a challenge for dynamic treatment regime (DTR) methods, which typically assume a single univariate outcome. We propose Latent Utility Q-Learning (LUQ-Learning), which estimates DTRs optimizing patient-specific preference-weighted combinations of multivariate outcomes $\mathbf{Y}\in\mathbb{R}^d$ across $K$ decision points. A conditional mean factorization decouples preference estimation from outcome regression, enabling flexible, modular learning under imperfectly observed and heterogeneous preferences without requiring explicit outcome ranking by patients. We establish consistency of the estimated value function and derive unified $ε$-optimality guarantees that bound policy value loss in terms of posterior preference uncertainty, yielding interpretable criteria for data-driven policy selection. Simulations calibrated to Sequential Multiple Assignment Randomized Trials (SMARTs) demonstrate that LUQ-Learning outperforms Q-learning with naive outcome aggregation, last-reported satisfaction optimization, and existing preference-based methods.
papers.comment: Joshua P. Zitovsky and Yating Zou contributed equally to this work as co-first authors
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent Utility Q-Learning (LUQ-Learning)，用于在 K 个决策点上估计优化患者特异性的、偏好加权组合的多元结局的动态治疗方案 (DTR)。该方法通过条件均值分解将偏好估计与结局回归解耦，从而可在偏好被部分观测且异质、且无需患者显式对结局排序的情形下进行灵活模块化学习。文章建立了估计值函数的一致性，并给出以偏好后验不确定性为界的统一 ε-最优性保证。基于 SMART 校准的模拟显示，LUQ-Learning 优于朴素聚合结局的 Q-learning、最后一次报告满意度优化及现有基于偏好的方法。
Motivation: 现有 DTR 方法通常假设单一单变量结局，难以处理患者对不同且相互竞争的结局赋予不同权重的情形，这限制了个体化治疗序列的优化。
Method: 提出 LUQ-Learning：在多个决策点上估计 DTR，优化患者特异性的偏好加权多元结局组合；利用条件均值分解把偏好估计从结局回归中分离出来，支持不完美观测和异质偏好下的模块化学习，且不要求患者显式排序结局。
Result: 在依据 SMART 校准的模拟试验中，LUQ-Learning 的表现优于朴素结局聚合的 Q-learning、基于最后报告满意度的优化方法以及现有基于偏好的方法；理论上还证明了值函数估计的一致性和以偏好后验不确定性为界的 ε-最优性保证。
Conclusion: 文章强调该方法为数据驱动的策略选择提供了可解释的准则，即策略价值损失可由偏好后验不确定性界定；其有效性来自模块化偏好估计与结局回归的解耦。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 文章强调该方法为数据驱动的策略选择提供了可解释的准则，即策略价值损失可由偏好后验不确定性界定；其有效性来自模块化偏好估计与结局回归的解耦。

papers.title: Path Planning of Cleaning Robot with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recently, as the demand for cleaning robots has steadily increased, therefore household electricity consumption is also increasing. To solve this electricity consumption issue, the problem of efficient path planning for cleaning robot has become important and many studies have been conducted. However, most of them are about moving along a simple path segment, not about the whole path to clean all places. As the emerging deep learning technique, reinforcement learning (RL) has been adopted for cleaning robot. However, the models for RL operate only in a specific cleaning environment, not the various cleaning environment. The problem is that the models have to retrain whenever the cleaning environment changes. To solve this problem, the proximal policy optimization (PPO) algorithm is combined with an efficient path planning that operates in various cleaning environments, using transfer learning (TL), detection nearest cleaned tile, reward shaping, and making elite set methods. The proposed method is validated with an ablation study and comparison with conventional methods such as random and zigzag. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves improved training performance and increased convergence speed over the original PPO. And it also demonstrates that this proposed method is better performance than conventional methods (random, zigzag).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对清洁机器人在不同清洁环境中需要重新训练强化学习模型的问题，提出将近端策略优化 (PPO) 与高效路径规划相结合的方法，并引入迁移学习 (transfer learning)、检测最近已清洁瓷砖、奖励塑形 (reward shaping) 和精英集 (elite set) 等技术。摘要报告该方法相较原始 PPO 提升了训练性能并加快收敛，且优于随机和之字形 (zigzag) 等传统路径规划方法。
Motivation: 清洁机器人需求增加导致家庭电力消耗上升，高效路径规划变得重要；现有基于强化学习的模型仅在特定清洁环境有效，环境变化时需重新训练，缺乏跨环境的泛化能力。
Method: 将 PPO 与高效路径规划结合，通过迁移学习、检测最近已清洁瓷砖、奖励塑形以及构建精英集等方法，使模型能够在多种清洁环境中工作而不必对环境变化重新训练。
Result: 消融实验和与传统方法（随机、之字形）的对比表明，所提方法相比原始 PPO 获得更好的训练性能和更快的收敛速度，并优于随机和之字形方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结合多种改进策略的 PPO 路径规划方法可适应多种清洁环境，并在训练效率和路径规划性能上优于原始 PPO 及传统方法。

papers.title: Transitional Conditional Independence
papers.abstract_en: Statistical models contain variables that are not random: parameters, treatments, environments, design points. Ordinary conditional independence cannot express relations involving such variables. To apply it one must first put a distribution on them, and that changes the meaning of the statement. This paper introduces transitional conditional independence. It relates three variables on a Markov kernel $K(W|T)$ with non-stochastic input $T$, and is defined by a single factorization: \[ X\perp\!\!\!\perp_{K(W|T)} Y |Z \quad :\iff \quad \exists\, Q(X|Z):\; K(X,Y,Z|T) = Q(X|Z)\otimes K(Y,Z|T).\] The relation asserts a Markov kernel $Q(X|Z)$ that is the same for every input $t$. It therefore yields a factorization rather than an almost-sure identity between conditional expectations, and it needs no distribution on the input space. The relation is asymmetric. We show that the asymmetry is essential: symmetrizing it destroys the statements it was built to make. We prove left and right versions of all separoid rules except Symmetry. Ten of them hold on arbitrary measurable spaces, the remaining ones under one condition on the spaces involved, and we give criteria for when Symmetry itself holds. We axiomatize the resulting structure and show that it arises from any symmetric separoid by a shift. We give several applications. Ancillarity, sufficiency and adequacy become factorizations that hold pointwise in the parameter, without a prior and without null sets; the theorems of Fisher--Neyman and of Basu take this form. The invariance hypothesis of invariant prediction, $Y \perp\!\!\!\perp E | X_S$, receives its intended meaning: one kernel predicts $Y$ from $X_S$ in every environment $E$. And Bayesian networks with non-stochastic input nodes satisfy a directed global Markov property whose graphical d-separation criterion returns a factorization of Markov kernels, on arbitrary input spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对统计模型中参数、处理、环境等非随机变量无法直接套用普通条件独立（conditional independence）的问题，提出过渡性条件独立（transitional conditional independence），通过 Markov kernel 的单一因子分解定义三者关系，使输入空间无需分布。作者证明该关系本质上不对称，对称化会破坏其表达能力；在可测空间上证明了除 Symmetry 外的左右版本 separoid 规则，并给出 Symmetry 成立的条件。
Motivation: 普通条件独立只能表述随机变量之间的关系，要处理非随机输入必须先给这些变量人为赋予分布，这会改变陈述的含义，因此需要一种不依赖输入空间分布的条件独立概念。
Method: 定义关系 X⊥⊥_K(W|T) Y | Z 为存在与输入 t 无关的 Markov kernel Q(X|Z)，使 K(X,Y,Z|T) 因子分解为 Q(X|Z)⊗K(Y,Z|T)；并研究其非对称的分离性质（separoid rules）与公理化结构。
Result: 证明除 Symmetry 外的所有 separoid 规则在任意可测空间上有十个成立，其余在空间满足某一条件时成立，并给出 Symmetry 成立的判据；该结构可由任何对称 separoid 通过平移（shift）得到。应用包括无先验且无零测集条件下逐点成立的辅助性（ancillarity）、充分性（sufficiency）与 adequacy，Fisher–Neyman 与 Basu 定理的这种形式，以及非随机输入节点上的贝叶斯网络满足有向全局 Markov 性质。
Conclusion: 该框架为包含非随机变量的统计模型提供一种基于因子分解而非几乎必然条件期望恒等式的条件独立语言，适用于任意输入空间，但关系的不对称性是其本质特征。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Analogy as Nonparametric Bayesian Inference over Relational Systems
papers.abstract_en: Our inferences in the real world are rarely naïve - we acquire experiences through our lifetime that can help us more quickly understand the structure of something new. A fundamental question in cognitive science is how we make such generalizations. Studies of analogy have explored the question of how to map information from a single familiar concept or environment to an unfamiliar one. In this paper, we examine how experience with multiple successive environments affects an individual's subsequent inferences. First, we present an online behavioral environment in which participants play a number of virtual games that each operate according to an underlying relational structure. Second, we show that exposing participants to a particular relational structure biases them towards expecting the same structure to hold in the test game, an effect that scales with the number of times the structure has been observed. Finally, we propose a novel probabilistic model that accounts for these behaviors in terms of nonparametric Bayesian inference. This model generates predictions from each past environment based on their relational structures, and then averages predictions from individual environments according to their analogical relevance to the task at hand. Our results and statistical framework provide a complementary perspective for several key computational ideas about analogy, and our nonparametric framework allows us to account for how a learner might continually build and use knowledge over a lifetime.
papers.comment: An earlier version of this work was presented in Proceedings for the Annual Meeting of the Cognitive Science Society 2020 (CogSci 2020)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究人在面对多个连续环境的经验时如何进行泛化，而非经典类比研究中的单一熟悉环境映射。作者先设计了一个在线行为实验环境，让被试玩多个由潜在关系结构驱动的虚拟游戏；随后发现，被试在测试游戏中会偏向于期待此前观察过的关系结构，且该偏向随结构被观察的次数增加而增强。文章进一步提出一个非参数贝叶斯推断模型，根据每个过去环境的关系统计生成预测，再按与当前任务的类比相关性对各环境预测加权平均。
Motivation: 认知科学的基本问题之一是人们如何借助一生积累的经验快速理解新事物，而现有类比研究大多只关注从单一熟悉概念或环境到不熟悉环境的映射，未充分考察多个先后环境经验的累积效应。
Method: 采用在线行为实验范式，包含多个按潜在关系结构运行的虚拟游戏；随后提出一个非参数贝叶斯推断模型，该模型从每个过去环境基于其关系结构生成预测，并按各环境与当前任务的类比相关性（analogical relevance）对预测求平均。
Result: 行为结果显示，先接触某一特定关系结构会使被试在测试游戏中倾向于预期相同结构成立，且该效应随结构出现次数增加而放大。
Conclusion: 作者认为这一结果与统计框架为关于类比的若干关键计算思想提供了互补视角，其非参数框架可用于刻画学习者在一生中持续构建和使用知识的过程。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: GenGA: Editable and Data-Grounded Graphical Abstract Generation for Academic Papers
papers.abstract_en: Graphical Abstracts (GAs) visually summarize the key findings of academic papers, playing a crucial role in facilitating the understanding of research content. Recently, advancements in vision-language models and image generation models have enabled the automatic generation of scientific figures based on paper content. However, most conventional methods output the generated results as raster graphics, making post-editing (e.g., text modification and layout changes) highly difficult. This poses a significant challenge, as they are unsuitable for the iterative figure revision process inherent in paper writing and peer review. To tackle these challenges, we define the novel task of generating editable GAs from paper content and propose GenGA, a new GA generation framework that directly produces figures in vector format. By generating figures as a collection of vector elements with a hierarchical structure, GenGA produces outputs that can be seamlessly imported into existing drawing tools for intuitive, element-level editing. Furthermore, we introduce the Structural Independence Coefficient (SIC), a metric that quantifies the editing simplicity of a figure based on the degree to which local modifications propagate to other elements. Experimental results show that GenGA achieves superior editing simplicity compared to conventional methods, and even surpasses human-authored GAs in conciseness and semantic alignment. We also validate SIC as an effective metric correlated with manual editing costs. This study fundamentally redefines GA generation as an editable vector graphic generation problem grounded in the practical workflows of researchers, significantly promoting effective scientific communication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GenGA，一种从论文内容直接生成可编辑矢量图形摘要（Graphical Abstract）的框架。它将图形摘要生成定义为可编辑矢量图形生成问题，通过层级结构的矢量元素集合输出，支持无缝导入现有绘图工具进行元素级编辑。同时提出Structural Independence Coefficient (SIC)指标，量化局部修改传播范围以衡量编辑简易性。实验显示GenGA在编辑简易性上优于传统方法，并在简洁性和语义对齐上超过人工绘制的图形摘要。
Motivation: 现有自动生成科学图形的方法输出栅格图形（raster graphics），导致后续编辑（如文字修改和布局调整）极为困难，不适合论文写作与同行评审中迭代修改图形的实际流程。
Method: 提出GenGA框架，直接生成矢量格式的图形，将图形表示为具有层级结构的矢量元素集合，从而可导入现有绘图工具进行直观的元素级编辑；并引入Structural Independence Coefficient (SIC)，基于局部修改向其他元素传播的程度来量化编辑简易性。
Result: 实验表明GenGA的编辑简易性优于传统方法，且在简洁性和语义对齐上超过人工撰写的图形摘要；SIC被验证为与手动编辑成本相关的有效指标。
Conclusion: 该研究将图形摘要生成重新定义为可编辑矢量图形生成问题，贴近研究者实际工作流，旨在促进有效的科学交流。

papers.title: KV-Skill: Forging Expertise in the Model's Native Language
papers.abstract_en: Task knowledge is commonly stored either as text in the prompt or as an update to model weights. Text is modular but must be interpreted on every use, while weight adaptation makes the resulting capability difficult to load, remove, or share independently. We introduce KV-Skill, a design space of external factorized operators that a frozen language model reads through a lightweight interface. KV-Skill supports two complementary paths. Registration converts an authored text skill into a text-derived operator and trains a shared per-backbone interface. Reward learning develops a compact latent operator directly from task outcomes, with or without an authored skill. Neither path adds positions to the prompt. Across ten benchmarks and four backbones from three model families, converting text to a KV-Skill consistently makes the same procedural knowledge more effective. On Qwen3.5-4B LiveMath, registration reaches 77.2 accuracy, compared with 23.4 for the source text skill, 52.0 for SkillOpt, and 64.5 for SoftSkill. Under matched reward training and parameter budgets, KV-Skill gives the best result in seven of eight matched settings against soft prefixes, prefix tuning, and LoRA. A post-hoc rank analysis further shows that text-derived operators retain nearly all of their benefit with one task-aligned direction per injection layer, while matched random directions fail. Finally, one shared interface retains three independently loadable KV-Skills without measurable forgetting. These results show that task knowledge can be acquired from text or experience, compressed into an external operator, and deployed separately from the backbone. Code is available at: https://github.com/shawnzhg/KV-Skill
papers.comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, 18 tables. Zhaowei Han and Xiang Zhang contributed equally to this work. Code: https://github.com/shawnzhg/KV-Skill
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KV-Skill，一种外部因子化算子 (external factorized operator) 设计空间：冻结的语言模型通过轻量接口读取这些算子来获得任务知识，而无需在提示中增加位置。它支持两条互补路径——将文本技能注册为文本派生算子，以及直接从任务结果学习紧凑的潜在算子。摘要报告在十个基准、四个骨干上，文本技能转为 KV-Skill 后的一致有效性，例如 Qwen3.5-4B LiveMath 上 registration 达到 77.2，远超源文本技能的 23.4。
Motivation: 现有任务知识要么以文本形式放在提示中、每次使用都要重新解释，要么以权重更新的方式存储、导致能力难以独立加载、移除或共享。本文针对的是这两种存储方式在模块化和可复用性上的根本矛盾。
Method: KV-Skill 将任务知识压缩为外部因子化算子，由冻结的语言模型通过共享的每骨干轻量接口读取。Registration 路径把作者撰写的文本技能转换成文本派生算子并训练接口；Reward learning 路径直接从任务结果学习紧凑潜在算子。两条路径都不向提示添加新位置。
Result: 在十个基准和四个来自三个模型家族的骨干上，文本转 KV-Skill 使相同程序性知识更有效：Qwen3.5-4B LiveMath 上 registration 为 77.2，对比源文本技能 23.4、SkillOpt 52.0、SoftSkill 64.5；在匹配奖励训练和参数预算下，KV-Skill 在八个匹配设置中的七个上优于 soft prefix、prefix tuning 和 LoRA。后验秩分析表明每注入层一个任务对齐方向即可保留几乎全部收益，而随机方向失败；一个共享接口可承载三个独立可加载的 KV-Skill 且无可测遗忘。
Conclusion: 作者认为任务知识可以从文本或经验中获取、压缩到外部算子中，并与骨干网络分离部署。摘要强调该方法不增加提示长度、可独立加载和共享接口等特性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Matrix Zonotopic Attention: A Context-Adaptive Value Projection for Set Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Multi-head attention combines an input-dependent softmax routing with an input-independent linear value projection, so the per-sample operator mapping aggregated values to outputs is the same for every input set. We study the consequences of this asymmetry for permutation-invariant set targets. We introduce the Transformation Degrees of Freedom (TDOF) of a target operator, a complexity measure counting the input-dependent directions an exact representation requires, and present a depth-separation analysis showing that context-rigid attention needs depth proportional to the target's TDOF, whereas a single layer with a context-adaptive value family can represent the same target. Building on this analysis, we propose Matrix Zonotopic Attention (MZAttn), which replaces the fixed value projection with a context-adaptive matrix-zonotope family: a centre matrix plus a sum of generator matrices weighted by input-dependent gates. The construction reduces to standard multi-head attention at initialisation, preserves permutation equivariance, and admits a data-driven reachability interpretation. Experiments on a range of set-prediction tasks are consistent with the TDOF prediction that the architectural advantage is selective: it appears on targets that depend on the input set in a high-rank, sparsely combinatorial way, and is small on aggregate-statistic targets where parameter-matched standard attention is already competitive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多头注意力中软路由输入相关而线性值投影输入无关的不对称性，指出这导致每个输入集对应的按样本聚合算子相同。作者提出目标算子的变换自由度 (TDOF) 作为复杂度度量，用深度分离分析说明上下文刚性注意力需要与 TDOF 成比例的深度，而带上下文自适应值族的单层即可表示同一目标。基于此提出矩阵带状注意力 (Matrix Zonotopic Attention, MZAttn)，用中心矩阵加输入相关门控加权的生成矩阵族替换固定值投影，并在多组集合预测任务上验证其优势具有选择性。
Motivation: 现有注意力机制的按样本操作算子与输入无关，这对置换不变集合目标可能造成表达上的不对称与过大的深度需求；作者希望揭示这种上下文刚性带来的表示代价，并构造上下文自适应的值投影来降低所需深度。
Method: 定义 Transformation Degrees of Freedom (TDOF) 作为目标算子复杂度度量，给出深度分离分析；提出 Matrix Zonotopic Attention (MZAttn)，以中心矩阵与输入相关门控加权的生成矩阵之和构成矩阵带状 (matrix zonotope) 值族，初始化时退化为标准多头注意力，并保持置换等变性，同时具有数据驱动的可达性解释。
Result: 在多种集合预测任务上的实验与 TDOF 预测一致：优势出现于依赖输入集合的高秩、稀疏组合式目标，而在参数匹配的标准注意力已具备竞争力的聚合统计量目标上收益很小。
Conclusion: 摘要认为上下文自适应值族能让单层注意力量级地替代需要深度的上下文刚性表示，但该优势是选择性的而非普适；作者未在摘要中给出明确局限性。
Relevance: 7

papers.title: A Foundational EDM2-Based Generative Model for High-Resolution Synthetic Fetal Ultrasound Imaging from Open Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Prenatal ultrasound imaging is key for assessing fetal health, but AI progress is limited by scarce, privacy-restricted, and hard-to-annotate datasets. We propose a high-resolution fetal ultrasound synthesis framework based on the EDM2 diffusion architecture, trained on multiple public datasets to generate 512x512 images across six anatomical classes. Our method achieved improved image quality with lower FID scores and enhanced downstream fetal plane classification, reaching 93.36% ensemble accuracy after fine-tuning, surpassing real-data-only training. Clinical evaluation by an experienced fetal ultrasound specialist (10+ years) on 100 images yielded a mean realism score of 2.67/5, with real images rated higher than synthetic. Artefacts included smoothing, speckle irregularities, and anatomical inconsistencies. Code, data, models and other resources to reproduce this work are available at https://github.com/xfetus/fetal-ultrasound-edm2.
papers.comment: Short paper for the 30th Conference on Medical Image Understanding and Analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于 EDM2 扩散架构的高分辨率胎儿超声合成框架，在多个公开数据集上训练，生成 512×512 六类解剖图像。摘要报告该方法获得更低的 FID，并提升下游胎儿平面分类性能，微调后集成准确率达 93.36%，超过仅用真实数据训练。临床超声专家对 100 张图像的评估显示平均真实感评分为 2.67/5，真实图像评分更高，合成图像存在平滑化、散斑不规则和解剖不一致等伪影。
Motivation: 产前超声对胎儿健康评估至关重要，但 AI 研究受限于数据集稀缺、隐私受限和难以标注的问题，需要合成数据来缓解训练数据不足的瓶颈。
Method: 提出基于 EDM2 扩散架构的高分辨率胎儿超声合成框架，利用多个公开数据集训练，面向六个解剖类别生成 512×512 图像。
Result: 摘要报告改进的图像质量与更低 FID；下游胎儿平面分类在微调后达到 93.36% 的集成准确率，优于仅用真实数据训练。临床评估中，100 张图像的专家平均真实感评分为 2.67/5，真实图像评分高于合成图像。
Conclusion: 摘要表明合成胎儿超声图像可作为训练数据的补充并提升下游分类性能，但当前合成图像仍存在平滑化、散斑不规则和解剖不一致等伪影，真实感评分低于真实图像。代码、数据、模型及复现资源已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Recursive Synthesis for Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks
papers.abstract_en: High-quality long-horizon training data for terminal agents is expensive to produce, often costing hundreds to thousands of dollars per task, because each task must keep the instruction, environment, reference solution, and verifier mutually consistent. Human authoring does not scale, and direct generation with large language models (LLMs) often breaks these dependencies. We present Recursive Synthetic Terminal Tasks (RST), a recursive verified synthesis framework for constructing long-horizon terminal-agent tasks at scale. Starting from verified seed tasks, RST extends the reference solution, realigns the verifier and instruction to the new workflow, validates the result in a fresh sandbox, and reuses accepted tasks as seeds for subsequent rounds. Across fifteen recursive rounds, RST produces 37,484 synthesized terminal-agent tasks at roughly \$0.05 per task. Task difficulty increases substantially over rounds: the median reference solution grows from 67 to 374 lines, the median number of executed commands grows from 40 to 244, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro pass@4 drops from 90\% at $R_1$ to 2.5\% at $R_{15}$. To demonstrate training utility, we collect rejection-sampled Qwen3.5 trajectories on the synthesized tasks and use them for supervised fine-tuning. Fine-tuning on these trajectories improves Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B by up to 10 points on Terminal-Bench~2, Terminal-Bench Hard, and Long-Horizon Terminal Bench, while agentic PPO lifts Qwen3.5-27B to 49.44\%, 32.00\%, and 22.07\% on the three benchmarks, corresponding to relative gains of 20.0\%, 41.2\%, and 21.9\% over the base model. Moreover, after 15 rounds, the recursion shows no ceiling: synthesis yield and validation rates remain stable as difficulty keeps climbing, indicating that the process can continue well beyond the scale reported here.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出递归合成终端任务 (Recursive Synthetic Terminal Tasks, RST)，一种用于大规模构建长时间跨度 terminal-agent 任务的递归验证合成框架。RST 从已验证的种子任务出发，扩展参考解并重新对齐 verifier 与指令，在全新沙箱中验证后把通过的任务作为下一轮种子。摘要报告在 15 轮递归中生成 37,484 个任务，单任务成本约 0.05 美元，任务难度逐轮显著上升，且用拒绝采样轨迹做 SFT 与 agentic PPO 训练能稳定提升终端任务基准表现。
Motivation: 高质量长时程 terminal-agent 训练数据人工编写成本极高（每任务数百至数千美元），且需保证指令、环境、参考解和 verifier 互相一致；LLM 直接生成容易破坏这些依赖关系，难以扩展。
Method: 提出 RST 递归验证合成框架：从已验证的种子任务出发，扩展参考解，将 verifier 和指令重新对齐到新工作流，在全新沙箱中验证结果，并把通过的任务作为后续轮次的种子。
Result: 15 轮递归产生 37,484 个任务，单任务约 0.05 美元；中位参考解从 67 行增至 374 行，中位执行命令数从 40 增至 244，DeepSeek-V4-Pro pass@4 从第 1 轮的 90% 降至第 15 轮的 2.5%。用 Qwen3.5 拒绝采样轨迹微调后，Qwen3.5-27B 与 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 在 Terminal-Bench 2、Terminal-Bench Hard 与 Long-Horizon Terminal Bench 上最高提升 10 个点；agentic PPO 将 Qwen3.5-27B 提升至 49.44%、32.00%、22.07%，相对增益分别为 20.0%、41.2%、21.9%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 15 轮后递归仍未出现天花板：合成产出率与验证率保持稳定而难度持续上升，表明该流程可扩展到本文报告规模之外。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Effective pruning of task-trained recurrent neural networks using noisy fluctuations and connection rescaling
papers.abstract_en: The pruning of network connections is key to brain function but, despite its importance, there exist few biologically-plausible pruning rules with demonstrated good performance. In this work we evaluate noise-prune, a recently introduced unsupervised local pruning rule for recurrent networks that uses noisy fluctuations to determine the importance of connections. Noise-prune has previously only been empirically tested on random networks without a specific computational function. We show that noise-prune preserves task-performance in task-trained recurrent neural networks, greatly outperforming a strategy that only uses the magnitude of connections and performing on par with or exceeding a non-local strategy that uses second-order information. Rather than deterministically removing connections that fall below a certain threshold importance, noise-prune samples connections to preserve based on their importance and strengthens retained connections to preserve average synaptic strength. We show that this sampling and rescaling is essential to good performance, but that the optimal empirical degree of rescaling is lower than that predicted by the original theoretical argument. Our work thus validates noise-prune as a biologically-plausible pruning rule for functional recurrent network architectures and characterizes its optimal parameter settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了最近提出的无监督局部剪枝规则 noise-prune 在任务训练循环网络（task-trained recurrent neural networks）中的表现。摘要表明 noise-prune 能在保持任务性能的同时大幅优于仅基于连接幅度的剪枝策略，并达到或超过使用二阶信息的非局部方法的水平；随机采样保留连接与连接重缩放（connection rescaling）是性能关键，且最优重缩放程度低于原始理论预测。
Motivation: 连接剪枝对大脑功能至关重要，但缺乏既有良好表现又具生物合理性的剪枝规则；noise-prune 此前仅在无特定计算功能的随机网络上得到实证检验，尚未在具有明确计算任务的功能性网络上得到验证。
Method: 在任务训练的 RNN 上评估 noise-prune；该规则利用噪声波动确定连接重要性，按重要性采样要保留的连接而非确定性移除低于阈值的连接，并通过重缩放增强保留连接以维持平均突触强度。
Result: noise-prune 在任务训练 RNN 中保持任务性能，大幅优于仅用连接幅度的策略，与使用二阶信息的非局部策略相当或更好；实验还表明采样和重缩放对性能至关重要，但最优经验重缩放程度低于原始理论给出的程度。

papers.title: Stochasticity Is Not the Hard Part: Reduction and Complexity in Instructional Sequencing over Prerequisite DAGs
authors: Kristian A. Stevens (1) ((1) Department of Computer Science
(3) School of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: When a student must learn concepts connected by prerequisite dependencies, when does the order of instruction matter, and what does it cost to find the best one? We study instructional sequencing as a stochastic shortest-path problem in which attempting a concept succeeds with a state-dependent probability and failure leaves the learner state unchanged. We first prove that this stochasticity can be eliminated exactly: the problem collapses to a deterministic shortest-path problem on the lattice of prerequisite order ideals, preserving optimal values and actions. The collapse removes stochastic complexity but not combinatorial complexity: optimal sequencing remains NP-hard -- via reduction from feedback arc set in tournaments -- even with no prerequisite edges, unit costs, uniform binary nonnegative transfer, and success probabilities at least $1/2$. Hardness is not uniform: when realizable transfer preferences remain jointly acyclic with the prerequisites, any topological order of the residual joint graph is optimal, and fixed prerequisite width yields polynomial-time exact dynamic programming. A computable diagnostic, $mΔ$, bounds the value of sequencing before optimization. On 70,893 interactions from an introductory CS course, the diagnostic certifies a doubly easy regime -- little value to optimize and little space to search -- while constructed transfer instances realize the challenging regime, where myopic sequencing suffers large regret yet exact A* with a consistent heuristic expands only linearly many states on that family.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Equal contribution among Y. Chen, J. Jiang, and T. Shi (alphabetical order)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带前置依赖关系的概念教学排序问题，将其建模为随机最短路径 (stochastic shortest-path) 问题：尝试学习一个概念以状态相关概率成功，失败时学习者状态不变。作者证明该随机性可以被精确消除——问题等价于在前提序理想格 (lattice of prerequisite order ideals) 上的确定性最短路径问题，最优值和最优动作保持不变。但组合复杂性仍在：即使没有前置边、单位代价、均匀二元非负迁移且成功概率至少 1/2，最优排序仍通过 tournament 中反馈弧集问题的归约证明为 NP-hard。
Motivation: 教学排序的难点究竟来自随机性还是组合结构并不清楚，而理解这一点决定了算法设计和问题可解性边界。作者想回答何时教学顺序重要、找到最优顺序需要多大代价。
Method: 首先给出将随机最短路径精确约简为确定性最短路径的证明；随后通过反馈弧集 (feedback arc set) 归约刻画 NP-hard 性，并分析可解特例：当可实现的迁移偏好与前置关系保持联合无环时任意拓扑序最优，固定前提宽度时给出多项式时间精确动态规划。还提出一个可计算诊断量 mΔ，在优化前界定排序的价值。
Result: 摘要报告：即使去掉前置边、采用单位代价和至少 1/2 的成功概率，最优排序仍 NP-hard；而在 70,893 条入门 CS 课程交互数据上，mΔ 认证了“双重容易”的情形（优化价值小、搜索空间小）；构造的迁移实例则呈现困难情形，其中贪心 (myopic) 排序有较大遗憾，而带一致启发式的精确 A* 在该族上只扩展线性数量的状态。
Conclusion: 作者强调随机性并非问题的困难根源，真正的复杂性来自组合结构；同时指出困难性并不均匀，并可用 mΔ 等诊断量在实际数据上预先识别容易实例。

papers.title: Hybrid Probabilistic Zonotopes for Identifiable and Refinable Predictive Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic prediction heads in neural networks typically output either a Gaussian mixture or a single conformal region. Neither separates the distinct sources of uncertainty often present in real prediction tasks: a discrete choice among modes, bounded systematic drift within the chosen mode, and irreducible stochastic noise. We introduce the Hybrid Probabilistic Zonotope (HProbZ), an output head that represents these three sources as binary, bounded, and stochastic generators of a zonotope, and admits a closed-form likelihood by convolution. Sharing the bounded generator across prediction steps couples future predictions algebraically, so observing one step refines the predictive distribution at every remaining step in a single forward pass. We establish that the three generators are identifiable from the likelihood up to permutation, and that an HProbZ density is representationally distinct from any finite Gaussian mixture. The same shared structure provides analytic per-mode risk and distribution-free multi-modal conformal sets at inference time. Empirical analysis on representative prediction benchmarks supports the effectiveness of the design relative to same-encoder mixture baselines, while offering structural properties that mixture or convex-conformal predictors do not jointly provide.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出混合概率 Zonotope（HProbZ）输出头，将预测不确定性的三种来源分别建模为二元、有界和随机生成器，并得到闭式似然。作者证明三个生成器在似然上可辨识（至多排列意义下），且 HProbZ 密度在表示上不同于任何有限高斯混合；共享有界生成器使得单步观测能以单次前向传播细化所有后续步骤的预测分布。
Motivation: 现有神经网络概率预测头通常输出高斯混合或单一 conformal 区域，无法区分真实预测任务中常见的不确定性来源：模式间的离散选择、所选模式内的有界系统漂移、以及不可约的随机噪声。
Method: HProbZ 将三类不确定性分别表示为 zonotope 的二元、有界和随机生成器，通过卷积获得闭式似然；共享有界生成器以代数方式耦合各预测步，使观测一步即可细化其余步骤的预测分布。
Result: 论文建立了生成器在似然上的可辨识性（至多排列意义下），并证明 HProbZ 密度与任何有限高斯混合在表示上不同；在代表性预测基准上与同编码器混合基线相比，经验分析支持其有效性，并提供混合或凸 conformal 预测器不能同时具备的结构性质。
Conclusion: HProbZ 在推断时提供解析的逐模式风险与分布无关的多模态 conformal 集合，兼具可辨识性与可细化性；但摘要未给出具体数据集与数值对比结果。

papers.title: MOSAIK: Multi-Patch Content-Aware Spatial Allocation of Image Tokens for Efficient Generation
papers.abstract_en: Pixel-space diffusion models avoid the reconstruction ceiling of latent diffusion models by generating directly in image space. However, their substantially higher token count makes generation expensive due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Several existing efficiency methods reduce this cost by using larger patches at selected denoising steps, thereby representing the image with fewer tokens. Yet, each step still uses a single patch size uniformly across the entire image, overlooking that different regions suffer different fidelity losses when coarsened. We introduce MOSAIK, a damage-guided framework that varies patch size across regions and denoising steps. MOSAIK adapts the PixelDiT backbone to generate arbitrary heterogeneous patch layouts, and a lightweight predictor uses intermediate denoising features to estimate the fidelity loss caused by coarsening each region. Given a token budget, our damage-guided layout predictor assigns fine patches to sensitive regions and coarse patches elsewhere. Remarkably, while reducing FLOPs by 70% and token count by 83%, MOSAIK matches the full-compute PixelDiT on GenEval and its DPG-Bench score drops by only 1.0 point. Compared to diverse efficiency paradigms, including temporal patch scheduling and feature caching, our approach delivers highly competitive performance at moderate budgets and consistently outperforms these baselines in highly constrained compute regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MOSAIK，一个基于损伤引导的框架，在像素空间扩散模型的不同图像区域和去噪步骤中自适应分配 patch 大小，以降低自注意力的二次计算成本。它让 PixelDiT 骨干能够生成任意异构 patch 布局，并用轻量预测器根据中间去噪特征估计每个区域因粗化造成的保真损失，在给定 token 预算下为敏感区域分配细 patch、其余区域使用粗 patch。摘要报告该方法在减少 70% FLOPs 和 83% token 的同时，在 GenEval 上匹配全计算量 PixelDiT，DPG-Bench 得分仅下降 1.0 分。
Motivation: 像素空间扩散模型虽然避免了潜空间扩散的重建上限，但 token 数量多，自注意力二次复杂度导致生成成本过高。现有效率方法只在选定的去噪步使用统一的大 patch，忽略不同区域被粗化时遭受的保真损失不同这一事实。
Method: 提出损伤引导框架 MOSAIK：一方面改造 PixelDiT 以生成任意异构 patch 布局；另一方面用轻量预测器基于中间去噪特征估计每个区域粗化导致的保真损失，并在给定 token 预算下据此分配细 patch 到敏感区域、粗 patch 到其他区域。
Result: 摘要报告 MOSAIK 在减少 70% FLOPs 和 83% token 的情况下匹配全计算量 PixelDiT 的 GenEval 结果，DPG-Bench 仅下降 1.0 分；与时间 patch 调度和 feature caching 等效率范式相比，在中等预算下竞争力强，并在高度受限计算条件下持续优于这些基线。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，按区域和去噪步骤自适应变化 patch 大小能够在保持生成质量的同时大幅降低计算开销，适用于像素空间扩散模型的高效图像生成。摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: EvoHarness-RL: Learning Self-Evolving Runtime Harness for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents increasingly rely on external execution support to maintain state, track progress, invoke tools, verify outcomes, and reuse experience across interactions. However, effective harness use raises two coupled challenges: state formation from noisy interaction traces and runtime control over external-state access. Existing agents usually handle both through prompts, heuristics, or domain-specific conventions, leaving the external workspace and its usage policy manually engineered. To address this, we study the problem of harness policy learning, where agents learn harness policies offline and deploy them to construct and update external harness state online during runtime task execution. We introduce EvoHarness-RL, which exposes Belief, Progress, and Experience (BPE) as policy-facing harness state. Supervised harness fine-tuning teaches the base agent the harness action space and how to construct useful external state, while cost-aware GRPO explores coordination policies to selectively read, update, and consolidate that state during long-horizon interaction. Instantiated on ALFWorld with a Qwen3-8B LLM, EvoHarness-RL reaches 96.9% success and reveals two key dynamics: harness annealing, where training internalizes recurring harness-use patterns into the model policy and shifts the agent from frequent harness calls toward selective external-state access, and harness evolution, where progress updates and experience consolidation refine the harness into a compact, task-adaptive state substrate. These results suggest that long-horizon agents benefit from trainable policies for constructing and coordinating with external harness workspaces, beyond simply adding stronger tools or larger memories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长时程 LLM 代理 (long-horizon LLM agents) 的外部执行支持问题，提出 EvoHarness-RL：将 Belief、Progress、Experience (BPE) 作为策略面向的 harness 状态，先通过监督式 harness 微调教基座代理 harness 动作空间，再用成本感知的 GRPO 学习在长时程交互中选择性地读取、更新与整合外部状态。在 ALFWorld 上用 Qwen3-8B 达到 96.9% 成功率，并观察到 harness annealing（训练将反复出现的 harness 使用模式内化到模型策略中，使代理从频繁调用外部状态转向选择性访问）与 harness evolution（进度更新与经验整合让 harness 收敛为紧凑、任务自适应的状态基底）两种动力学。
Motivation: 长时程 LLM 代理依赖外部执行支持来维护状态、追踪进度、调用工具、验证结果并复用经验，但现有方法通常通过提示、启发式或领域特定约定来手工设计外部工作区及其使用策略，形成状态形成与运行时控制两个耦合挑战。
Method: 作者将问题形式化为 harness 策略学习：代理离线学习 harness 策略、在线运行时构建和更新外部 harness 状态；方法包含暴露 Belief/Progress/Experience (BPE) 状态、监督式 harness 微调（学习 harness 动作空间与有用的外部状态构建），以及成本感知的 GRPO 来探索协调策略，实现选择性读取、更新与整合状态。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 上以 Qwen3-8B 实例化，EvoHarness-RL 达到 96.9% 成功率，并揭示 harness annealing 与 harness evolution 两种关键动态。
Conclusion: 作者认为长时程代理受益于可训练的 harness 工作区构建与协调策略，而非仅仅依赖更强的工具或更大的记忆；范围上该方法仅在单个环境 (ALFWorld) 和单一大小的模型上验证。

summary_sections.motivation: 长时程 LLM 代理依赖外部执行支持来维护状态、追踪进度、调用工具、验证结果并复用经验，但现有方法通常通过提示、启发式或领域特定约定来手工设计外部工作区及其使用策略，形成状态形成与运行时控制两个耦合挑战。
summary_sections.method: 作者将问题形式化为 harness 策略学习：代理离线学习 harness 策略、在线运行时构建和更新外部 harness 状态；方法包含暴露 Belief/Progress/Experience (BPE) 状态、监督式 harness 微调（学习 harness 动作空间与有用的外部状态构建），以及成本感知的 GRPO 来探索协调策略，实现选择性读取、更新与整合状态。

papers.title: SCP-NL2TL: Selective Conformal Prediction with Semantic Verification for Natural Language to Temporal Logic Specifications
papers.abstract_en: Translating natural language instructions into machine-interpretable formal specifications enables robots and autonomous systems to plan, reason, and formally verify their behavior. However, existing translation models typically generate a specification for every input, even when the result is unreliable or fails to capture the user's intent, creating risks in safety-critical applications. Inspired by selective conformal prediction, we propose a selective translation framework that not only generates formal specifications but also determines when they can be trusted. Reliability is scored by two complementary black-box signals, the fidelity of the specification back-translated into natural language and the dispersion of repeated translations under exact semantic equivalence, which fail on different errors and jointly separate incorrect translations more sharply than either alone. Conformal risk control calibrates this score into a decision that accepts a specification or abstains, with a distribution-free bound on the rate at which incorrect specifications are accepted for execution, and a conformal anomaly detector on instruction embeddings screens out-of-distribution inputs before any translation is attempted. The proposed framework is general across formal specification languages, with experiments on Signal Temporal Logic (STL), Linear Temporal Logic (LTL), and geometric Spatio-Temporal Logic (SpaTiaL) demonstrating improved translation reliability, robustness under the evaluated cross-tier shifts, and effective uncertainty-aware abstention. This work establishes a foundation for trustworthy natural language interfaces by enabling AI systems to recognize when generated specifications may not be reliable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个选择性翻译框架 SCP-NL2TL，把自然语言指令翻译为时序逻辑规范，并同时判断翻译结果是否可信、可接受执行或应弃权 (abstain)。方法受选择性共形预测 (selective conformal prediction) 启发，用两个互补的黑盒信号给可靠性打分，并通过共形风险控制 (conformal risk control) 提供分布无关的错误接受率上界；实验涵盖 Signal Temporal Logic (STL)、Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) 和几何 Spatio-Temporal Logic (SpaTiaL)。
Motivation: 现有翻译模型对每个输入都生成规范，即使结果不可靠或未捕捉用户意图，这在安全攸关的机器人/自主系统场景中构成风险。
Method: 提出选择性翻译框架：可靠性分数由两个互补的黑盒信号组成，一是将规范回译 (back-translate) 为自然语言的保真度，二是在精确语义等价下重复翻译的离散度 (dispersion)；用共形风险控制将分数校准为接受或弃权的决策，并额外用基于指令嵌入的共形异常检测器在翻译前筛出分布外 (out-of-distribution) 输入。
Result: 在 STL、LTL 和 SpaTiaL 上的实验表明，该方法提升了翻译可靠性，在所评估的跨层面偏移 (cross-tier shifts) 下表现稳健，并能有效进行不确定性感知的弃权。
Conclusion: 该框架通用且不依赖特定形式规范语言，为可信的自然语言接口打下基础，使 AI 系统能够识别生成规范可能不可靠的情形。

papers.title: Discrete energy as an exact label-free training objective for finite-element surrogates
papers.abstract_en: Supervised training of finite-element (FE) surrogate models requires reference solutions, and each reference solution is obtained by solving the system that the surrogate is intended to replace. The assembled discrete potential energy provides a training signal that requires no reference solution. This note records, with proofs, the identities that make this signal exact for linear elastostatics: the difference between the energy of a prediction and the energy of the reference solution equals one half of the squared stiffness-norm error, and the gradient of the energy equals the stiffness-weighted error. Label-free discrete-energy minimisation and supervised regression in the stiffness norm therefore have the same unique minimiser and identical gradients at every point. Around this central result, the note states a conditioning lemma that bounds the displacement error by the energy gap, a modewise contraction identity that explains why the Euclidean displacement error is an unsuitable primary metric, the Chebyshev bound that governs conjugate-gradient post-processing of surrogate predictions, and a conditional latent-separation proposition for joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) pretraining on a shared stiffness operator, with an explicit numerical counterexample that delimits its scope. Every claim with numeric content is implemented as an executable falsification check; the checks were executed twice, on synthetic test problems and on a probe set of 16 instances from the validation split of a pre-registered experimental run, and every inequality holds, with the measured tightness reported. A closing section explains why the construction does not extend to elastodynamics through direct minimisation of the action functional, and which time-discrete formulation restores exactness.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇理论笔记，证明在有限元（FE）线性弹性静力学中，组装后的离散势能可直接作为无标签训练目标：预测能量与参考解能量之差等于刚度范数误差平方的一半，且能量梯度等于刚度加权误差。由此，无标签离散能量最小化与刚度范数下的有监督回归具有相同唯一极小值和处处相同的梯度，并提供数值反例界定联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）预训练条件的适用范围。
Motivation: 有限元代理模型的监督训练需要参考解，而每个参考解本身需要求解代理模型试图替代的系统，成本高昂。论文旨在寻找无需参考解的精确训练信号，并以离散势能作为该信号。
Method: 以线性弹性静力学的离散势能为训练目标，通过数学证明给出能量差与刚度范数误差、能量梯度与刚度加权误差之间的恒等式；并给出位移误差的能量间隙界、模态收缩恒等式、共轭梯度后处理的切比雪夫界，以及共享刚度算子上JEPA预训练的条件性潜在分离命题。每个数值主张都实现为可执行的证伪检查。
Result: 所有不等式在合成测试问题和预注册实验验证集16个实例上均成立，并报告了实测紧度；同时给出一个显式数值反例，界定潜在分离命题的适用范围。
Conclusion: 该构造无法通过直接最小化作用泛函推广到弹性动力学，文中指出某种时间离散格式可恢复精确性。

papers.title: The ethics of artificial intelligence in the life sciences: Universality, cultural diversity and an architecture of care
papers.abstract_en: The life sciences and health research have started to benefit from artificial intelligence, which raises ethical concerns that are real but, we argue, not special. Any science should be governed by values that rest on how the human brain is built and socialised rather than anything distinct to artificial intelligence. Importantly, the human brain has a different, much less costly computational architecture than these machines. This is achieved through the orchestration of a global neuronal workspace, and through reward best described not as a quantity to be maximised but as a continuous cycle of wanting, liking and satiety. As such, this creates the deep tension running through the ethics of the human person, between the universality of ethical judgement and the diversity of morals. The brain networks of the global workspace and emotion are universally shared, but the diversity of content is shaped by epigenetic appropriation of the particulars of the physical, social and cultural world, which makes every person unique. Still, if we were to build machines on these principles rather than the present unaffordable reward maximisers, the question of their governance would change from restraint to upbringing. We set out the institutions such a future would require, together with the questions that remain open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论人工智能在生命科学和健康研究中的伦理问题，主张AI带来的伦理挑战并不特殊，而应回归基于人脑构建与社会化过程的普遍价值观。作者对比人脑与当前机器在计算架构和奖励机制上的差异，提出从“约束”转向“养育”的治理思路，并展望所需机构与开放问题。
Motivation: 生命科学与健康研究开始受益于AI，但相关伦理问题被割裂看待；作者认为任何科学都应受基于人脑本质的价值观约束，而非AI特有规则，同时需要平衡伦理判断的普遍性与道德多样性。
Method: 从神经科学出发，分析人脑的全局神经元工作空间（global neuronal workspace）与情感网络，指出奖励是“想要、喜欢、满足”的连续循环而非可最大化数量，并据此提出以“养育（upbringing）”替代“约束（restraint）”的机器治理框架及其所需制度。
Result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据或量化结果，主要提出概念性论证：人脑计算架构成本更低，伦理判断的普遍性与道德内容多样性并存，若按这些原则建造机器，治理问题将根本改变。
Conclusion: 作者认为AI伦理应根植于人脑科学，而非AI的独特性；未来需要建立相应机构，并指出仍有开放问题待解决。

papers.title: Risk-Aware Quantile Learning for Personalized Dynamic Treatment Regimes
papers.abstract_en: Sequential clinical decision-making often involves more than maximizing average efficacy. Clinicians may need to simultaneously optimize clinically relevant tails of the outcome distribution, control treatment-related risk, and choose among multiple treatment options. Existing quantile dynamic treatment regime (DTR) methods capture distributional features of treatment outcomes but remain largely restricted to efficacy-only objectives and binary treatments. To address these limitations, we propose Risk-Aware Quantile Dynamic Treatment Regimes (RQDTR), a unified framework that optimizes a prespecified quantile of the cumulative potential outcome while explicitly incorporating treatment-related risk. We also develop an angle-based formulation for jointly learning decision rules across multiple treatment categories. Our framework includes three interpretable subclasses: efficacy-only quantile learning, constraint-based learning with population-level risk control, and utility-based learning through a composite benefit-risk utility. Theoretically, we establish identification and oracle equivalence, Fisher consistency of the smoothed surrogate, consistency of the estimated regime, and finite-sample performance error rates. Extensive simulation studies and applications to All of Us major depressive disorder and MIMIC-III sepsis data demonstrate that RQDTR improves tail-oriented efficacy and achieves more favorable benefit-risk trade-offs than existing quantile DTR methods.
papers.comment: An earlier version of this work was accepted at STAI-X 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出风险感知的分位数动态治疗方案（RQDTR），在优化累积潜在结果预设分位数的同时显式纳入治疗相关风险，并开发基于角度（angle-based）的公式以联合学习多个治疗类别的决策规则。理论上建立了识别性、oracle等价性、平滑代理的Fisher一致性、估计方案的相合性以及有限样本性能误差率。模拟研究和All of Us重度抑郁症、MIMIC-III脓毒症数据应用表明，RQDTR改善了尾部导向疗效并取得更有利的获益-风险权衡。
Motivation: 现有分位数动态治疗方案（DTR）方法能够刻画治疗结局的分布特征，但大多局限于仅疗效目标和二值治疗，无法同时优化结局分布中临床相关的尾部、控制治疗相关风险，也无法处理多个治疗选项。临床序贯决策常常需要超越平均疗效的考量。
Method: 提出统一框架RQDTR，优化预设分位数的累积潜在结局并显式纳入治疗相关风险；开发基于角度的公式以联合学习跨多个治疗类别的决策规则。框架包含三个可解释子类：仅疗效分位数学习、带总体风险控制的约束学习，以及通过复合获益-风险效用进行的效用学习。
Result: 理论上建立识别性和oracle等价性、平滑代理的Fisher一致性、估计方案的相合性以及有限样本性能误差率。广泛模拟及All of Us重度抑郁症和MIMIC-III脓毒症数据应用表明，RQDTR在尾部导向疗效上优于现有分位数DTR方法，并实现更有利的获益-风险权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调RQDTR为多类别治疗下同时优化结果分布尾部和控制治疗风险的个性化序贯决策提供了统一、可解释且具有理论保证的框架。

papers.title: Robust Context-Aware Detection of Malicious Instructions in Text
papers.abstract_en: The remarkable instruction-following ability of modern LLMs has enabled their practical use as the minds of agents that can autonomously complete increasingly complex tasks. Therein, however, also lies their vulnerability to attacks which embed malicious instructions in text, common variants of which are known as indirect prompt injection (IPI). A fundamental task in addressing this vulnerability is successful segmentation of a given text into benign and malicious sentences (if any). While a number of approaches for this task have been proposed, no detector combines query-relative detection at the segment level, and none are hardened against adaptive evasion attacks realizable in agentic executions. We address the former limitation by developing an approach for malicious sentence classification that is both context- and query-aware. Next, to harden the resulting classifier against evasion, we present two adversarial training methods. The first is directly adapted feature-space adversarial training (AT) in which evasions are approximated using projected-gradient-based optimization in the embedding space. The second simulates realizable evasion attacks in the AT loop through LLM-based paraphrasing. Crucially, we parametrize both AT variants to facilitate a smooth tradeoff between utility and attack robustness. In extensive experiments using indirect prompt injection benchmarks we show that the proposed approach outperforms state-of-the-art IPI defense baselines under static attacks, while in the case of adaptive attacks, our AT variants provide significantly higher utility, lower attack success rate, and often both. Finally, we show that the best AT parameters can depend intimately on the particular application domain. Consequently, domain-dependent tuning of malicious text detectors is likely necessary in practice. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/tavia-liu/CAD.

Motivation: 现有恶意指令检测器缺乏在段级别进行查询相关（query-relative）检测的能力，且没有针对智能体执行场景中可实现的自适应规避攻击进行加固，从而在真实部署中易被绕过。
Method: 提出上下文与查询感知的恶意句子分类方法；随后给出两种对抗训练（adversarial training, AT）方法：一种在嵌入空间使用基于投影梯度的优化近似规避攻击，另一种在AT循环中通过LLM改写模拟可实现规避攻击，并对两种变体进行参数化以平滑调节效用与鲁棒性之间的权衡。
Result: 在间接提示注入基准的静态攻击下，该方法优于现有SOTA防御基线；在自适应攻击下，AT变体通常显著提高效用、降低攻击成功率，且往往两者兼得。摘要还指出最佳AT参数高度依赖具体应用领域。
Conclusion: 摘要强调恶意文本检测器在实践中很可能需要按应用领域进行参数调优；代码已在GitHub公开。

papers.title: Invisible Shortcuts: Why Vision Encoders Know Your Camera
papers.abstract_en: Deep vision models exploit shortcuts, relying on cues that correlate with supervision signals. Prior work has focused on visible biases, such as object-background or texture correlations. We identify a different source of shortcut learning: invisible metadata traces embedded at the pixel level, for metadata such as image processing and photo acquisition. We hypothesize that large-scale semantic supervision, whether through categorical labels (ImageNet) or billion-scale captions (LAION), naturally induces metadata-semantics correlations during pretraining, leading models to convert low-level signals into predictive features. By introducing controlled metadata-semantics correlations, we show that stronger ones produce systematically higher sensitivity to metadata traces and larger performance degradation under metadata distribution shifts. We further explore mitigation strategies applied during and after pretraining that reduce sensitivity not only to targeted metadata but also to unseen ones, without sacrificing performance on downstream tasks. Metadata sensitivity also has a positive side: it partly explains the strong generated-image detection ability of some encoders, while its mitigation can improve out-of-distribution generalization. Code: https://github.com/ryan-caesar-ramos/visual-encoder-traces
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种此前未被关注的捷径学习来源：嵌入在像素层面的不可见元数据痕迹（如图像处理和采集信息）。作者假设大规模语义预训练（如 ImageNet 分类标签或 LAION 的十亿级图文对）会自然诱导元数据与语义之间的相关性，使模型把低层信号转化为预测特征。通过人为控制元数据-语义相关性，他们证明更强的相关性会导致模型对元数据痕迹更敏感，并在元数据分布偏移下出现更大的性能下降；还探索了预训练期间和之后的缓解策略，并指出元数据敏感性部分解释了部分编码器对生成图像较强的检测能力。
Motivation: 以往工作主要关注可见的偏差，如物体-背景或纹理相关性，而忽略了隐藏在像素级元数据痕迹中的捷径。该问题值得关注，因为大规模语义监督会无意中让模型依赖这些不可见的采集和处理信息，导致在元数据分布变化时泛化能力受损。
Method: 通过引入受控的元数据-语义相关性来检验假设，并测试预训练期间及之后的多种缓解策略，观察其对目标元数据以及未见元数据敏感性的影响，同时评估下游任务表现和生成图像检测能力。
Result: 更强的元数据-语义相关性带来系统性更高的元数据敏感性和更大的分布偏移性能退化；缓解策略能在不牺牲下游任务表现的前提下降低对目标及未见元数据的敏感性，并改善分布外泛化能力，且能部分解释编码器的生成图像检测能力。
Conclusion: 不可见元数据痕迹是一类独立的捷径学习来源，可以通过针对性缓解来处理；对元数据敏感性的抑制不仅改善分布外泛化，还与生成图像检测能力存在正向关联。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Why the Third Axis Is Freedom
papers.abstract_en: In generative training, a model produces an output and is penalised for its difference from an example. With one output per comparison, a model that produces one common answer can outperform a model retaining a broader repertoire. Explorative Modeling (XM) produces $K$ outputs per comparison and updates on the closest, claiming exploration as a "third pretraining axis" associated with generative expressivity. Here I show the third axis is actually freedom, meaning the weakness of the constraint implied by a model's behaviour. Previous work showed freedom is a property of function rather than form. Parameters, architecture, minimum-description-length (MDL), and data can vary while the behavioural constraint remains unchanged. It was formally proved that weakest models are likeliest to generalise, and freedom selection beat MDL by 110-500\% in induction experiments. I prove average XM loss depends on the chance a candidate misses an acceptable region, with exploration raising miss probability to power $K$. For $K>1$, match probability rises with freedom. I then demonstrate empirically that XM optimises for freedom. In a Forward XM experiment, larger $K$ increased or saturated measured freedom, and increased freedom at every tested value under context-dependent targets. I trained XM candidate pools and compared validation selection with a freedom selector that read unlabelled parent contexts. Freedom won in 29 of 30 cases. Generative expressivity is a mode-count proxy for freedom, that discards the extension structure that gives freedom its generalisation significance. XM is a means, freedom an end, and selecting for freedom improved XM under distribution shift.
papers.comment: Experiment code available on GitHub, in the papers folder: https://github.com/ViscousLemming/Technical-Appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生成式训练中所谓“第三预训练轴”探索（exploration）的本质是自由（freedom），即模型行为所隐含约束的弱程度。作者证明 Explorative Modeling (XM) 的平均损失取决于候选错过可接受区域的概率，K 个输出将该概率提升到 K 次幂；Forward XM 实验显示增大 K 会提高或饱和实测自由，且自由选择器在 29/30 个案例中优于验证集选择。作者认为生成表达能力只是自由的模式计数代理，选择自由可在分布偏移下改进 XM。
Motivation: 标准生成训练每次比较只产生一个输出，导致保留单一常见答案的模型可能胜过保留更丰富行为库的模型；XM 提出探索作为第三条预训练轴，但本文指出该轴的本质是自由，需要将其与模型形式、参数和数据规模区分开。
Method: 从理论上刻画 XM 损失与候选错过可接受区域概率的关系，证明 K 个候选下的匹配概率随自由上升；并通过 Forward XM 实验测量不同 K 值与上下文相关目标下的自由，同时训练候选池，比较基于未标注父上下文的自由选择器与验证集选择。
Result: 实验表明更大的 K 会增加或饱和实测自由，并在所有测试的上下文相关目标值下提升自由；自由选择器在 29/30 个案例中胜过验证选择。摘要还援引此前工作：自由选择在归纳实验中比 MDL 提升 110-500%。
Conclusion: 作者主张自由是目标、XM 是手段；生成表达能力作为模式计数代理丢弃了自由泛化意义所依赖的外延结构，而在分布偏移下按自由选择可以改善 XM。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: IFlowNets: Extending Generative Samplers to Learn Strategies in Incomplete Information Games
papers.abstract_en: While many algorithms blend reinforcement learning (RL) with counterfactual regret (CFR) methods to leverage tradeoffs in computational speed and performance, there are fewer investigations into generative sampling frameworks in game theoretic applications in incomplete information games. We extend a generative flow network framework, Adversarial Flow Networks (AFlowNets), to incomplete information games, called Information Flow Networks (IFNs). We prove that previously established constraints for generative flow networks in complete information games are inadmissible for obtaining valid densities (corresponding to player strategies) and a valid training objective. We show that our proposed generalization, IFlowNets, alleviates this issue and strictly generalizes AFlowNets. In preliminary results for three standard game environments, IFlowNets perform comparably to or better than Outcome Sampling Monte Carlo Counterfactual Regret (OSMCCFR) and standard RL-based methods in performance and speed.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Dynamics at the Frontiers of Optimization, Sampling, and Games
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将生成流网络 (generative flow network) 框架 Adversarial Flow Networks (AFlowNets) 扩展到不完全信息博弈，称为 Information Flow Networks (IFNs)。作者证明完整信息博弈中已有的生成流网络约束在此时无法得到合法的策略密度和训练目标，并提出严格泛化 AFlowNets 的 IFlowNets 来解决该问题。初步实验显示 IFlowNets 在三个标准博弈环境中性能与速度与 Outcome Sampling Monte Carlo Counterfactual Regret (OSMCCFR) 及标准 RL 方法相当或更好。
Motivation: 现有的博弈求解方法多将强化学习 (RL) 与反事实遗憾 (CFR) 方法结合以权衡计算速度与性能，但对生成式采样框架在不完全信息博弈中的应用研究较少；同时已有生成流网络约束在此时不再适用，需要新的推广。
Method: 作者将 AFlowNets 扩展到不完全信息博弈，引入 Information Flow Networks (IFNs)；证明原有约束无法产生对应玩家策略的合法密度，并给出新的约束与训练目标，使 IFlowNets 成为 AFlowNets 的严格泛化。
Result: 初步结果显示，在三个标准博弈环境中，IFlowNets 在性能和速度上与 OSMCCFR 以及标准 RL 方法相当或更优。
Conclusion: IFlowNets 通过修正不可行的密度约束，为不完全信息博弈中的生成式采样提供了一种有效的策略学习方法，并严格覆盖了 AFlowNets 作为特例。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Can Open-Weight LLMs Produce Kernel-Verified Coq Proofs? A Pilot Study
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can generate text that resembles a mathematical proof, but resemblance does not establish correctness. A formal proof checker verifies whether each proof step follows established logical rules. Coq bases its rules on the Calculus of Inductive Constructions, a logical framework that defines which proof steps the system may accept. This pilot study evaluated six open-weight LLMs on the same 100 theorems from CoqStoq, a benchmark derived from real Coq projects. Each LLM received one attempt per theorem with the temperature set to 0, and Coq checked every proposed proof in the theorem's original project environment. We counted a proof as successful only if the Coq kernel accepted it. Gemma 4 verified 12 of 100 theorems, Llama 3.3 verified 8, and DeepSeek Coder V2 Lite verified 1. Qwen 3.5, Mistral Small 3.1, and GPT-OSS verified none. The 21 successful model-theorem results covered 15 distinct theorems, 11 of which were not solved by a baseline of standard Coq tactics. All verified theorems had short or medium human-written reference proofs; no model verified a theorem with a long reference proof. Because the proof-length analysis was exploratory, this pattern does not establish that proof length caused the difference. For the three models with at least one success, the total generation cost per verified proof ranged from 741 to 36,193 output tokens, 14.9 to 178.0 seconds, and 0.0167 to 0.2000 aggregate GPU hours. We could not calculate these ratios for models with no verified proofs. Across 600 attempts, the models produced 21 kernel-verified proofs, giving an overall success rate of 3.5%. The study reports descriptive differences among the models but does not statistically test whether one model outperforms another. Therefore, the results do not establish a universal ranking of the six models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一项关于开放权重大型语言模型能否生成通过 Coq 内核验证的证明的试点研究。作者在 CoqStoq 基准的 100 个定理上评估了六个开放权重模型，每个定理只给一次生成机会且温度为 0，并仅在 Coq 内核接受时才计为成功。结果显示 Gemma 4 验证了 12 个定理，Llama 3.3 验证了 8 个，DeepSeek Coder V2 Lite 验证了 1 个，其余三个模型均未成功；600 次尝试中共有 21 个内核验证的证明，总体成功率为 3.5%。研究仅报告描述性差异，未进行统计检验。
Motivation: LLM 生成的数学证明可能看起来合理，但外观并不等于正确性；形式化证明检查器能够验证每一步是否符合逻辑规则。Coq 基于归纳构造演算 (Calculus of Inductive Constructions) 定义可接受的证明步骤。作者希望探索开放权重模型能否在真实项目环境中产出被内核接受的证明。
Method: 在同一批来自 CoqStoq 的 100 个定理上评估六个开放权重 LLM，每个模型每个定理尝试一次，温度设为 0，并在定理原始项目环境下由 Coq 检查所有提议的证明。只有 Coq 内核接受的证明才被计为成功；还统计了生成成本，包括输出 token 数、时间和聚合 GPU 小时。
Result: Gemma 4 验证 12 个定理，Llama 3.3 验证 8 个，DeepSeek Coder V2 Lite 验证 1 个，Qwen 3.5、Mistral Small 3.1 和 GPT-OSS 均未验证任何定理。21 个成功的模型-定理结果覆盖 15 个不同定理，其中 11 个未被标准 Coq 战术 (standard Coq tactics) 基线解决；没有模型验证带有长参考证明的定理。对三个有成功结果的模型，每个已验证证明的总生成成本为 741 至 36,193 个输出 token、14.9 至 178.0 秒和 0.0167 至 0.2000 聚合 GPU 小时。总体成功率为 3.5%。

papers.title: Perturbation Sensitivity at Convergence: A Simple Signal for Identifying Spuriously Correlated Samples
papers.abstract_en: Models trained by empirical risk minimization on data containing spurious correlations achieve high average accuracy while failing on subpopulations where the correlation does not hold. Existing methods for identifying the affected samples without group annotations rely on signals from early training, which requires locating the epoch at which to intervene, a hyperparameter typically selected using group-labeled validation data. We show that a usable signal is available after convergence, when loss no longer distinguishes the two populations. Samples consistent with the spurious correlation are classified by a shared rule, while the remaining samples are fit through configurations specific to individual inputs and are correspondingly more fragile. Applying a fixed perturbation to a converged model's inputs flips the predictions of the latter far more often than the former. The resulting procedure requires two forward passes per training sample, no group annotations at any stage, and no early-stopping epoch. Using the detected samples to rebalance training raises worst-group accuracy on Waterbirds from 57.3% to 80.8%, against 85.8% with ground-truth group labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在模型收敛后识别虚假相关（spurious correlation）样本的简单信号：对收敛模型的输入施加固定扰动，与虚假相关一致的样本因由共享规则分类而更稳定，其余样本因拟合了输入特定的配置而更容易发生预测翻转。该方法只需每个训练样本两次前向传播，全程无需群体标注，也无需选择早停轮次。用检测出的样本重平衡训练，可将 Waterbirds 上的最差群体准确率从 57.3% 提升到 80.8%，而使用真实群体标签时为 85.8%。
Motivation: 在经验风险最小化下，包含虚假相关的数据会让模型平均准确率很高但在相关不成立的子群体上失效。现有无需群体标注的识别方法依赖训练早期信号，需要定位干预轮次，这一超参数通常要靠带群体标签的验证集来选择。
Method: 利用收敛后损失不再区分两类人群这一阶段：对收敛模型的输入施加固定扰动，统计预测翻转频率，将更容易翻转的样本判定为与虚假相关不一致的脆弱样本，并用这些检测到的样本重新平衡训练。
Result: 摘要报告在 Waterbirds 基准上，最差群体准确率从 57.3% 提升到 80.8%，而使用真实群体标签的上限为 85.8%。
Conclusion: 该流程只需要每个训练样本两次前向传播，不要求任何阶段的群体标注，也不需要早停轮次，即可在无标注条件下改善群体鲁棒性。

papers.title: Negotiating Risk Boundaries in AI for Policing Through Mixed-Stakeholder Deliberation
papers.abstract_en: AI tools are being increasingly adopted in policing in the UK and worldwide. Racial bias is a known and well-documented risk, yet representatives of affected communities are rarely included in decisions about AI adoption. We present results from a mixed-stakeholder deliberation workshop bringing together 30 community representatives, police officers, and academics to assess the risks of 13 AI use cases in policing, with an explicit focus on racial bias. We found that participants were broadly open to AI adoption, rejecting only three use cases outright, most notably recidivism risk assessment, where objections targeted the premise rather than the implementation. Our analysis reveals that foregrounding racial equity did not narrow the deliberation. Instead, discussions gravitated toward a fundamental set of questions: does this tool actually work, will it deliver genuine benefit, and will that benefit extend to everyone? This integrated reasoning, reminiscent of the curb-cut effect in inclusive design, highlights the benefit of incorporating the racial bias lens into the risk-benefit analysis of AI use cases from the outset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一场混合利益相关者审议工作坊的结果，参与者包括30名社区代表、警察和学者，共同评估13个警务AI用例的风险，并明确聚焦种族偏见。研究发现参与者总体对AI采纳持开放态度，仅彻底否决三个用例，最显著的是再犯风险评估，且反对意见针对的是其前提而非实施方式。分析显示，将种族公平置于前景并未收窄讨论，讨论反而转向一组根本性问题：该工具是否真正有效、能否带来真实收益、收益是否惠及所有人。
Motivation: AI工具在英国及全球警务中日益普及，种族偏见是已知且有充分记录的风险，但受影响社区的代表很少参与AI采纳决策。本文针对这一参与缺口，通过纳入社区代表来评估警务AI风险。
Method: 采用混合利益相关者审议工作坊方法，召集30名社区代表、警察和学者，对13个警务AI用例进行风险评估，并明确以种族偏见为讨论焦点。
Result: 参与者对AI采纳总体开放，仅彻底拒绝三个用例，最突出的是再犯风险评估，其中反对意见指向前提而非实施细节。将种族公平前置并未收窄讨论，讨论聚焦于工具是否有效、能否带来真实收益以及收益是否惠及所有人等根本问题。
Conclusion: 作者强调，从初始阶段就将种族偏见视角纳入AI用例的风险-收益分析是有益的，这种整合推理类似于包容性设计中的路缘坡效应（curb-cut effect）。

papers.title: Spectral Distillation: From Nonlinear Dynamics to Linear State-Space Models
papers.abstract_en: Can nonlinear dynamical systems be learned through a compact linear state-space representation, without directly solving a non-convex system-identification problem? We give a provable pipeline for doing so. Starting from observations of an unknown nonlinear dynamical system, we first learn an implicit spectral predictor using Observation Spectral Filtering (OSF), a convex method that competes with the best linear observer for the system. We then apply spectral-to-LDS distillation to convert this predictor into an explicit recurrent linear dynamical system. Our main theorem shows that the average prediction error of the distilled LDS decomposes into an exponentially-small distillation term and the OSF learning term governed by the Luenberger complexity of the best observer. The guarantee is dimension-free: it depends on observer complexity rather than on the latent dimension needed to represent the nonlinear system. To our knowledge, this yields the first end-to-end provable method for extracting a best-in-hindsight LDS representation of nonlinear dynamics through convex learning followed by provable distillation. Experiments on linear LDS benchmarks and MuJoCo behavior cloning show that the train-then-distill pipeline produces compact LDS predictors that match or outperform directly trained baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可证明的端到端流程：从未知非线性动力学系统的观测出发，先用观测谱滤波（OSF）这一凸方法学习隐式谱预测器，再通过谱到LDS蒸馏将其转化为显式的循环线性状态空间模型。主定理表明，蒸馏后LDS的平均预测误差分解为指数小的蒸馏项与由最优观测器Luenberger复杂度控制的OSF学习项，且保证与表示非线性系统所需的潜在维度无关。实验在LDS基准和MuJoCo行为克隆上显示该流程产生的紧凑LDS预测器匹配或优于直接训练的基线。
Motivation: 直接求解非线性系统辨识问题通常是非凸且困难的；论文希望回答能否通过紧凑的线性状态空间表示学习非线性动力学，而无需直接求解非凸问题。
Method: 采用两步流程：首先用观察光谱滤波（OSF）学习一个与系统最优线性观测器竞争的隐式谱预测器，然后对该预测器施加谱到LDS蒸馏，将其转换为显式循环线性动力学系统，从而通过凸学习加可证明蒸馏完成提取。
Result: 主定理将蒸馏LDS的平均预测误差界定为指数小的蒸馏项与OSF学习项之和，后者由最优观测器的Luenberger复杂度决定；实验在LDS基准和MuJoCo行为克隆任务上验证，紧凑LDS预测器匹配或超过直接训练的基线。
Conclusion: 作者称这是第一个可证明的、通过凸学习与蒸馏从非线性动力学中提取最优事后LDS表示的端到端方法；摘要未提及方法的具体局限性。

papers.title: Evaluating and Improving Pedagogical Fit in LLM-Based AI Tutors with the Pedagogical Suitability Index
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as AI tutors, but a correct answer is not always a pedagogically appropriate one. In classroom learning, effective help depends not only on correctness, but also on whether a response matches the learner's current foundation, the course sequence, and the timing of concept introduction. Existing evaluations focus mainly on answer quality, leaving this instructional fit under-measured. We present the Pedagogical Suitability Index (PSI), a composite metric of six theory-informed sub-scores that evaluates how well LLM-generated tutoring responses align with learner readiness and curricular progression, and we further use PSI as a structured feedback signal for response improvement. We evaluate four LLM tutors (ChatGPT, Gemini, Gemma4, and Qwen3) across 240 scenario-based evaluations using paired standard and defective prompts, then apply a PSI-guided regeneration protocol to 62 weak-performing cases. Baseline differences across the four tested models were modest overall (PSI range: 0.557 to 0.638), and open-weight and closed models did not exhibit a clear separation in pedagogical fit. Under the tested prompt perturbations, overall PSI remained largely stable (Delta = -0.002), though sub-score trade-offs emerged. More importantly, PSI-guided feedback substantially improved weak-performing cases: 51 of 62 cases improved (82.3%). Focused manual evaluation of the 62 PSI-selected weak cases provides initial evidence that the identified weaknesses are instructionally meaningful and that many PSI-guided regenerations correspond to human-judged improvement. These results suggest that learner- and curriculum-aware alignment may matter more for effective tutoring than model category alone, and that such alignment is both measurable and improvable.
papers.comment: This paper has already been accepted and presented at the IEEE 27th International Conference on Information Reuse and Integration for Data Science (IRI 2026) from July 31 to August 2, 2026, in Seattle, WA, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出教学适用性指数 (Pedagogical Suitability Index, PSI)，一个由六个理论驱动的子分数构成的复合指标，用于评估 LLM 生成的辅导回应是否与学习者的当前基础、课程顺序和概念引入时机相匹配。作者用 PSI 作为结构化反馈信号来改进回应质量，并评测了 ChatGPT、Gemini、Gemma4 和 Qwen3 四种 LLM 导师在 240 个场景化评估中的表现，随后对 62 个弱表现案例应用 PSI 引导的重生成协议，其中 51 个案例得到改善 (82.3%)。结果显示模型类别本身（开源 vs. 闭源）与教学适配度无明显分离，而学习者与课程感知的对齐更值得关注。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 导师评估主要关注答案正确性，但正确答案并不一定是教学上合适的回应；回应是否匹配学习者当前基础、课程顺序和概念引入时机这一教学适配度（instructional fit）长期缺乏度量。
Method: 提出 PSI 复合指标，由六个基于教学理论的子分数组成，用于量化 LLM 辅导回应与学习者准备度和课程进度的对齐，并将 PSI 作为结构化反馈信号驱动回应重生成（PSI-guided regeneration protocol）。
Result: 四种 LLM 导师 (ChatGPT, Gemini, Gemma4, Qwen3) 在 240 个场景化评估中的基线 PSI 范围为 0.557 至 0.638，模型间差异不大；在 prompt 扰动下整体 PSI 基本稳定 (Delta = -0.002)，但出现子分数权衡；PSI 引导反馈使 62 个弱案例中 51 个得到改善 (82.3%)，人工评估初步支持所识别的弱点在教学上具有意义。
Conclusion: 摘要认为对学习者和课程感知的对齐（learner- and curriculum-aware alignment）对有效辅导的影响可能比模型类别更大，而且这种对齐既可以被测量也可以被改进；作者强调结果是初始证据，聚焦于 PSI 选出的 62 个弱案例。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出教学适用性指数 (Pedagogical Suitability Index, PSI)，一个由六个理论驱动的子分数构成的复合指标，用于评估 LLM 生成的辅导回应是否与学习者的当前基础、课程顺序和概念引入时机相匹配。作者用 PSI 作为结构化反馈信号来改进回应质量，并评测了 ChatGPT、Gemini、Gemma4 和 Qwen3 四种 LLM 导师在 240 个场景化评估中的表现，随后对 62 个弱表现案例应用 PSI 引导的重生成协议，其中 51 个案例得到改善 (82.3%)。结果显示模型类别本身（开源 vs. 闭源）与教学适配度无明显分离，而学习者与课程感知的对齐更值得关注。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 LLM 导师评估主要关注答案正确性，但正确答案并不一定是教学上合适的回应；回应是否匹配学习者当前基础、课程顺序和概念引入时机这一教学适配度（instructional fit）长期缺乏度量。
summary_sections.method: 提出 PSI 复合指标，由六个基于教学理论的子分数组成，用于量化 LLM 辅导回应与学习者准备度和课程进度的对齐，并将 PSI 作为结构化反馈信号驱动回应重生成（PSI-guided regeneration protocol）。
summary_sections.result: 四种 LLM 导师 (ChatGPT, Gemini, Gemma4, Qwen3) 在 240 个场景化评估中的基线 PSI 范围为 0.557 至 0.638，模型间差异不大；在 prompt 扰动下整体 PSI 基本稳定 (Delta = -0.002)，但出现子分数权衡；PSI 引导反馈使 62 个弱案例中 51 个得到改善 (82.3%)，人工评估初步支持所识别的弱点在教学上具有意义。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为对学习者和课程感知的对齐（learner- and curriculum-aware alignment）对有效辅导的影响可能比模型类别更大，而且这种对齐既可以被测量也可以被改进；作者强调结果是初始证据，聚焦于 PSI 选出的 62 个弱案例。

papers.title: Adapting Vision Foundation Models with Cascaded Semantics
papers.abstract_en: Prompt tuning, a leading parameter-efficient adaptation paradigm in NLP, has recently been extended to computer vision. Visual prompt tuning (VPT) adapts pre-trained vision transformers (ViTs) by updating a small set of additional prompt parameters. However, existing visual prompts are randomly initialized and do not exploit prior knowledge, such as instructions in NLP. We address this gap by injecting two complementary semantic priors into VPT. Fundamental image priors, including color, texture, and shape, are extracted with classical hand-crafted operators and injected into the input space, while self-attention maps provide instance-aware semantics in the feature space. We further propose a cascaded scheme that integrates both priors throughout ViT adaptation. Experiments on 34 challenging image classification datasets demonstrate superior downstream adaptation while tuning only 0.74% of ViT parameters. Project page: https://xixiaouab.github.io/Cascaded-Semantics/.
papers.comment: Accepted by Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. Project page: https://xixiaouab.github.io/Cascaded-Semantics/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉提示微调 (visual prompt tuning, VPT) 中提示随机初始化、未利用先验知识的问题，提出级联语义注入方案：用经典手工算子提取颜色、纹理、形状等基础图像先验注入输入空间，同时利用自注意力图提供实例感知的语义特征先验，并通过级联机制在整个 ViT 适配过程中整合两类先验。摘要报告在 34 个图像分类数据集上取得更优的下游适配效果，且仅微调 0.74% 的 ViT 参数。
Motivation: NLP 中的提示微调往往利用指令等先验知识，而现有视觉提示是随机初始化且不利用任何先验；作者旨在弥补这一差距，将互补的语义先验注入视觉提示微调。
Method: 提出两类互补的语义先验：一是通过经典手工算子提取颜色、纹理、形状等基础图像先验并注入输入空间；二是利用自注意力图在特征空间提供实例感知语义；进一步设计级联方案，在 ViT 适配过程中整合两种先验。
Result: 在 34 个具有挑战性的图像分类数据集上，该方法实现了更优的下游适配性能，同时仅微调 0.74% 的 ViT 参数。
Conclusion: 摘要强调向 VPT 注入互补语义先验可以提升 ViT 的下游适配效果；其适用范围为图像分类与视觉 Transformer 参数高效微调。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Adaptive Arena-based Contestable Argumentative Network-of-Experts for Open-Ended Care Plan Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Care plan coordination demands synthesizing heterogeneous clinical, functional, and psychosocial information across multiple professional disciplines, where monolithic LLM pipelines cannot perform in a transparent or safe manner. We present CANOE (Contestable Argumentative Network-of-Experts), a multi-agent neuro-symbolic framework that addresses these limitations through five modules: complexity assessment, adaptive team recruitment, role-based argumentative computation via an Arena-based Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Framework (A-QBAF), human-in-the-loop contestation, and care-plan synthesis. Role-specialized agents generate supporting and attacking arguments for candidate interventions; conflicts are resolved through arena-based clash resolution before acceptability scores propagate across the argumentation graph. Care planners may accept, reject, edit, or add arguments, and the framework will deterministically recompute the final plan. Evaluation on Discharge Me! and MedicalRAG using ROUGE-L, AlignScore, MEDCON F1, FKGL, and LLM-as-a-judge shows that medically fine-tuned models achieve the strongest clinical correctness and safety, while CANOE's argumentative structure provides faithful explanation and human contestability.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 4th International Conference on Frontiers of Artificial Intelligence, Ethics, and Multidisciplinary Applications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CANOE（Contestable Argumentative Network-of-Experts），一个用于开放结局护理计划协调的多智能体神经符号框架，包含复杂度评估、自适应团队招募、基于 Arena 的量化双极论证框架（A-QBAF）的角色论证计算、人在回路质疑和护理计划综合五个模块。角色专用智能体生成支持与反对论点，冲突经 arena 式交锋解决后，可接受性分数在论证图中传播；护理规划者可接受、拒绝、编辑或添加论点，框架会确定性地重新计算最终计划。在 Discharge Me! 和 MedicalRAG 上的评估使用 ROUGE-L、AlignScore、MEDCON F1、FKGL 和 LLM-as-a-judge，显示医学微调模型在临床正确性和安全性上最强，而 CANOE 的论证结构提供忠实解释和人类可质疑性。
Motivation: 护理计划协调需要综合跨多个专业学科的异质临床、功能和心理社会信息，而单体 LLM 流水线无法以透明或安全的方式完成此类任务。
Method: 提出多智能体神经符号框架 CANOE，通过五个模块实现：复杂度评估、自适应团队招募、基于 Arena-based Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Framework (A-QBAF) 的角色论证计算、人在回路质疑以及护理计划综合；角色专用智能体生成支持和攻击性论点，冲突经 arena 式交锋解决后，可接受性分数在论证图中传播。
Result: 在 Discharge Me! 和 MedicalRAG 上使用 ROUGE-L、AlignScore、MEDCON F1、FKGL 和 LLM-as-a-judge 评估，医学微调模型取得最强的临床正确性和安全性，CANOE 的论证结构提供忠实解释和人类可质疑性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CANOE 通过论证结构实现忠实解释和人类可质疑性，为开放结局护理计划协调提供更安全透明的多智能体方案。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Text-Guided Refinement of Multi-sequence Glioma Subregion Segmentation with a Vision-Language Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Background: Accurate glioma subregion delineation is important for radiotherapy planning and longitudinal monitoring, but manual contour correction is time-consuming. Models such as nnU-Net may generalize imperfectly and lack clinician-directed text correction. Purpose: We investigated adapting a three-dimensional (3D) vision-language foundation model for text-guided brain tumor segmentation refinement. Methods: We developed a lightweight VoxTell-based framework. Pretrained VoxTell generated initial masks. Oracle prompts derived from segmentation errors encoded target, action, location, imaging evidence, edit size, and preservation constraints. Frozen Qwen/VoxTell prompt embeddings were injected through trainable projections into its multiscale decoder conditioning; other weights remained frozen. Training, validation, and testing used 901, 100, and 250 BraTS-GLI cases. Cross-dataset transfer was evaluated on 100 meningioma, metastasis, pediatric tumor, and UPENN-GBM cases. Results: On the internal test set using post-contrast T1-weighted input, correct instructions improved subregion Dice similarity coefficient (DSC; enhancing tumor, edema, and necrotic/non-enhancing core) from $0.774\pm0.158$ to $0.796\pm0.137$. They outperformed blank prompts ($0.762\pm0.155$; Holm-adjusted $p<0.001$, $d_z=0.71$) and contradictory prompts ($0.770\pm0.163$; $p<0.001$, $d_z=0.48$). In cross-dataset testing, correct instructions improved DSC from $0.527\pm0.287$ to $0.550\pm0.278$ and outperformed contradictory instructions ($0.504\pm0.275$; $p<0.001$, $d_z=0.43$). Conclusion: A 3D vision-language foundation model can perform instruction-guided refinement of glioma subregion segmentations. Sensitivity to correct, blank, and contradictory prompts suggests text-dependent contour editing rather than nonspecific post-processing, supporting further evaluation as a clinician-in-the-loop tool.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将三维医学影像分割的视觉-语言基础模型 VoxTell 用于胶质瘤亚区分割的文本引导细化。摘要报告，在内部测试集上使用对比增强 T1 输入时，正确指令可将亚区 Dice 相似系数从 0.774±0.158 提升至 0.796±0.137，且显著优于空白提示与矛盾提示；跨数据集测试同样显示正确指令带来增益。作者由此认为模型真正依赖文本指令进行轮廓编辑，而非无差别后处理。
Motivation: 胶质瘤亚区精确勾画对放疗计划和纵向监测很重要，但人工轮廓修正耗时；nnU-Net 等模型泛化性欠佳，且缺乏临床医生可用的文本修正接口。目标在于探索 3D 视觉-语言基础模型能否用于指令引导的脑肿瘤分割细化。
Method: 提出轻量级 VoxTell 框架：预训练 VoxTell 生成初始掩码，由分割误差派生的 Oracle 提示编码目标、动作、位置、影像证据、编辑尺寸与保留约束；冻结的 Qwen/VoxTell 提示嵌入经可训练投影注入多尺度解码器条件，其余权重保持冻结。训练、验证、测试分别使用 901、100、250 例 BraTS-GLI，跨数据集迁移用 100 例脑膜瘤、转移瘤、儿童肿瘤及 UPENN-GBM。
Result: 内部测试集上，正确指令将亚区 DSC 从 0.774±0.158 提升到 0.796±0.137，优于空白提示（0.762±0.155；Holm 校正 p<0.001，d_z=0.71）和矛盾提示（0.770±0.163；p<0.001，d_z=0.48）。跨数据集测试中，正确指令使 DSC 从 0.527±0.287 提升到 0.550±0.278，并优于矛盾指令（0.504±0.275；p<0.001，d_z=0.43）。
Conclusion: 3D 视觉-语言基础模型能够执行指令引导的胶质瘤亚区分割细化；对正确、空白与矛盾提示表现出的敏感性说明其效果来自文本依赖的轮廓编辑，而非非特异性后处理，值得进一步作为临床在环（clinician-in-the-loop）工具评估。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: C$^3$PO: Evaluating Cross-Modal Composition and Counterfactual Performance in Omnimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can process diverse sensory inputs, yet their reasoning remains heavily biased toward a dominant modality, resulting in brittle cross-modal reasoning. We introduce C$^3$PO, a benchmark of 3,404 samples spanning video, audio, image, and text, evaluating two abilities: information composition (fusing dispersed evidence) and counterfactual conflict (resolving deliberate contradictions). C$^3$PO's paired IC/CC structure and four-tier design enable targeted diagnosis of when and why cross-modal reasoning fails. Built through a fully automatic pipeline using 25 logically grounded templates, C$^3$PO reveals that while humans achieve 88.64% accuracy, the best model (Gemini-3.1-Pro) reaches only 73.17%, with open-source models collapsing under conflict. Through attention probes, we find 86-95% of failures stem from modality dominance: models commit to one modality while ignoring contradictory evidence, concentrating 87-95% of attention on text. Mid-layer attention entropy predicts correctness-sustained exploration succeeds, premature collapse fails. The 56-point accuracy gap between equally complex templates reveals that performance depends on modalities' structural roles in conflict resolution, not combinations. These findings show multimodal perception does not guarantee robust reasoning; architectures must enable sustained cross-modal attention to avoid premature
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 C³PO 基准，包含 3,404 个覆盖视频、音频、图像和文本的样本，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的信息组合（information composition）与反事实冲突（counterfactual conflict）能力。基准采用配对的 IC/CC 结构和四层设计，并通过 25 个逻辑模板的全自动管道构建。结果显示人类准确率为 88.64%，最佳模型 Gemini-3.1-Pro 仅达 73.17%，开源模型在冲突场景下崩溃；注意力探针发现 86-95% 的失败源于模态主导（modality dominance），注意力集中度 87-95% 落在文本上，且中层注意力熵能预测正确性。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 虽能处理多种感官输入，但推理仍高度偏向主导模态，导致跨模态推理脆弱；目前缺乏系统性诊断这种失败何时发生以及为何发生的基准。
Method: 引入 C³PO 基准，通过 25 个逻辑模板的自动管道生成 3,404 个样本，并设计配对的 IC/CC 结构与四层诊断体系；同时使用注意力探针分析失败机制。
Result: 人类准确率 88.64%，最佳模型 Gemini-3.1-Pro 准确率 73.17%；86-95% 的失败源于模态主导，模型将 87-95% 的注意力集中于文本；中层注意力熵可预测正确性，持续探索可成功而过早收敛则失败；复杂度相同的模板间存在 56 个百分点的准确率差距，取决于模态在冲突解决中的结构角色而非组合方式。
Conclusion: 多模态感知并不能保证鲁棒推理；架构需要维持持续的跨模态注意力以避免过早崩溃。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 引入 C³PO 基准，通过 25 个逻辑模板的自动管道生成 3,404 个样本，并设计配对的 IC/CC 结构与四层诊断体系；同时使用注意力探针分析失败机制。
summary_sections.result: 人类准确率 88.64%，最佳模型 Gemini-3.1-Pro 准确率 73.17%；86-95% 的失败源于模态主导，模型将 87-95% 的注意力集中于文本；中层注意力熵可预测正确性，持续探索可成功而过早收敛则失败；复杂度相同的模板间存在 56 个百分点的准确率差距，取决于模态在冲突解决中的结构角色而非组合方式。
summary_sections.conclusion: 多模态感知并不能保证鲁棒推理；架构需要维持持续的跨模态注意力以避免过早崩溃。

papers.title: DoctorAgents: an agentic framework to iteratively refine AutoML pipeline for small clinical temporal data
papers.abstract_en: Clinical machine learning (ML) has the potential to support high-stakes medical decision-making, but reliable deployment is often constrained by scarce, heterogeneous, and temporal complexity. Developing effective ML pipelines for such data remains time-consuming and error-prone, while existing automated machine learning (AutoML) systems only partially address this challenge because they largely rely on brute-force search over predefined spaces and lack explicit reasoning and memory. We therefore reformulate AutoML for small clinical data from exhaustive search to reasoning-driven refinement. We propose DoctorAgents, an agentic AI framework that autonomously constructs and optimizes end-to-end ML pipelines through specialized large language model (LLM) agents for generation, validation, and refinement. DoctorAgents backpropagates natural-language feedback through textual gradient descent to perform targeted updates without exhaustive search. Experiments across diverse clinical tasks show that DoctorAgents consistently outperforms established AutoML baselines while producing more interpretable task-specific representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DoctorAgents，一个基于大语言模型 (LLM) 智能体的 AutoML 框架，面向小型临床时序数据，通过生成、验证、细化三类智能体迭代构建和优化端到端机器学习管道。该方法用文本梯度下降 (textual gradient descent) 反向传播自然语言反馈，替代对预定义空间的穷举搜索。摘要报告在多种临床任务上一致优于已有 AutoML 基线，并产生更可解释的任务特定表示。
Motivation: 临床机器学习部署受限于数据稀缺、异质且具有时序复杂性，人工构建有效管道费时易错；现有 AutoML 主要依赖对预定义空间的暴力搜索，缺乏显式推理和记忆，只能部分解决该问题。
Method: 将 AutoML 从穷举搜索重构为推理驱动的精化过程，提出 DoctorAgents 框架，由生成、验证、细化三个专门 LLM 智能体协作，通过文本梯度下降将自然语言反馈反向传播，对管道进行针对性更新而不进行全面搜索。
Result: 在多种临床任务上的实验表明，DoctorAgents 一致优于既有 AutoML 基线，并产生更可解释的任务特定表示。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将 AutoML 转化为推理驱动的智能体协作，可以有效处理小规模、异质、时序临床数据这一此前难以自动化的问题。
