papers.title: Fractal KV-Cache Archives: Lossless Symbolic Storage with In-Place Retrieval for Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: The key-value (KV) cache dominates the memory cost of long-context autoregressive inference, and a growing body of work compresses it through quantization, eviction, or offloading. We study a complementary question: once a position's KV state has been quantized to codebook indices, how should the resulting symbol stream be stored, and can the storage layer do more than store? A family of contractive iterated-map codes that serialize a symbol sequence into a sequence of low-dimensional real vectors is revisited, and it is shown that they form a natural archive format for a quantized KV cache with the following features. The method provides exactly the access pattern a growing cache requires. It is lossless, it runs in linear time, and supports O(1) random access and O(1) amortized append. A controlled study of the quantizer feeding this archive is conducted on GPT-2 with 1024-token contexts. Keeping a small exact window (4 attention sinks plus 32 recent tokens) and archiving the rest, per-head residual vector quantization reduces the archived cache by 36-54x relative to an fp16 cache at a perplexity cost of 11-15%, and we quantify a sharp key/value asymmetry - quantizing keys is roughly 4x more damaging than quantizing values, consistent with prior low-bit KV work - and use it to allocate bits in a hybrid scheme. Finally, we show the archive is simultaneously a search index: approximate substring queries execute directly on the stored vectors, and matched context is decoded from the matched vector without ever materializing the surrounding text. We further characterize the archive's operating range: truncating stored points yields a lossy regime whose distortion we localize, and probability-weighting the maps recovers arithmetic coding, exposing a trade-off between rate efficiency, random access, and memory. We release all code; every number reproduces on a laptop CPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长上下文自回归推理中量化后的 KV cache 的存储层设计，提出用收缩迭代映射码（contractive iterated-map codes）将量化后的符号流序列化为低维实向量，形成一种无损、线性时间、支持 O(1) 随机访问和 O(1) 摊还追加的归档格式。作者在 GPT-2 的 1024-token 上下文上做受控实验，结合保留精确小窗口（4 个 attention sinks 加 32 个 recent tokens）的分层残差向量量化（residual vector quantization），相对 fp16 cache 将归档缓存压缩 36-54 倍，困惑度代价为 11-15%，并发现 key 的量化损伤约为 value 的 4 倍。该归档还可同时作为搜索索引，直接在存储向量上执行近似子串查询。
Motivation: KV cache 主导长上下文推理的内存开销，现有工作通过量化、驱逐或卸载来压缩，但很少关注量化后符号流本身如何存储，以及存储层能否在存储之外提供随机访问、追加和搜索等能力。
Method: 复用一类收缩迭代映射码，将符号序列序列化为低维实向量序列，作为量化 KV cache 的无损归档格式；配合保留 attention sinks 与 recent tokens 的精确窗口，对其余部分做分层残差向量量化，并根据观测到的 key/value 量化不对称性分配比特。
Result: 在 GPT-2 1024-token 上下文上，归档缓存相对 fp16 压缩 36-54 倍，困惑度增加 11-15%；量化 key 的损伤约为量化 value 的约 4 倍；近似子串查询可直接在存储向量上执行并从匹配向量解码上下文；截断存储点进入有损区，概率加权映射可恢复算术编码。
Conclusion: 作者指出该格式在率效率、随机访问和内存之间暴露权衡，并强调归档同时充当搜索索引；所有代码已开源，结果可在笔记本电脑 CPU 上复现。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Beyond the Library: An Agentic Framework for Autoformalizing Research Mathematics
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in mathematical reasoning, they frequently produce subtle errors that evade human detection. Formal mathematical languages like Lean 4 offer mechanical proof checking, strongly motivating the need for autoformalization: the automatic translation of natural language mathematics into verifiable code. Recent trends indicate that general-purpose LLMs, heavily optimized for standard programming, now outperform smaller models explicitly fine-tuned for Lean. Leveraging this shift, we introduce *Theo*, an agentic autoformalization framework powered by general coding LLMs. At the core of our system is an orchestrator that manages a multi-agent pipeline tailored for research-level mathematics. Because cutting-edge research frequently relies on concepts outside the scope of existing libraries like Mathlib, our system dynamically extends necessary type definitions and validates them via a novel Auxiliary Lemma technique before formalizing the primary theorems. We applied our approach to PutnamBench, producing machine-checked Lean proofs for a random sample of 32 problems. Furthermore, we evaluate our system on seven research papers---five from the ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing (STOC) and two recent OpenAI manuscripts---spanning combinatorics, communication complexity, mechanism design, learning theory, number theory, discrete geometry, and graph theory. We successfully formalize their main theorems and proofs and validate the generated formalizations with human experts; notably, two developments require no axioms beyond Lean's kernel. All of our formalizations are available at https://beyondthelibrary.github.io/formal_arxiv/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Theo，一个由通用编程大语言模型驱动的智能体自动形式化框架，用于把研究级数学定理翻译为 Lean 4 可验证代码。系统核心是一个编排器 (orchestrator) 管理多代理流水线，并在形式化主定理前动态扩展 Mathlib 缺失的类型定义，通过 Auxiliary Lemma 技术验证。作者在 PutnamBench 随机 32 道题上产出机器检查的 Lean 证明，并在 7 篇研究论文（5 篇 STOC、2 篇 OpenAI 手稿）上成功形式化主要定理与证明，其中两个开发不依赖 Lean 内核之外的公理。
Motivation: LLM 在数学推理中常产生难以被人类察觉的细微错误，而 Lean 4 等形式化语言可提供机械证明检查，因此自动形式化 (autoformalization) 很有价值；同时通用编程 LLM 已胜过针对 Lean 微调的小模型，需要相应更新系统设计。
Method: 提出 Theo 智能体框架，由 orchestrator 协调多代理流水线处理研究级数学；当定理依赖超出 Mathlib 现有库的概念时，系统动态扩展所需类型定义，并借助新提出的 Auxiliary Lemma 技术先行验证这些扩展，再形式化主定理。
Result: 在 PutnamBench 上随机选取的 32 个问题均生成机器检查的 Lean 证明；对 7 篇研究论文（覆盖组合学、通信复杂度、机制设计、学习理论、数论、离散几何和图论）成功形式化其主要定理与证明，并经人类专家验证，其中两个开发不需要 Lean 内核之外的公理。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作展示了通用编程 LLM 与多代理管线结合可用于自动形式化研究级数学，并公开了全部形式化代码；摘要未讨论具体局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Right Knowledge, Wrong Answer: Characterizing Parametric Temporal Conflict in Open-Weight Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Language models may encode both outdated facts and their newer replacements. We introduce Parametric Temporal Conflict (PTC), where the newer fact is present and recoverable, but the default forward pass prefers the outdated one. We release a deterministically verified benchmark of 8,746 Wikidata position-holder transitions and evaluate four open-weight language models across three families. A date-prefix prompt recovers the newer fact in 61-81% of PTC cases. Activation patching flips predictions in 72-85% of cases and localizes the preference to model-specific upper-layer regions. Residual-stream steering outperforms norm-matched random directions, indicating direction-specific representations. These results show that PTC reflects a localized representational preference rather than missing knowledge. Recovery is measured on oracle-identified conflicts because automatic detection remains unreliable. We release the benchmark, code, and statistics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出参数化时间冲突 (PTC) 概念，即语言模型同时编码过时事实及其新版本，默认前向传播偏向过时事实。作者构建了 8,746 条 Wikidata 职位持有者转变的确定性验证基准，并评估三个家族中的四个开放权重模型。日期前缀提示可在 61-81% 的 PTC 案例中恢复较新事实，激活修补 (activation patching) 在 72-85% 的案例中翻转预测并定位到模型特定的上层区域，残差流转向 (residual-stream steering) 优于范数匹配随机方向。
Motivation: 已有研究关注事实更新或知识遗忘，但缺少对“新旧事实并存且默认输出过时版本”这一现象的系统刻画。作者引入 PTC 来区分知识缺失与表征偏好，并指出自动检测 PTC 仍不可靠，因此需要一个可确定性验证的基准。
Method: 构建 8,746 条 Wikidata 职位持有者转变的确定性验证基准；在三个家族的四个开放权重语言模型上进行评估；使用日期前缀提示、激活修补和残差流转向三类干预手段，定位并操控模型对新旧事实的偏好。
Result: 日期前缀提示在 61-81% 的 PTC 案例中恢复较新事实；激活修补在 72-85% 的案例中翻转预测，并将偏好定位到特定模型的上层区域；残差流转向优于范数匹配的随机方向，表明存在方向特异性表征。
Conclusion: 结果表明 PTC 反映的是局部化的表征偏好而非知识缺失；恢复测量仅在 oracle 识别的冲突上进行，因为自动检测仍不可靠。作者发布了基准、代码和统计数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: As You Wish: Mission Planning with Formal Verification using LLMs in Precision Agriculture
papers.abstract_en: Though robotic systems are now being commercialized and deployed in various industries, many of these systems are highly specialized and often require an advanced skill set to operate and ensure they perform as instructed. To mitigate this problem, we recently introduced a mission planner leveraging LLMs to synthesize mission plans in precision agriculture based on mission descriptions provided in natural language. While the system demonstrates impressive performance, it also suffers from the inherent ambiguities of natural language. In this paper, we extend our system to address this issue by introducing multiple feedback loops in the planning architecture that leverage linear temporal logic (LTL) to ensure the mission planning system meets the specifications formulated by the user while still using natural language. To mitigate potential bias, this is achieved by using two different commercial LLMs in charge of the specification and verification subtasks. Through extensive experiments, we highlight the strengths and limitations of integrating mission verification into a fully autonomous pipeline, particularly regarding an LLM's ability to generate valuable LTL formulas, and show how our proposed implementation addresses and solves these challenges.
papers.journal_ref: Published in Proceedings of 2026 International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在精密农业场景中扩展了一个基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的自然语言任务规划器，通过引入基于线性时序逻辑 (LTL) 的多个反馈回路来缓解自然语言固有的歧义，并确保规划满足用户给定的规格。系统使用两个不同的商业 LLM 分别负责规格生成与验证子任务以缓解潜在偏差。实验评估了将任务验证集成到全自主管线中的优势与局限，特别是 LLM 生成有效 LTL 公式的能力。
Motivation: 农业机器人等专用系统往往需要高级操作技能，而基于自然语言的规划器虽然易用，但受限于自然语言的歧义性，难以保证规划结果满足用户规格。
Method: 在原有 LLM 任务规划架构中加入基于 LTL 的多个反馈回路，由规格 LLM 生成形式化规格、验证 LLM 检查规划是否满足规格，并将验证结果反馈回规划循环；两个 LLM 来自不同商业供应商以缓解潜在偏差。
Result: 大量实验显示了将任务验证集成到全自主规划管线中的优势与局限，尤其是 LLM 能否生成有价值的 LTL 公式这一关键环节，并展示了所提实现如何应对这些挑战。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过双 LLM 与 LTL 反馈实现了对自然语言歧义的缓解，同时指出其在完全自主管线中集成验证仍存在优缺点。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Weights and Gradients: A Taxonomy of Federated Learning Messages
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning is rapidly evolving beyond the exchange of traditional model weights and gradients, yet existing definitions fail to capture the full scope of modern payloads like synthetic data and federated analytics. This paper addresses the gap by proposing a formal mathematical definition of a federated message that accounts for both utility and privacy. We introduce a taxonomy that organizes these exchanges into three categories: model structures, statistical summaries, and data-conditioned representations. By evaluating these groups based on computational demands, communication costs, and privacy risks, we provide a clearer understanding of the trade-offs involved in decentralized training. Our review of 202 recent publications highlights a significant shift since 2021 toward diverse messaging paradigms, signaling a move away from standard deep learning updates toward more specialized information sharing. This framework provides a structured path for future research to optimize federated systems for varying hardware and security requirements.
papers.comment: 4 figures, 9 pages, with 7 pages of content
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出联邦消息（federated message）的形式化数学定义，兼顾效用与隐私，并将联邦学习中的信息交换分为三类：模型结构、统计摘要、数据条件表示。基于对202篇近期出版物的综述，指出自2021年以来联邦消息范式趋向多样化，并评估各类消息在计算需求、通信成本与隐私风险上的权衡。该框架旨在为面向不同硬件与安全需求的联邦系统优化提供结构化路径。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习定义局限于传统模型权重与梯度交换，无法覆盖合成数据、联邦分析等现代负载，缺少能同时刻画效用与隐私的消息形式化定义及分类体系。
Method: 提出联邦消息的数学定义，并建立包含模型结构、统计摘要、数据条件表示三类消息的分类法，从计算需求、通信成本和隐私风险三个维度评估各类消息的权衡。
Result: 对202篇近期出版物的综述显示，自2021年以来联邦学习明显向多样化消息范式转变，从标准深度学习更新转向更专门化的信息共享。
Conclusion: 作者认为该分类框架为未来优化联邦系统以适应不同硬件与安全需求提供了结构化路径；本文属于定义与综述性工作，未报告具体系统实验。
Relevance: 8

summary_sections.result: 对202篇近期出版物的综述显示，自2021年以来联邦学习明显向多样化消息范式转变，从标准深度学习更新转向更专门化的信息共享。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该分类框架为未来优化联邦系统以适应不同硬件与安全需求提供了结构化路径；本文属于定义与综述性工作，未报告具体系统实验。

papers.title: ClayBuddy: A Framework, Evaluation, & Mitigation of Coding Agent Failures
papers.abstract_en: Software engineering and deployment are increasingly delegated to AI coding agents. The scale of their adoption is surfacing rare, but highly destructive, failure modes. In this paper, we study these failure modes as stemming from three distinct mechanisms: underspecification, where default model behavior is unsafe; capability errors, where the safe action is available but the model does not adhere to it due to bias or capability limitations; and agent harness errors, where the model fails to execute the safe action through the harness. We assess these across 8 different evaluations, each inspired by real-life deployment failures, totaling 20 coding environments and 59 synthetic transcript templates. These evaluations act as controlled stress tests for isolating our failure mechanisms. Based on this evaluation, we propose ClayBuddy, a harness modification that molds to user preferences and can be modified by the model in-session, to mitigate these errors. By adding tools for the agent to edit its own context, an extended system prompt, a customizable command classifier, and deterministic guardrails, we show that ClayBuddy is safer across a statistically significant number of samples. Thus, we suggest concrete mitigations for current coding agents and a design philosophy for future agent harness features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 AI 编码代理（coding agents）在软件工程与部署中出现的罕见但破坏性高的失败模式，将其归因于三种机制：规格不足（underspecification）、能力错误（capability errors）和代理工具链错误（agent harness errors）。作者在 8 个评估、20 个编码环境和 59 个合成转录模板上做受控压力测试，并提出 ClayBuddy——一种可通过会话内修改来贴合用户偏好的工具链（harness）修改方案，以缓解这些错误。摘要报告 ClayBuddy 在统计显著数量的样本上更安全。
Motivation: AI 编码代理的广泛采用暴露出罕见但高破坏性的失败模式，现有方法缺乏对失败机制的系统隔离与针对性缓解手段。
Method: 将失败模式分为 underspecification、capability errors 和 agent harness errors 三类，并设计 8 个受真实部署失败启发的评估来分别隔离这些机制；进而提出 ClayBuddy，一种允许模型在会话中编辑自身上下文的工具链修改，包括扩展系统提示、可定制的命令分类器和确定性护栏（guardrails）。
Result: 在 20 个编码环境和 59 个合成转录模板上的受控测试表明，ClayBuddy 在统计显著数量的样本上比基线更安全。
Conclusion: 作者提出针对当前编码代理的具体缓解措施，以及未来代理工具链功能的设计理念。

papers.title: BenHalluEval: A Multi-Task Hallucination Evaluation Framework for Large Language Models on Bengali
papers.abstract_en: Despite Bengali being the sixth most spoken language in the world, no prior work has systematically evaluated hallucination in large language models (LLMs) for Bengali. We introduce BenHalluEval, a fine-grained hallucination evaluation framework for Bengali covering four tasks: Generative Question Answering (GQA), Bangla-English Code-Mixed QA, Summarization, and Reasoning. We construct 12,000 hallucinated candidates using GPT-5.4 across twelve task-specific hallucination types, drawn from three existing Bengali datasets, and evaluate seven LLMs spanning reasoning-oriented, multilingual, and Bengali-centric categories under a dual-track protocol that independently measures false-positive rate on ground-truth instances (Track A) and hallucination detection rate on hallucinated candidates (Track B). To jointly penalise both failure modes and prevent inflated scores from uniform response bias, we propose BenHalluScore, a dual-track calibration metric that ranges from 7.72% to 55.42% across models and tasks, revealing substantial variation in hallucination calibration. Chain-of-thought prompting, applied as a mitigation strategy, shifts response distributions without consistently improving hallucination discrimination. BenHalluEval establishes the first dedicated hallucination benchmark for Bengali and highlights the inadequacy of single-track and prompting-only evaluation approaches for low-resource language settings. The dataset and code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/BanglaHalluEval-EB77.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BenHalluEval，针对孟加拉语大语言模型幻觉评估的细粒度多任务框架，覆盖生成式问答、孟加拉语-英语代码混合问答、摘要和推理四类任务。作者基于三个现有孟加拉语数据集构造了 12,000 个幻觉候选样本，涵盖 12 种任务特定幻觉类型，并引入双轨评估协议（Track A 测量真实实例上的假阳性率，Track B 测量幻觉候选上的检测率）。同时提出 BenHalluScore 双轨校准指标，在模型与任务间波动于 7.72% 至 55.42%，表明幻觉校准存在显著差异；思维链提示作为缓解策略只能改变回答分布而不能一致提升幻觉判别能力。
Motivation: 尽管孟加拉语是世界第六大语言，但此前没有工作系统性地评估 LLM 在该语言上的幻觉问题；低资源语言设置下单一轨道的评估和仅靠提示词（prompting）的缓解方式被证明不够充分。
Method: 构建 BenHalluEval 基准，使用 GPT-5.4 生成 12,000 个幻觉候选，覆盖四类任务与 12 种任务特定幻觉类型；评估七个模型（推理导向、多语言、孟加拉语中心三类），采用双轨协议分别衡量假阳性率与幻觉检测率，并提出双轨校准指标 BenHalluScore 联合惩罚两类失败模式，避免均匀响应偏差带来的虚高分数。
Result: BenHalluScore 在模型与任务间范围为 7.72% 至 55.42%，显示幻觉校准的显著差异；思维链（chain-of-thought）提示会改变回答分布，但并未一致提升幻觉判别能力。
Conclusion: BenHalluEval 建立了首个孟加拉语专用幻觉基准，并揭示低资源语言场景下单轨道评估和仅提示词式缓解方法的不足。数据集与代码已公开。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SemiSAM-O1: Pushing the Boundary of Annotation-Efficient Medical Image Segmentation with Generalist Knowledge Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) has become a promising solution to alleviate the annotation burden of deep learning-based medical image segmentation models. While recent advances in foundation model-driven SSL have pushed the boundary to extremely limited annotation scenarios, they fail to maintain robust competitive performance in complex imaging modalities. In this paper, we propose SemiSAM-O1, an annotation-efficient framework using only one annotated template case for segmentation. SemiSAM-O1 extends the specialist-generalist collaborative learning framework to the extreme one-label setting by fully exploiting the foundation model's feature representation capability beyond its prompting interface. SemiSAM-O1 operates in two stages. In the first stage, the foundation model's encoder extracts dense features from all volumes, and class prototypes derived from the single annotated template are propagated to the unlabeled pool via feature similarity to produce coarse initial pseudo-labels. In the second stage, an iterative training-and-refinement loop progressively improves both the segmentation model and the pseudo-labels over multiple rounds, where each round trains the model from scratch on current pseudo-labels and generates updated predictions with voxel-wise uncertainty estimates. An uncertainty-guided refinement step further leverages the foundation model's global feature space to correct high-uncertainty regions by aggregating labels from their most similar confident neighbors, establishing a virtuous cycle of mutual improvement. Extensive experiments on a wide range of segmentation tasks across different modalities and anatomical targets demonstrate that SemiSAM-O1 significantly narrows the performance gap between one-label semi-supervised learning and full supervision, while significantly reducing the computational overhead of online foundation model inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SemiSAM-O1，一个仅使用一个标注模板样本 (one annotated template case) 即可进行医学图像分割的标注高效框架。它把专家-通才协作学习 (specialist-generalist collaborative learning) 推广到极端单标签半监督场景，并在两阶段流程中充分利用基础模型 (foundation model) 编码器的特征表达能力：先用单模板类别原型通过特征相似度传播生成粗糙伪标签，再通过多轮训练-精修循环和基于体素不确定性 (voxel-wise uncertainty) 的精修步骤逐步改进分割模型与伪标签。实验覆盖多种模态和解剖目标的医学分割任务，显示该方法显著缩小了单标签半监督与全监督之间的性能差距，并降低在线基础模型推理的计算开销。
Motivation: 半监督学习 (SSL) 被用于缓解医学图像分割的标注负担，但现有基础模型驱动的 SSL 方法在复杂成像模态下无法保持稳健且有竞争力的性能，尤其是在标注极少的场景。作者希望突破到极端的一标签设置，使仅靠一个标注模板也能获得接近全监督的分割效果。
Method: SemiSAM-O1 分两阶段工作：第一阶段由基础模型的编码器提取所有体数据的稠密特征，并利用从唯一标注模板得到的类别原型 (class prototypes) 通过特征相似度向未标注池传播，生成粗糙的初始伪标签；第二阶段是迭代的训练与精修循环，每轮从当前伪标签从头训练模型并输出带体素级不确定性估计的更新预测，随后用不确定性引导的精修步骤在基础模型的全局特征空间中聚合最相似的高置信邻域标签来修正高不确定区域，形成相互改进的良性循环。
Result: 摘要报告在多种模态和解剖目标的多个分割任务上进行的大量实验中，SemiSAM-O1 显著缩小了单标签半监督学习与全监督之间的性能差距，同时明显降低在线基础模型推理的计算开销。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过在提示接口之外充分挖掘基础模型的特征表示能力，可以将专家-通才协作框架推进到极端单标签设置，并同时改善分割性能与推理效率。

papers.title: Plausible Patients, Impossible Populations: Auditing Epidemiological Fidelity in Large Language Model Mental Health Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Language models asked to simulate psychiatric patients produce cases that survive inspection one at a time and populations that match no real one. We gave GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-3-Flash, DeepSeek-V3 and GLM-4.7 each of 120 demographic cohorts under two framings, one written as a clinician enters a patient and one as a person describes themselves, and scored all 28,800 responses against survey-weighted PHQ-8 anchors derived from NHANES microdata. Case by case the output holds up: 97.3% of elevated presentations satisfy the DSM-5 gateway rule, violating it at 2.68% against a chance null of 10.4%. As populations, four things fail at once. Every benchmarkable group returns inflated by 2.8 to 5.5 PHQ-8 points, and 18.2% of simulated patients screen at the treatment threshold against 7.5% of adults. Population Black-White and Hispanic-White disparities do not survive the simulation, with two models attenuating each gap and two flattening or inverting it. Symptom covariance reorganizes by cohort, putting the error beyond any recalibration, and demographic offsets do not stack, so a correction fitted on marginals misses the cells by about 0.4 points either way. And the answer does not hold still: at the decoding a deployment inherits, a third of patients change severity category between two draws of one prompt and one in five crosses the line from watchful waiting to treatment. We read the four together as one failure, and name the gap between case-level plausibility and population-level failure the coherence-fidelity dissociation. Individual cases clear a formal rule a case review would apply; the populations they compose fail every comparison we can construct against a real one. Gender identity carries an extreme on both symptom structure and regeneration stability, and no federal benchmark exists to check any of it. The patients look right. They do not represent real populations.
papers.comment: v2: substantially revised and retitled; withdraws the variance-compression and transgender-suppression results and adds a pre-registered decoding control. 21 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计大型语言模型模拟精神病患者时的流行病学保真度。作者让 GPT-4o-mini、Gemini-3-Flash、DeepSeek-V3 和 GLM-4.7 分别对 120 个人口学队列在两种框架（临床录入 vs 自述）下生成共 28,800 条回应，并以 NHANES 微数据派生的调查加权 PHQ-8 锚点评分。单例层面模拟病例能通过形式规则（97.3% 的升高表现满足 DSM-5 门槛规则），但群体层面所有可基准化人群的 PHQ-8 均值膨胀 2.8 至 5.5 分，人群间差距、症状协方差与人口学偏移的可加性均失效，且同一提示两次解码间有三分之一患者改变严重度类别。作者将病例级合理性与群体级失败之间的鸿沟命名为 coherence-fidelity dissociation。
Motivation: 现有的 LLM 模拟患者评估多为逐例检查其表面合理性，缺乏对生成群体是否匹配真实流行病学分布的审计；而模拟人口若用于研究或临床决策支持，其统计保真度（流行病学保真度）必须被检验。
Method: 作者构造了一个审计协议：对 4 个 LLM 给出 120 个队列 × 2 种提示框架的全部组合，收集 28,800 条模拟 PHQ-8 回应，并以 NHANES 微数据派生的调查加权锚点作为基准，检验 DSM-5 门槛规则、均值膨胀、人群间差距、症状协方差结构、边际校正的可迁移性以及同提示重采样稳定性。
Result: 摘要报告：DSM-5 门槛违反率仅 2.68%（随机零假设为 10.4%）；每个可基准化群体均值膨胀 2.8–5.5 PHQ-8 分，18.2% 的模拟患者达到治疗阈值而真实成人为 7.5%；黑-白与西语裔-白差距被两个模型减弱、被两个模型拉平或反转；症状协方差随队列重组；基于边际的校正对单元格的误差约为 ±0.4 分；同一提示两次抽取中有三分之一患者改变严重度类别、五分之一跨越观察等待与治疗的界限。性别认同在症状结构与再生成稳定性上表现极端。
Conclusion: 作者将四种群体级失败视为同一个失败，并把病例级合理性与群体级失败的分离命名为 coherence-fidelity dissociation。模拟病例能通过个案审查适用的形式规则，但构成的群体无法通过任何可构造的现实人群比较；且不存在联邦基准可对此进行核查。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CT Open: An Open-Access, Uncontaminated, Live Platform for the Open Challenge of Clinical Trial Outcome Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Scientists have long sought to accurately predict outcomes of real-world events before they happen. Can AI systems do so more reliably? We study this question through clinical trial outcome prediction, a high-stakes open challenge even for domain experts. We introduce CT Open, an open-access, live platform that will run four challenge every year. Anyone can submit predictions for each challenge. CT Open evaluates those submissions on trials whose outcomes were not yet public at the time of submission but were made public afterwards. Determining if a trial's outcome is public on the internet before a certain date is surprisingly difficult. Outcomes posted on official registries may lag behind by years, while the first mention may appear in obscure articles. To address this, we propose a novel, fully automated decontamination pipeline that uses iterative LLM-powered web search to identify the earliest mention of trial outcomes. We validate the pipeline's quality and accuracy by human expert's annotations. Since CT Open's pipeline ensures that every evaluated trial had no publicly reported outcome when the prediction was made, it allows participants to use any methodology and any data source. In this paper, we release a training set and two time-stamped test benchmarks, Winter 2025 and Summer 2025. We believe CT Open can serve as a central hub for advancing AI research on forecasting real-world outcomes before they occur, while also informing biomedical research and improving clinical trial design. CT Open Platform is hosted at $\href{https://ct-open.net/}{https://ct-open.net/}$
papers.comment: Published at Conference on Language Modeling (COLM), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CT Open，一个开放获取、实时运行的临床试验结局预测平台，每年举办四次挑战赛，允许任何人提交预测，并以提交时结局尚未公开、之后才公开的试验作为评估对象。为消除数据污染，作者提出一种基于迭代式 LLM 驱动网络搜索的全自动去污染 (decontamination) 流程，用于识别试验结局的最早公开提及，并用人类专家标注验证其质量。论文同时发布一个训练集和两个带时间戳的测试基准 (Winter 2025 与 Summer 2025)。
Motivation: 临床试验结局预测是连领域专家都难以应对的高风险开放挑战；而评估预测时最大的难点在于确认某个试验的结局在特定日期之前是否已在互联网上公开，因为官方注册处可能滞后数年，首次提及可能出现在不显眼的文章中。
Method: CT Open 平台每年运行四轮挑战，参与者可使用任意方法和数据源提交预测；核心创新是自动去污染流水线，它通过迭代式 LLM 驱动的网络搜索定位试验结局最早被公开的时间点，并辅以人类专家标注进行质量与准确性验证。
Result: 摘要报告该去污染流水线经人类专家标注验证有效，并发布了一个训练集以及 Winter 2025 和 Summer 2025 两个带时间戳的测试基准；摘要未给出具体的定量结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CT Open 可作为推进 AI 在真实事件发生前进行预测研究的中心平台，同时为生物医学研究和临床试验设计提供参考。

papers.title: An Axiomatic Benchmark for Evaluation of Scientific Novelty Metrics
papers.abstract_en: The rigorous evaluation of the novelty of a scientific paper is, even for human scientists, a challenging task. With the increasing interest in AI scientists, it is becoming more and more important that this task be automatable and reliable, lest attention and compute be wasted on ideas that have already been explored. Due to the challenge of quantifying ground-truth novelty, however, existing novelty metrics generally validate against noisy, confounded signals such as citation counts or peer review scores. We introduce a benchmark that compares novelty metrics without requiring explicit novelty labels. It tests whether scores move correctly under controlled pool manipulations, organized under three axioms requiring that scores fall as the pool covers more of a paper's content, rise as the pool loses relevance, and fall as the pool moves later in time. Indeed, we show that even for the most direct human signal, ICLR reviewer novelty scores, the axis of novelty is entangled with quality. Across ten systems, from embedding metrics to AI scientist novelty checks, we find that surface redundancy is largely solved but conceptual redundancy is not, and that embedding metrics and LLM-based metrics both have their places; future metrics should combine such approaches for better novelty evaluation. We release our benchmark and evaluation code to enable this research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个无需显式新颖性标签的基准，通过受控的池操作（pool manipulations）检验科学论文新颖性度量的行为是否符合三条公理：池覆盖论文内容越多分数越低、池失去相关性分数越高、池时间越晚分数越低。作者用该基准测试了从嵌入度量到 AI 科学家新颖性检查在内的十种系统，发现表面冗余基本被解决，但概念冗余仍未解决，且嵌入度量与基于 LLM 的度量各有优势。
Motivation: 科学论文新颖性的严格评估即使对人类科学家也很困难，而现有新颖性度量通常依赖引用数或同行评审分数等噪声大且混杂的信号来验证；随着 AI 科学家的兴起，需要可靠且可自动化的新颖性评估，以免算力和注意力浪费在已被探索的想法上。
Method: 引入一个不要求显式新颖性标签的评测基准，通过受控的池操作检验新颖性分数是否随池的内容覆盖、相关性和时间变化而正确移动，并将该基准应用于十种系统，包括嵌入度量和 AI 科学家新颖性检查。
Result: 即使是最直接的人类信号（ICLR 评审新颖性分数），新颖性轴也与质量混杂；在十种系统中，表面冗余大多已被解决，但概念冗余尚未解决，嵌入度量和 LLM 基度量各有适用场景。
Conclusion: 未来新颖性度量应结合嵌入方法和 LLM 方法以改进新颖性评估；作者已发布基准与评估代码以支持后续研究。

papers.title: SkillMOO: Multi-Objective Optimization of Agent Skills for Software Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills are increasingly used to configure coding agents for software engineering (SE) tasks, yet current practice treats them as static, hand-crafted assets, or evolved on pass rate alone. This is insufficient: a skill can improve task success while substantially raising token cost, or introducing misleading guidance. We argue that SE agent skill bundles can be treated as multi-objective search objects and present SkillMOO, a framework that evolves skill bundles through LLM-proposed edits and NSGA-II Pareto selection on pass rate and inference cost. Evaluated across all 16 SkillsBench SE tasks, SkillMOO achieves the top pass rate rank on 11 of 12 non-zero-pass tasks while achieving cost reductions of up to 31.7% over static bundles, with pass rate gains up to 21 percentage points. Analysis of 38 skill edits shows that pruning and substitution dominate successful operations, offering actionable principles for skill bundle design. Thereby, the current practice of deploying skills without cost-aware validation leaves better skill configurations unexplored, motivating a new class of cost-aware, search-based skill engineering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillMOO，将软件工程编码代理的技能包（skill bundle）视为多目标搜索对象，通过 LLM 提出的编辑与 NSGA-II 帕累托选择，在 pass rate 与推理成本上联合进化技能包。在全部 16 个 SkillsBench SE 任务上，该方法在 12 个非零通过率任务中的 11 个取得最高 pass rate 排名，相对静态技能包最多降低 31.7% 成本，pass rate 最多提升 21 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有实践把编码代理技能当作静态、手工配置的资产，或仅以 pass rate 为单一进化目标；这忽略了技能可能提升任务成功率却显著提高 token 成本，或引入误导性指导的问题。
Method: 提出 SkillMOO 框架，用 LLM 提出技能包编辑，并通过 NSGA-II 帕累托选择同时对 pass rate 和推理成本进行多目标优化；对 38 个技能编辑的分析识别出剪枝（pruning）和替换（substitution）是主要的成功操作。
Result: 在 SkillsBench 的 16 个 SE 任务中，SkillMOO 在 12 个非零通过率任务中的 11 个取得最高 pass rate 排名；相比静态技能包最多降低 31.7% 推理成本，pass rate 最多提升 21 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者认为，当前不进行成本感知验证就部署技能的做法会遗漏更好的技能配置，并呼吁迈向成本感知的、基于搜索的技能工程（cost-aware, search-based skill engineering）。

papers.title: Correct Answers from Sound Reasoning: Verifiable Process Supervision for Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Training language models to produce both correct answers and sound reasoning remains an open challenge. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards typically optimizes only final outcomes, which can improve task accuracy at the expense of reasoning quality, producing inaccurate, incomplete, or inconsistent traces. We propose verifiable process supervision (VPS), a post-training framework that jointly optimizes prediction accuracy and reasoning quality by supervising structured intermediate claims. We first apply supervised fine-tuning to induce a structured reasoning format, enabling deterministic extraction and verification of intermediate claims for process-level rewards. To address the heterogeneous difficulty of reasoning subtasks, we introduce adaptive weighting that prioritizes components with the largest remaining errors, creating an implicit curriculum. We evaluate VPS on chess as a controlled testbed where reasoning steps can be deterministically verified against engine signals. While outcome-only RL improves move accuracy, it sharply degrades reasoning quality, increasing win-rate error by up to 112% and reducing internal consistency by up to 69%. In contrast, VPS preserves accuracy while significantly improving reasoning quality, reducing win-rate error by up to 30% and restoring consistency to near saturation. A reasoning-space analysis further shows that, without a structured prior, outcome-only RL converges to budget-dependent shortcuts rather than sound multi-step reasoning. Beyond chess, we observe the same phenomenon on math reasoning, where outcome-only RL improves accuracy while degrading step-level arithmetic and consistency, whereas VPS maintains both. These results show that VPS enables language models to reason both accurately and reliably in verifiable domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可验证过程监督 (verifiable process supervision, VPS)，一种针对语言模型的后训练框架，通过监督结构化中间论断来同时优化预测准确性与推理质量。作者在象棋这一可确定性验证推理步骤的受控测试平台上评估，发现仅关注最终结果的强化学习 (outcome-only RL) 虽提升走棋准确率，却严重损害推理质量；而 VPS 在保持准确率的同时显著改善推理质量。该现象在数学推理任务上同样出现，说明 VPS 能使模型在可验证领域中既准确又可靠地推理。
Motivation: 用可验证奖励做强化学习通常只优化最终结果，能提升任务准确率却以推理质量为代价，产生不准确、不完整或不一致的推理轨迹；训练语言模型同时给出正确答案与可靠推理仍是开放挑战。
Method: 提出 VPS 后训练框架：先用监督微调诱导结构化推理格式，使中间论断可被确定性提取与验证以生成过程级奖励；再引入自适应加权 (adaptive weighting)，优先处理剩余错误最大的推理子任务，形成隐式课程 (implicit curriculum)。
Result: 在象棋基准上，outcome-only RL 使胜率误差 (win-rate error) 最多增加 112%、内部一致性最多降低 69%；相比之下，VPS 在保持准确率的同时将胜率误差最多降低 30%，并把一致性恢复到接近饱和。推理空间分析显示，没有结构化先验时 outcome-only RL 会收敛到依赖预算的捷径而非可靠的多步推理；数学推理上也观察到类似现象，VPS 同时维持了准确率与逐步算术及一致性。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果表明，在可验证领域中，VPS 能够让语言模型以既准确又可靠的方式进行推理，弥补仅优化最终答案带来的推理质量退化。

summary_sections.result: 在象棋基准上，outcome-only RL 使胜率误差 (win-rate error) 最多增加 112%、内部一致性最多降低 69%；相比之下，VPS 在保持准确率的同时将胜率误差最多降低 30%，并把一致性恢复到接近饱和。推理空间分析显示，没有结构化先验时 outcome-only RL 会收敛到依赖预算的捷径而非可靠的多步推理；数学推理上也观察到类似现象，VPS 同时维持了准确率与逐步算术及一致性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为这些结果表明，在可验证领域中，VPS 能够让语言模型以既准确又可靠的方式进行推理，弥补仅优化最终答案带来的推理质量退化。

papers.title: GrandCode: Achieving Grandmaster Level in Competitive Programming via Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Competitive programming remains one of the last few human strongholds in coding against AI. The best AI system to date still underperforms the best humans competitive programming: the most recent best result, Google's Gemini~3 Deep Think, attained 8th place even not being evaluated under live competition conditions. In this work, we introduce GrandCode, a multi-agent RL system designed for competitive programming. The capability of GrandCode is attributed to two key factors: (1) It orchestrates a variety of agentic modules (hypothesis proposal, solver, test generator, summarization, etc) and jointly improves them through post-training and online test-time RL; (2) We introduce Agentic GRPO specifically designed for multi-stage agent rollouts with delayed rewards and the severe off-policy drift that is prevalent in agentic RL. GrandCode is the first AI system that consistently beats all human participants in live contests of competitive programming: in the most recent three Codeforces live competitions, i.e., Round~1087 (Mar 21, 2026), Round~1088 (Mar 28, 2026), and Round~1089 (Mar 29, 2026), GrandCode placed first in all of them, beating all human participants, including legendary grandmasters. GrandCode shows that AI systems have reached a point where they surpass the strongest human programmers on the most competitive coding tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GrandCode，一个面向竞争编程（competitive programming）的多智能体强化学习系统。摘要报道该系统在最近的 Codeforces Round 1087、1088、1089 三场直播竞赛中均获得第一名，击败包括传奇宗师（legendary grandmasters）在内的所有人类参赛者，成为首个在直播竞赛中稳定超越全部人类选手的 AI 系统。其能力来自多种智能体模块的编排与联合后训练，以及为多阶段智能体轨迹设计的 Agentic GRPO 算法。
Motivation: 竞争编程被认为是 AI 尚未攻克的人类强项；此前最强的系统 Google Gemini 3 Deep Think 即使在非直播条件下也仅位列第 8。作者希望构建一个能在真实直播竞赛中超越最强人类程序员的系统。
Method: GrandCode 编排多种智能体模块（如假设提出、求解器、测试生成器、总结模块），并通过后训练（post-training）和在线测试时强化学习（test-time RL）联合改进它们。针对智能体强化学习常见的多阶段 rollout、延迟奖励和严重 off-policy drift 问题，作者提出 Agentic GRPO。
Result: 在 Codeforces Round 1087（2026-03-21）、Round 1088（2026-03-28）和 Round 1089（2026-03-29）三场直播竞赛中，GrandCode 全部获得第一名，击败所有人类参赛者，包括传奇宗师级选手。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这一结果表明 AI 系统已在最具竞争性的编程任务上超越最强人类程序员，并强调该成绩来自多智能体编排与专为智能体强化学习设计的训练算法。

papers.title: Gender-Based Heterogeneity in Youth Privacy-Protective Behavior for Smart Voice Assistants: Evidence from Multigroup PLS-SEM
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates how gender shapes privacy decision-making in youth smart voice assistant (SVA) ecosystems. Using survey data from 469 Canadian youths aged 16-24, we apply multigroup Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling to compare males (N=241) and females (N=174) (total N = 415) across five privacy constructs: Perceived Privacy Risks (PPR), Perceived Privacy Benefits (PPBf), Algorithmic Transparency and Trust (ATT), Privacy Self-Efficacy (PSE), and Privacy Protective Behavior (PPB). Results provide exploratory evidence of gender heterogeneity in selected pathways. The direct effect of PPR on PPB is stronger for males (Male: \b{eta} = 0.424; Female: \b{eta} = 0.233; p < 0.1), while the indirect effect of ATT on PPB via PSE is stronger for females (Female: \b{eta} = 0.229; Male: \b{eta} = 0.132; p < 0.1). Descriptive analysis of non-binary (N=15) and prefer-not-to-say participants (N=39) shows lower trust and higher perceived risk than the binary groups, motivating future work with adequately powered gender-diverse samples. Overall, the findings provide exploratory evidence that gender may moderate key privacy pathways, supporting more responsive transparency and control interventions for youth SVA use.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE Canadian Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (CCECE)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于加拿大 469 名 16–24 岁青少年的调查数据，采用多组偏最小二乘结构方程模型（multigroup PLS-SEM）比较男性和女性在智能语音助手（SVA）生态中的隐私决策路径。摘要报告了性别异质性的探索性证据：感知隐私风险（PPR）对隐私保护行为（PPB）的直接效应在男性中更强，而算法透明度与信任（ATT）经由隐私自我效能感（PSE）对 PPB 的间接效应在女性中更强。对非二元性别与不愿透露性别参与者的描述性分析显示其信任更低、感知风险更高。
Motivation: 青少年在智能语音助手场景中的隐私保护行为可能受性别影响，但现有证据有限；理解性别如何调节隐私决策路径，有助于设计更具针对性的透明度和控制干预措施。
Method: 使用 469 名加拿大青少年的问卷数据，其中男性 N=241、女性 N=174、非二元 N=15、不愿透露 N=39，采用多组 PLS-SEM 比较五个隐私构念（PPR、PPBf、ATT、PSE、PPB）之间的路径关系，并对非二元及不愿透露组做描述性分析。
Result: 摘要报告 PPR 对 PPB 的直接效应在男性中更强（男性 β=0.424，女性 β=0.233，p<0.1）；ATT 经 PSE 对 PPB 的间接效应在女性中更强（女性 β=0.229，男性 β=0.132，p<0.1）。非二元和不愿透露性别参与者的描述性结果显示较低的信任和较高的感知风险。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现提供了性别可能调节关键隐私路径的探索性证据，支持面向青少年 SVA 使用的更灵敏的透明度与控制干预，并指出未来需要样本量充分、性别多样化的研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation
papers.abstract_en: There are two major categories of embodied navigation: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN), where agents navigate by following natural language instructions; and Object-Goal Navigation (OGN), where agents navigate to a specified target object. However, existing work primarily evaluates model performance under nominal conditions, overlooking the potential corruptions that arise in real-world settings. To address this gap, we present NavTrust, a unified benchmark that systematically corrupts input modalities, including RGB, depth, and instructions, in realistic scenarios and evaluates their impact on navigation performance. To our best knowledge, NavTrust is the first benchmark that exposes embodied navigation agents to diverse RGB-Depth corruptions and instruction variations in a unified framework. Our extensive evaluation of seven state-of-the-art approaches reveals substantial performance degradation under realistic corruptions, which highlights critical robustness gaps and provides a roadmap toward more trustworthy embodied navigation systems. Furthermore, we systematically evaluate four distinct mitigation strategies to enhance robustness against RGB-Depth and instruction corruptions. Our base models include Uni-NaVid and ETPNav. We deployed them on a real mobile robot and observed improved robustness to corruptions. The project website is: https://navtrust.github.io/.
papers.comment: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026); Project Website: https://navtrust.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NavTrust，一个统一的基准测试，用于在真实世界场景下系统性破坏具身导航 (embodied navigation) 的输入模态，包括 RGB、深度和语言指令，并评估这些破坏对导航性能的影响。作者对七个最新方法进行广泛评估，发现现实破坏下性能显著下降，并系统比较了四种缓解策略。此外，将基础模型 Uni-NaVid 和 ETPNav 部署到真实移动机器人上，观察到对破坏的鲁棒性有所提升。
Motivation: 现有具身导航研究（如视觉语言导航 VLN 和物体目标导航 OGN）主要在名义条件下评估模型性能，忽略了真实环境中可能出现的输入损坏，因而缺乏对导航系统可信度的全面认识。
Method: 提出首个在统一框架下对具身导航智能体施加 RGB-Depth 与指令多种破坏 (corruptions) 的基准 NavTrust，并在此框架下评估七种前沿方法，同时系统评估四种针对 RGB-Depth 和指令破坏的鲁棒性提升策略。
Result: 摘要报告七个最新方法在现实破坏下出现大幅性能退化，暴露出关键的鲁棒性差距；在真实移动机器人上部署后观察到对破坏的鲁棒性有所改善。
Conclusion: 作者认为该基准揭示了现有具身导航系统在真实环境中的鲁棒性不足，并为构建更可信的具身导航系统提供了路线图。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Dual-space posterior sampling for Bayesian inference in constrained inverse problems
papers.abstract_en: Inverse problems constrained by partial differential equations are often ill-conditioned due to noisy, incomplete data or inherent non-uniqueness. A prominent example is full waveform inversion (FWI), which estimates Earth's subsurface properties by fitting seismic measurements subject to the wave equation, where ill-conditioning stems from noisy, band-limited, finite-aperture measurements and complex geological structures. A Bayesian framework describes the solution more comprehensively: instead of a single estimate, a posterior distribution of plausible solutions characterizes the non-uniqueness and can be sampled to quantify uncertainty. However, no clear procedure exists for translating hard physical constraints, such as the wave equation, into priors amenable to existing sampling techniques. We address this by sampling the posterior in the dual space via an augmented Lagrangian formulation, which converts hard constraints into penalties suited to sampling algorithms while enforcing them progressively through multiplier updates, so they are satisfied in the limit. We integrate the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) with Stein variational gradient descent (SVGD), a particle-based sampler: the constraint is relaxed at each iteration and the multiplier updates progressively enforce its satisfaction. This enables posterior sampling under hard constraints while inheriting the favorable conditioning of dual-space solvers, where partial constraint relaxation permits productive updates even when the current model is far from the true solution. We validate the method on a stylized Rosenbrock conditional inference problem and on frequency-domain FWI for a Gaussian anomaly model and the Marmousi II benchmark, demonstrating physically consistent uncertainty estimates and posterior contraction with increasing data coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对受偏微分方程约束的反问题（如全波形反演 FWI）提出一种贝叶斯推断方法：通过增广拉格朗日公式在对偶空间中采样后验，将硬物理约束转化为逐步满足的惩罚项，并把 ADMM 与基于粒子的采样器 SVGD 集成。作者在 Rosenbrock 条件推断问题、频域 FWI 的 Gaussian anomaly 模型和 Marmousi II 基准上验证了该方法，得到物理一致的 uncertainty estimates 以及随数据覆盖增加的后验收缩。
Motivation: 受 PDE 约束的反问题常因噪声、带限有限孔径数据或固有非唯一性而病态，贝叶斯框架能以整个后验分布刻画非唯一性并量化不确定性；但缺少把波动方程这类硬物理约束转化为适合现有采样技术的先验的明确程序。
Method: 提出在对偶空间进行后验采样：用增广拉格朗日公式将硬约束化为惩罚项，并通过乘子更新在迭代中渐进强制约束满足。具体将交替方向乘子法（ADMM）与 Stein 变分梯度下降（SVGD）结合，每步先放松约束、再由乘子更新渐进执行约束，从而继承对偶空间求解器良好的条件化性质，在模型远离真解时也能进行有效更新。
Result: 摘要报告在 Rosenbrock 条件推断问题和频域 FWI（Gaussian anomaly 模型、Marmousi II 基准）上的验证结果，表明该方法给出物理一致的 uncertainty estimates，并随观测数据覆盖增加呈现后验收缩。
Conclusion: 该方法允许在硬约束下进行后验采样，并通过乘子更新在极限意义上满足约束；作者强调其继承了 dual-space 求解器的有利条件化特性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Dynamics of Learning under User Choice: Overspecialization and Peer-Model Probing
papers.abstract_en: In many economically relevant contexts where machine learning is deployed, multiple platforms obtain data from the same pool of users, each of whom selects the platform that best serves them. Prior work in this setting focuses exclusively on the "local" losses of learners on the distribution of data that they observe. We find that there exist instances where learners who use existing algorithms almost surely converge to models with arbitrarily poor global performance, even when models with low full-population loss exist. This happens through a feedback-induced mechanism, which we call the overspecialization trap: as learners optimize for users who already prefer them, they become less attractive to users outside this base, which further restricts the data they observe. Inspired by the recent use of knowledge distillation in modern ML, we propose an algorithm that allows learners to "probe" the predictions of peer models, enabling them to learn about users who do not select them. Our analysis characterizes when probing succeeds: this procedure converges almost surely to a stationary point with bounded full-population risk when probing sources are sufficiently informative, e.g., a known market leader or a majority of peers with good global performance. We verify our findings with semi-synthetic experiments on the MovieLens, Census, and Amazon Sentiment datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多个机器学习平台从同一批用户池获取数据时，用户会选择最适合自己的平台，而现有算法只关注学习者在其观察到的数据分布上的局部损失。作者发现，在这种设置下，使用现有算法的学习者几乎必然收敛到全局性能任意差的模型，即使存在全人口损失很低的模型。他们将这一反馈机制称为过度专门化陷阱（overspecialization trap），并提出一种允许学习者对同伴模型进行预测探测（probing）的算法。分析刻画了探测成功的条件：当探测来源足够有信息量（如已知的市场领导者或多数表现良好的同伴）时，过程几乎必然收敛到有界全人口风险的驻点；半合成实验在 MovieLens、Census 和 Amazon Sentiment 数据集上验证了结论。
Motivation: 现有关于多平台学习的研究只关注学习者在各自观察到的数据分布上的局部损失，忽略了用户选择带来的反馈效应。作者发现这种反馈会导致学习者过度专门化，最终收敛到全局性能任意差的模型，即使低风险模型存在。
Method: 借鉴现代机器学习中的知识蒸馏思想，提出一种让学习者探测（probe）同伴模型预测的算法，使学习者能够了解未选择自己的用户。作者从理论上刻画了探测成功的条件，并证明当探测来源足够有信息量时，算法几乎必然收敛到有界全人口风险的驻点。
Result: 理论分析表明，在探测来源足够有信息量（例如已知的市场领导者或多数全局表现良好的同伴）的情况下，算法几乎必然收敛到有界全人口风险的驻点。在 MovieLens、Census 和 Amazon Sentiment 数据集上的半合成实验验证了这些发现。
Conclusion: 作者指出，通过同伴模型探测可以缓解用户选择带来的过度专门化陷阱，但其成功依赖于探测来源的信息量；摘要未提及该方法在探测来源信息不足时的表现或更多局限。

papers.title: MARS: Margin and Semantic-Aware Data Augmentation for Reward Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Reward modeling is central to RLHF, RLAIF, and PPO-based alignment, but its reliability is often limited by scarce and heterogeneous human preference data. In this paper, we introduce MARS (Margin and Semantic-Aware Data Augmentation for Reward Modeling), an adaptive augmentation framework for controlled low-resource reward modeling. MARS allocates more augmentation to low-margin preference pairs and uses semantic-distance-based refinement to improve chosen-rejected contrast before generating synthetic preference samples. Across three preference datasets, two reward-model backbones, and downstream alignment evaluations, MARS improves average RewardBench performance and alignment win rates over uniform augmentation, WoN, and AdaBoost-style baselines. Ablations and independent-judge evaluations suggest that the gains are not solely explained by semantic refinement alone or GPT-4.1 judge coupling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MARS（Margin and Semantic-Aware Data Augmentation for Reward Modeling），一个面向低资源奖励建模的自适应数据增强框架。MARS 对低间隔（low-margin）偏好对分配更多增强，并通过语义距离（semantic-distance）细化 chosen-rejected 对比，再生成合成偏好样本。在三个偏好数据集、两个奖励模型骨干及下游对齐评估上，MARS 相较于均匀增强、WoN 和 AdaBoost 式基线提升了平均 RewardBench 性能与对齐胜率。
Motivation: 奖励建模是 RLHF、RLAIF 和 PPO 对齐的核心，但其可靠性常受稀缺且异质的人类偏好数据限制。
Method: MARS 是一个自适应增强框架：优先对低间隔偏好对进行更多增强，并使用基于语义距离的细化来改善 chosen-rejected 对比，然后再生成合成偏好样本。
Result: 在三个偏好数据集、两个奖励模型骨干以及下游对齐评估中，MARS 的平均 RewardBench 性能和对齐胜率均优于均匀增强、WoN 与 AdaBoost 式基线；消融实验与独立评审者评估表明，收益不能仅由语义细化或 GPT-4.1 评审耦合解释。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MARS 的增益并非单纯来自语义细化或与 GPT-4.1 评审的耦合，说明其自适应增强机制本身对低资源奖励建模有效。

papers.title: STATe-of-Thoughts: Structured Action Templates for Tree-of-Thoughts
papers.abstract_en: Inference-Time-Compute (ITC) methods like Best-of-$n$ and Tree-of-Thoughts are meant to produce output candidates that are both high-quality and diverse, but their use of high-temperature sampling often fails to achieve meaningful output diversity. Moreover, existing ITC methods offer limited control over $\textit{how}$ to perform reasoning, which in turn limits their interpretability. We present $\textbf{STATe-of-Thoughts}$ (STATe), an interpretable ITC method that $\textit{searches}$ over high-level reasoning patterns. STATe branches over discrete and interpretable textual interventions rather than over token-level samples: a $\textit{controller}$ selects actions encoding high-level reasoning choices; a $\textit{generator}$ produces reasoning steps conditioned on those choices; and an $\textit{evaluator}$ scores candidates to guide search. This structured approach yields three main advantages. First, action-guided textual interventions reliably influence LLM generations and produce greater response diversity than temperature-based sampling. Second, in a case study on argument generation, STATe's explicit action sequences capture interpretable features that are highly predictive of output quality. Third, estimating the association between performance and action choices allows us to identify promising yet unexplored regions of the action space and steer generation toward them. STATe is most useful when a task admits multiple solutions and when understanding $\textit{why}$ an output succeeds matters beyond $\textit{whether}$ the output succeeds. Together, these results establish STATe as both a practical framework for diverse and controllable text generation, and as a tool for understanding the reasoning patterns that drive performance.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STATe-of-Thoughts (STATe)，一种可解释的推理时计算 (inference-time compute) 方法，在高级推理模式上进行搜索而非在 token 级别采样。STATe 由控制器、生成器和评估器组成：控制器选择编码高级推理选择的离散动作，生成器基于这些动作产生推理步骤，评估器对候选进行评分以指导搜索。摘要报告该方法比基于温度的采样产生更大的响应多样性，并在议论文生成案例研究中表明显式动作序列能捕捉高度可预测输出质量的可解释特征。
Motivation: 现有推理时计算方法如 Best-of-n 和 Tree-of-Thoughts 虽然旨在生成高质量且多样化的候选，但高温采样往往未能产生有意义的输出多样性，且对推理过程的控制有限，导致可解释性不足。
Method: STATe 在离散且可解释的文本干预（动作）上分支，而不是在 token 级样本上分支。控制器选择编码高层推理选择的动作，生成器在给定这些动作的条件下生成推理步骤，评估器对候选评分以引导搜索过程。
Result: 动作引导的文本干预能可靠地影响 LLM 生成并产生比温度采样更大的响应多样性；在议论文生成案例研究中，显式动作序列捕捉到高度可预测输出质量的可解释特征；通过估计性能与动作选择的关联，可以识别有前景但尚未探索的动作空间区域并引导生成朝向这些区域。
Conclusion: STATe 在任务允许多种解决方案且理解输出为何成功比关注输出是否成功更重要时最为有用，既可作为多样化和可控文本生成的实用框架，也可作为理解驱动性能的推理模式的工具。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Stochastic Parrots or Singing in Harmony? Testing Five Leading LLMs for their Ability to Replicate a Human Survey with Synthetic Data
papers.abstract_en: How well can AI-derived synthetic research data replicate the responses of human participants? An emerging literature has begun to engage with this question, which carries deep implications for organizational research practice. This article presents a comparison between a human-respondent survey of 420 Silicon Valley coders and developers and synthetic survey data designed to simulate real survey takers generated by five leading Generative AI Large Language Models: ChatGPT Thinking 5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5 Pro plus Claude CoWork 1.123, Gemini Advanced 2.5 Pro, Incredible 1.0, and DeepSeek 3.2. Our findings reveal that while AI agents produced technically plausible results that lean more towards replicability and harmonization than assumed, none were able to capture the counterintuitive insights that made the human survey valuable. Moreover, deviations grouped together for all models, leaving the real data as the outlier. Our key finding is that while leading LLMs are increasingly being used to scale, replicate and replace human survey responses in research, these advances only show an increased capacity to parrot conventional wisdom in harmony with each other rather than revealing novel findings. If synthetic respondents are used in future research, we need more replicable validation protocols and reporting standards for when and where synthetic survey data can be used responsibly, a gap that this paper fills. Our results suggest that synthetic survey responses cannot meaningfully model real human social beliefs within organizations, particularly in contexts lacking previously documented evidence. We conclude that synthetic survey-based research should be cast not as a substitute for rigorous survey methods, but as an increasingly reliable pre- or post-fieldwork instrument for identifying societal assumptions, conventional wisdoms, and other expectations about research populations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对比了420名硅谷程序员与开发者的真实调查数据和由五款前沿生成式大语言模型（ChatGPT Thinking 5 Pro、Claude Sonnet 4.5 Pro、Gemini Advanced 2.5 Pro、Incredible 1.0、DeepSeek 3.2）生成的合成调查数据，考察AI合成数据复现人类反应的能力。研究发现，AI代理能产生技术上合理的回答，且比预想中更倾向于可复制与趋同，但没有一个模型能捕获让真实调查具有价值的反直觉洞见；各模型的偏差高度聚集，真实数据反而成为离群点。作者据此认为合成调查无法有意义地建模组织内的真实社会信念，尤其缺乏既有证据背景时，只能作为田野调查前后的辅助工具。
Motivation: 生成式AI正越来越多地被用于扩展、复制甚至替代人类调查回答，但学界缺乏对这些合成数据能否真实复现人类反应的系统验证，这直接影响组织研究的实践基础。
Method: 将420名人类受访者的真实调查数据与五个领先LLM生成的合成调查数据进行系统性对比，从技术合理性、可复现性以及反直觉洞见的保留程度等维度评估AI合成数据的表现。
Result: 所有模型生成的数据在技术上看似合理并且彼此高度趋同，但均无法再现真实调查中的反直觉洞见；偏差在所有模型中成群出现，真实数据在对比中成为离群点。
Conclusion: 合成调查数据不能替代真实调查，也不应被定位为替代品；作者建议将其视为田野前后识别社会假设和常识预期的工具，并呼吁建立更可复制的验证协议和报告标准来规范合成数据的使用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Trust-Based Incentive Mechanisms in Semi-Decentralized Federated Learning Systems
papers.abstract_en: In federated learning (FL), decentralized model training allows multi-ple participants to collaboratively improve a shared machine learning model without exchanging raw data. However, ensuring the integrity and reliability of the system is challenging due to the presence of potentially malicious or faulty nodes that can degrade the model's performance. This paper proposes a novel trust-based incentive mechanism designed to evaluate and reward the quality of contributions in FL systems. By dynamically assessing trust scores based on fac-tors such as data quality, model accuracy, consistency, and contribution fre-quency, the system encourages honest participation and penalizes unreliable or malicious behavior. These trust scores form the basis of an incentive mechanism that rewards high-trust nodes with greater participation opportunities and penal-ties for low-trust participants. We further explore the integration of blockchain technology and smart contracts to automate the trust evaluation and incentive distribution processes, ensuring transparency and decentralization. Our proposed theoretical framework aims to create a more robust, fair, and transparent FL eco-system, reducing the risks posed by untrustworthy participants.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向半去中心化联邦学习（FL）系统，提出一种基于信任的激励机制，通过动态评估参与者的信任分数（依据数据质量、模型精度、一致性及贡献频率）来奖励诚实贡献并惩罚不可靠或恶意行为。作者还探讨利用区块链与智能合约实现信任评估和激励分配的自动化与透明化。摘要将其定位为理论框架，未报告具体实验数据。
Motivation: 联邦学习中可能存在恶意或故障节点，这些节点会降低共享模型性能，而现有机制难以保证参与者贡献的完整性与可靠性，缺乏对参与者可信度的有效评估与奖惩手段。
Method: 提出动态信任评分机制，将数据质量、模型精度、一致性、贡献频率等因素纳入信任分数计算；信任分数构成激励基础，高信任节点获得更多参与机会，低信任节点受到惩罚。同时探索区块链与智能合约来自动化信任评估和激励分发，以提升透明度与去中心化程度。
Result: 摘要未提供数值型实验结果，主要给出理论框架设计，目标是减少不可信参与者带来的风险，构建更稳健、公平、透明的FL生态系统。
Conclusion: 该工作属于理论层面的激励与信任机制设计，强调区块链辅助的自动化与去中心化治理；摘要未涉及实证验证或具体部署场景。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文面向半去中心化联邦学习（FL）系统，提出一种基于信任的激励机制，通过动态评估参与者的信任分数（依据数据质量、模型精度、一致性及贡献频率）来奖励诚实贡献并惩罚不可靠或恶意行为。作者还探讨利用区块链与智能合约实现信任评估和激励分配的自动化与透明化。摘要将其定位为理论框架，未报告具体实验数据。

summary_sections.method: 提出动态信任评分机制，将数据质量、模型精度、一致性、贡献频率等因素纳入信任分数计算；信任分数构成激励基础，高信任节点获得更多参与机会，低信任节点受到惩罚。同时探索区块链与智能合约来自动化信任评估和激励分发，以提升透明度与去中心化程度。

papers.title: PhaseCoder: Microphone Geometry-Agnostic Spatial Audio Understanding for Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Current multimodal LLMs process audio as a mono stream, ignoring the rich spatial information essential for embodied AI. Existing spatial audio models, conversely, are constrained to fixed microphone geometries, preventing deployment across diverse devices. We present PhaseCoder, a transformer-only spatial audio encoder that is agnostic to microphone geometry. PhaseCoder takes raw multichannel audio and microphone coordinates as inputs to perform localization and produces robust spatial embeddings. We demonstrate that Gemma 3n LLM can be fine-tuned to reason over "Spatial Audio Tokens" produced by PhaseCoder. We show our encoder achieves state-of-the-art results on microphone-invariant localization benchmarks and, for the first time, enables an LLM to perform complex spatial reasoning and targeted transcription tasks from an arbitrary microphone array.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhaseCoder，一种与麦克风几何形状无关（microphone geometry-agnostic）的纯 Transformer 空间音频编码器。它输入原始多声道音频和麦克风坐标，输出空间嵌入，并让 Gemma 3n 多模态 LLM 通过微调能够在任意麦克风阵列上进行空间推理和定向转录任务。摘要报告该方法在麦克风不变的定位基准上取得最优结果。
Motivation: 当前多模态 LLM 将音频当作单声道流处理，忽视对具身智能至关重要的空间信息；而现有空间音频模型受限于固定的麦克风几何结构，难以部署到多种设备上。
Method: PhaseCoder 是纯 Transformer 空间音频编码器，以原始多声道音频与麦克风坐标为输入，执行定位并生成空间嵌入；随后将生成的 "Spatial Audio Tokens" 用于微调 Gemma 3n LLM，使其能进行空间理解与定向转录。
Result: 摘要称该编码器在麦克风不变的定位基准（microphone-invariant localization benchmarks）上达到最优结果，并首次让 LLM 能在任意麦克风阵列上完成复杂空间推理和定向转录任务。
Conclusion: 作者认为消除对固定麦克风几何结构的依赖，并用空间音频 token 使 LLM 具备空间推理能力，是推进多模态 LLM 空间音频理解的有效路径。

papers.title: CUDA-L2: Surpassing cuBLAS Performance for Matrix Multiplication through Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose CUDA-L2, a system that combines large language models (LLMs) and reinforcement learning (RL) to automatically optimize Half-precision General Matrix Multiply (HGEMM) CUDA kernels. Using CUDA execution speed as the RL reward, CUDA-L2 automatically optimizes HGEMM kernels across 1,000 configurations. CUDA-L2 systematically outperforms major matmul baselines to date, from the widely-used torch.matmul to state-of-the-art Nvidia's closed-source libraries, i.e., cuBLAS, cuBLASLt. In offline mode, where kernels are executed consecutively without time intervals, CUDA-L2 yields +22.0% over torch.matmul on average; +19.2% over cuBLAS using the optimal layout configuration (normal-normal NN and transposed-normal TN); +16.8% over cuBLASLt-heuristic, which queries cuBLASLt library and selects the algorithm based on the heuristic's suggestion; and +11.4% over the most competitive cuBLASLt-AutoTuning model, which selects the fastest algorithm from up to 100 candidates from cuBLASLt's suggestions. In server mode, where kernels are executed at random intervals simulating real-time inference, the speedups further increase to +28.7%, +26.0%, +22.4%, and +15.9% for torch.matmul, cuBLAS, cuBLASLt-heuristic, and cuBLASLt-AutoTuning respectively. CUDA-L2 shows that even the most performance-critical, heavily-optimized kernels like HGEMM can be improved through LLM-guided RL automation by systematically exploring configuration spaces at scales impractical for humans. Project and code can be found at github.com/ornith-ai/CUDA-L2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CUDA-L2，一个结合大语言模型 (LLM) 与强化学习 (RL) 的系统，以 CUDA 执行速度作为奖励，在约 1000 种配置上自动优化半精度通用矩阵乘法 (HGEMM) CUDA 内核。摘要报告其在离线模式下较 torch.matmul 平均提升 22.0%，较 cuBLAS 最优布局配置提升 19.2%，较 cuBLASLt-heuristic 提升 16.8%，较最强的 cuBLASLt-AutoTuning 提升 11.4%；在模拟实时推理的服务器模式下提升分别增至 28.7%、26.0%、22.4% 与 15.9%。作者认为这显示即使 HGEMM 这类性能关键且高度优化的内核，也可通过 LLM 引导的 RL 自动化进一步改进。
Motivation: HGEMM 等矩阵乘法内核已被深度手工优化，但配置空间规模巨大，人工难以系统探索；作者希望用自动化方法在这些空间中寻找超越现有闭源库如 cuBLAS、cuBLASLt 的实现。
Method: CUDA-L2 将 LLM 与强化学习结合，直接以 CUDA 内核执行速度作为 RL 奖励信号，在 1000 种配置上自动搜索并优化 HGEMM CUDA 内核，并在离线连续执行与服务器随机间隔执行两种模式下评估。
Result: 离线模式下，相对 torch.matmul、cuBLAS（最佳 NN/TN 布局）、cuBLASLt-heuristic、cuBLASLt-AutoTuning 的平均加速分别为 +22.0%、+19.2%、+16.8%、+11.4%；服务器模式下加速进一步升至 +28.7%、+26.0%、+22.4%、+15.9%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LLM 引导的强化学习能以人工不可行的规模系统探索配置空间，从而改进最严苛优化的 HGEMM 内核，并提供项目代码链接。

papers.title: Trajectory-guided discharge stratification for heart failure using short-context electronic health record sequence modeling
papers.abstract_en: Purpose: Heart failure (HF) discharge planning depends on identifying patients at risk of deterioration or death, yet accurate prediction from routinely collected electronic health records (EHRs) remains challenging. Methods: We develop trajectory-guided discharge stratification for heart failure (TGDS-HF), a methodology that reads the patient in-hospital trajectory of diagnoses, vital signs, laboratories, medications, and procedures end-to-end with a compact short-context autoregressive Transformer, and uses it to stratify one-year risks of clinical instability (a rehospitalization phenotype) or mortality for discharge care. We instantiate TGDS-HF on a Swedish HF cohort (N = 42,820) to predict one-year clinical instability or mortality at the initial HF diagnosis in-hospital. TGDS-HF has three components: category-level tokenization, recency-weighted temporal representation, and sequence model configuration. We run ablations on these components to show the effectiveness of TGDS-HF. Results: Against traditional eXtreme gradient boosting machine (XGBoost) and bidirectional encoder representations from Transformers (BERT)-based EHR sequence-modeling baselines, TGDS-HF (Llama backbone) achieved area under the precision-recall curves (AUPRCs) with 95% confidence intervals of 0.555 (0.535-0.575) and 0.574 (0.550-0.599) across the two tasks at the method default, with robust calibration. A task-specific refinement using daily aggregation of repeated continuous events improves the mortality task to 0.582 (0.558-0.608). Further, TGDS-HF maintains strong performance under reduced clinical concept availability and limited training data. Conclusion: Combined predictions of instability and mortality from TGDS-HF may support personalized discharge planning, ranging from follow-up in primary care to specialist-led management and, when appropriate, palliative care.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TGDS-HF，一种基于短上下文自回归 Transformer 的心力衰竭出院分层方法，端到端读取患者住院期间的诊断、生命体征、实验室、药物和操作轨迹，用于预测一年内临床不稳定或死亡风险。方法在瑞典心力衰竭队列（N=42,820）上验证，相比 XGBoost 和 BERT 类序列建模基线取得更高 AUPRC，并保持稳健校准。
Motivation: 心力衰竭出院规划依赖识别有恶化或死亡风险的患者，但利用常规电子健康记录（EHR）进行准确预测仍然具有挑战性。
Method: TGDS-HF 包含三个组件：类别级分词（category-level tokenization）、近期加权时间表示（recency-weighted temporal representation）和序列模型配置；使用紧凑的短上下文自回归 Transformer 建模住院轨迹，并采用 Llama 作为骨干网络。
Result: 在默认设置下，TGDS-HF 在两个任务上的 AUPRC（95% 置信区间）分别为 0.555（0.535–0.575）和 0.574（0.550–0.599）；针对每日聚合重复连续事件的任务特定细化将死亡预测提升至 0.582（0.558–0.608）。在减少临床概念可用性和有限训练数据下仍保持较强性能。
Conclusion: TGDS-HF 对不稳定和死亡风险的联合预测可能支持个性化出院规划，涵盖初级保健随访、专科主导管理以及适当时的姑息治疗。

papers.title: MermaidSeqBench: An Evaluation Benchmark for NL-to-Mermaid Sequence Diagram Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown great promise in generating structured diagrams from natural language descriptions, particularly Mermaid sequence diagrams for software engineering. However, the lack of existing benchmarks to assess the LLM's correctness on this task hinders rigorous, systematic evaluation and principled comparison of model capabilities on this task. To address this shortcoming, we introduce MermaidSeqBench, a human-verified and synthetically extended benchmark for assessing LLM capabilities in generating Mermaid sequence diagrams from natural language prompts. The benchmark consists of 132 samples developed via a hybrid methodology of human-verified flows, LLM-based augmentation, and rule-based expansion. The evaluation uses an LLM-as-a-judge model to assess generation across various fine-grained metrics such as syntax correctness, activation handling, error handling, and practical usability. To demonstrate the effectiveness and flexibility of our benchmark, we perform initial evaluations on numerous state-of-the-art LLMs with multiple LLM judges which reveal significant capability gaps across models and evaluation modes. MermaidSeqBench provides a foundation for evaluating structured diagram generation and advances the scientific understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations in structured generation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MermaidSeqBench，一个用于评估大语言模型从自然语言生成 Mermaid 时序图（sequence diagram）能力的基准。基准包含 132 个样本，采用人工验证、LLM 增强和规则扩展的混合方法构建，并使用 LLM-as-a-judge 在语法正确性、激活处理、错误处理和实用可用性等细粒度指标上评估生成质量。初步评估多个 SOTA LLM 和多种评判模式，揭示模型间及评估模式间存在显著能力差距。
Motivation: 现有工作缺乏系统评估 LLM 从自然语言生成 Mermaid 时序图正确性的基准，阻碍了该任务的严谨评估与模型能力的可比性研究。
Method: 提出混合构建流程：人工验证的流程、LLM 增强与规则扩展相结合，得到 132 个样本的基准；评估采用 LLM-as-a-judge 模型，从语法正确性、激活处理、错误处理和实际可用性等维度进行细粒度评判。
Result: 摘要报告对多个 SOTA LLM 进行初步评估，并采用多个 LLM 评判器，结果表明不同模型和评估模式下存在显著能力差距，验证了基准的有效性和灵活性。
Conclusion: MermaidSeqBench 为结构化图表生成评估提供基础，有助于增进对 LLM 在结构化生成任务中能力与局限的科学理解。

papers.title: nnMIL: A generalizable multiple instance learning framework for computational pathology
papers.abstract_en: Computational pathology holds substantial promise for improving diagnosis and guiding treatment decisions. Recent pathology foundation models enable the extraction of rich patch-level representations from large-scale whole-slide images (WSIs), but current approaches for aggregating these features into slide-level predictions remain constrained by design limitations that hinder generalizability and reliability. Here we present nnMIL, a simple yet broadly applicable multiple-instance learning framework that connects patch-level foundation models to robust slide-level clinical prediction. nnMIL introduces random sampling at both the patch and feature levels, enabling large-batch optimization, task-aware sampling strategies, and efficient and scalable training across datasets and model architectures. A lightweight aggregator performs sliding-window inference to generate ensemble slide-level predictions and supports principled uncertainty estimation. Across 40,000 WSIs encompassing 35 clinical tasks and four pathology foundation models, nnMIL consistently outperformed existing MIL methods for disease diagnosis, histologic subtyping, molecular biomarker detection, and pan-cancer prognosis prediction. It further demonstrated strong cross-model generalization, reliable uncertainty quantification, and robust survival stratification in multiple external cohorts. In conclusion, nnMIL offers a practical and generalizable solution for translating pathology foundation models into clinically meaningful predictions, advancing the development and deployment of reliable AI systems in real-world settings.
papers.comment: In this version, we fixed some issues and updated some results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 nnMIL，一个面向计算病理学的通用多实例学习 (multiple instance learning) 框架，用于将 patch 级病理基础模型特征聚合为稳健的 slide 级临床预测。该框架在 patch 和特征层面引入随机采样以支持大批量优化与任务感知采样，并用轻量聚合器通过滑窗推理生成集成预测和不确定性估计。作者在 40,000 张全切片图像 (WSI)、35 项临床任务和四个病理基础模型上报告了优于现有 MIL 方法的结果，并在外部队列中验证了跨模型泛化、不确定性量化与生存分层。
Motivation: 现有将 patch 级特征聚合为 slide 级预测的方法受设计局限影响，泛化性和可靠性不足，限制了病理基础模型向临床应用的转化。
Method: nnMIL 在 patch 和特征两个层面进行随机采样，从而支持大批量优化、任务感知采样以及跨数据集和模型架构的高效可扩展训练；轻量聚合器采用滑窗推理生成集成式 slide 级预测，并支持有原则的不确定性估计。
Result: 在覆盖 40,000 张 WSI、35 项临床任务和四个病理基础模型的评估中，nnMIL 在疾病诊断、组织学亚型分型、分子生物标志物检测和泛癌预后预测上一致优于现有 MIL 方法；多个外部队列中展现出强跨模型泛化、可靠不确定性量化以及稳健的生存分层。
Conclusion: 作者认为 nnMIL 为将病理基础模型转化为有临床意义的预测提供了实用且可泛化的解决方案，有助于推进可靠 AI 系统在真实世界场景中的开发与部署。

papers.title: A Lexical Analysis of online Reviews on Human-AI Interactions
papers.abstract_en: This study focuses on understanding the complex dynamics between humans and AI systems by analyzing user reviews. While previous research has explored various aspects of human-AI interaction, such as user perceptions and ethical considerations, there remains a gap in understanding the specific concerns and challenges users face. By using a lexical approach to analyze 55,968 online reviews from G2.com, Producthunt.com, and Trustpilot.com, this preliminary research aims to analyze human-AI interaction. Initial results from factor analysis reveal key factors influencing these interactions. The study aims to provide deeper insights into these factors through content analysis, contributing to the development of more user-centric AI systems. The findings are expected to enhance our understanding of human-AI interaction and inform future AI technology and user experience improvements.
papers.journal_ref: Human Factors in Design, Engineering, and Computing, Vol. 159, pp. 558-568, 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过词法分析（lexical approach）研究了人类与AI系统交互中的复杂动态，数据来源为G2.com、Producthunt.com和Trustpilot.com上的55,968条在线评论。因子分析初步揭示了影响人机交互的关键因素，作者计划进一步通过内容分析深入理解这些因素，以帮助开发更以用户为中心的AI系统。
Motivation: 以往研究已涉及人机交互中的用户感知与伦理问题，但对用户在实际使用中面临的具体关切和挑战仍缺乏理解，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 采用词法分析方法处理来自三个平台的55,968条在线评论，结合因子分析（factor analysis）识别关键因素，并计划通过内容分析进行深入解读。
Result: 初步因子分析结果显示存在影响人机交互的关键因素；摘要未报告具体的量化指标或因子细节，内容分析结果也未给出。
Conclusion: 作者预期研究结果能增强对人机交互的理解，并为未来AI技术与用户体验改进提供参考；本研究为初步性工作，篇幅为10页。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: On the Anisotropy of Score-Based Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the role of network architecture in shaping the inductive biases of modern score-based generative models. To this end, we introduce the Score Anisotropy Directions (SADs), architecture-dependent directions that reveal how different networks preferentially capture data structure. Our analysis suggests that SADs form adaptive bases aligned with the architecture's output geometry, providing a principled way to predict generalization ability in score models prior to training. Through both synthetic data and standard image benchmarks, we demonstrate that SADs reliably capture fine-grained model behavior and correlate with downstream performance, as measured by Wasserstein metrics. Our work offers a new lens for explaining and predicting directional biases of generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究网络架构如何塑造基于分数的生成模型 (score-based generative models) 的归纳偏置，提出 Score Anisotropy Directions (SADs) 这一依赖于架构的方向概念。作者认为 SADs 形成与架构输出几何对齐的自适应基，可在训练前预测分数模型的泛化能力，并在合成数据和图像基准上验证其与 Wasserstein 度量下的下游性能相关。
Motivation: 现有基于分数的生成模型缺少对网络架构如何影响其方向性归纳偏置的系统理解，作者希望提供一种在训练前即可解释和预测模型方向性偏差的原则性框架。
Method: 引入 Score Anisotropy Directions (SADs)，即依赖特定架构的方向，用以揭示不同网络如何优先捕获数据结构，并利用这些方向作为预测分数模型泛化能力的分析工具。
Result: 在合成数据和标准图像基准上的实验表明，SADs 能可靠捕获细粒度的模型行为，并与 Wasserstein 度量衡量的下游性能相关。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为解释和预测生成模型的方向性偏置提供了新视角，但摘要未讨论模型规模、任务范围等局限性。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Worst-Case Distance-Aware Error Bounds for Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Safety-critical applications of machine learning require uncertainty estimates that support reliable worst-case analysis. Neural networks (NNs) provide expressive function approximation, while Gaussian processes (GPs) offer principled probabilistic uncertainty, but both face limitations in this setting: most modern neural architectures lack tractable worst-case error bounds, and Gaussian processes become computationally expensive at scale. For uncertainty to be interpretable, a central requirement is distance-awareness: that is, uncertainty increases with the distance between a test input and the nearest relevant training data. We present a general framework for worst-case distance-aware error bounds for NNs that combine dense layers with spline-based components. Our approach establishes error bounds that are both distance-aware, reflecting proximity of a test point to its nearest training data, and worst-case, providing deterministic guarantees under known Lipschitz constraints rather than probabilistic assumptions. Our algorithm, K-DAREK (Distance-Aware Error for Kurkova-Kolmogorov Networks), provides efficient and interpretable uncertainty quantification for NNs. K-DAREK is about four times faster and ten times more computationally efficient than an ensemble of KANs, 8.6 times more scalable than GP, eliminates up to 8.2% error-bound violation rate observed in DAREK, and reduces the average collision rate from 1.8% to 1.1% in the multi-agent safe control experiment. On high-dimensional real-world regression tasks (e.g., Real Estate Valuation), K-DAREK preserves distance-aware error bounds and achieves zero coverage violations, addressing the overgeneralization and inducing-point-coverage limitations exhibited by SNGP and DUE, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为结合稠密层与样条组件（spline-based components）的神经网络提出一种通用的最坏情况距离感知误差界框架。作者提出的算法K-DAREK（Distance-Aware Error for Kurkova-Kolmogorov Networks）在已知Lipschitz约束下提供确定性最坏情况保证，同时使不确定性随测试点与最近训练数据的距离增大而增大。摘要报告K-DAREK比KAN集成快约4倍、计算效率高10倍，比GP可扩展性高8.6倍，消除了DAREK中高达8.2%的误差界违反率，并在多智能体安全控制实验中将平均碰撞率从1.8%降到1.1%。
Motivation: 安全关键的机器学习应用需要支持可靠最坏情况分析的不确定性估计。神经网络表达力强但大多数现代架构缺乏可处理的误差界，高斯过程具有原则性的概率不确定性但规模扩展昂贵；此外，不确定性可解释性要求距离感知（distance-awareness），即不确定性随测试输入与最近训练数据距离增大而增大。
Method: 提出一个通用框架，为结合稠密层与样条组件的神经网络建立距离感知且最坏情况的误差界；具体算法K-DAREK在已知Lipschitz约束下给出确定性保证而非概率假设，从而提供高效且可解释的不确定性量化。
Result: K-DAREK比KAN集成快约4倍、计算效率高10倍，比GP可扩展性高8.6倍；消除了DAREK中高达8.2%的误差界违反率，并在多智能体安全控制实验中将平均碰撞率从1.8%降至1.1%。在高维真实回归任务（如房地产估值）上保持距离感知误差界并实现零覆盖违反，解决了SNGP的过度泛化（overgeneralization）与DUE的诱导点覆盖（inducing-point-coverage）局限。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过已知Lipschitz约束提供确定性、距离感知的最坏情况误差界，为神经网络不确定性量化提供了比高斯过程更可扩展且保持可解释性的方案；同时指出其在高维真实回归中解决了SNGP和DUE各自的覆盖与泛化问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dynamic Object Masks as Goal Representations for Visual Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) offers a unified way to pursue diverse tasks, yet most existing methods rely on state- or position-based goal representations that are unavailable in real-world robotics. Robots operating in warehouses, agriculture, or laboratory environments rarely have access to privileged goal states, object positions, or future observations, limiting the practicality of current GCRL approaches. We propose a dynamic mask-based goal representation that provides simple, object-agnostic visual cues for vision-based navigation and manipulation. At each timestep, an image-based goal detector produces a goal mask using standard image processing, task-specific object recognizers, or pretrained detectors such as Detic or Grounding DINO. These masks specify the spatial target without requiring privileged goal states, enabling broad applicability and strong generalization to unseen objects. Our method improves stability and sample efficiency in GCRL, achieving a 99% success rate in reaching both training and novel objects with Franka and UR10e robotic arms and faster learning in simulated navigation. We further demonstrate learning from scratch and sim-to-real transfer on both robotic arms, highlighting the effectiveness of our approach for real-world RL tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/fahimfss/GCRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种动态遮罩目标表示（dynamic mask-based goal representation），用于视觉目标条件强化学习（goal-conditioned reinforcement learning, GCRL）。该方法在每一步用图像目标检测器生成目标遮罩，无需特权目标状态，并在 Franka 和 UR10e 机械臂上达到 99% 的成功率，同时支持从零学习和 sim-to-real 迁移。摘要称其能提升 GCRL 的稳定性和样本效率，并泛化到未见物体。
Motivation: 现有 GCRL 方法通常依赖基于状态或位置的目标表示，但现实机器人（如仓库、农业、实验室场景）很难获得特权目标状态、物体位置或未来观测，限制了方法的实用性。
Method: 以动态遮罩作为目标表示：每时间步由一个基于图像的目标检测器生成目标遮罩，来源包括标准图像处理、任务相关物体识别器或预训练检测器（如 Detic、Grounding DINO）。遮罩指定空间目标，不依赖特权状态，适用于视觉导航与操作任务。
Result: 摘要报告在 Franka 和 UR10e 机械臂上，对训练物体和新物体均达到 99% 的成功率，并在模拟导航中学习速度更快；还展示了两个机械臂从零学习以及 sim-to-real 迁移的效果。
Conclusion: 动态遮罩提供简单、物体无关（object-agnostic）的视觉目标线索，能够泛化到未见物体，并为现实世界 RL 任务提供可行方案。代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI Playing Business Games: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Managerial Decision-Making in Dynamic Simulations
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of LLMs sparked significant interest in their potential to augment or automate managerial functions. One of the most recent trends in AI benchmarking is performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) over longer time horizons. While LLMs excel at tasks involving natural language and pattern recognition, their capabilities in multi-step, strategic business decision-making remain largely unexplored. Few studies demonstrated how results can be different from benchmarks in short-term tasks, as Vending-Bench revealed. Meanwhile, there is a shortage of alternative benchmarks for long-term coherence. This research analyses a novel benchmark using a business game for the decision making in business. The research contributes to the recent literature on AI by proposing a reproducible, open-access management simulator to the research community for LLM benchmarking. This novel framework is used for evaluating the performance of five leading LLMs available in free online interface: Gemini, ChatGPT, Meta AI, Mistral AI, and Grok. LLM makes decisions for a simulated retail company. A dynamic, month-by-month management simulation provides transparently in spreadsheet model as experimental environment. In each of twelve months, the LLMs are provided with a structured prompt containing a full business report from the previous period and are tasked with making key strategic decisions: pricing, order size, marketing budget, hiring, dismissal, loans, training expense, R&D expense, sales forecast, income forecast The methodology is designed to compare the LLMs on quantitative metrics: profit, revenue, and market share, and other KPIs. LLM decisions are analyzed in their strategic coherence, adaptability to market changes, and the rationale provided for their decisions. This approach allows to move beyond simple performance metrics for assessment of the long-term decision-making.

papers.title: Autonomous Learning From Success and Failure: Goal-Conditioned Supervised Learning with Negative Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Learning from reward functions and imitation learning of demonstrations are the two principal approaches for training autonomous systems that interact with an environment through action and observation. Both, however, require human specification for each behaviour to be acquired, a problem for long-lived self-adaptive systems whose goals and operating conditions cannot be fully anticipated at design time. Recently, Goal-Conditioned Supervised Learning (GCSL) through self-imitation has been proposed as a self-supervised alternative: by strategically relabelling goals, agents can derive policy insights from their own experiences. Despite its successes, this framework presents two notable limitations: (1) learning exclusively from self-generated experiences can exacerbate the agents' inherent biases; (2) the relabelling strategy allows agents to focus solely on successful outcomes, precluding them from learning from their mistakes. To address these issues, we propose GCSL with Negative Feedback (GCSL-NF), which evaluates each trajectory twice: positively with respect to relabelled goals, and correctively with respect to the goal originally intended. The corrective target comes from a similarity function learned contrastively from trajectory-induced neighbourhood relations, so that neither a reward function nor a geometric distance needs to be specified. Our experiments show that GCSL-NF overcomes limitations imposed by agents' initial biases, increasingly benefits from negative feedback as learning progresses, and matches or surpasses GCSL- and HER-based methods. By reducing reliance on prespecified reward functions, the proposed approach is particularly relevant for self-adaptive autonomous systems, where adaptation objectives may be diverse, changing, or difficult to engineer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GCSL with Negative Feedback (GCSL-NF)，一种在目标条件监督学习 (GCSL) 框架上加入负反馈的自监督方法。每条轨迹被评估两次：对重标注目标做正向评估，对原始意图目标做纠正性评估，其中纠正目标来自对比学习得到的相似函数，无需指定奖励函数或几何距离。实验表明 GCSL-NF 能克服智能体初始偏差带来的限制，随学习进展越来越受益于负反馈，并匹配或超越 GCSL 与 HER 类方法。
Motivation: GCSL 通过自模仿和重标注目标从自身经验中学习，但存在两个局限：只从自生成经验学习会放大智能体的固有偏差；重标注策略只关注成功结果，使智能体无法从错误中学习。
Method: 提出 GCSL-NF，对每条轨迹分别依据重标注目标给出正反馈、依据原始意图目标给出纠正性反馈；纠正目标由对比学习 (contrastive learning) 从轨迹诱导的邻域关系中学得的相似函数产生，因此无需人工指定奖励函数或几何距离。
Result: 实验显示 GCSL-NF 能克服初始偏差限制，随着训练进行越来越能从负反馈中获益，并在匹配或超越基于 GCSL 和 HER 的方法。
Conclusion: 该方法减少了对预定义奖励函数的依赖，适合适应目标多样、变化或难以工程化的自适应性自主系统。

papers.title: CRINN: Contrastive Reinforcement Learning for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
papers.abstract_en: Approximate nearest-neighbor search (ANNS) algorithms have become increasingly critical for recent AI applications, particularly in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent-based LLM applications. In this paper, we present CRINN, a new paradigm for ANNS algorithms. CRINN treats ANNS optimization as a reinforcement learning problem where execution speed serves as the reward signal. This approach enables the automatic generation of progressively faster ANNS implementations while maintaining accuracy constraints. Our experimental evaluation demonstrates CRINN's effectiveness across six widely-used NNS benchmark datasets. When compared against state-of-the-art open-source ANNS algorithms, CRINN achieves best performance on three of them (GIST-960-Euclidean, MNIST-784-Euclidean, and GloVe-25-angular), and tied for first place on two of them (SIFT-128-Euclidean and GloVe-25-angular). The implications of CRINN's success reach well beyond ANNS optimization: It validates that LLMs augmented with reinforcement learning can function as an effective tool for automating sophisticated algorithmic optimizations that demand specialized knowledge and labor-intensive manual refinement. Code can be found at https://github.com/ornith-ai/CRINN
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CRINN，一种将近似最近邻搜索 (ANNS) 优化建模为强化学习问题的新范式，以执行速度作为奖励信号，在满足精度约束的前提下自动生成更快的 ANNS 实现。实验在六个常用 NNS 基准数据集上对比开源 SOTA 算法，CRINN 在其中三个上取得最佳，两个上并列第一。作者认为该结果验证了强化学习增强的 LLM 可以自动化需要专业知识与大量人工调优的算法优化工作。
Motivation: ANNS 在检索增强生成 (RAG) 和 agent 型 LLM 应用中愈发关键，但传统 ANNS 优化依赖专门知识与大量人工精细调优。本文将 ANNS 优化重新表述为强化学习问题，以执行速度作为奖励，从而自动搜索更快的实现。
Method: CRINN 将 ANNS 优化视为强化学习问题，用执行速度 (execution speed) 作为 reward signal，在维持精度约束的同时逐步生成更快的 ANNS 实现；其成功还表明该方法背后可结合 LLM 与强化学习来驱动算法自动优化。
Result: 在六个广泛使用的 NNS 基准数据集上，CRINN 相比于现有开源 SOTA ANNS 算法，在 GIST-960-Euclidean、MNIST-784-Euclidean 与 GloVe-25-angular 上取得最佳性能，并在 SIFT-128-Euclidean 与 GloVe-25-angular 上并列第一。
Conclusion: 作者强调 CRINN 的意义超出 ANNS 本身：它表明强化学习增强的 LLM 能够成为自动化复杂算法优化的有效工具，此类优化通常需要专业知识且依赖人工打磨；代码已开源。
Relevance: 0
